00:42:25,500 --> 00:42:27,000
Nice and easy, honey.

426
00:42:27,100 --> 00:42:29,800
-Come here.
-All right, come on, baby.

427
00:42:30,100 --> 00:42:32,900
What's up, big man? Where the party at?

428
00:42:33,200 --> 00:42:35,100
Ain't no party up in here, girl.

429
00:42:35,200 --> 00:42:39,200
We thought Darnell and everybody
was gonna get their smoke on.

430
00:42:39,500 --> 00:42:41,400
Don't you know Darnell?

431
00:42:41,800 --> 00:42:43,900
What's this good boy's name?

432
00:42:44,300 --> 00:42:45,500
Hey, boy.

433
00:42:46,300 --> 00:42:47,900
How you doing today?

434
00:42:48,000 --> 00:42:50,200
You been good? This a good boy.

435
00:42:51,100 --> 00:42:54,300
-There it is.
-Car will be running.

436
00:42:59,400 --> 00:43:01,000
What is it, Lamar?

437
00:43:09,300 --> 00:43:11,300
No need to prolong this.

438
00:43:12,200 --> 00:43:13,700
No, we got time.

439
00:43:14,100 --> 00:43:16,800
-You kill my man?
-No, he's resting.

440
00:43:20,700 --> 00:43:24,900
-I'm saying, ain't you wanna know?
-Not particularly.

441
00:43:26,100 --> 00:43:29,200
About a year ago, a boy name Brandon got
got here in Baltimore.

442
00:43:29,300 --> 00:43:31,700
Stuck and burned before he passed.

443
00:43:32,400 --> 00:43:35,400
-The game is the game.
-Indeed.

444
00:43:36,400 --> 00:43:38,200
See, that boy was beautiful.

445
00:43:38,400 --> 00:43:40,900
Wasn't no need for y'all to do him
the way y'all did.

446
00:43:41,000 --> 00:43:42,400
You feel me?

447
00:43:42,600 --> 00:43:45,000
-A year, you say?
-About that.

448
00:43:48,100 --> 00:43:50,600
You've got some wrong information.

449
00:43:51,100 --> 00:43:53,000
Man, you lying to live.

450
00:43:53,800 --> 00:43:55,800
I'm at peace with my God.

451
00:43:57,000 --> 00:43:58,600
Do what you will.

452
00:44:16,700 --> 00:44:18,100
So you know?

453
00:44:19,100 --> 00:44:22,400
What happened to your boy,
it's not my style.

454
00:44:28,600 --> 00:44:33,000
The way you bleeding out your back,
looks like that bullet bore clean through.

455
00:44:34,600 --> 00:44:37,000
9 mm at close range will do that.

456
00:44:47,300 --> 00:44:49,500
Emergency. Do you need police
or ambulance?

457
00:44:49,600 --> 00:44:52,400
I wanna report a shooting
over here at the new motel.

458
00:44:52,500 --> 00:44:55,800
-On North Avenue. Room 221.
-Sir?

459
00:45:29,700 --> 00:45:31,300
My pal, Beatrice.

460
00:45:32,600 --> 00:45:36,400
What, you gonna run me in again?
Isn't that like double jeopardy or some shit?

461
00:45:36,500 --> 00:45:38,300
Stop it, just stop it.

462
00:45:41,500 --> 00:45:43,800
-Talk to me.
-And say what?

463
00:45:49,200 --> 00:45:51,700
I'm sitting here trying to figure it out myself.

464
00:45:51,800 --> 00:45:53,900
It didn't happen overnight.

465
00:46:04,200 --> 00:46:05,900
I knew I was wrong.

466
00:46:07,700 --> 00:46:11,100
But in my head, I thought I was wrong
for the right reasons, you know?

467
00:46:11,200 --> 00:46:13,700
There are different kinds of wrong.

468
00:46:17,300 --> 00:46:19,400
What're you doing here, Bea?

469
00:46:21,300 --> 00:46:24,700
I'd like you to come in. Not in cuffs.

470
00:46:26,100 --> 00:46:28,100
Because you want to.

471
00:46:29,600 --> 00:46:31,800
I'm opening a door here, Frank.

472
00:46:41,200 --> 00:46:43,400
I can't promise you anything.

473
00:46:45,100 --> 00:46:47,700
Just come in. We'll start from there.

474
00:46:53,500 --> 00:46:56,400
You're better than them you got in bed with.

475
00:47:06,400 --> 00:47:10,100
-Our man Vondopoulos didn't come home?
-Maybe he got lucky.

476
00:47:13,400 --> 00:47:15,000
Maybe we didn't.

477
00:47:16,700 --> 00:47:20,400
You think he ditched the Benz
because he picked up the tail?

478
00:47:28,800 --> 00:47:31,000
Nicky from the docks.

479
00:47:34,700 --> 00:47:37,500
If you hadn't called last night,
I'd have never found you.

480
00:47:37,600 --> 00:47:39,400
Relax, Niko, come on.

481
00:47:40,700 --> 00:47:43,100
It's like I told you on the phone.

482
00:47:43,300 --> 00:47:46,400
It is going to be all right.
We can make it all right.

483
00:47:46,500 --> 00:47:49,100
I should have never gone down the road
with you people.

484
00:47:49,200 --> 00:47:53,100
Come on.
You tried to make something of yourself.

485
00:47:53,300 --> 00:47:55,300
There's no harm in that.

486
00:47:55,700 --> 00:47:57,800
And you still have friends.

487
00:47:58,100 --> 00:47:59,500
I'm busted.

488
00:48:00,800 --> 00:48:04,800
So is my uncle and the whole fucking union.
And Ziggy?

489
00:48:06,400 --> 00:48:08,700
-Christ!
-We will be a friend to him, too.

490
00:48:08,800 --> 00:48:12,200
Nothing your people can do about that.
Ziggy's done.

491
00:48:13,800 --> 00:48:17,300
Nothing is done, Niko. Nothing.

492
00:48:19,100 --> 00:48:20,300
Take a look.

493
00:48:25,400 --> 00:48:27,200
That's not your name.

494
00:48:28,100 --> 00:48:30,100
Many names, many passports.

495
00:48:32,600 --> 00:48:34,400
We can do many things.

496
00:48:40,400 --> 00:48:42,400
What can you do for Ziggy?

497
00:48:46,500 --> 00:48:48,300
We ask only loyalty.

498
00:49:02,300 --> 00:49:06,000
Why do they need sticks?
Can't they kick it with their feet?

499
00:49:07,700 --> 00:49:11,000
She asked me straight-up to come in,
so I'm here.

500
00:49:11,500 --> 00:49:14,400
First, we need to know
what you're looking for.

501
00:49:14,500 --> 00:49:17,300
We don't want any misunderstandings
later on.

502
00:49:17,400 --> 00:49:21,800
I'm just looking for, you know,
some help with my son.

503
00:49:22,700 --> 00:49:26,500
-He can't jail where they got him.
-We move him to a county facility.

504
00:49:28,200 --> 00:49:31,700
-What about my nephew?
-He gets arrested and charged.

505
00:49:31,800 --> 00:49:34,300
But for his cooperation and yours...

506
00:49:35,200 --> 00:49:37,700
we can live with straight probation.

507
00:49:39,800 --> 00:49:42,600
But what we can and cannot do
for you and your family...

508
00:49:42,700 --> 00:49:46,800
-depends on the level of your cooperation.
-You mean, how much I give you?

509
00:49:48,200 --> 00:49:49,900
I got dirt on all of them.

510
00:49:50,700 --> 00:49:54,400
I'll put myself in, too. Whatever you need.
Anything but the union.

511
00:49:54,500 --> 00:49:58,300
I ain't putting in no union men.
I'll give you them dead girls in the can.

512
00:49:58,400 --> 00:50:00,700
I'll give you The Greek,
all them sons of bitches...

513
00:50:00,800 --> 00:50:04,100
just to have it off my chest.
Just look to my son and my nephew.

514
00:50:04,300 --> 00:50:06,700
Mr. Sobotka, at this point
I have to advise you...

515
00:50:06,800 --> 00:50:09,200
you need to retain
the services of an attorney.

516
00:50:09,300 --> 00:50:10,600
We're not gonna do this now?

517
00:50:10,700 --> 00:50:12,600
You need to have a lawyer
present in the room.

518
00:50:12,800 --> 00:50:16,500
You have that, we can make this happen
first thing tomorrow.

519
00:50:25,300 --> 00:50:27,800
Mr. Sobotka, I gotta ask.

520
00:50:28,300 --> 00:50:30,800
Why did you stop using your cell phone?

521
00:50:30,900 --> 00:50:34,600
You guys flagged it.
You think I didn't know?

522
00:52:00,400 --> 00:52:02,000
Under the bridge?

523
00:52:03,000 --> 00:52:06,800
It's out in the open.
I guess the cops can't bug it or nothing.

524
00:52:06,900 --> 00:52:09,300
These guys,
they got a big operation to protect.

525
00:52:09,400 --> 00:52:11,000
They're global-like.

526
00:52:11,100 --> 00:52:14,400
-They're really something?
-You got no idea.

527
00:52:14,500 --> 00:52:17,700
I think I got a pretty clear picture
of what they're about.

528
00:52:18,800 --> 00:52:23,100
We ain't talking about a bunch of thieves
rolling drums of olive oil off the docks.

529
00:52:23,200 --> 00:52:24,300
Heroin?

530
00:52:24,700 --> 00:52:27,800
How the fuck did that happen, Nick?
Look at me!

531
00:52:29,000 --> 00:52:31,300
You ain't much more than a kid.

532
00:52:33,400 --> 00:52:37,300
Me, I should've known better.
I put you up with them, for what?

533
00:52:39,700 --> 00:52:42,300
I flushed my fucking family, for what?

534
00:52:45,200 --> 00:52:47,800
You know what that is, Nicky? Do you?

535
00:52:50,500 --> 00:52:52,000
A condominium.

536
00:52:58,200 --> 00:52:59,800
I ain't going down there.

537
00:53:00,000 --> 00:53:03,400
What I'm gonna do is,
I'm gonna go in and talk with the police.

538
00:53:03,500 --> 00:53:06,900
That's right. I'm gonna do
to those cocksuckers what they did to me.

539
00:53:07,000 --> 00:53:09,100
-You can't do that.
-Why not?

540
00:53:10,800 --> 00:53:13,200
They wanna meet with us on Ziggy.

541
00:53:14,900 --> 00:53:16,600
They can lean on that witness...

542
00:53:16,700 --> 00:53:19,800
that kid that he shot,
the one that was there in the store.

543
00:53:19,900 --> 00:53:22,300
The kid's gonna say that
Double G had the gun.

544
00:53:22,400 --> 00:53:25,200
That it was like self-defense or some shit.

545
00:53:27,100 --> 00:53:29,300
Ziggy could walk, Uncle Frank.

546
00:53:30,200 --> 00:53:31,400
He could.

547
00:53:34,800 --> 00:53:36,000
-And for that they want what?
-Loyalty.

548
00:53:36,000 --> 00:53:37,400
-And for that they want what?
-Loyalty.

549
00:53:38,000 --> 00:53:39,400
Motherfuckers!

550
00:54:11,300 --> 00:54:13,000
I'll hear them out.

551
00:54:14,600 --> 00:54:17,400
-All right, I'll drive.
-No, it's just me.

552
00:54:18,800 --> 00:54:21,000
You ain't dealing with those guys no more.

553
00:54:21,100 --> 00:54:25,300
-Uncle Frank, me and Spiros--
-I don't fucking want you with me, Nick!

554
00:54:26,500 --> 00:54:27,700
Go home!

555
00:56:41,300 --> 00:56:42,700
Your way...

556
00:56:43,900 --> 00:56:45,400
it won't work.



## S02E12

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:07,700 --> 00:00:10,200
WA YE news time, 8:05.

2
00:00:10,300 --> 00:00:13,900
It's gonna be partly cloudy, breezy
and warm today with highs around 80.

3
00:00:14,000 --> 00:00:16,100
Right now in Baltimore, sunny skies.

4
00:00:16,200 --> 00:00:18,900
And here's one of my morning favorites.

5
00:00:30,900 --> 00:00:33,500
Yo, Ott. Santo Rey's late?

6
00:00:33,800 --> 00:00:36,400
Squall last night off of Hampton Roads.

7
00:03:54,500 --> 00:03:56,500
76-72 KGA.

8
00:03:57,000 --> 00:03:59,300
KGA, go ahead, 76-72.

9
00:03:59,400 --> 00:04:03,700
Notify Homicide and the OCME.
We got a floater at Patapsco Terminal.

10
00:04:03,800 --> 00:04:05,300
Copy that.

11
00:05:56,200 --> 00:05:58,000
Nothing at Vondopoulos's house?

12
00:05:58,100 --> 00:05:59,800
He's not going back.

13
00:05:59,900 --> 00:06:03,500
He's dumped his Benz and our GPS device
in the downtown garage.

14
00:06:03,600 --> 00:06:05,300
He's off the cell phones.

15
00:06:05,400 --> 00:06:07,500
And there's no text messaging
in Greek either.

16
00:06:07,700 --> 00:06:10,500
The raids, the follow,
one or both sent him underground.

17
00:06:10,600 --> 00:06:15,000
This guy, Stephen Rados? What's he?

18
00:06:15,200 --> 00:06:17,800
He rented the hotel room
for the meet with Vondopoulos.

19
00:06:17,900 --> 00:06:19,400
But checked out right after.

20
00:06:19,500 --> 00:06:21,600
Fitzhugh's running him
through every database.

21
00:06:21,700 --> 00:06:24,200
So far, nothing but a driver's license in D.C.

22
00:06:24,300 --> 00:06:26,700
Lester. Homicide for you, line 2.

23
00:06:27,800 --> 00:06:29,700
Maybe Sobotka knows him.

24
00:06:29,800 --> 00:06:33,900
When Sobotka comes in today, maybe
he gives us a line on every last Greek.

25
00:06:35,900 --> 00:06:37,400
Freamon here.

26
00:06:38,900 --> 00:06:41,600
Thirteen or so coming across the fax
from VICAP.

27
00:06:42,500 --> 00:06:44,000
All of them John Does.

28
00:06:44,100 --> 00:06:47,200
And that's just headless and handless
in the mid-Atlantic region.

29
00:06:47,300 --> 00:06:49,900
If you wanna go nationwide,
you'll be up over four dozen.

30
00:06:50,000 --> 00:06:52,400
-Fuck me.
-What can I tell you, kiddo?

31
00:06:52,500 --> 00:06:56,400
We are policing a culture in moral decline.
So, you want to come get these?

32
00:06:56,500 --> 00:06:58,900
Or should I have a uniform
run them over to Southeast?

33
00:06:59,000 --> 00:07:01,400
-Run them over to Southeast.
-Okay.

34
00:07:23,200 --> 00:07:25,300
-Have a seat.
-I can't.

35
00:07:25,700 --> 00:07:28,500
Gotta get back out there,
take care of business.

36
00:07:28,600 --> 00:07:31,000
Just wanted to make sure
they were treating you right.

37
00:07:31,100 --> 00:07:34,900
Making the most of it.
I'm catching up on my reading at least.

38
00:07:35,400 --> 00:07:38,600
I just want to let you know
that we got your back.

39
00:07:38,800 --> 00:07:42,200
You know, whoever did this, we'll find them.

40
00:07:42,900 --> 00:07:44,300
We got you, you understand?

41
00:07:44,400 --> 00:07:47,300
I appreciate the offer,
but that won't be necessary.

42
00:07:48,000 --> 00:07:49,900
Inform Mr. Barksdale that any obligation...

43
00:07:50,000 --> 00:07:52,600
he feels he might have
with regards to this incident...

44
00:07:52,700 --> 00:07:55,900
it's absolved, along with our agreement.

45
00:07:57,700 --> 00:07:59,000
All I'm saying is--

46
00:07:59,100 --> 00:08:01,100
I understand perfectly well
what you're saying.

47
00:08:01,200 --> 00:08:05,900
What I am saying to you is:
I will take care of them myself.

48
00:08:08,700 --> 00:08:10,000
Them?

49
00:08:13,100 --> 00:08:14,600
Who came at you?

50
00:08:20,800 --> 00:08:22,800
Thank you for your concern.

51
00:08:35,800 --> 00:08:38,600
Easy, Nick. Easy.

52
00:08:40,000 --> 00:08:43,800
I'm gonna kill them.
Fucking Greek bastards.

53
00:08:44,700 --> 00:08:46,000
Get out of my fucking way!

54
00:08:46,100 --> 00:08:48,200
Get off of me! Fuck all of you!

55
00:08:48,600 --> 00:08:51,800
He was there for all of you,
and now you're nowhere for him.

56
00:08:51,900 --> 00:08:54,000
What the fuck you gonna do?

57
00:08:54,700 --> 00:08:57,100
Get a gun? Go play gangster?

58
00:08:57,200 --> 00:08:59,000
Like your fucking cousin?

59
00:09:28,300 --> 00:09:29,600
Let's go.

60
00:10:02,000 --> 00:10:03,900
What was she firing, yo?

61
00:10:04,400 --> 00:10:06,800
Dirty Bomb, with a red-top chaser.

62
00:10:09,700 --> 00:10:12,300
Damn, yo. The bomb is the bomb.

63
00:10:25,500 --> 00:10:28,200
Opportunity knocking. Keep a lookout.

64
00:10:49,800 --> 00:10:52,500
He just boosted the whole fucking truck.

65
00:10:55,500 --> 00:10:57,400
Good looking out, Johnny.

66
00:11:16,100 --> 00:11:18,300
At least I remembered to call.

67
00:11:18,400 --> 00:11:20,400
Stabbed repeatedly.

68
00:11:21,000 --> 00:11:24,500
Torso, abdomen,
and they cut his throat to be sure.

69
00:11:26,000 --> 00:11:28,400
Single-edge blade. He fought, too.

70
00:11:28,900 --> 00:11:30,800
Defense wounds on both hands.

71
00:11:30,900 --> 00:11:32,700
Ligature on both legs.

72
00:11:33,000 --> 00:11:36,500
Weighed him down with something,
but it slipped off in the drink.

73
00:11:36,600 --> 00:11:38,600
One, two, three.

74
00:11:57,800 --> 00:12:01,100
Fuck it.
This Sobotka kid knows there's a warrant.

75
00:12:01,200 --> 00:12:04,100
He either turns himself in or not.
Who gives a fuck?

76
00:12:04,200 --> 00:12:08,100
Either we get to him now and roll him,
or he comes into the district with a lawyer.

77
00:12:08,200 --> 00:12:11,800
He comes in with a lawyer, he's less likely
to go for something in the box.

78
00:12:11,900 --> 00:12:14,000
You sound like McNulty now.

79
00:12:15,300 --> 00:12:19,600
We stay with these guys on their cases,
we ain't never gonna get no respect.

80
00:12:19,700 --> 00:12:21,200
You know this.

81
00:12:22,000 --> 00:12:25,300
I figure when the detail's over,
I go back to straight narcotics.

82
00:12:25,400 --> 00:12:28,600
Try to get over to Dawson's shift,
find a new rabbi.

83
00:12:29,200 --> 00:12:30,800
What about you?

84
00:12:32,100 --> 00:12:33,400
Don't know.

85
00:12:39,000 --> 00:12:42,100
I mean, you gotta admit,
Daniels has been okay for us.

86
00:12:42,300 --> 00:12:44,600
I mean, he's there for his troops.

87
00:12:47,800 --> 00:12:51,300
-You gotta be shitting me.
-I just came from the crime scene.

88
00:12:51,400 --> 00:12:52,900
He was coming in as a cooperator.

89
00:12:53,100 --> 00:12:56,200
Offering up the drug-and-prostitution ring
he'd been smuggling for.

90
00:12:56,300 --> 00:12:59,800
The guy lays down with gangsters,
gets up with his throat cut.

91
00:13:00,500 --> 00:13:03,300
Almost feel sorry for the son of a bitch.

92
00:13:03,700 --> 00:13:06,800
You were right about Sobotka.

93
00:13:08,400 --> 00:13:11,200
Case had enough legs on it
that I've got Burrell committed...

94
00:13:11,300 --> 00:13:15,500
to keeping my crew together
as a major case squad working out of CID.

95
00:13:18,500 --> 00:13:20,800
If you are gonna charge him....

96
00:13:21,000 --> 00:13:23,000
I'm gonna charge his narrow ass.

97
00:13:23,200 --> 00:13:24,800
You're gonna do your son-in-law?

98
00:13:24,900 --> 00:13:29,300
You don't think I didn't tell her
not to marry that brain-dead son of a bitch?

99
00:13:31,000 --> 00:13:35,400
I'll tell you the truth, Major.
Everyone who saw the punch wrote on it.

100
00:13:35,900 --> 00:13:39,200
And they've all got Prez
throwing the punch, no question.

101
00:13:39,300 --> 00:13:43,600
But they've also got you addressing
a subordinate officer as a....

102
00:13:43,700 --> 00:13:45,900
What was it? A shitbird?

103
00:13:47,800 --> 00:13:49,000
Fuck you.

104
00:13:49,300 --> 00:13:53,300
This is the Baltimore Police Department,
not the Roland Park Ladies' Tea.

105
00:13:53,400 --> 00:13:54,500
I'm just saying, the other detectives...

106
00:13:54,500 --> 00:13:56,100
I'm just saying, the other detectives...

107
00:13:57,400 --> 00:14:00,900
the FBI agents,
they gotta write it the way it happened.

108
00:14:01,000 --> 00:14:05,100
I mean, I could probably get my own people
to cheat it for you, but the FBl....

109
00:14:05,200 --> 00:14:07,600
You know how tight-assed they are.

110
00:14:11,500 --> 00:14:14,800
Roland Pryzbylewski rides
the Southeastern desk...

111
00:14:14,900 --> 00:14:17,100
on midnight shift for two months.

112
00:14:17,900 --> 00:14:21,200
During which time he writes
a personal letter of apology...

113
00:14:21,300 --> 00:14:23,700
to everyone seen that punch throwed.

114
00:14:23,900 --> 00:14:28,700
In which he makes it absolutely clear
that it was a penny-cheap sucker punch...

115
00:14:28,900 --> 00:14:31,700
that would've got his ass kicked in
by a real police...

116
00:14:31,800 --> 00:14:35,600
except for the fact that I have
my daughter's feelings to consider.

117
00:14:35,700 --> 00:14:38,900
And then he can come up here
and say the same to my face...

118
00:14:39,000 --> 00:14:43,000
and after that, if he wants
to piss his career away in your unit...

119
00:14:43,100 --> 00:14:45,300
I could give a hairy-ass fuck.

120
00:14:47,800 --> 00:14:49,300
Lieutenant.

121
00:14:53,100 --> 00:14:55,700
Rod, that shit goes into a supplemental.

122
00:14:55,800 --> 00:14:58,700
-You don't put witnesses on a face sheet.
-Officer.

123
00:15:00,300 --> 00:15:03,400
You got something for Freamon?
Homicide sent it over.

124
00:15:05,500 --> 00:15:09,000
Officer, my son wants
to turn himself in on a warrant.

125
00:15:09,700 --> 00:15:12,000
Everybody talks, nobody listens.

126
00:15:12,500 --> 00:15:15,700
Mike, that asshole calls back,
I'm in the shitter.

127
00:15:17,000 --> 00:15:21,300
-Now what can I do for you, gents?
-You got a warrant on me for drugs.

128
00:15:21,900 --> 00:15:24,700
-I'm turning myself in.
-A Southeastern warrant?

129
00:15:25,300 --> 00:15:29,000
He's surrendering.
He's gonna cooperate in any way he can.

130
00:15:29,200 --> 00:15:33,600
-What name am I looking for?
-Sobotka. Nicholas Sobotka.

131
00:15:38,900 --> 00:15:41,500
Morphine? From a city ambo?

132
00:15:42,000 --> 00:15:45,200
You should be ashamed
to be calling me on this one.

133
00:16:00,400 --> 00:16:03,600
-The body came up.
-I saw, on the television.

134
00:16:03,700 --> 00:16:05,900
We weighted him down
pretty goddamn good...

135
00:16:06,000 --> 00:16:08,500
but the water just coughed him back up.

136
00:16:08,600 --> 00:16:10,400
Bad luck, that's all.

137
00:16:11,200 --> 00:16:13,700
Sergei would've done better, I admit.

138
00:16:14,400 --> 00:16:17,800
Niko, the nephew. By now he knows.

139
00:16:18,400 --> 00:16:21,400
Our people wait for him,
but so do the police.

140
00:16:21,900 --> 00:16:23,600
I am thinking...

141
00:16:24,700 --> 00:16:27,500
there's nothing to be done at this point.

142
00:16:28,200 --> 00:16:30,000
What he says, he says.

143
00:16:30,700 --> 00:16:34,300
He knows my name.
But my name is not my name.

144
00:16:35,300 --> 00:16:36,500
And you?

145
00:16:37,700 --> 00:16:39,700
To them, you're only "The Greek."

146
00:16:39,800 --> 00:16:43,200
And, of course, I'm not even Greek.

147
00:16:49,100 --> 00:16:50,400
So we go.

148
00:16:51,700 --> 00:16:55,300
But there's a little business to do first.

149
00:16:56,300 --> 00:16:59,100
There's a shipment on the docks this week.

150
00:16:59,400 --> 00:17:02,900
-One hundred and fifty kilograms.
-And no one to pick it up.

151
00:17:04,300 --> 00:17:06,800
Not just Sergei, I miss Frank, too.

152
00:17:09,000 --> 00:17:12,000
We can't disappear the can.
But maybe we send someone.

153
00:17:12,100 --> 00:17:14,600
Bring it off the docks, legitimate.

154
00:17:15,300 --> 00:17:19,400
Everywhere we go these days,
we seem to be walking into police.

155
00:17:20,300 --> 00:17:22,500
This is telling us something.

156
00:17:24,400 --> 00:17:28,300
You're going to leave 15 million tholaria
to rot on the pier?

157
00:17:31,900 --> 00:17:35,500
Lambs go to slaughter.
A man, he learns when to walk away.

158
00:17:35,600 --> 00:17:36,900
No, we go.

159
00:17:39,000 --> 00:17:40,700
Call the others in.

160
00:17:41,700 --> 00:17:44,600
Let them know there is no longer any point.

161
00:17:58,300 --> 00:17:59,800
We don't wait?

162
00:17:59,900 --> 00:18:01,600
Our friends are still there, no?

163
00:18:01,700 --> 00:18:03,800
-Still here.
-Then go.

164
00:18:22,500 --> 00:18:24,500
Sobotka was a cooperator?

165
00:18:24,700 --> 00:18:27,200
We had preliminary discussions
with him yesterday.

166
00:18:27,300 --> 00:18:30,000
He agreed to post today
with a lawyer, but instead....

167
00:18:30,100 --> 00:18:31,800
So what's left of the case?

168
00:18:31,900 --> 00:18:35,600
We've pulled in everyone caught up
in the wiretaps, save for a couple bodies.

169
00:18:35,700 --> 00:18:38,600
We left the man we think is the number two
for the operation...

170
00:18:38,700 --> 00:18:40,900
on the street,
hoping he'd lead us to number one.

171
00:18:41,000 --> 00:18:42,900
We have people on him?

172
00:18:43,600 --> 00:18:45,500
He's out of pocket at the moment.

173
00:18:45,600 --> 00:18:49,600
Last seen leaving a downtown hotel,
but we expect he'll resurface.

174
00:18:50,900 --> 00:18:52,400
And the union people?

175
00:18:52,500 --> 00:18:56,100
With Sobotka dead, the case right now
is limited to a subordinate or two.

176
00:18:56,200 --> 00:18:58,800
But the important thing for us is the union.

177
00:18:58,900 --> 00:19:01,100
Either they jettison
their current leadership...

178
00:19:01,200 --> 00:19:03,600
or we have enough
to get that local decertified.

179
00:19:03,700 --> 00:19:06,600
Leaving only me and my 14 bodies.

180
00:19:07,100 --> 00:19:09,500
When do we get to that bit of business?

181
00:19:10,700 --> 00:19:14,800
Lt. Daniels? Line 2. Det. Freamon
insisted I put him through.

182
00:19:18,300 --> 00:19:21,600
In all likelihood, Frank Sobotka
was going to speak to that.

183
00:19:21,700 --> 00:19:24,300
Now, we're a step back, sorry to say.

184
00:19:24,700 --> 00:19:27,300
-Sobotka came in.
-The nephew?

185
00:19:27,400 --> 00:19:29,000
Yeah, he flipped.

186
00:19:30,000 --> 00:19:33,200
Come on, Bubs. You gotta do better
if you wanna walk on this.

187
00:19:33,300 --> 00:19:35,300
-How about some murders?
-How about them?

188
00:19:35,400 --> 00:19:38,100
They're not killing people
in West Baltimore these days?

189
00:19:38,200 --> 00:19:39,300
Been quiet.

190
00:19:39,400 --> 00:19:41,900
Except for that mess
with that young boy who got hit...

191
00:19:42,000 --> 00:19:44,500
with the stray through the window,
ain't been nothing.

192
00:19:44,600 --> 00:19:47,100
-How about that?
-I ain't got nothing on that one.

193
00:19:47,200 --> 00:19:49,200
It's just two crews beefing over a corner.

194
00:19:49,300 --> 00:19:51,900
You know what, Bubs? You going to jail.

195
00:19:52,300 --> 00:19:54,300
How you gonna talk about going to jail?

196
00:19:54,400 --> 00:19:55,900
You hearing this, Johnny?

197
00:19:56,000 --> 00:19:59,400
Like we ain't got history in this room.
Like we ain't friends or nothing.

198
00:19:59,500 --> 00:20:02,500
When you was up in that hospital,
all I did was worry.

199
00:20:02,600 --> 00:20:05,600
"What about Kima? What's up with my girl?"

200
00:20:05,700 --> 00:20:09,500
I'm just happy to see you're up in the mix...

201
00:20:09,600 --> 00:20:12,100
and you talking about jail and shit.

202
00:20:12,200 --> 00:20:14,300
That's too cold, girl, damn.

203
00:20:19,000 --> 00:20:21,600
Remember that Eastsider
got shot in the high-rises, right?

204
00:20:21,700 --> 00:20:23,100
You remember that shit, right?

205
00:20:23,200 --> 00:20:25,700
I mean, you were right there, Bubbles.

206
00:20:25,800 --> 00:20:28,900
That wasn't shit.
Boy got hit with a rat shot, that all.

207
00:20:29,000 --> 00:20:31,400
-Who you talking about?
-Boy named Cheese.

208
00:20:31,500 --> 00:20:34,800
Him and the other Eastsiders
moved into the Terrace...

209
00:20:34,900 --> 00:20:37,600
took over a couple towers
from the Stringer Bell's boys.

210
00:20:37,700 --> 00:20:41,600
Then some crazy-ass bow-tie nigger
came in and chased his ass home.

211
00:20:41,700 --> 00:20:43,100
And what happened?

212
00:20:43,300 --> 00:20:45,500
Mr. Bow Tie, he ran them off.

213
00:20:46,200 --> 00:20:49,200
He told them Eastsider fools,
"Them towers belong to Avon."

214
00:20:49,300 --> 00:20:50,900
But then he ain't come back no more.

215
00:20:51,000 --> 00:20:53,700
Now them Eastsiders
are back up in there steady slinging.

216
00:20:53,800 --> 00:20:55,800
I mean, it ain't like a war or nothing.

217
00:20:55,900 --> 00:20:58,900
It's like Stringer Bell and them are sharing.

218
00:20:59,500 --> 00:21:00,700
Sharing?

219
00:21:05,200 --> 00:21:07,200
You guys are on all of it?

220
00:21:09,500 --> 00:21:12,400
You have a public defender
sitting next to you, Mr. Sobotka.

221
00:21:12,500 --> 00:21:15,100
If there's anything about this deal
you don't understand--

222
00:21:15,200 --> 00:21:17,000
They killed my uncle.

223
00:21:17,100 --> 00:21:19,500
I don't need to talk to no one
but you people.

224
00:21:19,600 --> 00:21:21,700
How do you know they did it?

225
00:21:28,500 --> 00:21:29,800
I told....

226
00:21:39,900 --> 00:21:43,500
Spiros calls me
after everybody's getting arrested, right?

227
00:21:45,500 --> 00:21:48,500
Tells me he wants us
to keep our mouths shut...

228
00:21:49,000 --> 00:21:51,800
but Uncle Frank, he says he ain't gonna.

229
00:21:52,100 --> 00:21:54,700
Says he's gonna go talk to the police.

230
00:21:55,600 --> 00:21:58,500
Spiros says that if we keep quiet...

231
00:21:58,900 --> 00:22:01,600
they can help my cousin, Zig, you know?

232
00:22:02,000 --> 00:22:04,300
And now Spiros is saying that...

233
00:22:04,500 --> 00:22:08,400
I don't know, the kid,
the one that didn't die...

234
00:22:08,500 --> 00:22:10,400
the one that got shot...

235
00:22:10,500 --> 00:22:14,300
he's gonna say that the gun, it wasn't Zig's.

236
00:22:15,100 --> 00:22:18,900
That Glekas pulled the gun,
and it wasn't really Zig's fault.

237
00:22:20,400 --> 00:22:23,600
So your uncle went to meet them
and talk about that?

238
00:22:23,700 --> 00:22:25,500
Under the Key Bridge.

239
00:22:28,100 --> 00:22:31,100
I seen his car was still there this morning.

240
00:22:32,300 --> 00:22:34,400
I seen that, I fucking knew.

241
00:22:35,200 --> 00:22:38,000
If they killed your uncle to shut him up,
they probably--

242
00:22:38,100 --> 00:22:39,800
Wanna kill me, too?

243
00:22:42,500 --> 00:22:43,600
Shit!

244
00:22:45,100 --> 00:22:48,000
I was gonna go down with him
to the bridge.

245
00:22:49,000 --> 00:22:51,400
I was gonna go down there with him.

246
00:22:52,200 --> 00:22:53,700
He wouldn't....

247
00:22:58,800 --> 00:23:01,300
You were involved in the smuggling?

248
00:23:04,400 --> 00:23:06,700
We didn't know about the girls.

249
00:23:07,200 --> 00:23:08,800
Them girls that got found?

250
00:23:08,900 --> 00:23:12,100
-We didn't know there were girls in there.
-You thought it was drugs?

251
00:23:12,200 --> 00:23:14,600
Drugs, stolen shit, whatever.

252
00:23:14,900 --> 00:23:19,100
We got paid by the can
to creep shit off the docks. That's all.

253
00:23:19,200 --> 00:23:23,300
That and selling the drugs
that you got from The Greek, too, right?

254
00:23:25,600 --> 00:23:28,000
That's your cousin's signed statement.

255
00:23:28,100 --> 00:23:31,100
He put himself in,
talked about buying the gun.

256
00:23:31,200 --> 00:23:33,800
The bill of sale
from the pawn shop is in there, too.

257
00:23:33,900 --> 00:23:38,000
It wouldn't have mattered if the
second victim had backed up on his story.

258
00:23:38,100 --> 00:23:40,100
Your cousin was locked in.

259
00:23:44,000 --> 00:23:47,300
Your uncle was sitting yesterday
right where you're sitting now...

260
00:23:47,400 --> 00:23:51,400
ready to give us everything, if we made
the drug charges go away for you.

261
00:23:51,500 --> 00:23:55,400
And maybe got your cousin
to a better lock-up than Eager Street.

262
00:23:55,800 --> 00:23:58,700
As you can see,
we're willing to honor that deal...

263
00:23:58,800 --> 00:24:01,500
even if it didn't happen for your uncle.

264
00:24:09,100 --> 00:24:11,100
Spiros was the main guy.

265
00:24:11,900 --> 00:24:14,600
He told me and Frank
which cans to disappear...

266
00:24:14,700 --> 00:24:18,700
and then when it came to me and the drugs,
he was the one that hooked that up, too.

267
00:24:18,800 --> 00:24:22,800
The lsraeli, he was their drug guy.
I went through him for all my re-ups...

268
00:24:22,900 --> 00:24:26,800
until they passed me off
to White Mike McArdle. You know Mike?

269
00:24:28,600 --> 00:24:29,600
Guess you do.

270
00:24:29,700 --> 00:24:31,600
Double G was in charge of stolen shit.

271
00:24:31,700 --> 00:24:34,800
Anything we could lift from the docks
went straight to his store...

272
00:24:34,900 --> 00:24:38,000
but he's dead,
so why am I wasting your time, right?

273
00:24:38,100 --> 00:24:39,200
Her, I don't know.

274
00:24:40,600 --> 00:24:43,500
My uncle, you know about him.

275
00:24:45,700 --> 00:24:48,800
I don't know
why you got Horse's picture up there.

276
00:24:48,900 --> 00:24:51,800
Horse don't know shit. I'll testify to that.

277
00:24:52,200 --> 00:24:53,700
What about the Russian?

278
00:24:53,800 --> 00:24:55,400
He drove for them.

279
00:24:55,500 --> 00:24:59,100
Anything that had to come off the docks,
he was their guy.

280
00:24:59,200 --> 00:25:02,900
But I also got the feeling
that if somebody had to get hurt...

281
00:25:03,100 --> 00:25:05,900
he was probably going to be around
for that part of it, too.

282
00:25:06,000 --> 00:25:07,700
Why did you think that?

283
00:25:07,800 --> 00:25:10,400
Sergei, he just carried it like that.

284
00:25:11,100 --> 00:25:14,100
And also, after them girls died in the can...

285
00:25:14,800 --> 00:25:18,100
they told me that whoever fucked that up...

286
00:25:18,500 --> 00:25:20,900
they had already got to in Philly.

287
00:25:21,000 --> 00:25:24,400
They said that
whoever did that to them girls was dead.

288
00:25:24,700 --> 00:25:26,600
And how did they say it?

289
00:25:26,900 --> 00:25:30,800
They just said, I don't know...

290
00:25:31,800 --> 00:25:34,700
that the guy that you all was looking for...

291
00:25:34,800 --> 00:25:36,500
he was a dead end.

292
00:25:37,500 --> 00:25:39,800
-A dead end?
-Yeah.

293
00:25:40,900 --> 00:25:42,700
In Philly, they said.

294
00:25:46,700 --> 00:25:48,200
Who's the suit?

295
00:25:54,100 --> 00:25:55,400
You sure?

296
00:25:56,100 --> 00:25:59,000
We know that someone
is above your man Spiros.

297
00:25:59,100 --> 00:26:01,700
Someone he was in communication with.

298
00:26:02,200 --> 00:26:03,700
Yeah, The Greek.

299
00:26:03,800 --> 00:26:07,800
Sure, I know who you mean.
I mean, I don't have a name or nothing.

300
00:26:08,500 --> 00:26:09,600
The man in the suit...

301
00:26:09,700 --> 00:26:11,800
the man with Vondopoulos
in the photograph.

302
00:26:12,000 --> 00:26:13,700
That's not The Greek?

303
00:26:23,600 --> 00:26:25,800
That's The Greek right there.

304
00:26:30,900 --> 00:26:32,400
That the guy?

305
00:26:38,600 --> 00:26:41,100
He picked out an Eastsider, all right.

306
00:26:41,200 --> 00:26:43,500
Cheese runs with Proposition Joe's mob.

307
00:26:43,600 --> 00:26:46,300
Had a few corners off of Ashland,
last I heard.

308
00:26:46,400 --> 00:26:49,100
-What's the verdict?
-He did good for us.

309
00:26:49,200 --> 00:26:52,100
-So I'm out the stat?
-I owe you one, Sanny.

310
00:27:02,300 --> 00:27:05,100
-Both of them?
-Yeah, that one's his valet.

311
00:27:05,400 --> 00:27:07,300
Can I use your bathroom?

312
00:27:07,400 --> 00:27:09,400
Fuck, no. Get out of here.

313
00:27:10,000 --> 00:27:13,400
Bubs, one last question.
How's product in the Towers?

314
00:27:14,300 --> 00:27:16,300
It was shit, now it's right.

315
00:27:27,800 --> 00:27:31,000
Found this guy.
Federal court computer down in D.C.

316
00:27:31,600 --> 00:27:33,300
But not in a bad way.

317
00:27:33,900 --> 00:27:36,100
He's a K Street lawyer down there.

318
00:27:36,200 --> 00:27:38,300
So the suit was only a suit?

319
00:27:38,500 --> 00:27:42,300
On the other hand, my friend,
this is from overseas.

320
00:27:42,900 --> 00:27:47,100
A can on the Adriatica, which docks
the day after tomorrow at Patapsco.

321
00:27:47,500 --> 00:27:49,400
Fake manifest out of Le Havre.

322
00:27:49,500 --> 00:27:51,200
You people got reach.

323
00:27:51,300 --> 00:27:54,400
That's about $300,000 in man-hours
we're holding here.

324
00:27:55,100 --> 00:27:57,000
What's the plan for him?

325
00:27:57,100 --> 00:28:00,300
You gotta call the US Attorney
about witness protection.

326
00:28:00,400 --> 00:28:02,800
We're rounding up his girl and kid.

327
00:28:02,900 --> 00:28:07,400
It's best we keep this as quiet as we can.
We already lost one cooperator.

328
00:28:26,700 --> 00:28:28,200
It's for you.

329
00:28:39,700 --> 00:28:40,900
Daniels.

330
00:28:41,000 --> 00:28:45,200
Lieutenant, Fitzhugh's calling for WITSEC,
and we're pulling in the girlfriend and kid.

331
00:28:45,300 --> 00:28:47,100
Okay, thanks.

332
00:29:29,900 --> 00:29:30,900
FBl.

333
00:29:31,000 --> 00:29:34,300
This is Special Agent Terrence Fitzhugh,
Baltimore field office.

334
00:29:34,400 --> 00:29:36,800
-May I speak with Agent Koutris, please?
-Who?

335
00:29:36,900 --> 00:29:38,400
Agent Koutris.

336
00:29:38,500 --> 00:29:41,500
He's no longer
with the San Diego field office.

337
00:29:41,600 --> 00:29:43,000
Where's he at?

338
00:29:43,100 --> 00:29:46,800
You could try headquarters in Washington.
Counterterrorism.

339
00:29:50,700 --> 00:29:53,000
Counterterrorism? For how long?

340
00:29:53,100 --> 00:29:57,600
I'd have to check, but I'm sure
he's been gone from here more than a year.

341
00:30:11,200 --> 00:30:15,100
Either he comes home
in the next five minutes, or I eat my gun.

342
00:30:17,800 --> 00:30:19,400
I'm just saying, this is not the way...

343
00:30:19,500 --> 00:30:21,800
me and you learned how to do it
in West Baltimore.

344
00:30:21,900 --> 00:30:23,900
Not by a fucking long shot!

345
00:30:42,300 --> 00:30:44,300
Either your son surrenders within the hour...

346
00:30:44,400 --> 00:30:47,600
or all the police will come
crashing through this door twice a day...

347
00:30:47,700 --> 00:30:50,800
for as long as it takes you people
to get the message. You hear me?

348
00:30:50,900 --> 00:30:54,900
We will take this door once in the morning
and once at night, and toss your house...

349
00:30:55,000 --> 00:30:58,200
until there isn't any furniture
with more than three legs left on it.

350
00:30:58,300 --> 00:31:02,400
Officer, my son turned himself in
to the police last night.

351
00:31:03,000 --> 00:31:06,600
At Southeastern.
A detective was there at the time.

352
00:31:14,800 --> 00:31:17,700
-A detective?
-Motherfucker. Come on.

353
00:31:24,600 --> 00:31:26,300
Don't use the phone.

354
00:31:26,400 --> 00:31:30,600
There'll be an agent posted outside.
If you go anywhere, go with him.

355
00:31:38,800 --> 00:31:40,200
What a dump.

356
00:31:42,700 --> 00:31:45,200
You wanted us to get a place, right?

357
00:31:52,000 --> 00:31:53,600
If they got to him in Philly...

358
00:31:53,700 --> 00:31:56,300
then they probably dumped
the body in that area, right?

359
00:31:56,400 --> 00:32:00,300
No use in dragging a headless torso around
further than you need.

360
00:32:00,400 --> 00:32:01,600
Good God.

361
00:32:02,700 --> 00:32:05,500
I bet you there's a police detective
somewhere else...

362
00:32:05,600 --> 00:32:07,900
Iooking at a table full of heads right now.

363
00:32:08,000 --> 00:32:12,000
In that stuff that we took off the ship,
did we keep any photos?

364
00:32:12,100 --> 00:32:14,800
Couple of pictures of one guy
that left his gear, yeah.

365
00:32:14,900 --> 00:32:16,400
They're at ECU.

366
00:32:20,300 --> 00:32:24,500
You two should get on the road.
Get up there before the offices close.

367
00:32:28,300 --> 00:32:30,200
Where y'all been at?

368
00:32:34,600 --> 00:32:37,400
I'm saying, though, Butchie,
something just ain't feel right.

369
00:32:37,500 --> 00:32:39,800
The man didn't even know
what I was saying.

370
00:32:39,900 --> 00:32:41,600
So I just eased off.

371
00:32:42,900 --> 00:32:45,400
-You think brother played me?
-No.

372
00:32:45,500 --> 00:32:48,800
Y'all can't read lying eyes
after all these years...

373
00:32:49,000 --> 00:32:51,400
then I'd be talking to a dead man.

374
00:32:52,100 --> 00:32:55,100
You saying Stringer told you...

375
00:32:56,000 --> 00:32:58,700
the brother had something to do
with your boy Brandon?

376
00:32:58,800 --> 00:32:59,800
Yeah.

377
00:32:59,900 --> 00:33:03,500
Near as I know, Brother Mouzone
spends most of his time up north.

378
00:33:03,600 --> 00:33:05,400
New York and Philly.

379
00:33:05,800 --> 00:33:10,000
If Avon contracted him to get at you...

380
00:33:11,300 --> 00:33:15,300
the brother wouldn't have stop coming
until you two were bumped.

381
00:33:15,900 --> 00:33:17,100
It's my fault.

382
00:33:17,200 --> 00:33:20,000
I should've said no to Prop Joe
from the get-go.

383
00:33:20,100 --> 00:33:23,400
Avon's father was plain evil,
and the son ain't no better.

384
00:33:23,600 --> 00:33:25,600
Neither is Stringer,
now that we making a list.

385
00:33:25,700 --> 00:33:27,900
I'm going hard after Stringer.

386
00:33:28,900 --> 00:33:32,200
No point in trying
to talk you back down, I suppose.

387
00:33:32,800 --> 00:33:36,600
You been my bank for how long
and gonna ask me something like that?

388
00:33:36,700 --> 00:33:38,600
How you gonna get at him?

389
00:33:41,000 --> 00:33:43,000
I don't even know, Butch.

390
00:33:44,000 --> 00:33:46,300
Take some time and think on it.

391
00:33:47,500 --> 00:33:51,300
One thing for sure, though,
the man got to be got, you feel me?

392
00:33:57,300 --> 00:33:59,000
What you see, Butch?

393
00:34:03,300 --> 00:34:04,800
Too much, boy.

394
00:34:05,500 --> 00:34:07,000
Too damn much.

395
00:34:15,500 --> 00:34:17,100
A lot happened overnight.

396
00:34:17,200 --> 00:34:18,500
Not to us.

397
00:34:18,600 --> 00:34:21,000
-Look, this isn't personal--
-Fucking-A, right.

398
00:34:21,100 --> 00:34:24,100
We're not even people in this unit.
We're your goddamn pack mules.

399
00:34:24,200 --> 00:34:27,400
"Sit on this house,
transport this mope, wait for that one."

400
00:34:27,500 --> 00:34:28,700
That's part of the job.

401
00:34:28,800 --> 00:34:32,300
The job had a little more rip-and-run to it,
the way I remember it.

402
00:34:32,500 --> 00:34:34,800
These cases are more than that.

403
00:34:34,900 --> 00:34:37,800
We're putting people in jail
with phone taps and typewriters.

404
00:34:37,900 --> 00:34:40,400
So you're saying we ain't up to it.

405
00:34:43,500 --> 00:34:46,900
I saw on the postings that Major Colvin
needs a sergeant in the Western.

406
00:34:47,000 --> 00:34:50,400
Flex squad.
And the last time I checked, I had stripes.

407
00:34:59,300 --> 00:35:01,000
Eastside, Westside.

408
00:35:02,200 --> 00:35:04,600
Cats and dogs, sleeping together.

409
00:35:11,400 --> 00:35:14,400
Shit. I'm late for something.

410
00:35:33,400 --> 00:35:36,900
You say you want everybody
that came on the port that day?

411
00:35:37,300 --> 00:35:40,700
No, we're looking for anything
out of the ordinary. Probably at night.

412
00:35:40,800 --> 00:35:43,400
Oh, unusual. You should've said so.

413
00:35:43,700 --> 00:35:46,800
-What you asked for before--
-That's what we....

414
00:35:47,200 --> 00:35:51,200
You're right, sir, absolutely right.
Just see if there's anything like that.

415
00:35:58,300 --> 00:36:01,200
Nope, all I got is usual.

416
00:36:01,300 --> 00:36:03,300
All right.
Any way you could give us the name...

417
00:36:03,400 --> 00:36:06,000
of the security officer
that was on this pier that night?

418
00:36:06,100 --> 00:36:08,100
What was that date again?

419
00:36:08,600 --> 00:36:10,100
February 5.

420
00:36:10,200 --> 00:36:13,600
You had the Atlantic Light on that pier
from 6:00 p.m.

421
00:36:18,100 --> 00:36:20,800
That was Walt. Walt Stokes.

422
00:36:20,900 --> 00:36:22,600
Is he working tonight?

423
00:36:22,700 --> 00:36:25,600
It's Tuesday. Walt's off on Tuesdays.

424
00:36:25,900 --> 00:36:27,300
What do you want Walt for?

425
00:36:27,400 --> 00:36:29,700
See if he can make any of these.

426
00:36:31,800 --> 00:36:33,400
Wouldn't do much good.

427
00:36:33,500 --> 00:36:36,800
Afraid Walt's not as up to speed
as the rest of us.

428
00:36:43,500 --> 00:36:45,800
Seeing as you've come
all this way, though...

429
00:36:45,900 --> 00:36:49,200
you might want to have a look-see
at the videotapes.

430
00:36:59,800 --> 00:37:01,600
$300 for a stroller?

431
00:37:02,400 --> 00:37:05,800
I know, I know.
Cost more than your first car, right?

432
00:37:06,100 --> 00:37:07,900
A hooptie, no doubt?

433
00:37:09,800 --> 00:37:12,200
We're so gonna need one of these.

434
00:37:15,600 --> 00:37:17,400
Look at this, Kima.

435
00:37:18,600 --> 00:37:20,700
Blue's Clues juice box holder.

436
00:37:21,600 --> 00:37:26,100
If the kid can't hold on to a little old box
without no help, we got problems.

437
00:37:35,600 --> 00:37:37,100
Okay, listen.

438
00:37:39,300 --> 00:37:44,200
This baby is gonna come out of my belly
and need both of us, forever.

439
00:37:45,000 --> 00:37:46,600
You understand?

440
00:37:47,000 --> 00:37:49,700
I mean, it may not be real for you yet.

441
00:37:50,800 --> 00:37:53,100
But, goddamn it, it's real for me.

442
00:38:22,900 --> 00:38:24,000
Nick.

443
00:38:29,600 --> 00:38:31,700
What's gonna happen, Nicky?

444
00:38:39,100 --> 00:38:40,800
That can on the fifth wheel there.

445
00:38:40,900 --> 00:38:44,300
By the plan, it's a hot box,
but there's no one on a pick-up.

446
00:38:44,400 --> 00:38:47,500
-Where's it from?
-Le Havre, France.

447
00:38:48,500 --> 00:38:50,400
Fuck it, then. Dump her.

448
00:39:01,600 --> 00:39:05,400
Lester, the drug talk coming
from Proposition Joe's people...

449
00:39:05,500 --> 00:39:07,300
before the warehouse phone came down.

450
00:39:07,400 --> 00:39:09,300
Those were for steady re-ups, right?

451
00:39:09,400 --> 00:39:12,900
We weren't up on that wire long,
but, yeah, three weeks in a row.

452
00:39:13,000 --> 00:39:16,800
-How much?
-Five or six La-Z-Boys at a clip, to start.

453
00:39:17,400 --> 00:39:20,700
Last call to Eton's cell phone,
the re-up went to 12.

454
00:39:21,400 --> 00:39:23,800
He doubles his re-up to 12 kilos?

455
00:39:29,400 --> 00:39:31,300
That's her right there.

456
00:39:32,600 --> 00:39:35,000
They ain't doing the dirt, though.

457
00:39:35,100 --> 00:39:37,900
Team leader,
keep an eye on that can till we post.

458
00:39:38,000 --> 00:39:39,200
Copy.

459
00:39:46,600 --> 00:39:49,000
Sorry to hear about my boy Sergei.

460
00:39:49,700 --> 00:39:51,000
Eton, too.

461
00:39:52,100 --> 00:39:54,100
You lost some good people.

462
00:39:56,800 --> 00:39:59,000
There'll be some new faces soon.

463
00:40:00,300 --> 00:40:02,600
A week or so. They'll find you.

464
00:40:03,600 --> 00:40:06,500
Just as they'll find the others
that work with us.

465
00:40:06,600 --> 00:40:07,700
A week?

466
00:40:09,200 --> 00:40:12,900
I ain't got enough of your good shit
to last much past that.

467
00:40:13,200 --> 00:40:16,100
You got anything to lay off
before you leave?

468
00:40:17,200 --> 00:40:19,200
The last shipment is lost.

469
00:40:19,600 --> 00:40:22,500
Lost? How you mean?

470
00:40:24,200 --> 00:40:27,100
The police may be sitting on it.

471
00:40:27,200 --> 00:40:28,700
You ain't sure?

472
00:40:29,100 --> 00:40:31,500
There's more where that came from.

473
00:40:32,000 --> 00:40:33,900
Always, there is more.

474
00:40:36,100 --> 00:40:37,600
All right, then.

475
00:40:38,100 --> 00:40:40,700
I'm gonna let your new people find me.

476
00:40:41,400 --> 00:40:43,100
Have a safe trip.

477
00:40:44,700 --> 00:40:47,000
Where you say you off to again?

478
00:41:00,700 --> 00:41:03,000
There's 12 in this, 15 in that.

479
00:41:03,500 --> 00:41:06,300
And if the rest of them
holds this same pattern....

480
00:41:06,400 --> 00:41:09,100
Maybe 200 kilos of raw left on the pier.

481
00:41:09,500 --> 00:41:12,100
The Greeks are definitely in the wind.

482
00:41:12,200 --> 00:41:14,100
And we are in the dark.

483
00:41:14,400 --> 00:41:16,900
You want us to take it down
to the customs shed, or what?

484
00:41:17,000 --> 00:41:18,900
No, you're gonna seal it up and sit on it.

485
00:41:19,000 --> 00:41:21,500
If we're lucky, someone will come
calling in a day or so.

486
00:41:21,600 --> 00:41:22,600
You that lucky?

487
00:41:22,700 --> 00:41:27,200
If they didn't get onto us when they did,
this might've been a hell of a case.

488
00:41:28,200 --> 00:41:29,600
It's on you.

489
00:41:34,800 --> 00:41:37,300
Ambushed? ln his own goddamn room?

490
00:41:37,900 --> 00:41:40,400
Yeah, he gonna be all right, but he--

491
00:41:40,500 --> 00:41:43,500
I don't give a fuck
about how he gonna be, man.

492
00:41:43,900 --> 00:41:46,200
You put on out-of-town talent
at a high price...

493
00:41:46,300 --> 00:41:48,700
you expect them
to get the motherfucking job done.

494
00:41:48,800 --> 00:41:51,200
He said that thing between us is....

495
00:41:51,300 --> 00:41:53,700
How did he put it? Absolved.

496
00:41:54,400 --> 00:41:57,100
Absolved? What the fuck do that mean?

497
00:41:57,600 --> 00:42:01,000
Mouzone booked out,
we worse off than when he came.

498
00:42:01,100 --> 00:42:03,600
If word gets out on the street
that we weak like this...

499
00:42:03,700 --> 00:42:05,700
how the fuck we supposed
to maintain our shit?

500
00:42:05,800 --> 00:42:08,400
I know, but we gotta hit right back,
make a statement.

501
00:42:08,500 --> 00:42:10,400
But Mouzone not saying who did this.

502
00:42:10,500 --> 00:42:12,600
-You asked him who it was?
-Yeah, I asked him.

503
00:42:12,700 --> 00:42:14,300
-Why?
-Why what?

504
00:42:17,200 --> 00:42:20,400
How you gonna ask a soldier like Mouzone
a question like that?

505
00:42:20,500 --> 00:42:23,000
Either he gonna say,
or he gonna go and work it out.

506
00:42:23,200 --> 00:42:26,200
Either way,
you ain't got to be asking him shit.

507
00:42:34,400 --> 00:42:37,700
Man, every market-based business
runs in cycles...

508
00:42:37,800 --> 00:42:40,000
and we going
through a down-cycle right now.

509
00:42:40,100 --> 00:42:44,200
String, this ain't about
your motherfucking business class either.

510
00:42:45,000 --> 00:42:48,500
It ain't that part of it. It's that other thing.

511
00:42:49,700 --> 00:42:52,800
The street is the street. Always.

512
00:42:59,100 --> 00:43:02,600
Man, we gonna get through
this bullshit anyway.

513
00:43:02,700 --> 00:43:05,500
No doubt.
You just need to hold tight 'til I get uptown.

514
00:43:05,600 --> 00:43:07,500
And that day gonna come, but until then...

515
00:43:07,600 --> 00:43:10,500
we gotta do what we can do,
when we can do it.

516
00:43:12,300 --> 00:43:14,700
Yeah, you need to go to Prop Joe.

517
00:43:15,300 --> 00:43:17,400
I ain't gonna argue with you.

518
00:43:17,500 --> 00:43:19,500
You run it as you see fit.

519
00:43:19,900 --> 00:43:22,100
At least until I get home, you do.

520
00:43:22,300 --> 00:43:23,500
No doubt.

521
00:43:27,700 --> 00:43:29,000
Us, man.

522
00:43:33,600 --> 00:43:34,600
Us.

523
00:43:46,400 --> 00:43:48,900
-Tape is fucked up.
-It's multiplexed.

524
00:43:49,600 --> 00:43:51,200
It's a way to save money.

525
00:43:51,300 --> 00:43:53,300
Instead of one camera, one VCR...

526
00:43:53,400 --> 00:43:55,500
it's 10 cameras playing on one VCR tape.

527
00:43:55,600 --> 00:43:58,500
-Can you make sense of it?
-Not a problem, with this software.

528
00:43:58,600 --> 00:44:01,100
-We just de-plex it.
-De-plex?

529
00:44:01,200 --> 00:44:03,400
Let me show you the highlight reel.

530
00:44:10,000 --> 00:44:13,000
-Is he flashing a badge?
-Looks like it.

531
00:44:13,100 --> 00:44:15,100
That's something you don't see too often...

532
00:44:15,200 --> 00:44:16,900
John Law in a Mercedes-Benz.

533
00:44:17,000 --> 00:44:18,800
That could be our boy.

534
00:44:18,900 --> 00:44:20,900
Head still on.

535
00:44:23,400 --> 00:44:25,900
Tell me we got cameras inside.

536
00:44:27,500 --> 00:44:29,200
Jesus, my pants are wet.

537
00:44:29,300 --> 00:44:31,500
Yeah. C'mon, baby.

538
00:44:32,300 --> 00:44:33,300
Yeah.

539
00:44:51,500 --> 00:44:53,900
Re-up gonna be about a week or so late.

540
00:44:54,000 --> 00:44:56,600
My people are having to readjust
to some shit.

541
00:44:56,700 --> 00:44:57,700
A week?

542
00:44:57,800 --> 00:44:59,900
No later than that, they say.

543
00:45:00,700 --> 00:45:02,800
How it go with Avon today?

544
00:45:04,200 --> 00:45:05,700
It's all good.

545
00:45:19,900 --> 00:45:21,600
Our old friend.

546
00:45:25,700 --> 00:45:27,000
What's the news?

547
00:45:27,100 --> 00:45:30,200
Port cops are sitting on a can
that came off the Adriatica.

548
00:45:30,300 --> 00:45:32,600
Word around the customs shed,
it's full of dope.

549
00:45:32,700 --> 00:45:34,200
I mean, about Frank.

550
00:45:34,300 --> 00:45:37,000
-What's the district council saying?
-Gentlemen.

551
00:45:39,000 --> 00:45:42,200
Mr. Pakusa, in light
of your pending indictment...

552
00:45:42,300 --> 00:45:45,300
I'd think you'd stay as far away
from this hall as possible.

553
00:45:45,400 --> 00:45:47,200
Ain't y'all got some place to go?

554
00:45:47,300 --> 00:45:48,900
Just came to make it clear...

555
00:45:49,000 --> 00:45:50,900
that if there's no cleaning up in here...

556
00:45:51,000 --> 00:45:52,600
this local will be decertified.

557
00:45:52,700 --> 00:45:55,100
Instead of your union
running out of this office...

558
00:45:55,200 --> 00:45:58,700
it'll be a federal magistrate
down the courthouse deciding things.

559
00:45:58,800 --> 00:46:01,300
Take the opportunity to elect new officers...

560
00:46:01,400 --> 00:46:03,700
or the US Attorney will padlock the door.

561
00:46:03,800 --> 00:46:06,200
And you'll be outside, looking in.

562
00:46:21,000 --> 00:46:23,700
One man, one vote.

563
00:46:40,600 --> 00:46:44,100
Did he have hands? Did he have a face?

564
00:46:44,200 --> 00:46:47,200
Yes? Then it wasn't us.

565
00:46:50,000 --> 00:46:52,800
You don't think that had anything to do...

566
00:46:53,800 --> 00:46:55,300
with this mope?

567
00:47:03,400 --> 00:47:06,000
You gotta do better than that, Lester.

568
00:47:06,200 --> 00:47:08,400
This poor guy ain't got a face.

569
00:47:22,200 --> 00:47:24,500
Did I mention the DNA matches?

570
00:47:26,100 --> 00:47:29,100
This has nothing to do with me.

571
00:47:45,700 --> 00:47:47,800
Is that the security guard?

572
00:47:50,000 --> 00:47:52,500
Walt Stokes. A good man.

573
00:47:53,500 --> 00:47:55,500
Keeps meticulous records.

574
00:47:57,200 --> 00:48:00,700
Bunk, they tell me
you can enhance each frame...

575
00:48:00,800 --> 00:48:02,500
to get a clear look.

576
00:48:02,900 --> 00:48:05,300
Yeah? Show it to me.

577
00:48:09,500 --> 00:48:12,700
I'll be damned. Maryland tags.

578
00:48:13,100 --> 00:48:15,500
Juliet-Lima-Yankee...

579
00:48:16,400 --> 00:48:17,900
5-4-5.

580
00:48:18,500 --> 00:48:21,000
That comes back to a BWI rental.

581
00:48:22,200 --> 00:48:24,100
I wonder who rented it.

582
00:48:25,600 --> 00:48:28,600
This is aggravated murder and kidnapping.

583
00:48:29,400 --> 00:48:32,400
In this state, it's a death penalty case.

584
00:48:35,700 --> 00:48:37,400
I didn't kill him.

585
00:48:41,000 --> 00:48:43,800
I was there, but I didn't kill him.

586
00:48:48,600 --> 00:48:50,400
Vondas did.

587
00:48:51,700 --> 00:48:53,300
He cut his throat.

588
00:48:55,400 --> 00:48:58,600
The shepherd was supposed
to watch over the women.

589
00:48:59,500 --> 00:49:02,400
Instead, he used them to make money.

590
00:49:03,700 --> 00:49:06,900
One of the women, she fought.
She was killed.

591
00:49:07,600 --> 00:49:12,000
And this idiot kills the rest
to make no witnesses.

592
00:49:12,100 --> 00:49:13,600
He had to die.

593
00:49:21,400 --> 00:49:23,700
You want a coffee? Soda?

594
00:49:24,300 --> 00:49:25,600
Vodka.

595
00:49:27,200 --> 00:49:28,400
Coffee.

596
00:49:41,300 --> 00:49:44,100
They're down. All 14 of them.

597
00:49:44,700 --> 00:49:47,800
Abated by the untimely death
of a known suspect.

598
00:49:48,000 --> 00:49:51,700
Plus another clearance
on a John Doe case, just for laughs.

599
00:49:52,100 --> 00:49:55,100
You wanna tell Rawls?

600
00:49:55,900 --> 00:49:58,000
Let him stew a while longer.

601
00:49:58,300 --> 00:50:00,800
One thing, though,
we should do right away.

602
00:50:11,800 --> 00:50:13,900
Who's the man above Vondas?

603
00:50:15,200 --> 00:50:16,500
The Greek.

604
00:50:17,200 --> 00:50:18,700
What's his name?

605
00:50:22,800 --> 00:50:26,000
You want a chance at anything
less than death row...

606
00:50:26,100 --> 00:50:27,600
you're gonna tell me right now...

607
00:50:27,700 --> 00:50:31,400
whatever it is you know
about where those bastards might be.

608
00:50:31,800 --> 00:50:35,200
A hotel at the harbor.

609
00:50:35,700 --> 00:50:36,900
This one?

610
00:50:38,800 --> 00:50:40,000
Another.

611
00:50:41,000 --> 00:50:42,500
I can show you.

612
00:50:59,900 --> 00:51:00,900
Go.

613
00:51:04,900 --> 00:51:06,500
Clear!

614
00:51:22,300 --> 00:51:24,200
Business or pleasure for you?

615
00:51:24,600 --> 00:51:27,200
Business. Always business.

616
00:51:42,100 --> 00:51:44,700
-What did you forget?
-Nothing important.

617
00:52:01,200 --> 00:52:03,000
You come to the bar without me?

618
00:52:03,100 --> 00:52:05,500
Kiss my black cat's sister's ass.

619
00:52:07,600 --> 00:52:09,800
-What happened?
-Case hit the wall.

620
00:52:09,900 --> 00:52:11,100
How so?

621
00:52:11,200 --> 00:52:13,800
The Sobotka nephew breaks for
the smuggling and the drugs.

622
00:52:13,900 --> 00:52:17,100
The Russian breaks for the murder
that fucking killed my girls.

623
00:52:17,300 --> 00:52:19,700
We were late on Vondopoulos
and The Greek.

624
00:52:19,800 --> 00:52:21,900
-How late?
-They skipped.

625
00:52:22,000 --> 00:52:25,700
We got interstate flight warrants out,
but from what the Sobotka kid says...

626
00:52:25,800 --> 00:52:27,100
these guys collect passports.

627
00:52:27,200 --> 00:52:30,000
We ain't even got a name
for The Greek yet, right?

628
00:52:30,500 --> 00:52:32,600
What're we doing
with the drug end of the case?

629
00:52:32,700 --> 00:52:35,700
I guess we could offer up Dixon
and Prop Joe to Narcotics.

630
00:52:35,800 --> 00:52:38,200
See if they want
to follow through on their end.

631
00:52:38,300 --> 00:52:39,500
I don't know.

632
00:52:39,600 --> 00:52:42,700
I wouldn't be so quick
to throw Joe back into the pond.

633
00:52:43,700 --> 00:52:47,500
A major case squad could have some fun
with that mess, don't you think?

634
00:53:01,900 --> 00:53:03,200
Lieutenant.

635
00:53:07,700 --> 00:53:09,500
I never told you this.

636
00:53:10,300 --> 00:53:13,300
In fact, if you tell anyone
I ever told you this...

637
00:53:13,400 --> 00:53:16,700
I'll finish my career
in fucking Montana or some shit.

638
00:53:18,200 --> 00:53:19,600
Excuse me, sorry.

639
00:53:23,500 --> 00:53:25,600
The leak wasn't your people.

640
00:53:26,400 --> 00:53:29,500
When I called around
looking for info on your targets...

641
00:53:29,600 --> 00:53:32,100
I used the FedCom software, you know?

642
00:53:32,500 --> 00:53:35,700
I thought I was talking
to some fuck in San Diego.

643
00:53:35,900 --> 00:53:38,000
The 9/11 boys in D.C.

644
00:53:39,000 --> 00:53:42,100
I'm guessing Vondopoulos
or The Greek was an asset to them.

645
00:53:42,200 --> 00:53:44,900
Hooked up like, I don't know,
who knows what?

646
00:53:52,100 --> 00:53:53,700
I'm sorry, Lieutenant.

647
00:54:03,800 --> 00:54:06,100
World just keeps turning, right?

648
00:54:07,000 --> 00:54:10,400
You guys move on to something new.
No one looks back.

649
00:54:16,600 --> 00:54:18,400
It's on me this time.

650
00:54:21,200 --> 00:54:22,400
Anyone?

651
00:54:43,300 --> 00:54:45,000
Where are you going?

652
00:54:45,900 --> 00:54:47,000
Work.

653
00:55:12,700 --> 00:55:14,600
Frank, you cocksucker.

654
00:55:34,000 --> 00:55:36,500
-I can take it from here.
-You sure?

655
00:55:36,800 --> 00:55:39,200
No one fucks with us on our turf.

656
00:56:02,900 --> 00:56:06,000
Where the fuck else am I gonna go?
How's it looking?

657
00:56:06,100 --> 00:56:09,600
One ROIRO at North Point.
Graybeards grabbed that.

658
00:56:10,200 --> 00:56:12,200
Nothing else today, really.

659
00:56:12,600 --> 00:56:14,100
Seniority sucks.

660
00:56:14,700 --> 00:56:16,400
If you ain't senior.

661
00:56:18,700 --> 00:56:20,200
All right, man.

662
00:58:16,600 --> 00:58:18,700
This is a great day for Baltimore.



## S03E08

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:09,442 --> 00:00:12,741
Tengo rojos, amigo.
Dos por uno, dos por uno.

2
00:00:12,912 --> 00:00:15,779
Tengo Rasheed y Beno. Rasheed y Beno.

3
00:00:16,516 --> 00:00:18,347
Ponle hielo en las bolas.

4
00:00:18,451 --> 00:00:21,318
Comprobado, siempre funciona.

5
00:00:21,421 --> 00:00:23,753
¿Dónde vamos a conseguir hielo por aquí?

6
00:00:24,424 --> 00:00:28,087
- Llévalo a Bon Secours.
- Rasheed y Beno. Rasheed y Beno...

7
00:00:33,033 --> 00:00:36,366
- ¿Nos das 1l8?
- 1l8, ¿no?

8
00:00:37,804 --> 00:00:39,567
¿Cómo estás hoy?

9
00:00:39,672 --> 00:00:42,232
Sin ofensas, sólo quiero 1l8.

10
00:00:42,542 --> 00:00:44,339
De acuerdo. Sólo quería ser social.

11
00:00:44,444 --> 00:00:46,275
Aquí está.

12
00:00:48,648 --> 00:00:49,774
Gracias.

13
00:00:50,483 --> 00:00:54,510
¿Oíste que robaron
la joyería Mack Man anoche?

14
00:00:54,621 --> 00:00:57,215
Conseguí toda esta mierda
en aquella casa.

15
00:00:57,323 --> 00:01:00,554
Hay que moverla rápido. 15% de su valor.

16
00:01:00,660 --> 00:01:04,994
Si quieren diamantes,
vayan y digan que Rafik los envía.

17
00:01:05,498 --> 00:01:08,661
Encendedores, pipas, fósforos.
Pipas, encendedores.

18
00:01:08,868 --> 00:01:11,496
Tengo lo que necesitas.
Aquí mismo, pipas.

19
00:01:11,938 --> 00:01:15,738
Rojos. Dos por uno, dos por uno.

20
00:01:17,343 --> 00:01:19,538
Pregúntame si está cargada, perra.

21
00:01:22,682 --> 00:01:24,650
Rojos, amigo, dos por uno.

22
00:01:28,922 --> 00:01:31,356
- ¿Hay algo?
- Sólo un buen paquete.

23
00:01:31,825 --> 00:01:33,053
Tres sobredosis.

24
00:01:33,159 --> 00:01:36,253
El otro tampoco lucía bien
hasta que llegó la ambulancia.

25
00:01:45,705 --> 00:01:46,933
Mierda.

26
00:01:47,207 --> 00:01:48,504
Soy policía.

27
00:01:51,444 --> 00:01:53,002
Hay más adentro, Carv.

28
00:01:53,947 --> 00:01:54,936
¡Mierda!

29
00:01:55,048 --> 00:01:58,711
¿No se puede conseguir un puto policía
cuando se lo necesita?

30
00:02:04,891 --> 00:02:06,085
DETECTIVE
POLICÍA DE LA CIUDAD DE BALTIMORE

31
00:02:06,192 --> 00:02:07,250
LA ESCUCHA

32
00:02:34,921 --> 00:02:37,754
DEPTO. DE POLICÍA DE BALTIMORE
ANÁLISIS INFORMÁTICO

33
00:02:50,770 --> 00:02:53,238
ESTADO DE MARYLAND
AUTORIZACIÓN DE ESCUCHAS

34
00:02:59,345 --> 00:03:01,745
BALTIMUERTES, MORTALANDIA

35
00:03:34,113 --> 00:03:37,913
<i>"Gatea, camina y después corre. "
- Clay Davis</i>

36
00:03:39,452 --> 00:03:40,942
De acuerdo, ¿en ese prepago?

37
00:03:41,054 --> 00:03:43,352
Llamé a Trac, le di el número de serie.

38
00:03:43,456 --> 00:03:45,981
Trac Corporation me dijo
que lo enviaron a Northland...

39
00:03:46,092 --> 00:03:47,457
...una empresa de compras.

40
00:03:47,560 --> 00:03:51,462
Northland dice que lo enviaron
a su centro de distribución en Hagerstown.

41
00:03:51,564 --> 00:03:54,863
Hagerstown dice que lo enviaron
al Mondo Mart de Buddy...

42
00:03:54,968 --> 00:03:59,234
...en la calle Propane, nÃºmero 1440,
Falls Church, Virginia.

43
00:03:59,472 --> 00:04:01,736
De ahí salió a la calle.

44
00:04:01,841 --> 00:04:02,830
¿Qué?

45
00:04:02,942 --> 00:04:07,276
¿Buddy los exhibía a la derecha o a la
izquierda de la caja registradora?

46
00:04:08,248 --> 00:04:10,113
¿Cómo voy a saberlo?

47
00:04:13,953 --> 00:04:15,147
De acuerdo.

48
00:04:15,255 --> 00:04:18,247
Sobre los números
en la memoria del teléfono...

49
00:04:18,358 --> 00:04:19,825
...tenemos un número local.

50
00:04:19,926 --> 00:04:22,292
Uno es el número de la
abuela de Bodie...

51
00:04:22,395 --> 00:04:23,692
...en la calle Baltimore Oeste...

52
00:04:23,796 --> 00:04:26,162
...y otros seis números asignados...

53
00:04:26,266 --> 00:04:28,427
a celulares prepagos de Trac.

54
00:04:28,534 --> 00:04:31,503
Esos teléfonos fueron comprados
fuera de la ciudad.

55
00:04:31,604 --> 00:04:35,973
En Catonsville, Laurel, Bethesda...

56
00:04:36,075 --> 00:04:37,906
...y comercios en Virginia...

57
00:04:38,011 --> 00:04:41,572
...en Springfield, Dumfries y Lakeside.

58
00:04:42,148 --> 00:04:46,744
Todos sobre la I-95,
desde aquí hasta casi Richmond.

59
00:04:47,654 --> 00:04:51,750
Conducen casi 320 kilómetros
cada dos semanas por precaución.

60
00:04:51,858 --> 00:04:53,348
Es hermoso.

61
00:04:55,828 --> 00:04:57,295
¿Qué cosa?

62
00:04:58,831 --> 00:05:00,162
La disciplina.

63
00:05:03,336 --> 00:05:04,735
¿Alguna vez pensaste...

64
00:05:04,837 --> 00:05:08,238
...que volverías a ver
Mount y Fayette así?

65
00:05:08,508 --> 00:05:10,373
No son revendedores.

66
00:05:10,476 --> 00:05:12,239
Son pájaros cantando.

67
00:05:12,345 --> 00:05:15,610
- ¿Cómo?
- Te mostraré.

68
00:05:16,449 --> 00:05:18,747
Dijiste sin armas,
sin fuerza, sin intimidación.

69
00:05:18,851 --> 00:05:20,284
Debes estar más allá de eso.

70
00:05:20,386 --> 00:05:22,980
Dijiste que debía ser
como el Jardín del Edén.

71
00:05:23,089 --> 00:05:26,684
- Servir y proteger, hijos de puta.
- Llámalo injusticia poética.

72
00:05:26,793 --> 00:05:28,055
Quiero hacer una denuncia.

73
00:05:28,161 --> 00:05:29,822
- ¿Qué dices?
- Me oíste.

74
00:05:29,929 --> 00:05:32,898
¿Quieres denunciar
que estabas vendiendo drogas...

75
00:05:32,999 --> 00:05:35,433
- ... y alguien se llevó tu dinero?
- Mierda, sí.

76
00:05:42,275 --> 00:05:44,140
- Aquí.
- ¿Fredericksburg?

77
00:05:44,410 --> 00:05:46,571
¿Van hasta allí a comprar celulares?

78
00:05:46,679 --> 00:05:48,909
Uno aquí, dos allá.
Nada de compras al por mayor.

79
00:05:49,015 --> 00:05:51,677
Descartan teléfonos cada dos semanas...

80
00:05:51,784 --> 00:05:55,049
...y les preocupa que los intervengamos.

81
00:05:55,154 --> 00:05:59,022
Que seas paranoico no implica que
no haya alguien detrás de ti, ¿verdad?

82
00:05:59,726 --> 00:06:02,786
Me gustaría saber quién está comprando
esos celulares.

83
00:06:06,933 --> 00:06:08,025
Yo conduzco.

84
00:06:31,124 --> 00:06:33,456
¿Te interesa, viejo?

85
00:06:33,726 --> 00:06:35,956
Tienen razón en algo, ¿verdad?

86
00:06:36,062 --> 00:06:38,292
Es decir,
les decimos que vengan aquí sin armas...

87
00:06:38,398 --> 00:06:40,263
...y luego fallamos en protegerlos.

88
00:06:40,366 --> 00:06:42,129
Los ladrones hacen que los vendedores...

89
00:06:42,235 --> 00:06:44,795
...se sientan vulnerables.

90
00:06:44,904 --> 00:06:48,965
Si ven otra arma, se acabó la paz.

91
00:06:49,409 --> 00:06:50,967
¿Qué estás haciendo al respecto?

92
00:06:51,077 --> 00:06:53,409
Mandé a algunas víctimas
al distrito con Herc.

93
00:06:53,513 --> 00:06:56,505
Que se entretengan armando un perfil,
pero ya sabes lo que pasa.

94
00:06:56,616 --> 00:07:00,677
¿Puedo ser sincero? No son sólo
lobos los que vigilan el corral.

95
00:07:00,987 --> 00:07:03,512
Tenemos 50, 60 chicos adentro...

96
00:07:03,623 --> 00:07:05,386
...inmersos en violencia
desde que nacen...

97
00:07:05,491 --> 00:07:07,459
...y ahora no hacen nada.

98
00:07:07,560 --> 00:07:10,085
Los corredores, los cuidadores.

99
00:07:10,696 --> 00:07:14,257
Esa escoria me preocupa más
que los predadores.

100
00:07:15,034 --> 00:07:19,061
Si quieres anular una amenaza,
dale un empleo.

101
00:07:20,406 --> 00:07:22,840
- ¿Como qué?
- Ayudantes de policía.

102
00:07:23,409 --> 00:07:25,502
Que estén alerta contra los predadores.

103
00:07:25,611 --> 00:07:28,603
¿No haces que los vendedores les paguen
por no hacer nada?

104
00:07:28,714 --> 00:07:31,706
- Matas dos pájaros y todo eso.
- Correcto.

105
00:07:31,818 --> 00:07:34,150
Dales unas bicicletas,
tal vez unos radios.

106
00:07:34,253 --> 00:07:38,349
- Eso se puede hacer.
- No hablaba... ¿Hablas en serio?

107
00:07:38,724 --> 00:07:41,215
¿Qué diablos hiciste aquí?

108
00:07:42,428 --> 00:07:44,726
Armas de destrucción masiva. Tengo ADM.

109
00:07:49,268 --> 00:07:50,633
Hola, ¿cómo estás?

110
00:07:50,736 --> 00:07:53,466
Buscamos a un tipo que vino aquí
hace como 10 u 11 días...

111
00:07:53,573 --> 00:07:55,734
...compró dos teléfonos prepagos
en efectivo.

112
00:07:55,842 --> 00:07:57,935
- ¿Hace diez u once días?
- Sí.

113
00:07:58,044 --> 00:08:01,445
- Probablemente negro.
- Eso sí que es ser específico.

114
00:08:01,781 --> 00:08:04,443
¿Qué te parece si vemos
tus videos de seguridad?

115
00:08:04,550 --> 00:08:06,040
¿De hace diez días?

116
00:08:06,152 --> 00:08:09,815
Si no pasa algo en especial,
reutilizamos las cintas cada semana.

117
00:08:09,922 --> 00:08:12,720
- ¿Cada semana?
- Política de Mondo Mart.

118
00:08:13,593 --> 00:08:15,117
Eso salió bien.

119
00:08:16,429 --> 00:08:18,522
- ¿Aló?
<I>- Briana Barksdale te llamó.</I>

120
00:08:18,631 --> 00:08:21,532
- ¿Quién?
<I>- La madre de D'Angelo Barksdale.</I>

121
00:08:21,801 --> 00:08:24,395
- ¿Tienes su número?
<I>- ¿Tienes para anotar?</I>

122
00:08:25,738 --> 00:08:29,731
<i>410-718-9433. ¿Lo anotaste?</i>

123
00:08:30,877 --> 00:08:31,901
Bien.

124
00:08:32,011 --> 00:08:33,478
<I>- ¿Vas a llamarla?</I>
- No lo sé.

125
00:08:33,579 --> 00:08:35,877
<I>- Es toda tuya.</I>
- Gracias, Jay.

126
00:08:35,982 --> 00:08:37,449
Mira esto.

127
00:08:37,550 --> 00:08:41,316
Mondo Mart, Mondo Mart, Mondo Mart,
Mondo Mart. Estamos cagados.

128
00:08:41,420 --> 00:08:45,288
Hasta que llegamos aquí.
BaBa Jani Comidas, Dumfries, Virginia.

129
00:08:45,858 --> 00:08:50,192
¿Vamos a viajar 160 kilómetros a ver
si este tipo tiene memoria o una cámara?

130
00:08:50,296 --> 00:08:54,255
¿Realmente quieres volver a casa
temprano y decepcionar a Lester Freamon?

131
00:08:55,401 --> 00:08:56,800
¿Quién llamó?

132
00:08:56,903 --> 00:09:00,464
Adivina quién llama a Homicidios
y me busca por lo de D'Angelo Barksdale.

133
00:09:00,573 --> 00:09:02,200
- Su madre.
- ¿Sí?

134
00:09:02,308 --> 00:09:04,640
Mierda, había olvidado
que quise ese caso.

135
00:09:04,744 --> 00:09:06,712
Ahora llama con preguntas.

136
00:09:06,812 --> 00:09:08,871
Una pérdida de su tiempo y el mío.

137
00:09:10,883 --> 00:09:13,010
Como este viaje.

138
00:09:19,458 --> 00:09:21,187
Se ve natural.

139
00:09:24,697 --> 00:09:26,665
El hijo de puta de Marlo.

140
00:09:27,733 --> 00:09:30,531
Vamos a tener que ponernos serios
con este negro.

141
00:09:33,739 --> 00:09:38,472
Parece que lo único que cambia
es que pierdo dinero.

142
00:09:38,578 --> 00:09:41,775
¿Dónde está mi permiso, el de
los hijos de puta de la Preservación?

143
00:09:41,881 --> 00:09:44,873
- ¿Mi derecho de paso, mis permisos?
- Espera, espera.

144
00:09:44,984 --> 00:09:46,952
Todo está por salir.

145
00:09:47,053 --> 00:09:50,545
Tenemos los inspectores
de plomería y electricidad mañana...

146
00:09:50,656 --> 00:09:52,521
...el martes vienen los bomberos...

147
00:09:52,625 --> 00:09:55,992
y eso es todo, String, estará listo.

148
00:09:56,596 --> 00:09:59,895
Y, de paso, felicitaciones.

149
00:10:00,933 --> 00:10:03,094
Eres un contratista de la minoría...

150
00:10:03,202 --> 00:10:05,898
...para proveer bombillas
al Consejo de Educación...

151
00:10:06,005 --> 00:10:07,666
...de la Ciudad de Baltimore.

152
00:10:08,674 --> 00:10:10,869
¿Qué carajo sé yo de bombillas, amigo?

153
00:10:10,977 --> 00:10:14,435
¿Sabes poner las palabras
en una hoja membretada de B&B?

154
00:10:14,547 --> 00:10:18,142
Vamos, amigo, relájate,
el blanco está haciendo todo el trabajo.

155
00:10:18,317 --> 00:10:20,649
Sólo eres su fachada para el subsidio.

156
00:10:20,987 --> 00:10:24,684
Son $5.000 más al mes por relajarse
en un lugar seguro.

157
00:10:25,057 --> 00:10:26,456
¿Ves cómo funciona?

158
00:10:26,559 --> 00:10:31,155
Voy a llevarte, String, pero
no puede ser de un día para el otro.

159
00:10:31,864 --> 00:10:34,424
Pasamos este año tratando
con la ciudad...

160
00:10:34,533 --> 00:10:37,297
...el próximo, con el estado.

161
00:10:37,503 --> 00:10:39,903
¿Qué pasa el tercer año?

162
00:10:40,640 --> 00:10:44,974
Vamos por el oro. Vamos por el país.

163
00:10:45,077 --> 00:10:48,478
Veremos al hombre que maneja el grifo.

164
00:10:48,581 --> 00:10:53,382
- ¿Qué grifo?
- $$ del Dpto. de Vivienda y Desarrollo.

165
00:10:53,486 --> 00:10:56,785
Amigo, no sé por qué debemos esperar
tres años por esta mierda.

166
00:10:56,889 --> 00:11:00,222
- Estoy listo ahora.
- No lo estás.

167
00:11:01,193 --> 00:11:02,660
Quiero decir, perdóname...

168
00:11:02,762 --> 00:11:06,323
...pero todavía tienes
la mentalidad de las calles.

169
00:11:06,432 --> 00:11:08,662
Quejándote por cada
centavo que gastas...

170
00:11:08,768 --> 00:11:12,363
...en los permisos,
en crear un Comité de Acción Política...

171
00:11:12,471 --> 00:11:16,134
...en hacer donaciones
a los fondos electorales...

172
00:11:16,509 --> 00:11:19,307
...que, de paso,
es como conseguí mi pago.

173
00:11:19,845 --> 00:11:22,177
Se necesita dinero
para ganar dinero, String...

174
00:11:22,281 --> 00:11:24,749
...de otro modo, todo mendigo sería rey.

175
00:11:24,850 --> 00:11:28,251
Y yo digo que estoy listo.

176
00:11:28,587 --> 00:11:29,918
Tres años.

177
00:11:30,022 --> 00:11:35,153
Gatea, camina y después corre.

178
00:11:35,695 --> 00:11:38,960
- No, hombre, tenía más rulos.
- Sí, sí.

179
00:11:39,065 --> 00:11:42,125
Y los ojos... Tenía ojos como habas.

180
00:11:43,069 --> 00:11:45,264
¿Qué carajo son ojos como habas?

181
00:11:45,671 --> 00:11:50,608
- Ya sabes, como los de las ratas.
- Sí, está bien. Ponle un lunar ahí.

182
00:11:51,143 --> 00:11:53,407
- No tenía un lunar.
- Sí tenía.

183
00:11:53,512 --> 00:11:56,606
Estabas muy ocupado cagándote encima
con el arma en tu cabeza...

184
00:11:56,716 --> 00:11:59,617
- ... para ver al hijo de puta.
- Mierda, sí que lo vi.

185
00:12:00,486 --> 00:12:04,445
- ¿Cómo sabes cómo hacerlo?
- ¿Cómo no sabes hacerlo?

186
00:12:05,224 --> 00:12:06,623
Que sus orejas sobresalgan.

187
00:12:06,726 --> 00:12:08,557
- ¿Por qué?
- Porque yo lo digo.

188
00:12:10,629 --> 00:12:13,996
Mierda, bien. Dale ojos claros.

189
00:12:14,266 --> 00:12:16,757
- ¿Por qué?
- Porque yo lo digo.

190
00:12:18,771 --> 00:12:21,001
¿Puedes hacer que se crucen?

191
00:12:23,709 --> 00:12:24,835
Esto está bueno.

192
00:12:24,944 --> 00:12:28,038
Mira a estos idiotas armando el perfil.

193
00:12:29,782 --> 00:12:30,749
Deja eso.

194
00:12:32,685 --> 00:12:34,175
Sí, espera.

195
00:12:35,121 --> 00:12:36,918
- Hermano, te digo...
- Al carajo...

196
00:12:37,022 --> 00:12:38,319
...que no se trata de eso.

197
00:12:38,424 --> 00:12:41,325
Estoy intentando hacer
que se pueda vivir en mi distrito.

198
00:12:41,427 --> 00:12:45,363
Doy por perdidas un par de cuadras,
pero salvo el resto.

199
00:12:45,464 --> 00:12:47,955
No quiero ofender,
estás como el ciego con el elefante.

200
00:12:48,067 --> 00:12:50,058
Es más grande
que lo que tu mano percibe...

201
00:12:50,169 --> 00:12:52,160
- ... simplemente no lo ves.
- ¿Ver qué?

202
00:12:52,271 --> 00:12:55,172
Un pueblo de problemas
y tú eres el alcalde.

203
00:12:56,408 --> 00:12:58,376
¿Dónde está el agua potable?

204
00:12:58,477 --> 00:13:01,844
¿Los baños, la calefacción,
la electricidad?

205
00:13:03,182 --> 00:13:04,945
¿Dónde está el camión con las agujas...

206
00:13:05,050 --> 00:13:08,542
...la distribución de preservativos,
el tratamiento contra la droga?

207
00:13:08,687 --> 00:13:10,416
La mitad de la gente se muere...

208
00:13:10,523 --> 00:13:12,491
...y el resto se contagiará
lo que los mata.

209
00:13:12,591 --> 00:13:16,049
No están peor
que cuando estaban por todos lados.

210
00:13:16,162 --> 00:13:19,529
- Ahora están en un solo lugar.
- Y ese lugar es el infierno.

211
00:13:28,841 --> 00:13:30,604
Mira, soy policía.

212
00:13:30,709 --> 00:13:34,440
Puedo encerrar a un hombre
o sacar su trasero de una esquina.

213
00:13:35,748 --> 00:13:39,650
Si quieres algo más,
estás en el lugar equivocado.

214
00:13:41,187 --> 00:13:44,384
Que su pelo sea un poco más lacio.

215
00:13:44,623 --> 00:13:47,091
Largo, con flequillo.

216
00:13:47,860 --> 00:13:50,226
Sí, así.

217
00:13:50,329 --> 00:13:53,059
Achínale los ojos, como Beyoncé.

218
00:13:53,365 --> 00:13:57,699
- Súbele las mejillas un poco.
- No, es demasiado.

219
00:13:57,803 --> 00:14:00,203
Parece un plato con pelo.

220
00:14:00,306 --> 00:14:03,173
- Espera.
- Sí, está bien.

221
00:14:03,275 --> 00:14:07,405
- Agrándale los labios un poco.
- Quiero una cita con ella.

222
00:14:08,547 --> 00:14:10,708
Sí.

223
00:14:10,816 --> 00:14:13,341
¿Tienes algo para diseñarle el culo?

224
00:14:15,054 --> 00:14:18,387
- ¿Qué?
- Sí, eso.

225
00:14:22,828 --> 00:14:23,988
BaBa Jani - COMIDAS

226
00:14:24,096 --> 00:14:25,427
Hola, amigos.

227
00:14:26,899 --> 00:14:29,766
¿Qué tal?
Buscamos una compra en efectivo.

228
00:14:29,869 --> 00:14:33,396
Un par de teléfonos Trac.
Hace algo más de una semana. Un negro.

229
00:14:33,505 --> 00:14:36,030
Sí, seguro, ese tipo.
Viene cada dos semanas.

230
00:14:36,141 --> 00:14:39,201
La última vez compró ocho teléfonos.
Casi $900.

231
00:14:39,511 --> 00:14:41,479
Son muchos ring ring, ¿no?

232
00:14:42,248 --> 00:14:44,113
- ¿Ring ring?
- Un chiste.

233
00:14:48,854 --> 00:14:51,618
¿Tienes algún comprobante
de la transacción?

234
00:14:57,196 --> 00:14:59,130
Busquen y encontrarán.

235
00:15:00,499 --> 00:15:01,727
Espera.

236
00:15:02,034 --> 00:15:03,626
Espera.

237
00:15:06,171 --> 00:15:09,106
$927,24.

238
00:15:09,508 --> 00:15:13,467
- ¿Podemos ver el video de ese día?
- No. Lo rebobino todos los días.

239
00:15:17,416 --> 00:15:19,475
- ¿Puedo quedarme con esto?
- Seguro.

240
00:15:19,919 --> 00:15:23,787
¿Qué carajo hacemos ahora?
¿Le compramos una caja de cintas?

241
00:15:24,189 --> 00:15:28,148
¿O acampamos aquí una semana esperando
que vuelva por el mismo camino?

242
00:15:34,166 --> 00:15:35,224
COOPERATIVA DE COMIDA

243
00:15:35,334 --> 00:15:37,802
Sólo sé que debo hacer algo
o volveré a caer.

244
00:15:37,903 --> 00:15:40,463
Necesito controlarme, ¿me entiendes?

245
00:15:40,572 --> 00:15:42,870
- Tomar el control de tu vida.
- Algo.

246
00:15:43,042 --> 00:15:46,034
- Cultivar la autodisciplina.
- Lo que sea.

247
00:15:46,312 --> 00:15:50,078
¿Qué pasaría si te dijera
que hay una cierta liberación...

248
00:15:50,683 --> 00:15:54,278
...no en dirigir o controlar,
sino en entregarse?

249
00:15:54,386 --> 00:15:57,514
Eso depende de a quién te entregues.

250
00:15:59,325 --> 00:16:01,759
Eso. Oye...

251
00:16:01,860 --> 00:16:05,660
...con el debido respeto,
puedes dejar de hablar de eso ahora.

252
00:16:07,266 --> 00:16:10,997
Mira, no se trata de hacer cosas por mí.

253
00:16:11,270 --> 00:16:13,329
Debe ser algo más.

254
00:16:14,306 --> 00:16:17,833
Traes una caída del 2% al mes...

255
00:16:17,943 --> 00:16:20,741
...pero, si entiendo bien,
casi la mitad viene...

256
00:16:20,846 --> 00:16:22,871
...de una baja del 8% en el
Distrito Oeste.

257
00:16:22,982 --> 00:16:26,315
El mayor Colvin está dispuesto a
reconocer la posibilidad...

258
00:16:26,418 --> 00:16:29,819
...de una variación del promedio
en sus estadísticas del mes.

259
00:16:29,922 --> 00:16:31,321
Una variación, ¿no?

260
00:16:33,058 --> 00:16:35,686
Si miro los informes
del incidente del Oeste...

261
00:16:35,794 --> 00:16:38,194
...¿voy a encontrar
menos delitos o más incidentes...

262
00:16:38,297 --> 00:16:40,288
...que han sido degradados o infundados?

263
00:16:40,399 --> 00:16:43,960
Porque este tipo de variación
me suena a manipulación...

264
00:16:44,069 --> 00:16:47,095
...y si me equivoco,
si no hubo manipulación...

265
00:16:47,206 --> 00:16:49,367
...quisiera saber qué es
lo que el mayor Colvin...

266
00:16:49,475 --> 00:16:52,239
...aprendió sobre el trabajo
que los demás parecen no entender.

267
00:16:52,344 --> 00:16:55,006
Le aseguro que estas estadísticas
no han sido manipuladas.

268
00:16:55,114 --> 00:16:56,547
No hacemos eso.

269
00:16:56,648 --> 00:16:59,617
Yo no lo hago.
Y no permito que mi gente lo haga.

270
00:16:59,718 --> 00:17:02,585
Sentimos que es una aberración.

271
00:17:02,688 --> 00:17:05,282
Y si se repite el mes que viene...

272
00:17:05,424 --> 00:17:07,551
...requerirá una mayor investigación.
Si no...

273
00:17:07,659 --> 00:17:10,753
Otro tema, entonces.
¿Cómo estamos con asistencia al testigo?

274
00:17:10,863 --> 00:17:14,094
¿Hay fondos para asegurar
la seguridad antes del juicio...

275
00:17:14,199 --> 00:17:16,064
...a los testigos en peligro?

276
00:17:17,870 --> 00:17:21,863
Tenemos los recursos
de los que puede disponer la ciudad.

277
00:17:21,974 --> 00:17:24,238
Entiendo que no pueda criticar
al Alcalde.

278
00:17:24,343 --> 00:17:27,039
- Ni lo haría.
- Ni lo haría.

279
00:17:28,080 --> 00:17:31,538
Permítame hacer una pregunta. ¿Cuánto
está dispuesta a pagar la ciudad...

280
