on this camera if it comes back.

197
00:12:40,294 --> 00:12:41,571
No questions asked.

198
00:12:41,823 --> 00:12:42,943
500?

199
00:12:43,023 --> 00:12:44,388
Swear to God.
I'm good for it

200
00:12:44,428 --> 00:12:45,903
if it's the right camera.

201
00:12:47,307 --> 00:12:49,055
Here's the model
and serial number.

202
00:12:49,981 --> 00:12:52,696
So it's 500 for the camera
and a chicken box for Bubs, huh?

203
00:12:52,756 --> 00:12:55,103
It's another hundred to you
if this happens.

204
00:12:55,313 --> 00:12:57,379
But I need this camera quick,
or shit's gonna fly.

205
00:12:57,459 --> 00:12:58,546
Look, man.

206
00:12:58,626 --> 00:13:00,936
I told you, it's not about
the money for me right now.

207
00:13:01,114 --> 00:13:04,001
All right? This motherfucker,
He messing with my livelihood here.

208
00:13:04,112 --> 00:13:06,119
They're always coming back,
always.

209
00:13:06,838 --> 00:13:08,376
He's like some Terminator and shit.

210
00:13:08,425 --> 00:13:09,436
I'm with you.

211
00:13:09,503 --> 00:13:12,153
I'm gonna do everything I can
to help you out with your problem,

212
00:13:12,193 --> 00:13:13,984
and you're gonna help me out
with mine.

213
00:13:25,394 --> 00:13:26,685
Who the fuck is Randy?

214
00:13:27,286 --> 00:13:29,451
He's a little hopper
from around the way.

215
00:13:30,162 --> 00:13:32,569
He ain't in the game,
but he be with Michael and them.

216
00:13:32,881 --> 00:13:34,236
And he talking to police?

217
00:13:34,376 --> 00:13:36,163
I know it.
I know he did,

218
00:13:36,202 --> 00:13:37,414
because he was the one I told,

219
00:13:37,454 --> 00:13:38,944
"Go tell Lex
to go up to the alley.

220
00:13:39,004 --> 00:13:40,067
Patrice is waiting."

221
00:13:40,353 --> 00:13:41,545
You were supposed to do that.

222
00:13:41,584 --> 00:13:42,835
Yeah, I know, but this way,

223
00:13:43,172 --> 00:13:46,073
try to keep some distance
between me and Lex, right?

224
00:13:49,988 --> 00:13:51,975
You tell Randy
what happened to Lex?

225
00:13:52,638 --> 00:13:54,386
No, I swear it.

226
00:14:00,463 --> 00:14:03,100
Go, motherfucker.
The fuck you still waiting for?

227
00:14:09,837 --> 00:14:11,377
What the fuck y'all
following me for?

228
00:14:11,446 --> 00:14:12,499
Easy, son.

229
00:14:12,578 --> 00:14:14,823
No. Ain't nobody
walking with me nowhere.

230
00:14:37,935 --> 00:14:39,143
What's up with this Randy?

231
00:14:39,242 --> 00:14:40,447
He can't hurt us.

232
00:14:40,526 --> 00:14:41,878
He a snitch, though.

233
00:14:42,240 --> 00:14:43,766
Yeah. Put that around, then.

234
00:14:43,868 --> 00:14:44,898
Slim.

235
00:14:45,198 --> 00:14:46,265
Marlo.

236
00:14:46,662 --> 00:14:47,655
How you feeling?

237
00:14:47,734 --> 00:14:48,907
Can't complain, yo.

238
00:14:49,791 --> 00:14:51,638
Getting to be that time, though.

239
00:14:52,780 --> 00:14:54,866
Joe wanted me to check in,
you know?

240
00:14:55,697 --> 00:14:57,897
All right. Pull up a chair
and shop it up.

241
00:15:00,029 --> 00:15:01,917
Now, that there a Barksdale boy.

242
00:15:03,116 --> 00:15:04,328
So?

243
00:15:06,275 --> 00:15:07,447
Don't add up.

244
00:15:09,697 --> 00:15:10,864
Interesting, though.

245
00:15:29,654 --> 00:15:30,945
Got a burner, see?

246
00:15:32,149 --> 00:15:33,997
If anything else comes up,
you call me.

247

502
00:28:23,480 --> 00:28:25,249
No shit, you were sloppy.

503
00:28:26,606 --> 00:28:29,199
I actually went back a couple
weeks on your run sheets.

504
00:28:30,104 --> 00:28:32,533
Nothing there references
a meet with a C.I. 238.

505
00:28:32,855 --> 00:28:35,290
- You went through all my run sheets?
- The best I could.

506
00:28:38,836 --> 00:28:40,523
- Sir, listen--
- I don't care who it is.

507
00:28:40,562 --> 00:28:41,754
Turn that fucking thing off.

508
00:28:45,121 --> 00:28:46,882
I am starting to believe

509
00:28:47,359 --> 00:28:51,869
that this fuzzy fella
doesn't exist.

510
00:28:53,926 --> 00:28:55,459
I am starting to believe

511
00:28:55,618 --> 00:28:58,964
that you just followed Stanfield
into the train station

512
00:28:59,384 --> 00:29:02,026
and grabbed the first broad
he brushed up against.

513
00:29:02,915 --> 00:29:03,955
That what happened?

514
00:29:03,995 --> 00:29:05,431
No. No, sir.

515
00:29:05,706 --> 00:29:06,912
You lie to me now, Sergeant,

516
00:29:06,952 --> 00:29:09,396
and I guaran-fucking-tee you
I will jam you up,

517
00:29:09,416 --> 00:29:11,059
ship this whole mess to I.I.D.

518
00:29:11,060 --> 00:29:13,525
and be there to pass out
sandwiches at your execution.

519
00:29:13,664 --> 00:29:14,674
Yes, sir.

520
00:29:14,714 --> 00:29:17,853
You haven't brought me
a case yet worth talking about.

521
00:29:18,289 --> 00:29:20,574
Not on Marlo Stanfield,
not on anyone.

522
00:29:21,796 --> 00:29:25,571
You bring me something
other than I.I.D. Complaints,

523
00:29:26,266 --> 00:29:29,226
and I might have some reason
to let a few things slide.

524
00:29:32,104 --> 00:29:33,117
Mad at me?

525
00:29:35,585 --> 00:29:37,196
Dukie's just mad
at everything.

526
00:29:39,229 --> 00:29:40,663
Snitch bitch.

527
00:29:42,174 --> 00:29:43,545
Yo, what the fuck was that?

528
00:29:44,402 --> 00:29:45,574
I don't know.

529
00:30:03,264 --> 00:30:05,023
I can't believe
y'all are doing this shit.

530
00:30:05,063 --> 00:30:07,429
You're degrading the quality
of life in this neighborhood.

531
00:30:07,770 --> 00:30:09,796
- Malt liquor.
- Oh, come on, man!

532
00:30:10,077 --> 00:30:12,203
Brother, you got to shake hands
with a pilsner,

533
00:30:12,362 --> 00:30:14,193
maybe a nice tail ale.

534
00:30:14,253 --> 00:30:16,075
Hell, what-- Oh, man!
My brew!

535
00:30:16,274 --> 00:30:17,361
My shoes!

536
00:30:17,750 --> 00:30:18,964
God! Man.

537
00:30:19,202 --> 00:30:20,489
What's the violation?

538
00:30:20,608 --> 00:30:23,094
Parking in a bus stop,
expired registration.

539
00:30:23,411 --> 00:30:24,885
First-Class police work, baker.

540
00:30:25,163 --> 00:30:27,294
Yeah, well, this is the word
from up on high,

541
00:30:27,569 --> 00:30:29,375
straight from the eighth floor downtown.

542
00:30:29,514 --> 00:30:32,061
Blessed bosses juking stats
for the new administration.

543
00:30:32,240 --> 00:30:33,506
I know you think it's bullshit,

544
00:30:33,565 --> 00:30:35,493
but I spend my shift
where they tell me.

545
00:30:36,169 --> 00:30:38,155
Baker, let me tell you
a little secret.

546
00:30:38,747 --> 00:30:42,710
A patrolling officer on his beat
is the one true dictatorship in America.

547
00:30:43,250 --> 00:30:44,991
We can lock a guy up on a humble;

548
00:30:45,071 --> 00:30:46,342
we can lock him up for real;

549
00:30:46,382 --> 00:30:47,760
or we can say, fuck it,

550
00:30:47,957 --> 00:30:50,593
pull under the expressway,
and drink ourselves to death.

551
00:30:50,885 --> 00:30:52,726
And our side partners
will cover it.

552
00:30:53,057 --> 00:30:57,150
So no one, and I mean no one,
tells us how to waste our shift.

553
00:31:00,084 --> 00:31:02,065
Pulled the reports
on those church burglaries.

554
00:31:02,104 --> 00:31:03,138
Yeah?

555
00:31:03,178 --> 00:31:04,450
Yeah. There's a pattern.

556
00:31:06,144 --> 00:31:07,515
Times and locations.

557
00:31:08,120 --> 00:31:11,219
They're working west by northwest
through Sandtown-Winchester.

558
00:31:11,930 --> 00:31:13,430
The last 3--
Here, here, and here--

559
00:31:13,477 --> 00:31:15,612
these ones in blue
are the churches they haven't hit

560
00:31:15,649 --> 00:31:16,844
closest to the ones they have.

561
00:31:16,868 --> 00:31:18,604
You got all this
from the incident reports?

562
00:31:18,644 --> 00:31:20,074
That's why we do the paperwork.

563
00:31:24,431 --> 00:31:26,392
Are you out of your motherfucking mind?

564
00:31:26,756 --> 00:31:27,967
I live here, man!

565
00:31:28,200 --> 00:31:29,559
This could get out of hand.

566
00:31:29,810 --> 00:31:31,638
That's what we want, isn't it?
More arrests?

567
00:31:31,678 --> 00:31:32,750
Come on.

568
00:31:40,751 --> 00:31:42,301
No justice, no peace.

569
00:31:51,893 --> 00:31:53,101
It'll only be for tonight.

570
00:31:53,280 --> 00:31:55,391
Mama gets back from New York tomorrow.

571
00:31:58,176 --> 00:31:59,257
Your call.

572
00:32:03,908 --> 00:32:05,955
The young man seems
to think highly of you, boss.

573
00:32:06,034 --> 00:32:08,498
He invoked your name
with a measure of respect.

574
00:32:09,031 --> 00:32:10,545
It wasn't but a few weeks ago

575
00:32:10,605 --> 00:32:13,981

called everything but a child of God.

576
00:32:14,609 --> 00:32:16,139
"Mr. Colvin, sir.

577
00:32:16,667 --> 00:32:17,760
Fuck you."

578
00:32:18,646 --> 00:32:20,474
Yeah, well, at least
I said, "mister."

579
00:32:27,464 --> 00:32:29,723
- So what was the charge?
- Slinging.

580
00:32:29,849 --> 00:32:31,887
They've been out there
a few weeks or so.

581
00:32:32,046 --> 00:32:34,251
First pop,
second warning from me.

582
00:32:35,746 --> 00:32:37,931
Maybe you should put him
on the juvenile bus.

583
00:32:38,357 --> 00:32:39,946
He wants so bad
to be a gangster,

584
00:32:40,400 --> 00:32:43,501
maybe it's time he get a taste of what
a real lock-up's all about, you know?

585
00:32:43,560 --> 00:32:45,356
Come on, Mr. C.,
don't do me like that.

586
00:32:45,593 --> 00:32:47,789
I made him sleep on the D.E.U.
bench last night,

587
00:32:48,158 --> 00:32:49,688

588
00:32:51,152 --> 00:32:52,443
Isn't there anybody else?

589
00:32:52,956 --> 00:32:54,455
I mean, friend, relative, anybody?

590
00:32:54,791 --> 00:32:56,996
You've always been good
with the knuckleheads, boss.

591
00:33:05,018 --> 00:33:06,722
All right.
Let me go call my wife.

592
00:33:27,527 --> 00:33:29,321
Yeah.
Go up in that building.

593
00:33:39,745 --> 00:33:40,996
That was delicious.

594
00:33:41,458 --> 00:33:42,504
There's more.

595
00:33:42,742 --> 00:33:44,886
No, ma'am.
Saving room for the cobbler.

596
00:33:45,095 --> 00:33:46,153
A la mode?

597
00:33:47,872 --> 00:33:49,601
Would you like ice cream on it?

598
00:33:51,208 --> 00:33:52,282
Yes, ma'am.

599
00:33:52,679 --> 00:33:53,891
Nice manners.

600
00:33:54,463 --> 00:33:56,847
From what you told me
on the phone, Bunny,

601
00:33:57,240 --> 00:33:59,783
I was expecting
more of an adventure.

602
00:34:08,119 --> 00:34:09,156
Bunny?

603
00:34:09,196 --> 00:34:10,905
Only my friends call me Bunny.

604
00:34:11,325 --> 00:34:12,460
Yeah, but why?

605
00:34:12,698 --> 00:34:14,069
You don't need to know.

606
00:34:16,103 --> 00:34:19,401
And if you tell anybody,
I'll cut your balls off.

607
00:34:22,683 --> 00:34:25,346
I'll cut them off,
give 'em to Donnelly in a jar.

608
00:34:25,760 --> 00:34:27,150
Don't doubt me, boy.

609
00:34:34,079 --> 00:34:35,284
You ain't got no kids?

610
00:34:35,559 --> 00:34:36,649

611

They're at college

612

613
00:34:47,600 --> 00:34:50,103
Thank you, sweetie.
But don't be fooled.

614
00:34:52,060 --> 00:34:53,927
This is his Eddie Haskell act.

615
00:34:55,596 --> 00:34:57,046
Eddie Haskell?
Who that?

616
00:34:58,226 --> 00:35:01,226
You are, son.
Trust me.

617
00:35:03,949 --> 00:35:05,260
Take a seat.

618

619
00:35:08,568 --> 00:35:10,157

620
00:35:10,207 --> 00:35:11,936
No, we need the key

621

622
00:35:14,618 --> 00:35:15,651
Felony?

623
00:35:17,827 --> 00:35:19,859
Caught them coming
out of St. Martin's on Fulton.

624
00:35:19,958 --> 00:35:21,182
Charging them with the one,

625

626
00:35:23,229 --> 00:35:24,366
No shit?

627
00:35:24,702 --> 00:35:27,649
Fucking knew there was still some

628
00:35:30,161 --> 00:35:32,962
Swear to God, I'm seeing

629

We're locking people up
for open container,

630
00:35:35,824 --> 00:35:37,915

631

The neighborhood people,

633

635
00:35:46,695 --> 00:35:48,531

636

637

638
00:35:53,197 --> 00:35:55,048

639
00:35:55,523 --> 00:35:57,037
It's rolling downhill, for sure.

640
00:35:57,136 --> 00:35:59,447
- Morale?
- Split down the middle, I'd say.

641
00:35:59,645 --> 00:36:01,472

642

The rest of you?

643
00:36:03,225 --> 00:36:04,636
We don't know where to turn.

644
00:36:05,058 --> 00:36:07,813
I thought a new hump as mayor
might change this shit,

645
00:36:08,069 --> 00:36:09,213
not ramp it up.

646
00:36:10,824 --> 00:36:12,380
Hey, you still fucking that bitch?

647
00:36:12,913 --> 00:36:14,515
Yeah. It burning like hell, man.

648
00:36:15,383 --> 00:36:17,893

649
00:36:18,880 --> 00:36:20,014
Slim.

650
00:36:20,193 --> 00:36:22,227
- B. What up?
- All right.

651
00:36:22,425 --> 00:36:23,614
- Poot.
- It's good.

652

653
00:36:25,171 --> 00:36:26,263
Yeah.

654
00:36:27,046 --> 00:36:28,060
Welcome home.

655
00:36:28,108 --> 00:36:29,291
Thanks, Dawg.

656
00:36:29,788 --> 00:36:31,477

657

Never would have thought.

658
00:36:33,979 --> 00:36:36,045
Yeah, well, life's strange.

659
00:36:37,455 --> 00:36:39,601

how you and Marlo?

661

662

663

664

665
00:36:54,768 --> 00:36:55,933
Big boy,

666
00:36:56,032 --> 00:36:58,436

Kevin?

669

Chris and Snoop walked him
down an alley.

670

He in a vacant now.

How you know that?

672
00:37:10,445 --> 00:37:12,220
I seen them lay hands on the boy.

673
00:37:13,027 --> 00:37:14,974
And now the word out in the street.

674
00:37:18,781 --> 00:37:19,978
Sorry, Dawg.

675
00:37:24,505 --> 00:37:25,558
Let's roll.

676
00:37:34,884 --> 00:37:37,547
Plymouth rock.
Got that Plymouth rock.

677
00:37:44,268 --> 00:37:45,341
All right.

678
00:37:45,480 --> 00:37:48,942
So now look at the next
example question on page 20.

679
00:37:49,209 --> 00:37:50,443
As you can see...

680
00:37:52,150 --> 00:37:53,909
if you turn to page 20,

681
00:37:53,981 --> 00:37:55,376
they will sometimes ask you

682
00:37:55,443 --> 00:37:58,310

683
00:37:58,920 --> 00:38:00,642
Thank you, Mr. Pryzbylewski.

684
00:38:00,852 --> 00:38:01,925
Thank you.

685
00:38:06,138 --> 00:38:08,065
All right, put away
your test notebooks.

00:38:12,622 --> 00:38:14,612

00:38:14,651 --> 00:38:16,122
We can do
<i>Last of the Mohicans--«/i»

00:38:20,393 --> 00:38:22,499

696
00:38:35,400 --> 00:38:37,441

697

No kidding.

698

That's my boy resting his head, see?

699
00:39:16,630 --> 00:39:18,577
Hey, Renaldo,
you want a coddie?

700
00:39:19,262 --> 00:39:21,587
- No.
- They're from Faidley's, yo.

701
00:39:22,741 --> 00:39:24,473
He might stay home all day, you know?

702
00:39:24,834 --> 00:39:26,240
We gonna find out, ain't we?

703

Like to see about my D.S.S. Code.

704
00:39:35,391 --> 00:39:36,488
Do you have an appointment?

705
00:39:36,524 --> 00:39:37,557
Why I need an appointment?

706
00:39:37,568 --> 00:39:39,536
Zenobia, I don't think

707
00:39:39,576 --> 00:39:41,253
Sorry.
Just trying to make it realistic.

708
00:39:41,312 --> 00:39:42,559

709
00:39:42,921 --> 00:39:44,304
You've to take a number and wait.

710
00:39:44,344 --> 00:39:45,734
I need to see somebody right now.

711

Don't get angry.
Anger doesn't help.

712
00:39:47,701 --> 00:39:49,123
It just makes people defensive.

713
00:39:49,203 --> 00:39:50,739
Tell her what you need calmly.

714
00:39:51,050 --> 00:39:53,174
- Card didn't come this month.
- We mailed it.

715
00:39:53,452 --> 00:39:54,631
Maybe it got stolen.

716
00:39:54,850 --> 00:39:56,335
Sorry. Nothing we can do.

717
00:39:56,513 --> 00:39:57,914
- Fuck you.
- Chandra!

718
00:39:57,974 --> 00:39:59,038
She ain't helping me.

719
00:39:59,104 --> 00:40:00,038
That's how they do.

720
00:40:00,157 --> 00:40:01,663
Just tell her what you need.

721
00:40:01,703 --> 00:40:03,091
Need another card, bitch.

722
00:40:04,036 --> 00:40:05,148
And that's reality.

723
00:40:06,000 --> 00:40:07,937
Fuck you for real.

724
00:40:11,502 --> 00:40:12,971
Calm down. Calm down.

725
00:40:13,338 --> 00:40:14,507
Go with Ms. Mason.

726
00:40:14,587 --> 00:40:15,560
Get your hands off!

727
00:40:17,339 --> 00:40:18,729
I'll get the school police.

728
00:40:21,276 --> 00:40:22,453
She was like...

729
00:40:22,592 --> 00:40:24,270

and then she was like...

00:40:24,337 --> 00:40:25,404
typical day?

731
00:40:25,579 --> 00:40:28,003
I wouldn't know.
My first time.

732
00:40:29,521 --> 00:40:30,574
Your first time?

733
00:40:31,496 --> 00:40:33,149
Mrs. Donnelly oversees this project.

734
00:40:50,123 --> 00:40:51,355
Good morning, ladies.

735
00:40:51,932 --> 00:40:53,382

736
00:40:56,181 --> 00:40:57,234
God bless.

737
00:41:04,300 --> 00:41:05,636
Good morning, reverend.

738
00:41:17,351 --> 00:41:18,535
Glad you finally answered.

739
00:41:18,602 --> 00:41:21,455
Yeah, I was in a meeting yesterday.
You got the asshole pinned down?

740
00:41:21,575 --> 00:41:24,014
Nah, I got Marlo's people
getting ready to make a drop.

741
00:41:24,173 --> 00:41:25,201
Where?

742
00:41:25,260 --> 00:41:26,412
Edmondson and Pulaski.

743
00:41:26,591 --> 00:41:28,011
You eyeballing them right now?

744
00:41:28,130 --> 00:41:29,390
Yeah, he got the package.

745
00:41:29,510 --> 00:41:31,240
Black bag,
putting it in the trunk.

746
00:41:31,359 --> 00:41:33,214

747
00:41:33,652 --> 00:41:34,943
Late model Lincoln.

748
00:41:35,845 --> 00:41:37,580

- Yeah, give it.

749
00:41:37,917 --> 00:41:41,434
P-R-8-Z-G-O-D.

750
00:41:43,035 --> 00:41:45,301
Yeah, he pulling out now,
turning down Gilmore.

751
00:41:45,600 --> 00:41:46,993
Dozerman, get me foxtrot.

752
00:41:47,092 --> 00:41:49,000
Good job, Bubs.
We're on it.

753
00:41:51,441 --> 00:41:53,965
Ladies, a cellphone?
It's got, like, a half-hour on it.

754
00:41:53,975 --> 00:41:55,028
No thank you.

755
00:42:09,845 --> 00:42:10,997
What I saw today

756
00:42:11,386 --> 00:42:13,651
wasn't education
as I understand the term,

00:42:14,296 --> 00:42:17,494
and they didn't seem
very socialized, either.

00:42:18,038 --> 00:42:19,846
You didn't catch us on our best day.

759
00:42:20,242 --> 00:42:21,255
Or your worst day?

760
00:42:21,295 --> 00:42:23,606
On the whole, they've actually
made a lot of progress.

761
00:42:23,665 --> 00:42:26,087
I mean, they come to class,
they're more engaged.

762
00:42:26,146 --> 00:42:27,279
We're reaching them.

763
00:42:27,318 --> 00:42:29,214
Fewer outbursts,
no suspensions.

764
00:42:29,492 --> 00:42:31,653
But are they really learning anything?

765
00:42:31,752 --> 00:42:33,568
Yes.
We believe they are.

766
00:42:33,707 --> 00:42:34,798
Be truthful.

767
00:42:35,255 --> 00:42:38,292
If this program were to continue

768
00:42:38,351 --> 00:42:40,093
trough the rest of the school year,

769
00:42:40,232 --> 00:42:42,666
how many of your students
could realistically

770
00:42:43,174 --> 00:42:45,757
be expected to return
to a regular classroom?

771
00:42:46,897 --> 00:42:48,725
What do you think, Ms. Duquette?

772
00:42:49,628 --> 00:42:52,747
Namond, Darnell,
maybe Zenobia.

773
00:42:53,999 --> 00:42:56,824
Look, considering where we started
and considering that those kids

774
00:42:56,844 --> 00:42:58,811
ain't out there
tearing up other classes--

775
00:42:58,930 --> 00:43:00,102
Mrs. Donnelly.

776
00:43:01,049 --> 00:43:02,519
A tremendous achievement.

777
00:43:04,530 --> 00:43:05,665
Mr. Withers?

778
00:43:08,056 --> 00:43:09,964
I'll go along with Mrs. Donnelly.

779
00:43:12,288 --> 00:43:13,957
You haven't said anything yet.

780
00:43:14,599 --> 00:43:15,851
I just don't see it.

781
00:43:16,475 --> 00:43:18,796
Many of these kids
are profoundly damaged--

782
00:43:19,227 --> 00:43:21,770
what they've seen,
how they've lived.

783
00:43:22,524 --> 00:43:25,783
And I think any gain or progress
is temporary.

784
00:43:26,676 --> 00:43:28,643
I think this project
may be flawed.

785
00:43:30,908 --> 00:43:32,211
<i>Foxtrot 23-30.</i>

786
00:43:32,271 --> 00:43:34,933
<i>We have a visual on the suspect.</i>
<i>Vehicle headed east on Mulberry.</i>

787
00:43:34,972 --> 00:43:36,130
<i>Do you copy?</i>

788
00:43:36,552 --> 00:43:37,862
10-4. We're almost there.

789
00:43:38,349 --> 00:43:39,962
10-4...

790
00:43:45,190 --> 00:43:46,410
After your phone call,

791
00:43:46,946 --> 00:43:48,901
I checked.
It came directly from Burrell.

792
00:43:49,306 --> 00:43:52,318
He bypassed Rawls
after I specifically told him he was--

793
00:43:52,338 --> 00:43:55,437
Burrell's making a play
for you to keep him.

794
00:43:56,139 --> 00:43:58,682
By, uh, just--
what did you call that?

795
00:43:59,235 --> 00:44:00,351
Juking the stats.

796
00:44:00,411 --> 00:44:01,901
Guy is unbelievable.

797
00:44:01,962 --> 00:44:05,290
It runs completely counter to
all my discussions with Rawls,

798
00:44:05,330 --> 00:44:06,741
with you, with everyone.

799
00:44:06,880 --> 00:44:08,094
He's also serving notice.

800
00:44:08,500 --> 00:44:10,586
He's reasserting control
of the department.

801
00:44:10,937 --> 00:44:13,838
He probably figures if you can't
fire him, then you can't fire him.

802
00:44:14,426 --> 00:44:15,618
And does Rawls know?

803
00:44:15,746 --> 00:44:17,630
My guess is,
Rawls heard about it days ago

804
00:44:17,690 --> 00:44:19,628
from half a dozen
district commanders.

805
00:44:19,972 --> 00:44:21,561
Why wouldn't he come to me?

806
00:44:21,913 --> 00:44:23,006
Talk to him.

807
00:44:24,407 --> 00:44:25,790
Why did you come to me?

808
00:44:25,890 --> 00:44:27,590
I mean, why not go to Rawls?

809
00:44:30,832 --> 00:44:32,993
Because I need to know
if you're serious.

810
00:44:33,413 --> 00:44:36,215
If Rawls already came to you
and this shit is still going on,

811
00:44:36,334 --> 00:44:38,993
then you're OK with it,
which is for me a problem.

812
00:44:39,412 --> 00:44:40,529
If he didn't come to you,

813
00:44:40,569 --> 00:44:42,765
then either he's OK with it,
which is also a problem,

814
00:44:42,784 --> 00:44:44,999
or he's letting it go,
trying give Burrell enough rope

815
00:44:45,019 --> 00:44:48,100
for you to get angry and fire
the man for insubordination.

816
00:44:48,765 --> 00:44:50,694
But I need to know
where you stand.

817
00:44:51,153 --> 00:44:52,643
Well, I gave you my word.

818
00:44:53,731 --> 00:44:56,036
Yes.
You did.

819
00:44:58,275 --> 00:45:00,818
Well, thanks for going outside
the chain of command.

820
00:45:03,655 --> 00:45:05,721
Don't expect me
to make a habit of it.

821
00:45:19,466 --> 00:45:20,698
Stay in the car!

822
00:45:21,169 --> 00:45:23,851
Stay in the car.
Keep your hands on the wheel.

823
00:45:26,642 --> 00:45:28,933
- Let's see those hands.
- What's the problem, officer?

824
00:45:28,973 --> 00:45:31,158
Step slowly out of the vehicle.
Keep your hands up.

825
00:45:44,333 --> 00:45:45,869
Son, be gentler than that.

826
00:45:46,227 --> 00:45:47,524
Fuck up.
I ain't your son.

827
00:45:51,206 --> 00:45:52,424
This guy.

828
00:46:08,421 --> 00:46:10,308
What's this, huh?
What's this?

829

Do you know what?

830
00:46:25,356 --> 00:46:28,395
I'm gonna damn sure
get your name and badge number.

831

Daniels.
I don't think I know him.

832
00:46:39,289 --> 00:46:41,126
Oh, he hasn't
played much politics,

833
00:46:41,225 --> 00:46:44,475
though he used to be married
to the new councilwoman in the 11th.

834
00:46:44,654 --> 00:46:45,871
Marla Daniels?

835

That's the one.

836
00:46:47,899 --> 00:46:51,564
This is the last man we want
as police commissioner, Nerese.

837

I mean, I squared off against
this fellow a few years back,

838
00:46:54,895 --> 00:46:56,361

839
00:46:56,600 --> 00:46:59,081
He's not gonna listen to you
or the ministers

840

841

842

Oh, he's the mayor's boy,

843

844

845

847

848

but less than he needs
to entice anyone real.

849
00:47:18,700 --> 00:47:21,105
Meanwhile, Carcetti's gonna
have to give Daniels

850
00:47:21,184 --> 00:47:24,363
6 months in C.I.D.
before he can bump him again,

851
00:47:24,543 --> 00:47:25,687
for appearance's sake.

852

So we're buying time here.

853
00:47:27,551 --> 00:47:30,438
Enough for Ervin to show
the new mayor who butters the bread.

854
00:47:30,577 --> 00:47:34,387
And for events to take the new

855
00:47:34,821 --> 00:47:38,487
I happen to know he's less
the saint than he pretends to be.

856
00:47:47,712 --> 00:47:51,070
This is senator Davis.
Is the mayor in at the moment?

857
00:47:53,455 --> 00:47:56,745
Well...
you just tell him his friend Clay

858
00:47:57,260 --> 00:48:01,829

salary bump for the police commissioner.

859
00:48:02,587 --> 00:48:03,918
You tell him...

860

861

You tell him that senator Davis

862
00:48:14,215 --> 00:48:15,327
Right.

863
00:48:16,676 --> 00:48:17,809
Thanks.

864
00:48:32,939 --> 00:48:34,929
Hey, ma.

00:48:39,858 --> 00:48:40,990

867

868

869

He stayed at our house last night,

870

871

Tell her.

872
00:48:57,380 --> 00:48:59,804
The cops picked me up,

873
00:49:00,133 --> 00:49:02,438
They was gonna send me

874

But we took him in.

875

You leave my son
the fuck alone.

876

And you,
you afraid to go to baby booking?

877
00:49:15,553 --> 00:49:18,831
The fuck is wrong with you, boy?

878

879

Only drunk and disorderlies

880

881

882

883
00:49:45,615 --> 00:49:47,446
Well, he might turn out a decent police.

884

885

886

887

888

Rock star.

00:50:23,925 --> 00:50:25,414

902

908

921

Dennis.

924

Man.

932

933

941
00:52:39,081 --> 00:52:40,441
He's a cold motherfucker.

942

943

Thought you said
it was getting warmer, man.

944
00:52:45,629 --> 00:52:49,363

945

952

953

00:55:53,279 --> 00:55:54,283
Damn.

00:01:42,857 --> 00:01:44,520
Fucked up somewhere,
I suppose.

38
00:01:47,407 --> 00:01:50,151
What the fuck you little hoppers
doing on my avenue?

39
00:01:50,252 --> 00:01:51,433
- Eating.
- Shit you are.

40
00:01:51,514 --> 00:01:53,537
You're probably setting up
to snatch a purse.

41
00:01:54,318 --> 00:01:57,345
Get the fuck back on the reservation
where your black asses belong.

44
00:02:02,445 --> 00:02:03,647
I said get.

45
00:02:11,792 --> 00:02:12,947
Yo, y'all hear that shit?

46
00:02:12,967 --> 00:02:14,109
"My avenue."

47
00:02:14,310 --> 00:02:15,992
It's just as much ours as it is his.

48
00:02:16,053 --> 00:02:17,214
Walker be evil, yo.

49
00:02:17,255 --> 00:02:18,894
He be thieving and
smackin' folk down.

50
00:02:18,954 --> 00:02:22,084
We should get him back on
the payback tip for all the dirt he do.

51
00:02:22,244 --> 00:02:24,047
You want to throw down with police?

52
00:02:24,548 --> 00:02:25,943
I don't mean go at him direct,

53
00:02:25,963 --> 00:02:27,285
but, you know, hurt him.

54
00:02:27,425 --> 00:02:29,589
Like, slash his tires
or some shit.

55
00:02:30,428 --> 00:02:32,251
We could stick
condoms on his car.

56
00:02:33,894 --> 00:02:35,196
That'd send a message.

57
00:02:35,357 --> 00:02:36,599
Yeah, but what kind?

58
00:02:36,799 --> 00:02:38,814
We should slap bumper stickers
on his windshield.

59
00:02:38,834 --> 00:02:40,757
I mean,
they is hard to get off.

60
00:02:40,837 --> 00:02:42,059
Hold on, wait, wait.

61
00:02:42,368 --> 00:02:45,173
Do officer walker
go to that club on Stockton,

62
00:02:45,233 --> 00:02:46,835
the one where
the western police party?

63
00:02:46,875 --> 00:02:48,258
I seen his car there.

64
00:02:49,945 --> 00:02:51,247
I got this one.

65
00:02:55,023 --> 00:02:57,647
4x11 A New Day

66
00:04:33,838 --> 00:04:35,380
And as much as I empathize,

67
00:04:35,401 --> 00:04:37,524
I can only tell you
that there is a process

68
00:04:37,564 --> 00:04:38,726
for complaints like this one.

69
00:04:38,747 --> 00:04:40,822
Don't sell us on process, Mr. Mayor.

70
00:04:40,942 --> 00:04:43,666
We've had years of this kind
of treatment from city police.

71
00:04:43,826 --> 00:04:46,511
You need to understand
we do this as an affront to the cloth.

72
00:04:46,611 --> 00:04:49,237
We've asked
for a civilian review board

73
00:04:49,318 --> 00:04:50,379
for decades, now.

74
00:04:50,600 --> 00:04:52,443
Absent that,
how can we trust

75
00:04:52,643 --> 00:04:54,827
any investigation
of any complaint?

76
00:04:54,907 --> 00:04:56,149
Forgive me, gentlemen,

77
00:04:56,209 --> 00:04:57,644
but last I checked,

78
00:04:57,984 --> 00:04:59,603
the department had
a black commissioner

79
00:04:59,643 --> 00:05:01,258
and a black I.I.D. director.

80
00:05:01,538 --> 00:05:03,281
The problem is systemic.

81
00:05:03,341 --> 00:05:04,904
And as to commissioner Burrell,

82
00:05:04,964 --> 00:05:07,871
we understand that
his authority is now limited.

83
00:05:08,492 --> 00:05:10,836
Mr. Mayor, when it comes
to matters like this one,

84
00:05:10,936 --> 00:05:14,041
do you expect us to have
faith in deputy Rawls?

85
00:05:14,141 --> 00:05:15,359
I expect you'll be good enough

86
00:05:15,399 --> 00:05:17,082
not to prejudge
the department's response

87
00:05:17,122 --> 00:05:18,965
before the investigation
even begins,

88
00:05:19,025 --> 00:05:20,251
as I won't prejudge it.

89
00:05:20,322 --> 00:05:22,176
I can only tell you
that I take this incident

90
00:05:22,216 --> 00:05:25,563
very seriously,
and that I will pursue all of the facts.

91
00:05:29,435 --> 00:05:30,517
Well, Mr. Mayor,

92
00:05:30,597 --> 00:05:32,220
you said you would have
an open door,

93
00:05:32,280 --> 00:05:34,949
and so far I credit you
for keeping that promise.

94
00:05:35,089 --> 00:05:37,092
And my door
will always be open to you.

95
00:05:37,593 --> 00:05:38,795
Thank you.

96
00:05:45,314 --> 00:05:47,783
If they couldn't get civilian review
in Royce administration,

97
00:05:47,803 --> 00:05:49,526
how can they think
they'll get it from me?

98
00:05:49,546 --> 00:05:50,728
They're just testing you here,

99
00:05:50,788 --> 00:05:53,132
trying to see how vulnerable
you feel on the racial stuff.

100
00:05:53,172 --> 00:05:54,674
On Burrell, too,
for what it's worth.

101
00:05:54,714 --> 00:05:56,838
Well, civilian review is a nonstarter.

102
00:05:56,888 --> 00:05:58,230
You go now there now,

103
00:05:58,270 --> 00:06:00,995
you'll be bending over
for 4 years for the ministers.

104
00:06:01,074 --> 00:06:03,568
So what? I throw them a bone
and fire some idiot cop?

105
00:06:03,597 --> 00:06:05,200
By pressing that
the average beat cop's

106
00:06:05,229 --> 00:06:07,052
gonna hate my guts,
and I ain't gonna change

107
00:06:07,072 --> 00:06:08,936
anything around without
rank-and-file support.

108
00:06:08,956 --> 00:06:10,787
You don't fire him,
you're going to piss off

109
00:06:10,822 --> 00:06:12,642
most of the black
political infrastructure.

110
00:06:12,859 --> 00:06:15,579
Yummy.
My first bowl of shit.

111
00:06:23,058 --> 00:06:24,200
Circle that right.

112
00:06:25,843 --> 00:06:27,445
And you press that right there.

113
00:06:32,983 --> 00:06:34,245
It's work time.

114
00:06:35,490 --> 00:06:37,573
You guys got work to do?
You write down that data?

115
00:06:37,614 --> 00:06:38,713
- Yeah.
- All right.

116
00:06:41,671 --> 00:06:43,575
Charlene,
what don't you understand?

117
00:06:43,615 --> 00:06:44,636
None of it.

118
00:06:44,676 --> 00:06:47,221
OK, let's see if we can
find a way you can get it, OK?

119
00:06:47,822 --> 00:06:48,908
What's the diameter?

120
00:06:49,469 --> 00:06:50,912
- It's 7.
- Good.

121
00:06:51,564 --> 00:06:52,586
OK, what's half of that?

122
00:06:52,666 --> 00:06:53,968
You can't take half of it.

123
00:06:54,723 --> 00:06:57,447
OK, let's say you have $10
and you gave half of it to Jasmine.

124
00:06:57,507 --> 00:06:58,609
Why I do that?

125
00:06:59,571 --> 00:07:01,505
Well, just pretend, OK?

126
00:07:02,527 --> 00:07:04,270
You give her half,
how much does she have?

127
00:07:04,336 --> 00:07:05,958
- Duh, 5.
- Good.

128
00:07:06,018 --> 00:07:08,242
Now let's say this time
you have $7

129
00:07:08,262 --> 00:07:10,386
and you give her half,
how much does she have?

130
00:07:10,586 --> 00:07:11,978
$3.50.

131
00:07:12,220 --> 00:07:13,983
Good, so...

132
00:07:16,256 --> 00:07:17,358
Yo, Mr. Prez,

133
00:07:18,300 --> 00:07:19,391
check this out.

134
00:07:28,348 --> 00:07:29,850
Why we no pick him up at his casa,

135
00:07:29,950 --> 00:07:31,052
follow him from there?

136
00:07:31,116 --> 00:07:32,739
Why, so we can
lose him here again?

137
00:07:32,779 --> 00:07:35,368
Papa, nothin' say he got to come back
through this way, you know?

138
00:07:35,408 --> 00:07:36,614
What if he take another road...

139
00:07:37,324 --> 00:07:39,728
All right.
We pick him up from his casa tomorrow.

140
00:07:42,463 --> 00:07:43,527
Talk.

141
00:07:44,408 --> 00:07:45,550
- Don't pout.
- Omar,

142
00:07:45,791 --> 00:07:46,932
I'm tired of this, bro.

143
00:07:48,716 --> 00:07:50,960
Lo siento, baby.
Lo siento.

144
00:07:55,424 --> 00:07:56,466
Hey, now.

145
00:07:58,339 --> 00:07:59,578
There she blow.

146
00:08:13,355 --> 00:08:14,477
All right, then.

147
00:08:14,701 --> 00:08:16,250
So we agree staring down

148
00:08:16,290 --> 00:08:18,694
a stick-up boy on a corner
takes courage,

149
00:08:19,325 --> 00:08:21,312
and we agree it takes courage
to go overnight

150
00:08:21,379 --> 00:08:22,708
to Cheltenham or Hickey.

151
00:08:23,145 --> 00:08:24,327
This is a good list,

152
00:08:24,557 --> 00:08:26,180
but are there any examples
we can make

153
00:08:26,220 --> 00:08:27,923
outside of being on a corner?

154
00:08:29,683 --> 00:08:30,945
I need a volunteer.

155
00:08:32,531 --> 00:08:33,573
Not me.

156
00:08:34,034 --> 00:08:35,236
What about you, Albert?

157
00:08:36,038 --> 00:08:37,069
No.

158
00:08:37,109 --> 00:08:38,852
You volunteer
and you don't know what for,

159
00:08:38,892 --> 00:08:40,094
you ain't got brains.

160
00:08:40,234 --> 00:08:43,438
All right, then.
I need a volunteer to stand on this box

161
00:08:43,689 --> 00:08:46,494
blindfolded, fall off,
and let us catch him

162
00:08:46,534 --> 00:08:47,673
before he hits the ground.

163
00:08:50,547 --> 00:08:52,769
- Albert?
- That's fucking stupid.

164
00:08:54,171 --> 00:08:55,313
What about you, Namond?

165
00:08:55,373 --> 00:08:57,016
Wait, wait,
let me get this right.

166
00:08:57,256 --> 00:08:59,208
So you want me to stand up
on that box,

167
00:08:59,229 --> 00:09:01,332
put a blindfold on, fall,

168
00:09:01,392 --> 00:09:03,698
and expect these
weak-ass clowns to catch me?

169
00:09:05,040 --> 00:09:06,062
Hell, no.

170
00:09:07,124 --> 00:09:08,125
Who you talkin' to?

171
00:09:08,185 --> 00:09:09,207
For real.

172
00:09:10,229 --> 00:09:11,331
Yeah, for real.

173
00:09:11,411 --> 00:09:13,859
Hey, yo, y'all drop me,
and we gonna have more than words.

174
00:09:15,886 --> 00:09:16,928
A'ight.

175
00:09:17,295 --> 00:09:18,857
All right, everybody, gather around.

176
00:09:23,673 --> 00:09:24,855
Oh, shit.

177
00:09:26,477 --> 00:09:29,181
You ready? On 3.

178
00:09:29,362 --> 00:09:32,667
1, 2, 3.

179
00:09:36,121 --> 00:09:38,304
Shit!
Oh, that shit was right.

180
00:09:38,765 --> 00:09:40,167
All right, who wants to go next?

181
00:09:40,333 --> 00:09:41,375
Albert?

182
00:09:41,435 --> 00:09:43,319
I ain't doing no
stupid shit like that.

183
00:09:43,419 --> 00:09:45,162
Fuck you, and fuck all
y'all bitches.

184
00:09:51,942 --> 00:09:53,605
We don't like your ass anyway.

185
00:09:53,725 --> 00:09:55,348
Settle down,
settle down.

186
00:09:58,610 --> 00:10:01,094
Yo, today's specials
are those little Hershey bars,

187
00:10:01,154 --> 00:10:04,600
3 for a dime, and I got all your
your other favorites, too.

188
00:10:04,700 --> 00:10:06,537
Yo, Deante,
I got your licorice--

189
00:10:06,637 --> 00:10:07,919
red and black both.

190
00:10:08,140 --> 00:10:09,602
Snitchin' Randy.

191
00:10:27,762 --> 00:10:30,237
Well, I' be blessed, yo.
Look it.

192
00:10:30,347 --> 00:10:31,789
This is good?
We put him here?

193
00:10:31,989 --> 00:10:33,813
That tall man with prop Joe?

194
00:10:34,414 --> 00:10:36,270
Yo, for real,
on this caper,

195
00:10:36,571 --> 00:10:38,434
the more we learn,
the less we know.

196
00:10:38,554 --> 00:10:39,616
We can go?

197
00:10:39,656 --> 00:10:40,815
No, we stay.

198
00:10:41,536 --> 00:10:42,899
Papa, I need to go.

199
00:10:42,959 --> 00:10:44,742
I say we stay, Renaldo.
What's wrong, yo?

200
00:10:44,782 --> 00:10:45,944
No, no, I mean go.

201
00:10:47,806 --> 00:10:49,328
We been in the car
too many hours.

202
00:10:49,409 --> 00:10:52,474
Whether you squat in an alley
or sittin' on a porcelain throne,

203
00:10:52,742 --> 00:10:55,066
don't really change
the moment, now do it?

204
00:10:58,241 --> 00:10:59,403
Rough day?

205
00:11:01,354 --> 00:11:02,936
Doesn't help to hold it in.

206
00:11:04,058 --> 00:11:05,560
What the fuck you know?

207
00:11:06,616 --> 00:11:10,382
If you tell me,
maybe we can help.

208
00:11:13,602 --> 00:11:14,824
Ain't nothing.

209
00:11:15,989 --> 00:11:18,393
Look, come on, Albert,
you been doing real good

210
00:11:18,453 --> 00:11:21,097
in this class,
real good till today.

211
00:11:25,910 --> 00:11:27,493
Just give it a try.

212
00:11:34,530 --> 00:11:37,655
I went home yesterday,
my mom's on the couch.

213
00:11:39,082 --> 00:11:40,344
She dead.

214
00:11:41,105 --> 00:11:44,290
Me-Maw said best not come
to school, but...

215
00:11:49,913 --> 00:11:51,876
Yeah, you want to be with your mom.

216
00:11:54,727 --> 00:11:55,949
Of course you did.

217
00:11:57,880 --> 00:11:59,943
Some of you know me
from narcotics work,

218
00:12:00,484 --> 00:12:02,668
some from earlier if you
worked the western district,

219
00:12:02,708 --> 00:12:04,695
and some of you I'm meeting
for the first time,

220
00:12:04,780 --> 00:12:06,933
but the only point I'd
really like to make here today

221
00:12:07,000 --> 00:12:08,880
is that this is a transitional time

222
00:12:08,940 --> 00:12:11,304
for this department
and for the city as a whole.

223
00:12:11,433 --> 00:12:13,456
We have a new mayor
and a new state's attorney,

224
00:12:13,516 --> 00:12:16,181
and they both feel like
they have a mandate for change.

225
00:12:18,590 --> 00:12:21,775
The point is that given
the Mayor's position on crime

226
00:12:22,075 --> 00:12:23,598
and given the outcome of the election,

227
00:12:23,658 --> 00:12:25,080
we can expect certain enhancements.

228
00:12:25,120 --> 00:12:26,122
Oh, really?

229
00:12:26,162 --> 00:12:27,224
Certain improvements...

230
00:12:27,304 --> 00:12:29,207
may be forthcoming
in the near future.

231
00:12:29,387 --> 00:12:31,030
So we're looking
for feedback here,

232
00:12:31,090 --> 00:12:32,250
some input as to what we need

233
00:12:32,290 --> 00:12:34,634
more of or less of
to better work murders.

234
00:12:34,754 --> 00:12:35,896
Better witness protection.

235
00:12:35,976 --> 00:12:37,591
More proactive investigation.

236
00:12:37,671 --> 00:12:38,693
Pay raise.

237
00:12:40,786 --> 00:12:41,798
Better lab work.

238
00:12:41,838 --> 00:12:43,461
- More techs on duty.
- More overtime.

239
00:12:43,521 --> 00:12:44,683
More scotch!

240
00:12:45,384 --> 00:12:47,409
More time for case prep.
Seriously.

241
00:12:47,469 --> 00:12:48,892
More women.
Loose women.

242
00:12:49,813 --> 00:12:51,296
Pay hike, double-digits.

243
00:12:51,450 --> 00:12:54,154
Mo' better,
mo' better, mo' better.

244
00:12:54,260 --> 00:12:55,743
That's what we need.

245
00:12:58,985 --> 00:13:00,388
Sounds like a new day, don't it?

246
00:13:00,488 --> 00:13:02,571
Department's finally gonna
get what it needs.

247
00:13:02,651 --> 00:13:04,294
State's attorney's office, too.

248
00:13:04,895 --> 00:13:06,272
A new day.

249
00:13:07,194 --> 00:13:08,776
They make a nice couple, anyway.

250
00:13:09,237 --> 00:13:11,000
Looking forward to working with you.

251
00:13:13,229 --> 00:13:15,352
That's signed by
a now inaugurated Mayor

252
00:13:15,412 --> 00:13:18,998
ordering his police commanders
to avoid mass arrests.

253
00:13:19,078 --> 00:13:20,336
Community based policing,

254
00:13:20,396 --> 00:13:22,560
and high-end enforcements
are to be emphasized.

255
00:13:22,620 --> 00:13:24,142
I take it Burrell got a copy.

256
00:13:24,222 --> 00:13:25,272
In person.

257
00:13:26,234 --> 00:13:27,275
I don't see it.

258
00:13:27,811 --> 00:13:29,414
Why not just fire the fucking asshole?

259
00:13:29,514 --> 00:13:31,077
The mayor is weighing his options.

260
00:13:31,137 --> 00:13:32,339
What the fuck does that mean?

261
00:13:32,379 --> 00:13:34,062
To fire Burrell,
we're going to need more

262
00:13:34,102 --> 00:13:36,456
political capital
than we have right now.

263
00:13:36,676 --> 00:13:39,941
Speaking of which,
it brings us to another

264
00:13:40,042 --> 00:13:41,384
little piece of business.

265
00:13:41,424 --> 00:13:44,118
- The thing with the minister.
- It's a delicate situation.

266
00:13:44,259 --> 00:13:46,502
The ministers are pressing
for a civilian review,

267
00:13:46,562 --> 00:13:48,707
which I know the rank-and-file
don't want to hear,

268
00:13:48,747 --> 00:13:51,311
but it speaks directly
to the situation with Burrell.

269
00:13:51,531 --> 00:13:53,688
If we expend capital
defending this incident--

270
00:13:53,789 --> 00:13:56,132
I get it.
You want the cop fired.

271
00:13:56,253 --> 00:13:58,016
No, we're not saying that at all.

272
00:13:58,076 --> 00:14:01,730
The mayor doesn't want to interfere with
the everyday workings of the department.

273
00:14:03,272 --> 00:14:04,755
But it's a balancing act.

274
00:14:05,293 --> 00:14:08,166
Our response has to be smart
and evenhanded,

275
00:14:08,246 --> 00:14:09,929
in a racial sense especially.

276
00:14:10,169 --> 00:14:11,972
If I'm hearing you,
it's about perception.

277
00:14:12,153 --> 00:14:13,259
Exactly.

278
00:14:14,481 --> 00:14:17,664
I.I.D. has a black commander,
but he's beholden to Burrell.

279
00:14:17,845 --> 00:14:19,868
He'll stir shit with this if he can.

280
00:14:22,836 --> 00:14:25,641
The sergeant in question
is assigned to C.I.D.

281
00:14:25,941 --> 00:14:27,624
His new commander is Daniels.

282
00:14:27,904 --> 00:14:30,589
He's smart, he's black,
and politically neutral.

283
00:14:31,941 --> 00:14:33,003
That work for you?

284
00:14:33,083 --> 00:14:34,165
Works for us.

285
00:14:44,461 --> 00:14:46,985
Who that?
I said, who's that?

286
00:14:56,629 --> 00:14:58,051
You home, or you just visiting?

287
00:14:58,492 --> 00:14:59,671
Home if I can.

288
00:15:02,100 --> 00:15:04,613
All right.
Get by the fire if you want.

289
00:15:08,353 --> 00:15:09,695
I got a couple of dogs left,

290
00:15:09,715 --> 00:15:10,716
you hungry?

291
00:15:18,228 --> 00:15:20,164
Shit weren't working out with
Jo-Jo and them.

292
00:15:20,224 --> 00:15:22,728
Said I owed him some cheddar or
some shit some other boy did.

293
00:15:22,758 --> 00:15:24,638
I don't want to make no
noise on that, though.

294
00:15:24,705 --> 00:15:25,946
They pressin' you.

295
00:15:27,760 --> 00:15:29,102
You know...

296
00:15:31,280 --> 00:15:33,123
get with me,
and we pay 'em right back, OK?

297
00:15:33,163 --> 00:15:35,688
No, all that shit you been sayin' to me
goin' through my head.

298
00:15:35,728 --> 00:15:37,393
Forget about that.
Forget about all that.

299
00:15:37,427 --> 00:15:38,795
If I wouldn't have pushed you off,

300
00:15:38,835 --> 00:15:40,332
you'd have never
been on that corner.

301
00:15:40,399 --> 00:15:42,171
But everything I do I be fucking up.

302
00:15:42,332 --> 00:15:44,475
Whole time it feel like it
wasn't me on that corner.

303
00:15:44,535 --> 00:15:45,897
I just wanted to get away.

304
00:15:49,324 --> 00:15:51,969
Well, you're here now,
ain't you? Right?

305
00:15:52,349 --> 00:15:55,034
This is you, right here,
right now, OK?

306
00:15:58,300 --> 00:16:00,003
You're burning a hole in
that shirt, man.

307
00:16:00,043 --> 00:16:01,265
Fuck-- You fucked me all up when

308
00:16:01,305 --> 00:16:03,107
I saw you walking through
the door, Sherrod.

309
00:16:03,348 --> 00:16:04,550
Shit!

310
00:16:05,184 --> 00:16:06,243
What you think, huh?

311
00:16:06,310 --> 00:16:07,889
You know, I get
half price for this.

312
00:16:08,491 --> 00:16:09,915
All right,
take your hat off, man.

313
00:16:09,982 --> 00:16:11,942
Don't burn them pimp steaks, huh?

314
00:16:22,419 --> 00:16:23,841
Took long enough.

315
00:16:28,613 --> 00:16:30,477
Yo, Dukie,
you sure about this?

316
00:16:31,392 --> 00:16:34,237
I mean,
I'm with y'all.

317
00:16:34,450 --> 00:16:35,833
Y'all my boys like that.

318
00:16:36,053 --> 00:16:38,407
Y'all there for me,
I'm there for y'all.

319
00:16:38,581 --> 00:16:41,566
I'm really starting to think
this is some fucked-up shit.

320
00:16:41,747 --> 00:16:44,231
I mean, Officer Walker's
a shady motherfucker,

321
00:16:44,291 --> 00:16:46,075
but he's police.

322
00:16:47,883 --> 00:16:49,886
We do it Michael's way,
we send a message.

323
00:16:49,966 --> 00:16:51,850
You ain't got to do what I got to do.

324
00:16:53,160 --> 00:16:54,643
We drew straws, Nay.

325
00:17:18,032 --> 00:17:19,314
Let's go.

326
00:17:28,653 --> 00:17:29,675
This is everything?

327
00:17:29,695 --> 00:17:31,779
Sergeant Hauk's statement,
the ministers',

328
00:17:32,139 --> 00:17:34,488
statements of the other officers,
it's all there.

329
00:17:34,588 --> 00:17:36,131
No independent witnesses, huh?

330
00:17:36,251 --> 00:17:38,915
It's a lot of smoke, but
I'm not feeling much in the way of fire.

331
00:17:38,935 --> 00:17:40,598
It was a strong case
for discourtesy.

332
00:17:40,658 --> 00:17:43,742
True, but no indication
of racial or religious overtones.

333
00:17:43,782 --> 00:17:46,106
And the brutality allegation
is a stretch.

334
00:17:47,315 --> 00:17:49,358
I've gone over GOC/7.

335
00:17:49,519 --> 00:17:51,402
I'm up to speed with the matrix,

336
00:17:51,862 --> 00:17:53,986
but since the buck stops
with me on this one,

337
00:17:54,086 --> 00:17:55,672
walk me through my options.

338
00:17:56,032 --> 00:17:58,937
Minor offenses,
you can issue a summary judgment--

339
00:18:00,280 --> 00:18:02,162
A period of extra duty without pay,

340
00:18:02,245 --> 00:18:04,128
guidance and counseling, the like,

341
00:18:04,369 --> 00:18:06,372
or if Sergeant Hauk
fights your decision

342
00:18:06,432 --> 00:18:08,285
or if there's a more
substantive charge,

343
00:18:08,352 --> 00:18:09,817
it goes downstairs to a trial board.

344
00:18:09,857 --> 00:18:11,039
And possible termination?

345
00:18:16,876 --> 00:18:17,877
Let me ask you...

346
00:18:19,300 --> 00:18:20,742
if the minister's connected,

347
00:18:21,381 --> 00:18:23,004
and if all eyes are on this one,

348
00:18:23,979 --> 00:18:25,738
what does Command want to see happen?

349
00:18:25,798 --> 00:18:27,401
What does city hall want
to see happen?

350
00:18:27,441 --> 00:18:30,166
City hall just wants
someone to do the right thing,

351
00:18:30,544 --> 00:18:31,826
whatever that is.

352
00:18:32,108 --> 00:18:35,157
You're sitting here, Deputy,
telling me to just do the right thing?

353
00:18:35,278 --> 00:18:36,980
Doesn't happen often, I know.

354
00:19:01,887 --> 00:19:04,451
Hey! What are you doing?
Come here!

355
00:19:07,316 --> 00:19:09,580
You motherfucker,
when I get your little ass...

356
00:19:13,139 --> 00:19:14,802
Come on,
show me hands, bitch.

357
00:19:15,543 --> 00:19:17,827
Back the fuck,
little hopper, I'm police.

358
00:19:17,907 --> 00:19:21,188
Yeah, I know, you the police who like
To fuck with a nigger. Turn around.

359
00:19:24,529 --> 00:19:26,242
You ain't gonna hear the next one.

360
00:19:26,636 --> 00:19:28,456
Get on your knees,
cross them legs,

361
00:19:28,522 --> 00:19:30,004
knit them hand come on.

362
00:19:33,450 --> 00:19:34,729
Ooh, hold on.

363
00:19:36,793 --> 00:19:38,416
Yo, what the fuck you doing?

364
00:19:38,524 --> 00:19:40,546
What the fuck is wrong with you, man?

365
00:19:41,127 --> 00:19:42,509
Give up that ring, man.

366
00:19:43,856 --> 00:19:44,877
Come on.

367
00:19:47,007 --> 00:19:48,149
Yeah.

368
00:19:57,295 --> 00:19:58,377
Payback.

369
00:19:59,458 --> 00:20:01,402
That's right, run, motherfuckers!

370
00:20:03,004 --> 00:20:04,175
Shit!

371
00:20:18,267 --> 00:20:19,489
I'm telling you, right there.

372
00:20:19,577 --> 00:20:22,194
This horse is a winner,
look at it, OK?

373
00:20:22,378 --> 00:20:23,440
How you doing?

374
00:20:23,967 --> 00:20:24,969
Excuse me.

375
00:20:25,776 --> 00:20:26,778
Mr. Mayor.

376
00:20:26,838 --> 00:20:29,326
On my way downtown today
I saw an abandoned car.

377
00:20:29,393 --> 00:20:30,435
Tow it right away.

378
00:20:30,495 --> 00:20:33,079
Where is--
Mr. Mayor, the location.

379
00:20:34,165 --> 00:20:36,148
Fucking Christ.
Call transpo!

380
00:20:36,208 --> 00:20:37,550
Get the fucking trucks moving!

381
00:20:44,119 --> 00:20:45,982
- Mr. Mayor.
- I got a constituent call.

382
00:20:46,023 --> 00:20:47,587
She said the playground
near her house

383
00:20:47,647 --> 00:20:49,370
was a hazard.
Rusted metal.

384
00:20:49,440 --> 00:20:50,529
We'll get right on it.

385
00:20:50,597 --> 00:20:53,272
The location?
Sir, I need a location.

386
00:20:54,074 --> 00:20:57,441
Mr. Mayor, I understand your concern,
but you've got to understand,

387
00:20:57,621 --> 00:20:59,880
we have more than 9,100 hydrants.

388
00:20:59,946 --> 00:21:01,204
And one of them's leaking.

389
00:21:03,456 --> 00:21:04,721
Sensitivity counseling,

390
00:21:04,894 --> 00:21:08,320
two week's extra duty,
no punishment past that.

391
00:21:08,807 --> 00:21:10,570
They sliced it into the rough.

392
00:21:11,132 --> 00:21:14,170
Does Daniels know the bind
this puts his boy Carcetti in?

393
00:21:14,238 --> 00:21:17,249
Well, Wilson briefed Rawls,
Rawls briefed Daniels.

394
00:21:18,835 --> 00:21:20,718
It's Carcetti doing Pontius Pilate,

395
00:21:20,839 --> 00:21:23,283
putting it on Daniels,
who was a safe choice

396
00:21:23,387 --> 00:21:25,223
as far as the rank-and-file goes.

397
00:21:25,290 --> 00:21:27,025
But that won't be enough
for the ministers,

398
00:21:27,085 --> 00:21:28,387
not by a long shot.

399
00:21:34,734 --> 00:21:37,458
Am I the only one that knows
how to play this game?

400
00:21:41,765 --> 00:21:43,789
Let's go, get that hydrant sealed.

401
00:22:19,257 --> 00:22:22,923
Three of them with shotguns got me
coming outside the club.

402
00:22:23,419 --> 00:22:24,701
I made 'em for bloods.

403
00:22:25,018 --> 00:22:27,943
The paint's supposed to be some
kind of declaration of war.

404
00:22:28,177 --> 00:22:29,840
Sounds like we get to stomp some ass.

405
00:22:29,900 --> 00:22:31,162
The western district way.

406
00:22:35,072 --> 00:22:37,175
Yellow paint
a declaration of war?

407
00:22:38,561 --> 00:22:39,763
That's a new one.

408
00:22:46,469 --> 00:22:48,664
So what I heard was
that this wild-ass boys--

409
00:22:48,732 --> 00:22:51,720
I ain't saying no names--
but they past crazy.

410
00:22:52,083 --> 00:22:53,085
They robbed him.

411
00:22:53,134 --> 00:22:55,478
They threw paint on his ass,
yellow paint.

412
00:22:56,044 --> 00:22:57,386
Shit, I ain't lying.

413
00:22:58,375 --> 00:22:59,637
Well, I don't know about that,

414
00:22:59,717 --> 00:23:02,161
but you showed me something
getting on that box like that.

415
00:23:02,322 --> 00:23:03,384
That wasn't nothing.

416
00:23:03,491 --> 00:23:04,890
No, don't sell yourself short.

417
00:23:05,174 --> 00:23:07,768
Ms. Duquette, Mr. Parenti,
we all thought it took courage.

418
00:23:07,997 --> 00:23:09,935
Especially considering
how y'all do each other.

419
00:23:10,001 --> 00:23:11,050
You think?

420
00:23:11,370 --> 00:23:12,452
Yeah.

421
00:23:13,150 --> 00:23:16,515
Now, look, you're showing
a lot of progress in class.

422
00:23:16,676 --> 00:23:18,050
I mean, you know that, don't you?

423
00:23:18,117 --> 00:23:20,557
You know, you're doing the work.
You're not acting out.

424
00:23:21,938 --> 00:23:23,180
It's getting to the point where

425
00:23:23,200 --> 00:23:25,433
you can go back to regular
class, no problem.

426
00:23:25,533 --> 00:23:26,835
Back to gen-pop?

427
00:23:28,400 --> 00:23:29,405
You want me to go?

428
00:23:29,749 --> 00:23:31,071
Well, if you're ready.

429
00:23:34,464 --> 00:23:35,927
I ain't going back there.

430
00:23:36,140 --> 00:23:37,302
Why not?

431
00:23:38,073 --> 00:23:39,976
Shit they teach there be deadly,

432
00:23:41,583 --> 00:23:43,466
but I know you know that, Bunny.

433
00:23:45,103 --> 00:23:47,306
All right, all right!
All right, all right!

434
00:23:47,663 --> 00:23:49,670
We can squeeze a little money
from here and there

435
00:23:49,687 --> 00:23:51,710
but nothing on the scale
for what you're asking.

436
00:23:51,750 --> 00:23:53,543
Maybe free up some operating money

437
00:23:53,603 --> 00:23:55,830
by shifting some of these
pay-go projects

438
00:23:55,890 --> 00:23:57,252
into the capital program.

439
00:23:57,312 --> 00:23:59,997
I can steal a little from
the budget stabilization fund,

440
00:24:00,155 --> 00:24:03,460
but we still got
to absorb 120 grant positions

441
00:24:03,527 --> 00:24:05,478
in the police department,
mostly officers.

442
00:24:05,558 --> 00:24:08,459
- Christ, don't let those go unfunded.
- A lot of balls in the air,

443
00:24:08,519 --> 00:24:10,272
and I still haven't seen
the schools' budget.

444
00:24:10,339 --> 00:24:12,075
What about the revenue surplus?

445
00:24:12,142 --> 00:24:13,894
As I said, that's one-time money.

446
00:24:13,975 --> 00:24:16,272
I'm going to give the police
a 5% raise, that's forever.

447
00:24:16,312 --> 00:24:19,422
If I'm gonna ask the police department
to get up on its hind legs and fight,

448
00:24:19,488 --> 00:24:22,499
I got to throw some money. You're
telling me how I can't do, not how I can.

449
00:24:22,519 --> 00:24:25,742
There's the rainy day fund,
but you really shouldn't draw that down.

450
00:24:25,882 --> 00:24:29,260
The bond rating houses want at least 5%
of the budget in reserve.

451
00:24:29,400 --> 00:24:30,922
Feels like a rainy day to me.

452
00:24:31,064 --> 00:24:32,667
Cloudy like a motherfucker.

453
00:24:34,717 --> 00:24:35,919
Yo, yo, wait up, yo.

454
00:24:44,859 --> 00:24:46,782
Hey, yo.
Check it.

455
00:24:48,043 --> 00:24:49,826
- Fuck is up with y'all?
- Ain't you, Mike.

456
00:24:49,866 --> 00:24:51,849
We wanna have a word
with your boy, here.

457
00:24:52,681 --> 00:24:54,744
Ain't nothing stopping you. Talk.

458
00:24:55,025 --> 00:24:56,026
You know what we mean.

459
00:24:56,066 --> 00:24:57,689
The little bitch been talking to police.

460
00:24:57,729 --> 00:24:59,291
That's a lie.
I ain't do no snitching.

461
00:24:59,339 --> 00:25:02,015
The fuck you ain't.
Peeing hisself right now, man.

462
00:25:03,013 --> 00:25:05,878
You ain't gonna stand by
no rat motherfucker, is you?

463
00:25:13,920 --> 00:25:16,805
Naw, I ain't standing with no rat.

464
00:25:29,508 --> 00:25:30,975
These here be them 18-hour junks.

465
00:25:31,043 --> 00:25:32,805
Go to bed, wake up,
still be hot.

466
00:25:32,865 --> 00:25:34,989
Man, feel this one from 3 hours ago.

467
00:25:36,766 --> 00:25:38,423
See what I'm saying, two for one?

468
00:25:38,490 --> 00:25:41,515
Each pack come with two pads.
Buy 5, I give you 6.

469
00:25:41,745 --> 00:25:43,047
Gimme 6 then.

470
00:25:43,094 --> 00:25:44,133
$5?

471
00:25:44,200 --> 00:25:45,308
A piece.

472
00:25:45,368 --> 00:25:47,305
Obliged, sir, obliged.

473
00:25:47,395 --> 00:25:49,058
Take this side,
I'll take this side.

474
00:25:50,601 --> 00:25:51,963
Bubbles depot.

475
00:25:52,103 --> 00:25:53,706
Bubbles depot got what you need,

476
00:25:53,746 --> 00:25:56,130
ya'll come see.
Come see me.

477
00:25:56,648 --> 00:25:58,511
Oh, lookie, lookie--
Hey, Sherrod!

478
00:26:01,215 --> 00:26:02,417
What up?

479
00:26:02,542 --> 00:26:04,225
Car must've hit it or some shit.

480
00:26:06,749 --> 00:26:08,711
- How much you think?
- Aluminum?

481
00:26:08,751 --> 00:26:10,954
Aluminum about 30,
40 cents a pound.

482
00:26:11,853 --> 00:26:13,797
We've got a benjamin here easy, baby.

483
00:26:18,614 --> 00:26:20,399
Teamwork payin' off today,
ain't it, baby?

484
00:26:20,518 --> 00:26:22,061
Go get the heavy side.
Let me try it.

485
00:26:26,545 --> 00:26:27,727
Get out of the way!

486
00:26:28,709 --> 00:26:29,971
That's enough!

487
00:26:31,954 --> 00:26:33,159
Get out of here!

488
00:26:33,641 --> 00:26:35,164
That's enough! Break it up!

489
00:26:35,224 --> 00:26:36,507
Hey, Randy, you bitch.

490
00:26:36,567 --> 00:26:38,510
We ain't even done
with your snitchin' ass.

491
00:26:41,307 --> 00:26:43,431
Guess them books
are good for something.

492
00:26:47,896 --> 00:26:49,459
Somebody call the nurse.

493
00:26:50,340 --> 00:26:51,943
Yo, why they banged me?

494
00:26:52,700 --> 00:26:53,819
I ain't no snitch.

495
00:26:53,886 --> 00:26:55,876
Randy, Randy, it's OK.

496
00:27:03,396 --> 00:27:04,798
Thanks a lot.

497
00:27:09,929 --> 00:27:11,776
Health department shut
Chicken George again?

498
00:27:11,850 --> 00:27:13,319
No, I had to duck in here for cover.

499
00:27:13,385 --> 00:27:14,924
Your boys off the hook today.

500
00:27:26,529 --> 00:27:28,598
Not a good day to be
cross-eyed in west Baltimore.

501
00:27:28,658 --> 00:27:30,982
- What, y'all behind on your
quotas or some shit?

502
00:27:31,142 --> 00:27:32,464
What the fuck?

503
00:27:33,843 --> 00:27:35,606
Seems one of my side
got jumped last night.

504
00:27:35,646 --> 00:27:37,609
Yeah, Walker.
I heard about that shit.

505
00:27:38,131 --> 00:27:39,173
Threw paint on him.

506
00:27:43,834 --> 00:27:45,156
Walker's an asshole.

507
00:27:48,178 --> 00:27:49,791
Hey, you play in dirt,
you get dirty.

508
00:27:50,649 --> 00:27:52,115
<i>7-Adam-14, do you copy?</i>

509
00:27:53,645 --> 00:27:54,968
Go ahead, K.G.A.

510
00:27:55,810 --> 00:27:58,932
<i>Report of a burglary 19 North Monroe.</i>

511
00:27:58,998 --> 00:28:00,046
Copy.

512
00:28:03,257 --> 00:28:04,500
We should do this again.

513
00:28:06,416 --> 00:28:07,946
Don't go making any furtive moves.

514
00:28:08,013 --> 00:28:09,014
No doubt.

515
00:28:09,074 --> 00:28:10,316
Don't break a pencil point.

516
00:28:17,029 --> 00:28:20,455
Mr. P., I swear I only told
the police what everybody knows.

517
00:28:25,142 --> 00:28:26,684
Does that make me a snitch, Michael?

518
00:28:26,784 --> 00:28:28,707
Shouldn't oughta told nobody nothing.

519
00:28:29,933 --> 00:28:31,255
But that don't make you a snitch.

520
00:28:31,315 --> 00:28:32,554
Not if you ain't put nobody in.

521
00:28:32,621 --> 00:28:34,642
Jesus.
I should have stopped this.

522
00:28:34,781 --> 00:28:36,063
It ain't your fault, Mr. P.

523
00:28:36,103 --> 00:28:39,339
I mean, all this come up because of what
Tiffany said happened in the bathroom.

524
00:28:39,399 --> 00:28:41,503
What did you tell them, Randy?
What do they know?

525
00:28:41,584 --> 00:28:44,042
I just told them about
Lex going up to the playground

526
00:28:44,108 --> 00:28:46,512
behind Fulton,
and how everybody said he got killed

527
00:28:46,572 --> 00:28:48,349
and put in one of
them boarded up houses.

528
00:28:48,416 --> 00:28:49,434
That's all you told them?

529
00:28:49,474 --> 00:28:52,484
I mean, they wanted me
to say that I was there, but...

530
00:28:54,596 --> 00:28:56,346
I just told them
that Little Kevin told me.

531
00:28:56,386 --> 00:28:57,994
- Little Kevin?
- He killed, too.

532
00:28:58,332 --> 00:29:01,494
I mean, Marlo got him, too.
That's what everybody saying, anyway.

533
00:29:02,139 --> 00:29:03,494
Marlo Stanfield?

534
00:29:05,959 --> 00:29:07,842
I heard Kevin got
locked up just last week.

535
00:29:07,922 --> 00:29:09,946
Now he's supposed to be up
in the house somewhere.

536
00:29:09,986 --> 00:29:11,706
They put him in a vacant, too, huh?

537
00:29:13,993 --> 00:29:17,962
OK, Randy, for now,
I want to say Michael's right.

538
00:29:18,102 --> 00:29:20,025
If anyone tries to talk to you again,

539
00:29:20,326 --> 00:29:23,233
say nothing to anyone, understand?

540
00:29:23,794 --> 00:29:25,196
Will that make it better?

541
00:29:28,354 --> 00:29:31,019
So in sum, gentlemen,
the gods have spoken.

542
00:29:31,620 --> 00:29:34,084
No longer do we live
and die by stats.

543
00:29:34,445 --> 00:29:36,949
From this day forward
we are about quality arrests,

544
00:29:37,069 --> 00:29:39,016
felonies, serious misdemeanors,

545
00:29:39,237 --> 00:29:42,127
the back-to-basics police work
of our sainted fathers.

546
00:29:42,214 --> 00:29:43,911
Still, the truth is it would be easier

547
00:29:43,978 --> 00:29:46,261
to turn an oil tanker around
in a puddle.

548
00:29:46,651 --> 00:29:48,534
Our people were raised on stats.

549
00:29:50,001 --> 00:29:52,526
If you can't bend patrol
to the mission, Eugene,

550
00:29:53,085 --> 00:29:55,109
I'll damn sure find someone who can.

551
00:29:56,985 --> 00:29:58,067
Gentlemen.

552
00:30:01,507 --> 00:30:02,548
Sir.

553
00:30:06,309 --> 00:30:07,972
Along the line of what you propose,

554
00:30:08,032 --> 00:30:10,196
I'd like to reconstitute
the major crimes unit,

555
00:30:10,276 --> 00:30:11,925
bring it under
the umbrella of homicide.

556
00:30:11,992 --> 00:30:14,887
And let me guess, you'd like
to shake up the personnel.

557
00:30:14,987 --> 00:30:16,149
Where appropriate.

558
00:30:19,205 --> 00:30:20,417
Go for it, Colonel.

559
00:30:27,084 --> 00:30:29,956
- What?
- Smart move, accepting any ideas

560
00:30:30,022 --> 00:30:32,446
whatsoever come from
the anointed fella.

561
00:30:33,822 --> 00:30:35,705
Daniels.
The next commissioner.

562
00:30:35,905 --> 00:30:38,003
Any cocksucker that
manages to go from

563
00:30:38,070 --> 00:30:41,989
Lieutenant to full bird in
a little more than a year

564
00:30:42,156 --> 00:30:43,438
is getting groomed.

565
00:30:44,720 --> 00:30:47,765
Wait...
you didn't for a minute think that--

566
00:30:48,587 --> 00:30:52,213
Ah, Jesus, Bill,
it's Baltimore.

567
00:30:52,526 --> 00:30:54,817
You ain't one
of the natives, are ya?

568
00:31:09,607 --> 00:31:10,937
You see where they went?

569
00:31:11,979 --> 00:31:14,423
El gordo and tall man,
they go in a big room.

570
00:31:14,599 --> 00:31:15,667
First floor.

571
00:31:15,777 --> 00:31:17,620
Sign outside say "new day coop".

572
00:31:17,820 --> 00:31:20,966
Coop?
What's a coop?

573
00:31:22,091 --> 00:31:24,254
New day coop.
That's what it say.

574
00:31:24,890 --> 00:31:27,614
Hey, yo, was there like a bar
between the two O's?

575
00:31:27,754 --> 00:31:28,917
Si, exactly.

576
00:31:29,020 --> 00:31:30,122
Yeah, that's co-op.

577
00:31:31,495 --> 00:31:32,977
Prop Joe in a co-op?

578
00:31:33,298 --> 00:31:35,021
Joe go in with the man we robbed.

579
00:31:35,561 --> 00:31:37,645
Remember, he fell down on his knees,

580
00:31:37,906 --> 00:31:39,144
wept like a little baby.

581
00:31:39,204 --> 00:31:41,708
Yeah, fat face Ricky.
Anybody else?

582
00:31:42,798 --> 00:31:46,364
Si, como 8 or 9 others
I never see before,

583
00:31:46,952 --> 00:31:48,534
but all the same to me, you know?

584
00:31:48,738 --> 00:31:50,120
Narcotraficantes.

585
00:31:50,359 --> 00:31:52,623
Prop Joe sat down to the table.

586
00:31:54,952 --> 00:31:59,099
Oh, do tell.
The worm done came full circle.

587
00:32:01,282 --> 00:32:02,322
Marlo.

588
00:32:04,024 --> 00:32:05,026
Que?

589
00:32:05,106 --> 00:32:06,569
If that is what I think it is,

590
00:32:06,689 --> 00:32:08,548
our little clutch of chickens
might be putting

591
00:32:08,589 --> 00:32:10,231
all their eggs up in one basket.

592
00:32:10,695 --> 00:32:11,799
Is good?

593
00:32:12,881 --> 00:32:14,404
Muy bueno, baby.

594
00:32:17,005 --> 00:32:19,266
Know one thing--
I wouldn't walk around with it

595
00:32:19,326 --> 00:32:21,009
on my neck for walker to find.

596
00:32:21,149 --> 00:32:22,491
He ain't gonna find it.

597
00:32:22,611 --> 00:32:24,429
You crazy even taking a chance.

598
00:32:24,850 --> 00:32:25,954
If he catch you with it,

599
00:32:26,022 --> 00:32:28,065
he gonna break more than them fingers.

600
00:32:30,196 --> 00:32:31,431
Man, what up with you?

601
00:32:31,844 --> 00:32:33,567
It's like lately you gone all...

602
00:32:34,622 --> 00:32:36,185
like taking off the mask, yo.

603
00:32:36,586 --> 00:32:39,110
What up with that?
If Walker got a look--

604
00:32:39,170 --> 00:32:40,332
He didn't.

605
00:32:41,611 --> 00:32:43,234
What about the thing
with you and Randy?

606
00:32:43,294 --> 00:32:45,358
Everybody now is sayin'
you threw down with him,

607
00:32:45,418 --> 00:32:46,900
busted up the boy, dimples, and them.

608
00:32:46,940 --> 00:32:48,194
You wouldn't have stood tall?

609
00:32:48,260 --> 00:32:49,408
That's not what I'm saying.

610
00:32:49,468 --> 00:32:51,752
It's not that you do shit,
it's how you do it.

611
00:32:52,354 --> 00:32:54,904
Yo, look, I'm not trying to stand around

612
00:32:54,971 --> 00:32:57,675
and let no chump-ass niggers
think I'm shook.

613
00:32:58,490 --> 00:32:59,592
I ain't.

614
00:33:09,813 --> 00:33:10,835
And?

615
00:33:10,895 --> 00:33:13,088
And I want you to sign up.

616
00:33:19,408 --> 00:33:22,485
Colonel,
there's the matter of-

617
00:33:22,553 --> 00:33:25,464
You find yourself incompatible
with a certain Lieutenant?

618
00:33:26,148 --> 00:33:27,261
Detective Freamon,

619
00:33:27,327 --> 00:33:29,731
you have carte blanche
in picking your squad.

620
00:33:29,797 --> 00:33:32,785
In fact, you can pick your
supervisor for all I care.

621
00:33:41,462 --> 00:33:45,199
Motherfucker, as far as I'm concerned,
You are the major crimes unit.

622
00:33:46,465 --> 00:33:48,348
It's morning in Baltimore, Lester.

623
00:33:48,743 --> 00:33:50,466
Wake up and smell the coffee.

624
00:33:55,294 --> 00:33:56,526
Reinforcements?

625
00:33:57,899 --> 00:33:59,421
- Carver.
- Damn, boy,

626
00:33:59,502 --> 00:34:01,104
what brings you back
to the plantation?

627
00:34:01,144 --> 00:34:02,967
I trusted you.
Trusted Daniels.

628
00:34:03,335 --> 00:34:04,624
My fucking mistake, huh?

629
00:34:04,811 --> 00:34:05,863
Hold up.
What's wrong?

630
00:34:05,883 --> 00:34:08,707
The kid you were supposed to protect.
You put his name on the street.

631
00:34:08,748 --> 00:34:10,801
They were beating him in front
of the school today,

632
00:34:10,841 --> 00:34:12,063
stomping on him for snitching.

633
00:34:12,103 --> 00:34:13,702
- He all right?
- It's always the same.

634
00:34:13,742 --> 00:34:15,285
I should have fucking seen this coming.

635
00:34:15,325 --> 00:34:17,088
I swear to you,
I don't know what happened.

636
00:34:17,108 --> 00:34:18,914
I hooked the kid into
Bunk Moreland and Herc.

637
00:34:18,981 --> 00:34:20,137
I can't believe...

638
00:34:21,639 --> 00:34:22,681
where's the kid now?

639
00:34:22,741 --> 00:34:23,743
Home.

640
00:34:24,433 --> 00:34:26,176
Let me go give this
to the night commander.

641
00:34:26,196 --> 00:34:27,999
We'll park a plainclothes unit
on the house.

642
00:34:28,039 --> 00:34:29,277
You think that makes it better?

643
00:34:29,317 --> 00:34:31,561
We'll be discreet,
set up down the block or some shit.

644
00:34:31,761 --> 00:34:34,706
Come on inside. I swear to you--
I'm gonna find out what happened.

645
00:35:56,116 --> 00:35:57,617
- Ed Bowers.
- Pleasure to meet you.

646
00:35:57,684 --> 00:35:58,820
You surprised us all.

647
00:35:58,887 --> 00:36:00,686
- Congratulations, Mr. Mayor.
- Thanks.

648
00:36:00,723 --> 00:36:02,491
I'd like to introduce you to Dorothy.

649
00:36:02,551 --> 00:36:03,753
You heard about Ed Nully?

650
00:36:03,793 --> 00:36:06,499
I've heard great things about
what you've been doing, so keep it up.

651
00:36:06,539 --> 00:36:09,605
- I'm delighted you made it, Mr. Mayor.
- Well, it's for a good cause, right?

652
00:36:09,655 --> 00:36:12,341
I am getting the evil eye, however.
I gotta keep him circulating.

653
00:36:12,408 --> 00:36:13,474
- OK.
- This way.

654
00:36:13,514 --> 00:36:14,876
- See you later.
- Take care.

655
00:36:34,624 --> 00:36:37,587
The Washington crowd is driving
the local real estate market now,

656
00:36:37,668 --> 00:36:39,090
and if the harbor promenade

657
00:36:39,130 --> 00:36:40,859
could extend to the south branch--

658
00:36:40,925 --> 00:36:42,528
- We're looking at that.
- Should be.

659
00:36:42,595 --> 00:36:44,550
Everything from here
to Hanover Street is money.

660
00:36:44,591 --> 00:36:46,333
Mr. Mayor,
play a little poker?

661
00:36:46,399 --> 00:36:47,506
I'm not very lucky.

662
00:36:47,826 --> 00:36:49,168
Luck can change.

663
00:36:49,181 --> 00:36:51,005
Mr. Mayor, I'd like you
to meet Ray Chandler.

664
00:36:51,045 --> 00:36:52,588
Pleasure to meet you.

665
00:37:21,758 --> 00:37:25,203
Boy, either you gonna do it,
or I'm gonna.

666
00:37:27,434 --> 00:37:30,159
There's a reason the police keep
jumping out on you, Nay.

667
00:37:34,016 --> 00:37:36,393
So, was it the Bunk's cologne, huh?

668
00:37:38,422 --> 00:37:39,484
Pussy.

669
00:37:40,159 --> 00:37:41,528
I'm gonna miss you, too, bitch.

670
00:37:41,568 --> 00:37:43,511
Lester do love listening
to other people's

671
00:37:43,551 --> 00:37:46,096
phone calls, don't you?
A bit of a pervert that way.

672
00:37:46,136 --> 00:37:48,300
You could use a wiretap case or two.

673
00:37:48,480 --> 00:37:49,642
Broaden your horizons.

674
00:37:49,702 --> 00:37:51,024
Oh, no, no.

675
00:37:51,385 --> 00:37:54,189
The Bunk is strictly
a suit-and-tie motherfucker.

676
00:37:54,931 --> 00:37:57,515
At all hazards,
a man must keep up appearances.

677
00:37:57,575 --> 00:37:59,796
Dignity, I say.
Dignity above all.

678
00:37:59,856 --> 00:38:01,098
Governor, hear, hear!

679
00:38:01,218 --> 00:38:03,802
Bunk, you got a minute?

680
00:38:03,903 --> 00:38:06,109
- What's up?
- The Wagstaff kid I sent your way.

681
00:38:06,204 --> 00:38:07,626
Wagstaff?
He one of mine?

682
00:38:07,666 --> 00:38:09,269
Yeah, you were looking
for the boy Lex,

683
00:38:09,309 --> 00:38:12,498
shot someone outside a nightclub
a couple--three months back.

684
00:38:12,599 --> 00:38:14,562
This kid knew about
Lex getting killed.

685
00:38:14,822 --> 00:38:15,995
Herc brought him to you.

686
00:38:16,656 --> 00:38:17,718
Herc?

687
00:38:19,701 --> 00:38:21,524
This kid is a witness,
and Herc was supposed

688
00:38:21,564 --> 00:38:23,267
- to bring him to me?
- That was the plan.

689
00:38:23,300 --> 00:38:25,063
I'm gonna skin that motherfucker.

690
00:38:28,325 --> 00:38:30,870
Jesus, Herc.
The fuck did you do?

691
00:38:32,208 --> 00:38:33,770
Something happen to that boy?

692
00:38:35,421 --> 00:38:37,084
Well, young man,
your wish has come true.

693
00:38:37,104 --> 00:38:38,947
So this mean I can finally
get out of here?

694
00:38:38,987 --> 00:38:41,031
Yes, Monnel,
paperwork was slow coming in

695
00:38:41,098 --> 00:38:43,735
from North Avenue,
but you five are at the age

696
00:38:43,802 --> 00:38:45,258
where we feel it's to your advantage

697
00:38:45,318 --> 00:38:47,201
to join your peers in the ninth grade.

698
00:38:47,281 --> 00:38:48,664
Yo, we in high school!

699
00:38:48,784 --> 00:38:51,055
- When we bump?
- The end of this marking period.

700
00:38:51,195 --> 00:38:52,537
Congratulations.

701
00:38:52,677 --> 00:38:53,979
You're excused.

702
00:38:56,037 --> 00:38:58,862
<i>Mr. Johnson, you have</i>
<i>a visitor in the front office.</i>

703
00:38:58,962 --> 00:39:01,927
<i>Mr. Johnson, please come down</i>
<i>to the front office.</i>

704
00:39:02,307 --> 00:39:03,579
Bad news?

705
00:39:03,759 --> 00:39:05,282
Plenty more to go around.

706
00:39:05,522 --> 00:39:07,626
They pulled the pin on your program.

707
00:39:13,224 --> 00:39:15,448
As I've been saying this week
at every roll call

708
00:39:15,528 --> 00:39:16,627
in every damn district,

709
00:39:16,667 --> 00:39:18,495
if I could scrape together
anymore, I would,

710
00:39:18,561 --> 00:39:21,367
but for starters, it's a 5% salary year,
and that's a given.

711
00:39:21,407 --> 00:39:22,969
I know it's not half what you deserve,

712
00:39:23,009 --> 00:39:26,341
but if the revenue estimates stay good,
I promise you'll be seeing more.

713
00:39:29,915 --> 00:39:31,029
Mr. Mayor!

714
00:39:31,109 --> 00:39:33,192
My wife thanks you,
my children thank you,

715
00:39:33,272 --> 00:39:34,474
my dog thanks you.

716
00:39:35,098 --> 00:39:37,842
Hey, Sanny, how you able to
tell your wife from your mutt?

717
00:39:37,902 --> 00:39:40,106
His wife, she's the one
that's got the fleas.

718
00:39:40,166 --> 00:39:43,381
Shit, Bobby, with your old lady,
fleas would be an improvement.

719
00:39:43,502 --> 00:39:45,845
At ease, we got the Mayor here,
gentlemen.

720
00:39:45,905 --> 00:39:48,545
When they sit in one place too long
they get a little feisty.

721
00:39:48,622 --> 00:39:51,346
I'm not going to stand here
and pretend I know how to do your job.

722
00:39:51,386 --> 00:39:53,029
I don't, but what
I can tell you is that

723
00:39:53,049 --> 00:39:56,226
during the past few weeks
I have spoken with many of your peers,

724
00:39:56,293 --> 00:39:58,871
with your union reps,
with the representatives of the F.O.P.,

725
00:39:58,911 --> 00:40:01,015
and the biggest
single complaint I'm hearing

726
00:40:01,055 --> 00:40:03,389
concerns the department's
obsession with stats.

727
00:40:03,449 --> 00:40:04,851
The fucking numbers game.

728
00:40:04,931 --> 00:40:07,275
Well, under my watch
the numbers game is over.

729
00:40:07,315 --> 00:40:09,891
You will no longer be under
the gun to meet monthly quotas

730
00:40:09,951 --> 00:40:12,616
of ineffective, meaningless
arrests and citations.

731
00:40:15,739 --> 00:40:16,741
Excuse me, your worship.

732
00:40:16,781 --> 00:40:19,505
You're not the first person
who stood at the podium making promises.

733
00:40:19,545 --> 00:40:21,709
Jimmy, I'm sure the Mayor
has some pressing business.

734
00:40:21,729 --> 00:40:23,748
No, I'm just saying,
the first community activist

735
00:40:23,788 --> 00:40:26,507
who pitches a bitch about
the corner activity in her neighborhood,

736
00:40:26,537 --> 00:40:28,661
aren't we gonna go right back
to rounding up bodies?

737
00:40:28,681 --> 00:40:30,912
We need to educate
our citizens to the new approach.

738
00:40:30,952 --> 00:40:32,785
They're not the only
ones who need educating.

739
00:40:32,845 --> 00:40:35,690
We got bosses that wouldn't know
police work if it bit 'em in the ass.

740
00:40:35,909 --> 00:40:37,251
They been juking stats for years,

741
00:40:37,272 --> 00:40:39,423
and will do it again once
the neighborhoods complain.

742
00:40:39,463 --> 00:40:40,464
It's all they know.

743
00:40:40,504 --> 00:40:43,669
If the old dogs can't get the job done,
I'll find new ones who can.

744
00:40:45,930 --> 00:40:48,194
Look, for years,
I sat on the back bench of the council

745
00:40:48,234 --> 00:40:49,997
and watched our city deteriorate.

746
00:40:50,138 --> 00:40:52,626
It was business as usual
with the same old ideas

747
00:40:52,686 --> 00:40:54,369
producing the same old results.

748
00:40:54,589 --> 00:40:56,893
Well, I'm here now as you are,
and I'm asking you

749
00:40:56,953 --> 00:40:59,248
to put aside your reservations
and give it a go.

750
00:41:03,257 --> 00:41:04,399
All told.

751
00:41:06,583 --> 00:41:07,825
You did good.

752
00:41:08,006 --> 00:41:09,749
You got 'em pumped.
They love you.

753
00:41:09,909 --> 00:41:13,707
Of course, the wrong decision on
Sergeant Hauk, and who knows?

754
00:41:16,667 --> 00:41:18,670
Carv said the kid had something on it.

755
00:41:18,890 --> 00:41:19,892
I talked to him.

756
00:41:19,932 --> 00:41:22,316
He had nothing,
just a bunch of hearsay

757
00:41:22,376 --> 00:41:23,564
and some shit about zombies.

758
00:41:23,604 --> 00:41:24,926
The boy was to come to me.

759
00:41:24,966 --> 00:41:27,196
You know the goddamn G.O.--
it's homicide's call.

760
00:41:27,236 --> 00:41:29,652
You don't go putting your paws
in my murder, you simple fuck.

761
00:41:29,719 --> 00:41:31,058
Hey! You're talking to a Sergeant.

762
00:41:31,098 --> 00:41:32,524
Oh, fuck your fucking stripes!

763
00:41:32,751 --> 00:41:34,193
Take it easy, Bunk.

764
00:41:34,273 --> 00:41:36,076
Now, Herc is trying to help us, here.

765
00:41:36,136 --> 00:41:37,799
Man, he messed in my murder, he pays.

766
00:41:37,859 --> 00:41:40,050
Give him a chance.
We can work something out.

767
00:41:40,110 --> 00:41:42,988
That's easy for you to say.
You ain't the primary on this.

768
00:41:43,389 --> 00:41:44,771
Mother fucker...

769
00:41:48,982 --> 00:41:50,144
What got into him?

770
00:41:51,186 --> 00:41:52,528
He's emotional.

771
00:41:52,628 --> 00:41:54,531
He's been working this case
for a long time.

772
00:41:56,630 --> 00:41:58,489
So the thing right now
is for you to remember

773
00:41:58,529 --> 00:42:00,393
everything you did on this case.

774
00:42:00,886 --> 00:42:02,289
From the beginning.

775
00:42:13,939 --> 00:42:17,265
He's out there,
hat in hand, literally.

776
00:42:17,374 --> 00:42:19,498
Well, he can wait till hell freezes over.

777
00:42:19,698 --> 00:42:21,841
A wise man does not burn his bridges

778
00:42:21,881 --> 00:42:24,596
until he first knows
he can part the waters.

779
00:42:25,017 --> 00:42:26,158
Old Ashanti saying.

780
00:42:26,199 --> 00:42:28,087
Norman, you grew up in Catonsville.

781
00:42:31,799 --> 00:42:33,261
Show the motherfucker in.

782
00:42:42,895 --> 00:42:44,192
Mr. Mayor,

783
00:42:44,713 --> 00:42:47,448
you know, I don't want to take time
out of your busy schedule.

784
00:42:47,528 --> 00:42:49,857
Look, if this is about me
countermanding your orders

785
00:42:49,923 --> 00:42:51,439
- for more arrests--
- No, sir.

786
00:42:51,496 --> 00:42:54,381
You should proceed as you feel
the situation warrants.

787
00:42:54,441 --> 00:42:58,307
Overall policing strategies
may not be my strongest suit.

788
00:42:58,635 --> 00:43:00,738
I'm here about what I do know.

789
00:43:00,911 --> 00:43:03,516
A recommendation from
Sergeant Hauk's commander

790
00:43:03,636 --> 00:43:05,219
will cross your desk tomorrow.

791
00:43:05,379 --> 00:43:07,522
Colonel Daniels,

00:05:35,518 --> 00:05:38,361
We find these in the plywood
anywhere in this city,

30
00:05:38,738 --> 00:05:40,248
and there's a body inside.

31
00:05:41,256 --> 00:05:43,805
Gosh, that's good work.

32
00:05:44,660 --> 00:05:46,557
No, I'm very impressed.

33
00:05:48,866 --> 00:05:50,552
Do you see a tool belt on me?

34
00:05:51,122 --> 00:05:52,948
Do I look like
one of those fuckin' jerkoffs

35
00:05:53,007 --> 00:05:54,699
in aisle 5 of the Home fuckin' Depot?

36
00:05:55,123 --> 00:05:56,888
There's 3 weeks left in the year,

37
00:05:57,260 --> 00:05:59,691
And our unit clearance rate
is under 50%.

38
00:06:01,240 --> 00:06:02,809
We do not go looking for bodies,

39
00:06:03,198 --> 00:06:06,276
Especially moldering
fucking John does.

40
00:06:06,527 --> 00:06:08,760
We do not put red up
on the board voluntarily.

41
00:06:08,884 --> 00:06:11,256
Jay, the bodies are in the houses.

44
00:06:15,455 --> 00:06:17,373
Now, I realize
you're no longer in my squad,

45
00:06:17,413 --> 00:06:18,864
Mr. Major crimes,

46
00:06:19,477 --> 00:06:21,359
But you're still part of C.I.D., right?

47
00:06:21,660 --> 00:06:23,470
And look--
I'm still a Sergeant, right?

48
00:06:23,660 --> 00:06:25,771
And I'm giving you
an order on this, Lester.

49
00:06:26,096 --> 00:06:28,685
Until I feel
chain-of-command down on this

50
00:06:28,861 --> 00:06:31,990
and until you hear otherwise,

51
00:06:32,128 --> 00:06:35,373
I repeat not--
pull down any more

52
00:06:35,529 --> 00:06:36,941
Fucking wood!

53
00:06:48,994 --> 00:06:50,206
Let it go, man.

54
00:06:50,336 --> 00:06:52,128
I mean, you know,
I expect a shortfall

55
00:06:52,281 --> 00:06:54,595
