It's a natural.

56
00:06:54,653 --> 00:06:57,771
But how in Christ's name
do you lose $54 million?

57
00:06:57,894 --> 00:06:59,161
One million at a time.

58
00:06:59,228 --> 00:07:00,922
Exactly.
It didn't happen this morning.

59
00:07:00,981 --> 00:07:02,512

60
00:07:02,689 --> 00:07:06,669
You didn't get a whiff

61
00:07:06,768 --> 00:07:09,761

62
00:07:09,827 --> 00:07:12,293

63
00:07:12,360 --> 00:07:14,184

64
00:07:14,262 --> 00:07:15,987

65

66
00:07:18,321 --> 00:07:19,911

67
00:07:20,505 --> 00:07:22,368

pretty new chief of staff

68
00:07:22,407 --> 00:07:24,133

69

70

71
00:07:27,460 --> 00:07:28,702

72

73
00:07:32,410 --> 00:07:35,128

74
00:07:35,194 --> 00:07:38,498

until it ran out of cash.

75
00:07:38,510 --> 00:07:40,275
That's not bookkeeping,
that's stupidity.

76

77
00:07:43,210 --> 00:07:44,641

78

I would say that although
the system has

79
00:07:47,460 --> 00:07:49,187

80
00:07:49,505 --> 00:07:52,413
in the end we're going to find

81

82
00:07:54,470 --> 00:07:56,588

83
00:07:57,183 --> 00:07:59,961
No one's responsible,

84
00:08:00,027 --> 00:08:02,298

85
00:08:02,337 --> 00:08:04,161

86
00:08:04,228 --> 00:08:06,617

87
00:08:08,354 --> 00:08:09,923

88
00:08:11,427 --> 00:08:12,707

89

90

Tell everyone-- Schools,

91
00:08:19,232 --> 00:08:21,164

92
00:08:21,360 --> 00:08:22,610

93
00:08:23,525 --> 00:08:25,643
I just ran

94
00:08:26,190 --> 00:08:29,179
I just got done promising the world

95
00:08:30,123 --> 00:08:31,358

96
00:08:32,090 --> 00:08:33,875

97
00:08:48,633 --> 00:08:50,535

98
00:08:50,986 --> 00:08:52,417

99

100
00:08:57,953 --> 00:09:00,463

00:09:04,836 --> 00:09:06,895

102
00:09:07,532 --> 00:09:08,865
Vamanos, 'Naldo.

00:09:25,391 --> 00:09:27,764

104
00:09:32,758 --> 00:09:35,288
Damn, y'all some semper fi

00:09:47,994 --> 00:09:50,660

00:09:50,953 --> 00:09:53,188

Yeah.

113

114

The shit will be

115
00:10:14,827 --> 00:10:17,053
- Yo, we ain't usin' these no more.

116

All we do is ring you

118

119

120

121

122

125

126
00:11:18,327 --> 00:11:19,594

127

I'm the luckiest motherfucker you know.

128

129

If anyone needs me,

147

148
00:12:17,383 --> 00:12:18,638

- Yes?

Damn, boy,

They kicked my motherfuckin' door in.

Well, look,
how the police know

Ain't that,

187

$50 million in the hole,

Nah, nah.
That ain't me.

Oh, you thinking formaldehyde.

212

That's the shit.

Nigga's got a taste of that shit,

university started

No, man, that stuff

That shit looks and cooks

That's all there is to it?

227

It ain't no thing to kill a nigga

And the police,

231

More young males

233

238
00:16:44,495 --> 00:16:48,319

239
00:16:48,916 --> 00:16:51,700
For the files...
right.

240
00:16:54,147 --> 00:16:55,382
Damn, son.

241

Kenard said the police took it?

242

He said they kicked his door in.

243

And they ain't lock no one up?

244

Yo, you see that door?

245

Were the hinges broke?

246

I mean, if he said

00:17:16,660 --> 00:17:18,477

I sweated him, yo.

250
00:17:24,207 --> 00:17:26,697
That little motherfucker

Bet it.

00:17:32,204 --> 00:17:34,381

254

255

258

Enough to get me home, didn't it?

259
00:17:52,413 --> 00:17:54,236
I'm just sayin', Butch,

00:17:54,256 --> 00:17:56,761

You feel me?
So they don't see me coming.

It ain't like you

265
00:18:08,919 --> 00:18:10,016

266

What's up, baby?

267
00:18:13,172 --> 00:18:14,427
Damn, girl, you looking good.

268

269

270

Long time, long time.

271

272

273

Subtle.

277
00:18:40,289 --> 00:18:42,074
Glasses first so they don't spot.

278
00:18:42,293 --> 00:18:43,397
Yes, ma'am.

279
00:18:51,427 --> 00:18:53,349
- Hello.
- Ho, Mr. Prezbo.

280
00:18:53,627 --> 00:18:55,850
- Come in, please.
- Oh, that's OK.

281
00:18:55,889 --> 00:18:58,730
I just wanted
to stop by on my way home

282
00:18:58,788 --> 00:19:00,861
and drop off Randy's work
for next week.

283
00:19:01,022 --> 00:19:04,218
Hopefully...
this thing will be over soon.

284
00:19:04,296 --> 00:19:06,427
Maybe so,
but we're looking at

285
00:19:06,494 --> 00:19:07,951
the possibility of moving him

286
00:19:08,010 --> 00:19:09,827
to Booker T. Washington
next semester.

287
00:19:10,102 --> 00:19:11,475
I hope that isn't necessary.

288
00:19:11,514 --> 00:19:12,632
I hope so, too.

289
00:19:12,899 --> 00:19:14,527
Anyway, thanks
for bringing this.

290
00:19:14,686 --> 00:19:16,427
I'll try to keep him up to speed.

291
00:19:16,589 --> 00:19:17,785
Hang in there, kiddo.

292
00:19:17,927 --> 00:19:19,010
Thanks.

293
00:19:50,748 --> 00:19:52,003
Long conference call.

294
00:19:53,015 --> 00:19:55,446
About an hour so far,
by my watch.

295
00:19:57,032 --> 00:19:58,835
Got me out here riding the wood.

296
00:19:59,208 --> 00:20:01,128
Unfortunately
the Governor's phone call

297
00:20:01,186 --> 00:20:03,160
has gone longer than anticipated.

298
00:20:03,331 --> 00:20:04,687
Can I get you anything?
Coffee?

299
00:20:04,766 --> 00:20:07,228
Look,
I have other appointments.

300
00:20:07,497 --> 00:20:08,987
It shouldn't be much longer.

301
00:20:13,897 --> 00:20:15,975
Check out
Fisher's column in metro.

302
00:20:16,629 --> 00:20:19,276
He says,
the Governor thinks, quote,

303
00:20:19,723 --> 00:20:23,292
"This latest fiscal emergency
calls into question

304
00:20:23,370 --> 00:20:26,691
"the Baltimore school system's
ability to manage itself

305
00:20:26,750 --> 00:20:29,893
as well as the local
oversight of the system,"

306
00:20:30,275 --> 00:20:31,392
Unquote.

307
00:20:31,918 --> 00:20:33,075
Motherfucker.

308
00:20:34,970 --> 00:20:36,676
He's playing to the D.C. suburbs.

309
00:20:36,794 --> 00:20:39,069
He sees you coming for him
two years from now.

310
00:20:39,702 --> 00:20:41,094
He ain't no fool.

311
00:20:44,994 --> 00:20:47,296
There's all your electronic
requisitions right there.

312
00:20:50,568 --> 00:20:52,469
What one's that, a cop?

313
00:20:53,027 --> 00:20:54,988
Nah, security guard.

314
00:20:55,527 --> 00:20:57,460
I don't think he's
one of Marlo's though.

315
00:20:59,123 --> 00:21:00,260
Lieutenant.

316
00:21:01,102 --> 00:21:03,762
Will someone explain to me
what the fuck the brass is doing?

317
00:21:03,914 --> 00:21:05,927
First I get bounced
to telephone reporting,

318
00:21:05,994 --> 00:21:07,594
then I get a call this morning...

319
00:21:07,660 --> 00:21:09,460
How's that beach house coming, huh?

320
00:21:09,527 --> 00:21:10,529
It's almost done,

321
00:21:10,568 --> 00:21:12,980
- I just need a load of lumber--
- That's great, just great.

322
00:21:12,999 --> 00:21:14,514
Welcome. Welcome back.

323
00:21:22,105 --> 00:21:23,438
Who the fuck is that?

324
00:21:25,598 --> 00:21:27,324
That, Sergeant Hauk...

325
00:21:28,180 --> 00:21:31,839
is one of the most effective supervisors
in our police department.

326
00:21:36,327 --> 00:21:37,470
Sorry.

327
00:21:37,587 --> 00:21:39,927
It's just taking a little
longer than we expected.

328
00:21:40,146 --> 00:21:41,871
It shouldn't be much longer, though.

329
00:21:44,360 --> 00:21:45,993
I understand what you're saying.

330
00:21:46,052 --> 00:21:47,895
Some of those kids
are ready for high school,

331
00:21:47,954 --> 00:21:49,241
But not Duquan.

332
00:21:51,143 --> 00:21:52,621
- I've--
- Adopted him?

333
00:21:53,027 --> 00:21:54,994
I've noticed Duquan this semester.

334
00:21:55,186 --> 00:21:57,735
He's more nourished,
wears fresher clothes.

335
00:21:58,285 --> 00:22:00,246
Sometimes he even smells like soap.

336
00:22:01,329 --> 00:22:02,506
You and your wife...

337
00:22:02,945 --> 00:22:04,553
you don't have children, do you?

338
00:22:05,149 --> 00:22:06,994
- Not yet, no.
- Well, have some.

339
00:22:07,061 --> 00:22:09,027
For better or for worse,
they're yours for life.

340
00:22:09,094 --> 00:22:11,122
The kids in this school aren't yours.

341
00:22:11,507 --> 00:22:14,154
You do your piece with them,
and you let them go.

342
00:22:14,890 --> 00:22:17,930
Because there'll be plenty more
coming up behind Duquan,

343
00:22:18,457 --> 00:22:20,457
and they're gonna
need your help, too.

344
00:22:23,689 --> 00:22:26,376
You've got your third period
in five minutes, right?

345
00:22:32,558 --> 00:22:34,460
Settle down.
Settle down.

346
00:22:34,527 --> 00:22:36,293
We need to concentrate on these tests.

347
00:22:36,360 --> 00:22:37,668
Ah, fuck this, man.

348
00:22:37,707 --> 00:22:39,260
Talking 'bout,
"if Jane's father

349
00:22:39,327 --> 00:22:41,228
gives Jane one week's 
worth of allowance."

350
00:22:41,441 --> 00:22:45,254
Shit, I ain't got no allowance
where I stay at. Father, neither.

351
00:22:45,313 --> 00:22:47,274
How many sides a sexagon got?

352
00:22:47,430 --> 00:22:48,547
Why I care about that?

353
00:22:48,605 --> 00:22:51,174
You need to take the test
so you can move on to the next level.

354
00:22:51,213 --> 00:22:53,306
I ain't moving nowhere
but out this motherfucker.

355
00:22:54,258 --> 00:22:56,759
All right, all right.
Let's settle down.

356
00:22:57,205 --> 00:22:59,264
Let's start with question number 1.

357
00:22:59,455 --> 00:23:00,867
Settle down!

358
00:23:03,894 --> 00:23:06,503
All right.
All right, listen up.

359
00:23:07,454 --> 00:23:08,552
Here's the problem.

360
00:23:08,978 --> 00:23:10,644
Two couples go into a restaurant.

361
00:23:10,703 --> 00:23:12,827
- They get the check--
- Yo, when they say couples,

362
00:23:12,866 --> 00:23:15,161
- do it mean they married?
- Why they got to be married?

363
00:23:15,228 --> 00:23:17,199
Mr. Prezbo, why you even get married?

364
00:23:17,531 --> 00:23:20,335
Well, to build a life together for one,

365
00:23:21,070 --> 00:23:22,327
you know, family.

366
00:23:22,532 --> 00:23:24,454
Also to have intimacy.

367
00:23:24,546 --> 00:23:26,652
- What do that mean?
- He mean, like, getting some.

368
00:23:27,103 --> 00:23:30,182
No, no.
It's not just that.

369
00:23:31,313 --> 00:23:34,803
Intimacy can be, um,
a quiet conversation.

370
00:23:35,165 --> 00:23:36,500
Or it can fun, you know?

371
00:23:36,578 --> 00:23:38,993
Like when you tickle your partner.

372
00:23:39,075 --> 00:23:40,350
Yo, tickle my nuts.

373
00:23:45,421 --> 00:23:48,617
All right, all right,
no more of that.

374
00:23:48,994 --> 00:23:51,130
Come on, let's get to the test material.

375
00:23:52,194 --> 00:23:54,073
The statewide exam is next week,

376
00:23:54,132 --> 00:23:56,574
and then we'll get back
to the regular lessons.

377
00:23:56,711 --> 00:23:58,224
Can we talk about intimacy?

378
00:23:58,322 --> 00:24:02,327
If you like, and,
if I don't get too embarrassed.

379
00:24:04,609 --> 00:24:07,066
All right, uh...
so the grand total on the check

380
00:24:07,124 --> 00:24:11,078
is $67.40,
but if they want to leave a tip--

381
00:24:12,696 --> 00:24:15,304
Look at your sample test, please.

382
00:24:15,397 --> 00:24:18,042
I got to say, miss Duquette,
it felt like y'all schemed us.

383
00:24:18,120 --> 00:24:20,101
This class is the same
as the ones down the hall.

384
00:24:20,159 --> 00:24:21,610
Yeah, it's 'cause the test coming up.

385
00:24:21,669 --> 00:24:24,159
OK, class, let's take a look
at the sample math test.

386
00:24:24,238 --> 00:24:27,561
- In sample "a", we start with...
- Kid's right. This is bullshit.

387
00:24:27,846 --> 00:24:30,110
The test material doesn't
exactly speak to their world.

388
00:24:30,169 --> 00:24:32,183
Yeah, don't speak too loud
to mine, either.

389
00:24:32,944 --> 00:24:34,375
An estimate, Detective.

390
00:24:35,260 --> 00:24:36,694
We start opening those houses,

391
00:24:36,761 --> 00:24:39,409
we might turn over
a couple of dozen bodies,

392
00:24:39,821 --> 00:24:41,468
but that's just me guessing.

393
00:24:41,508 --> 00:24:42,782
All of them homicides?

394
00:24:42,924 --> 00:24:45,081
The boy took over half the west side.

395
00:24:45,228 --> 00:24:46,930
We never saw the violence.

396
00:24:47,662 --> 00:24:49,643
This right here is the reason why.

397
00:24:50,460 --> 00:24:52,771
You're asking us to call out
half of public works

398
00:24:52,942 --> 00:24:55,360
and pull the plywood off
thousands of vacant houses

399
00:24:55,427 --> 00:24:57,961
all so we can raise
the city's murder rate by 10%?

400
00:24:58,549 --> 00:25:00,260
What else are we doing on Stanfield?

401
00:25:00,553 --> 00:25:04,260
I'm trying to get backup on his people's
cellphones as fast as I can.

402
00:25:04,327 --> 00:25:06,194
And I started to look for his money.

403
00:25:06,628 --> 00:25:09,628
But if I'm right about this,
they have to be worked.

404
00:25:10,161 --> 00:25:11,363
Is there any evidence at all

405
00:25:11,421 --> 00:25:13,535
that links all these
missing persons reports

406
00:25:13,593 --> 00:25:15,128
to the Stanfield organization?

407
00:25:15,415 --> 00:25:16,694
I'm just starting at that.

408
00:25:16,858 --> 00:25:20,300
The one body that we pulled out of
the Fulton avenue house is Lex.

409
00:25:20,774 --> 00:25:22,637
His case is a direct tie.

410
00:25:23,097 --> 00:25:25,519
And there are two other names on
those missing persons reports

411
00:25:25,637 --> 00:25:28,094
that show up in our wire taps
from earlier this year.

412
00:25:28,376 --> 00:25:30,572
So, yes, there are links, counselor.

413
00:25:31,570 --> 00:25:34,912
By any chance, did Landsman
run this up the chain to you guys?

414
00:25:35,089 --> 00:25:36,187
No.

415
00:25:38,358 --> 00:25:39,515
Your call.

416
00:25:40,574 --> 00:25:43,084
My office won't care
until they see case files.

417
00:25:51,987 --> 00:25:53,202
I'll run it upstairs,

418
00:25:54,242 --> 00:25:55,692
and we'll see what comes.

419
00:26:01,566 --> 00:26:02,594
OK, I get it.

420
00:26:02,660 --> 00:26:03,761
He's still tied up,

421
00:26:03,827 --> 00:26:06,579
but it really should only be
a little while longer.

422
00:26:06,964 --> 00:26:09,393
Can you tell the Governor
I have to go back to Baltimore.

423
00:26:09,585 --> 00:26:12,154
I have a little bit
of business today.

424
00:26:13,842 --> 00:26:16,235
I'm the mayor of a major American city,
for Christ's sakes.

425
00:26:16,294 --> 00:26:18,118
How much shit
do I have to eat from this guy?

426
00:26:18,157 --> 00:26:20,262
Wouldn't you play the politics
if you were him?

427
00:26:20,320 --> 00:26:22,332
It's not like the state
had no role in this thing.

428
00:26:22,351 --> 00:26:24,748
The state money for those
schools had no oversight either.

429
00:26:24,826 --> 00:26:26,798
But I'm not telling
the Washington fucking Post,

430
00:26:26,856 --> 00:26:28,385
talking about how
he might be forced

431
00:26:28,443 --> 00:26:31,424
to bail me out because--
What was the quote again?

432
00:26:33,027 --> 00:26:35,809
Because "those are my children
in Baltimore, too."

433
00:26:37,344 --> 00:26:39,011
He's gonna bleed me for that money.

434
00:26:39,893 --> 00:26:40,971
Mayor Carcetti?

435
00:26:41,128 --> 00:26:43,558
The governor's office
says he's ready to see you now.

436
00:26:45,736 --> 00:26:47,422
$54 million's a big number.

437
00:26:50,440 --> 00:26:52,373
We won't go until we get some,

438
00:26:52,432 --> 00:26:54,288
we won't go until we get some--

439
00:27:31,934 --> 00:27:33,424
Did I do something wrong?

440
00:27:33,895 --> 00:27:35,483
I ain't acted up or nothing.

441
00:27:37,809 --> 00:27:39,142
You're ready for this.

442
00:27:40,907 --> 00:27:42,398
You can do the work.

443
00:27:43,217 --> 00:27:44,472
I know you can.

444
00:27:46,158 --> 00:27:49,111
And if you need
to come back here

445
00:27:49,190 --> 00:27:53,142
and use the showers
or give me laundry,

446
00:27:53,745 --> 00:27:56,235
use the computer,
you can do that any time.

447
00:27:58,788 --> 00:28:00,161
Anyway, let me show you.

448
00:28:00,827 --> 00:28:02,670
This here the way to the hard drive.

449
00:28:06,355 --> 00:28:08,041
This isn't necessary, Duquan.

450
00:28:09,036 --> 00:28:10,722
Just in case I'm busy, Mr. P.

451
00:28:11,260 --> 00:28:12,870
So you know how to work it.

452
00:28:44,185 --> 00:28:45,695
- Hey, boy.
- What's up?

453
00:28:46,995 --> 00:28:49,132
Big day for you.
See here?

454
00:28:49,540 --> 00:28:51,228
I got the inventory
divided between us.

455
00:28:51,293 --> 00:28:54,142
You gonna go up one way
towards North Avenue...

456
00:28:54,957 --> 00:28:56,660
and I'm gonna stay down
by the highway.

457
00:28:56,727 --> 00:28:58,850
You gonna let me handle
the money alone?

458
00:29:00,518 --> 00:29:01,593
You ready, ain't you?

459
00:29:01,893 --> 00:29:03,094
Yeah, I'm good.

460
00:29:03,364 --> 00:29:06,148
All right.
Let's get on it.

461
00:29:07,094 --> 00:29:08,360
I see you back here tonight.

462
00:29:08,427 --> 00:29:09,525
All right.

463
00:29:12,217 --> 00:29:14,927
You see that foul motherfucker,
you let him have his money, OK?

464
00:29:14,994 --> 00:29:17,109
- I don't need you messing with him.
- All right.

465
00:29:19,088 --> 00:29:20,775
Make sure that count's right!

466
00:29:23,893 --> 00:29:26,226
Yo, I need to talk to
the little motherfucker.

467
00:29:26,814 --> 00:29:28,246
Maybe you can do that with me,

468
00:29:28,559 --> 00:29:29,940
see it don't get out of hand.

469
00:29:30,118 --> 00:29:31,707
Hey! Yo, Mike!

470
00:29:33,105 --> 00:29:34,164
Yo, what up, Duke?

471
00:29:37,385 --> 00:29:40,090
I heard Randy's foster mom
gonna take him out of Tilghman, too.

472
00:29:40,308 --> 00:29:41,833
Send him somewhere else.

473
00:29:42,065 --> 00:29:43,438
That's messed up, man.

474
00:29:45,073 --> 00:29:46,269
All right, holla, man.

475
00:29:50,386 --> 00:29:51,451
How many?

476
00:29:52,414 --> 00:29:53,606
As a theory,

477
00:29:53,777 --> 00:29:55,474
Detective Freamon believes
there could be

478
00:29:55,513 --> 00:29:57,944
additional bodies in those vacants,
maybe a dozen or more.

479
00:29:58,062 --> 00:29:59,226
He believes?

480
00:29:59,559 --> 00:30:02,525
Lester Freamon is not
in the habit of selling woof tickets.

481
00:30:03,107 --> 00:30:04,818
I, for one,
would not bet against him.

482
00:30:04,896 --> 00:30:07,445
And what do you suggest I do
with this information?

483
00:30:08,490 --> 00:30:09,744
My feeling is

484
00:30:10,250 --> 00:30:12,309
that city hall should be
brought into the loop.

485
00:30:12,925 --> 00:30:14,982
We pull the bodies now
before New Year's,

486
00:30:15,041 --> 00:30:17,352
and the stats
go to Royce's last year in office.

487
00:30:17,786 --> 00:30:19,705
Matter of fact,
it gives Carcetti an advantage

488
00:30:19,745 --> 00:30:21,333
with regards to
next year's crime rate.

489
00:30:21,391 --> 00:30:22,823
- You mean--
- Tell the mayor

490
00:30:22,980 --> 00:30:24,990
that now is the time
to empty those houses,

491
00:30:25,088 --> 00:30:28,715
not next year, when it's on his watch
and he has to eat the stats.

492
00:30:32,878 --> 00:30:35,100
Colonel, I see you've
thought this through,

493
00:30:35,321 --> 00:30:36,534
politically, I mean.

494
00:30:37,253 --> 00:30:38,430
I'm learning as I go.

495
00:30:39,033 --> 00:30:40,288
I bet you fuckin' are.

496
00:30:42,102 --> 00:30:44,200
Colonel, keep this conversation close.

497
00:30:44,676 --> 00:30:45,971
That's a direct order.

498
00:30:48,208 --> 00:30:50,462
You seen those girls at Douglass, man?

499
00:30:51,440 --> 00:30:53,292
Yo, you right, Duke.

500
00:30:53,645 --> 00:30:55,606
Ain't gonna be like
middle school no more.

501
00:30:55,900 --> 00:30:57,584
You know, I'm just thinking, yo.

502
00:31:00,349 --> 00:31:02,271
Dag, man, not again.

503
00:31:07,631 --> 00:31:09,121
Where your people at now?

504
00:31:17,919 --> 00:31:20,156
Need any of your stuff from the pile?

505
00:31:20,607 --> 00:31:21,823
It ain't no thing.

506
00:31:26,166 --> 00:31:27,276
Yo, man, listen.

507
00:31:27,688 --> 00:31:29,200
Me and Bug got our own spot now,

508
00:31:29,551 --> 00:31:32,002
so you could come
crib with us if you want.

509
00:31:41,419 --> 00:31:43,811
What you mean
Kenard took the stash?

510
00:31:44,959 --> 00:31:46,534
And he's still walking around?

511
00:31:47,028 --> 00:31:49,567
I'm gonna talk to him, Ma.
Make sure this never happen again.

512
00:31:50,069 --> 00:31:51,285
Look at me, boy.

513
00:31:52,459 --> 00:31:54,701
Kenard got to feel
some pain for what he did.

514
00:31:55,264 --> 00:31:56,470
- He got to.
- I don't--

515
00:31:56,509 --> 00:31:58,146
You don't what, motherfucker?

516
00:31:58,834 --> 00:32:01,467
This how you pay me back
for all the love I showed?

517
00:32:01,859 --> 00:32:05,564
Shit, I been kept you in Nikes
since you were in diapers.

518
00:32:05,724 --> 00:32:07,434
- I'm trying.
- You trying, huh?

519
00:32:08,010 --> 00:32:09,614
That's what you gonna tell your father

520
00:32:09,673 --> 00:32:11,701
the next time you see him,
that you trying?

521
00:32:12,055 --> 00:32:14,174
Or you gonna tell him
what you've done?

522
00:32:14,233 --> 00:32:15,978
What he done got him locked up.

523
00:32:18,517 --> 00:32:19,634
That's right.

524
00:32:19,856 --> 00:32:23,346
Wee-Bey walked in Jessup a man,
and he gonna walk out one.

525
00:32:23,405 --> 00:32:26,924
But you out here,
wearing his name, acting a bitch.

526
00:32:27,978 --> 00:32:30,351
Oh, look at you,
crying now.

527
00:32:35,612 --> 00:32:37,063
Fuck you think you going?

528

fucked his shit up.

Bunny.

Omar had one of them commando

Listen,
you got to understand

Mike.

## S04E13

7

He is a hun, a Visigoth,
a barbarian at the gate

00:00:56,848 --> 00:01:01,143

28

29

I did.

30
00:01:56,057 --> 00:01:57,104
I did.

39

If you're saying--

Fuck!

Shit.
He got my fucking sleeve.

Yeah.

Fuck.

Jesus.

Come on. Come on.

Call 911. The mutt in Box 1

4x13 Final Grades

Two on this block

58

Scary thing is we're only

Shit. One sector.

64

There's only one way to find out.

65

Dennis.

69

70

Once they start scoping

76

Probably.

77

78

Major crimes was working wiretaps

80

81

86

87

Jesus Christ.

99

100

104

Herc.

West side.

Fucking Freeman.

Borderline.

What kind of a fellow rigs up a hotshot

Naw.

126

128

No mother, no family.

He in the street

I tried to, um...

00:10:32,266 --> 00:10:33,933
like I ain't
who I am, right?

136

Like I'm pretending I ain't been

137

00:26:28,439 --> 00:26:31,963
help the city a lot more
if I'm Governor two years from now.

392
00:26:33,729 --> 00:26:35,706
Thinking that way,
it wouldn't just be about me

393
00:26:35,842 --> 00:26:37,199
if I don't take the money.

394
00:26:38,150 --> 00:26:39,933
Are you asking me what I think?

395
00:26:43,201 --> 00:26:45,043
I think you'll do the right thing.

396
00:27:18,431 --> 00:27:19,826
You sure you want to do this?

397
00:27:21,443 --> 00:27:22,762
I don't want to hurt you.

398
00:27:22,917 --> 00:27:24,002
You're not hurting me.

399
00:28:29,279 --> 00:28:31,787
Detective Crutchfield,
do you have a moment?

400
00:28:32,000 --> 00:28:33,047
Yes, ma'am.

401
00:28:37,069 --> 00:28:39,470
I've got a question in these reports.

402
00:28:39,983 --> 00:28:41,863
Were they all found
in the basement?

403
00:28:42,057 --> 00:28:44,422
No, ma'am. We've been finding
most in the basement,

404
00:28:44,635 --> 00:28:46,962
But some are on the upper floors, too.

405
00:28:47,446 --> 00:28:51,561
Can you be specific in the 24s,
for my sake anyway?

406
00:28:52,123 --> 00:28:53,887
- You got it.
- Thanks.

407
00:28:55,659 --> 00:28:56,725
How many so far?

408
00:28:58,645 --> 00:28:59,943
- 17.
- Christ.

409
00:29:01,066 --> 00:29:02,559
That's a lot of red names.

410
00:29:03,509 --> 00:29:04,904
It's your first red bull.

411
00:29:05,331 --> 00:29:09,463
Yeah. I thought I'd get a nice,
quiet domestic or two to start me off.

412
00:29:10,239 --> 00:29:11,984
We got national press
on this already.

413
00:29:12,145 --> 00:29:13,231
You'll be fine, Rhonnie.

414
00:29:13,909 --> 00:29:16,119
Just don't let any of these guys
see you sweating.

415
00:29:17,353 --> 00:29:18,651
And your case dropped.

416
00:29:19,625 --> 00:29:22,320
Tell Mello to sign off
on your friendly A.S.A.

417
00:29:24,545 --> 00:29:27,592
He kicks out a radio car window,
and you want to give him a walk?

418
00:29:30,682 --> 00:29:32,678
What's the date range for decomp?

419
00:29:33,689 --> 00:29:35,764
The one on Mount Street
looked about a week.

420
00:29:35,899 --> 00:29:37,276
Some a few days.

421
00:29:38,298 --> 00:29:41,186
Some are skeleton at this stage.

422
00:29:42,001 --> 00:29:43,067
They all head shots?

423
00:29:43,280 --> 00:29:44,385
Most of them.

424
00:29:44,579 --> 00:29:46,110
Black males 15-25?

425
00:29:46,769 --> 00:29:48,184
No, some older.

426
00:29:48,913 --> 00:29:52,002
We got one in a security guard's
uniform around here somewhere.

427
00:29:52,060 --> 00:29:53,127
You laser print?

428
00:29:53,708 --> 00:29:54,806
Vacuum the rooms?

429
00:29:56,473 --> 00:29:57,509
Yes.

430
00:29:57,586 --> 00:30:00,126
Gluco for blood?
What's the geography?

431
00:30:00,281 --> 00:30:02,627
13 on west side.
Baltimore to Winchester.

432
00:30:03,072 --> 00:30:04,198
Schroeder to the Grove.

433
00:30:04,275 --> 00:30:07,164
The eastern boys found four more
in the houses on Monument Street.

434
00:30:07,222 --> 00:30:08,812
- East side?
- Yeah. That threw us.

435
00:30:09,238 --> 00:30:12,055
We're casting a wider net now
searching the vacants citywide.

436
00:30:12,093 --> 00:30:14,109
My number's 23 in the office pool.

437
00:30:14,710 --> 00:30:15,854
I still have hope.

438
00:30:16,384 --> 00:30:18,730
Hell of a case right here.

439
00:30:19,544 --> 00:30:23,104
You know, if I was police, I don't
think I could lean back on it. You?

440
00:30:23,538 --> 00:30:25,050
Not if I was real police.

441
00:30:27,718 --> 00:30:28,920
Thank you, Detective.

442
00:31:07,089 --> 00:31:08,369
Calvin, you done already?

443
00:31:08,834 --> 00:31:09,862
Yeah, I'm done.

444
00:31:37,850 --> 00:31:40,293
<i>Attention, proctors, a reminder.</i>

445
00:31:40,471 --> 00:31:44,822
<i>Answer sheets must be turned into</i>
<i>the office by you and only you</i>

446
00:31:45,120 --> 00:31:48,048
<i>immediately</i>
<i>upon completion of the tests.</i>

447
00:31:48,552 --> 00:31:50,430
<i>Thank you for your cooperation.</i>

448
00:31:51,468 --> 00:31:52,981
Where are we on the nail gun?

449
00:31:53,185 --> 00:31:54,748
A Hill T.D.X. model.

450
00:31:54,787 --> 00:31:56,648
High end but common
among contractors.

451
00:31:56,668 --> 00:31:59,589
Is it what Sergeant Hauk saw
in the back of Chris Partlow's truck?

452
00:31:59,705 --> 00:32:01,566
We showed him one,
and he thought so.

453
00:32:01,894 --> 00:32:04,821
Then we dragged his ass back down
to the block where he did the car stop.

454
00:32:04,840 --> 00:32:05,868
Anything?

455
00:32:05,907 --> 00:32:09,277
We found what might be a hole
where he said he fired into the street,

456
00:32:09,316 --> 00:32:13,484
but no nail even after sweeping
the block with metal detectors.

457
00:32:13,930 --> 00:32:15,934
Probably took a ride
in some bastard's radio,

458
00:32:15,992 --> 00:32:17,962
but now it's in a tire pile somewhere.

459
00:32:18,214 --> 00:32:20,734
So our next move is a search
and seizure on that truck.

460
00:32:20,812 --> 00:32:24,528
Along with a court order for hair
and blood from Chris and Snoop both.

461
00:32:24,935 --> 00:32:27,368
With everything we're pulling out
of these houses,

462
00:32:27,504 --> 00:32:29,275
we might get lucky
with some trace work.

463
00:32:29,450 --> 00:32:30,594
What's your P.C.?

464
00:32:30,943 --> 00:32:32,280
Herc sees the nail gun.

465
00:32:32,668 --> 00:32:34,260
Nothing wrong with owning a power tool.

466
00:32:34,298 --> 00:32:36,755
What's the P.C.
on Chris and Snoop specifically?

467
00:32:37,007 --> 00:32:38,034
A witness.

468
00:32:39,585 --> 00:32:42,714
Boy who was told by
a co-conspirator who the murderer was.

469
00:32:43,076 --> 00:32:46,139
The boy is a source.
He's not a witness.

470
00:32:46,159 --> 00:32:48,350
If he's just a source,
you don't have enough.

471
00:32:48,389 --> 00:32:51,156
With the links that we got between
some of these bodies of Stanfield

472
00:32:51,194 --> 00:32:53,036
and his organization,
we have a pattern.

473
00:32:53,152 --> 00:32:56,169
Weak.
Very weak.

474
00:32:56,447 --> 00:32:57,533
Oh, fuck it.

475
00:32:59,506 --> 00:33:00,664
Give me an hour.

476
00:33:05,645 --> 00:33:07,348
<i>You haven't let me alone all week.</i>

477
00:33:07,464 --> 00:33:10,848
<i>Every time I come out of the pool,</i>
<i>want to dry me off without a towel.</i>

478
00:33:14,311 --> 00:33:16,288
- Dennis Wise.
- Hey, man.

479
00:33:17,343 --> 00:33:19,456
Yeah.
Were you able to get some word?

480
00:33:20,627 --> 00:33:23,481
On my say so,
he's willing to sit and hear you out.

481
00:33:25,087 --> 00:33:27,569
What you asking him for,
I don't know.

482
00:33:30,016 --> 00:33:31,101
He'll love it, though.

483
00:33:31,431 --> 00:33:35,813
You see my man Carver again,
you tell him he owe me one now.

484
00:33:37,733 --> 00:33:39,032
All right, man.
Appreciate it.

485
00:33:39,149 --> 00:33:40,254
You got it, bro.

486
00:33:43,995 --> 00:33:45,487
Y'all coming back with a warrant?

487
00:33:46,922 --> 00:33:48,744
The roughneck in room 232.

488
00:33:51,321 --> 00:33:53,888
From what I know,
he runs a gym program for kids.

489
00:33:54,412 --> 00:33:57,009
He got hisself shot for trying
to pull a kid off the corner.

490
00:34:00,630 --> 00:34:02,220
Look, you need to speak up now

491
00:34:02,678 --> 00:34:04,927
or face the fact
that you never spoke at all.

492
00:34:07,083 --> 00:34:09,739
They wouldn't let me see my son,
at marches.

493
00:34:11,554 --> 00:34:14,133
Said there wasn't much left
by the time y'all found him.

494
00:34:16,604 --> 00:34:19,665
We did the best we could
with the information we had.

495
00:34:28,809 --> 00:34:31,096
Word come to me
that a man named Chris

496
00:34:31,747 --> 00:34:36,691
and a girl named Loop or Snoop
or some such took my son and killed him.

497
00:34:37,944 --> 00:34:40,057
Told I would never see my boy again.

498
00:34:45,954 --> 00:34:47,916
Why can't you just make
an exception in this case

499
00:34:47,955 --> 00:34:49,777
and move his name
to the top of the list?

500
00:34:49,836 --> 00:34:51,465
See that he gets another foster parent.

501
00:34:51,899 --> 00:34:53,023
The list is the list.

502
00:34:53,101 --> 00:34:55,252
Some clients have been
in group homes for years.

503
00:34:55,446 --> 00:34:56,932
He was in group homes for years.

504
00:34:57,165 --> 00:34:59,878
- Now he's gotta go back because--
- Please don't raise your voice.

505
00:34:59,917 --> 00:35:02,107
- If you're going to raise your voice--
- Please.

506
00:35:04,945 --> 00:35:07,698
There's gotta be some way
that he doesn't have to go--

507
00:35:11,735 --> 00:35:13,150
Yeah, there is.

508
00:35:15,192 --> 00:35:16,259
There's gotta be.

509
00:35:19,373 --> 00:35:20,458
How about--

510
00:35:22,642 --> 00:35:25,744
How about if I take him
as a foster parent?

511
00:35:26,151 --> 00:35:28,458
The screening process takes 3-4 months.

512
00:35:28,652 --> 00:35:30,670
This child can't be
in your custody, Sergeant.

513
00:35:30,748 --> 00:35:34,218
He needs to come back under
our supervision per the juvenile order.

514
00:35:43,882 --> 00:35:46,421
Think you all that
for hassling niggers and shit.

515
00:35:46,776 --> 00:35:50,226
I know I'm all that.
I'm thinking about some pussy.

516
00:35:50,478 --> 00:35:51,553
Yeah. Me, too.

517
00:35:52,823 --> 00:35:54,064
They dumped their tools.

518
00:35:57,379 --> 00:36:00,793
Nothing under the seats.
Nothing in the glove box.

519
00:36:02,679 --> 00:36:05,156
Registered to some
little old lady, no doubt.

520
00:36:05,628 --> 00:36:07,101
These guys know the drill.

521
00:36:09,262 --> 00:36:11,278
Can you see these two riding tail?

522
00:36:14,991 --> 00:36:16,115
Come on.

523
00:36:41,194 --> 00:36:43,036
Aw, shit.

524
00:36:46,739 --> 00:36:47,824
There it is.

525
00:36:54,809 --> 00:36:55,914
It ain't even our truck.

526
00:37:04,068 --> 00:37:05,503
But I need to hear it from you.

527
00:37:06,055 --> 00:37:07,121
From me?

528
00:37:08,404 --> 00:37:10,148
This is not my affair, huh?

529
00:37:11,115 --> 00:37:13,616
It is what Joe says.
I'm only here right now for Joe.

530
00:37:14,066 --> 00:37:15,869
It's who I trust,
who I respect,

531
00:37:16,601 --> 00:37:18,481
Who I worked with for many years.

532
00:37:19,744 --> 00:37:22,400
You I do not know,
and I don't need to know.

533
00:37:22,497 --> 00:37:27,170
But because this thing
go wrong for Joe, then--

534
00:37:27,732 --> 00:37:30,426
Well, how am I supposed to know
this ain't no setup?

535
00:37:31,459 --> 00:37:34,986
How I supposed to know
your people ain't in on it, too?

536
00:37:36,556 --> 00:37:40,996
You know because Joe says
and because I say.

537
00:37:42,422 --> 00:37:44,218
And you trust your people like that?

538
00:37:45,233 --> 00:37:49,672
I talk to my driver.
I looked into his soul.

539
00:38:15,890 --> 00:38:17,635
Chris and Snoop just been found,

540
00:38:18,391 --> 00:38:20,756
with a gun charge found in the truck.

541
00:38:22,056 --> 00:38:23,378
Call the bondsman.

542
00:38:24,173 --> 00:38:27,228
But first,
put a follow on him right there.

543
00:38:29,055 --> 00:38:30,744
Who, white dude with the hat on?

544
00:38:30,879 --> 00:38:32,720
- What, he a problem?
- Naw.

545
00:38:35,493 --> 00:38:36,953
I just need to know more.

546
00:38:38,911 --> 00:38:40,055
All right.

547
00:38:44,116 --> 00:38:45,259
Satisfied?

548
00:38:45,434 --> 00:38:46,927
90,000 to you in the morning.

549
00:38:46,965 --> 00:38:48,652
We'll put a hundred more on later

550
00:38:48,865 --> 00:38:51,201
After the heat on them
empty houses gives way.

551
00:39:00,883 --> 00:39:02,337
What the fuck are you doing here?

552
00:39:03,782 --> 00:39:05,178
You think that charge gets dropped

553
00:39:05,236 --> 00:39:07,358
without somebody
showing you some special love?

554
00:39:10,983 --> 00:39:12,146
You hungry?

555
00:39:13,728 --> 00:39:14,891
Come on.

556
00:39:25,819 --> 00:39:26,885
All right.

557
00:39:26,943 --> 00:39:29,754
Might be surety bond
on this Chris Partlow

558
00:39:30,173 --> 00:39:31,457
given all of his priors.

559
00:39:32,202 --> 00:39:34,315
Pearson woman--
Not so much.

560
00:39:34,646 --> 00:39:35,648
All right?

561
00:39:49,703 --> 00:39:50,750
What's this?

562
00:39:51,176 --> 00:39:52,243
Court order.

563
00:39:52,340 --> 00:39:53,619
We get blood and hair.

564
00:39:54,220 --> 00:39:59,047
14 head hairs, 14 body hairs
two blood samples each.

565
00:39:59,473 --> 00:40:00,714
It's a lot of houses.

566
00:40:01,437 --> 00:40:02,562
A lot of deeds.

567
00:40:02,890 --> 00:40:04,809
Who knows what you left behind?

568
00:40:16,493 --> 00:40:17,715
We still in the city?

569
00:40:19,711 --> 00:40:20,975
Cylburn Arboretum.

570
00:40:21,673 --> 00:40:23,197
Pimlico is right up the hill.

571
00:40:26,457 --> 00:40:27,639
This is nice.

572
00:40:32,900 --> 00:40:34,160
I ain't no snitch.

573
00:40:36,164 --> 00:40:37,424
I didn't say you were.

574
00:40:37,998 --> 00:40:39,588
I been doing this a long time.

575
00:40:40,926 --> 00:40:42,982
I ain't never said nothing to no cop.

576
00:40:52,763 --> 00:40:53,965
I feel old.

577
00:40:56,204 --> 00:40:57,891
I been out there since I was 13.

578
00:40:58,569 --> 00:41:01,806
I ain't never fucked up a count,
never stole off a package,

579
00:41:02,152 --> 00:41:04,905
never did some shit
that I wasn't told to do.

580
00:41:05,834 --> 00:41:07,017
I've been straight up.

581
00:41:07,075 --> 00:41:08,258
But what come back?

582
00:41:08,608 --> 00:41:10,494
You think if I get jammed up
on some shit,

583
00:41:10,533 --> 00:41:12,802
they'd be like, "all right.
Yeah. Bodie been there.

584
00:41:12,841 --> 00:41:14,702
"Bodie hang tough.
We got to his pay lawyer.

585
00:41:14,741 --> 00:41:15,904
We got a bail."

586
00:41:17,011 --> 00:41:18,833
They want me to stand
with them, right?

587
00:41:18,911 --> 00:41:21,450
Where the fuck they at when
they supposed to be standing by us?

588
00:41:21,489 --> 00:41:24,205
I mean, when shit goes bad
and there's hell to pay,

589
00:41:24,768 --> 00:41:25,989
where they at?

590
00:41:28,218 --> 00:41:29,646
This game is rigged, man.

591
00:41:31,238 --> 00:41:33,545
Be like the little bitches
on a chessboard.

592
00:41:34,069 --> 00:41:35,204
Pawns.

593
00:41:38,423 --> 00:41:40,671
Yo, I'm not snitching
on none of my boys,

594
00:41:40,996 --> 00:41:45,288
not my corner, and not no Barksdale
people or what's left of them.

595
00:41:46,238 --> 00:41:48,728
But Marlo--
this nigger and his kind, man--

596
00:41:49,154 --> 00:41:50,685
They gotta fall.
They gotta.

597
00:41:53,001 --> 00:41:55,734
Well, for that to happen,
somebody's gotta step up.

598
00:42:00,457 --> 00:42:01,659
I'll do what I gotta.

599
00:42:02,085 --> 00:42:03,268
I don't give a fuck.

600
00:42:05,163 --> 00:42:07,683
Just don't ask me to live
on my fucking knees, you know.

601
00:42:13,283 --> 00:42:14,699
You're a soldier, Bodie.

602
00:42:17,607 --> 00:42:18,770
Hell, yeah.

603
00:42:37,794 --> 00:42:38,996
I remember you.

604
00:42:39,548 --> 00:42:41,739
You used to be
a role-up pitcher and Fremont.

605
00:42:41,797 --> 00:42:43,406
Yeah. It was my old post.

606
00:42:43,856 --> 00:42:46,764
- I came up with C.B.S.
- Calhoun-Baker-Stricker.

607
00:42:48,460 --> 00:42:50,825
Yeah. I used to have
to bang up on y'all all the time.

608
00:42:50,883 --> 00:42:52,202
I remember that, too.

609
00:42:54,317 --> 00:42:57,128
Yeah.
I ain't a cop now, right.

610
00:42:58,183 --> 00:43:02,448
And like I told Cutty,
I'm sort of like a teacher now,

611
00:43:02,894 --> 00:43:04,548
And that's how I come to know Namond.

612
00:43:04,704 --> 00:43:06,972
Only reason I'm even here
is Cutty spoke for you.

613
00:43:07,217 --> 00:43:08,594
He say what I'm asking?

614
00:43:12,200 --> 00:43:13,465
Your boy...

615
00:43:14,202 --> 00:43:18,227
is smart and funny,
and open-hearted,

616
00:43:19,275 --> 00:43:20,787
and he got some flex in him.

617
00:43:21,882 --> 00:43:24,552
And I ain't see it at first
'cause he was always acting out,

618
00:43:24,726 --> 00:43:27,111
always full up of corner talk.

619
00:43:27,226 --> 00:43:29,494
You know,
just talking shit to hide hisself.

620
00:43:30,737 --> 00:43:33,789
But he could go a lot of places,
and do a lot of things in his life,

621
00:43:34,076 --> 00:43:36,112
be out there in the world in a way that,

622
00:43:36,189 --> 00:43:38,031
you know,
didn't happen for you and me.

623
00:43:40,020 --> 00:43:42,341
I mean, you know, our kind?
Shit.

624
00:43:44,590 --> 00:43:47,211
Man, we both know we gonna go
to our grave forever knowing

625
00:43:47,643 --> 00:43:50,724
what block Bentalou dead-ends at or

626
00:43:50,899 --> 00:43:53,234
who got their liquor license
over at the underground

627
00:43:53,311 --> 00:43:54,860
or what corner Tatum man got shot

628
00:43:54,918 --> 00:43:57,388
on when he come out
the musical lounge back in '88.

629
00:43:57,804 --> 00:43:59,335
It's a vision in Gold.

630
00:44:06,933 --> 00:44:08,445
I mean, the westside, we know...

631
00:44:10,187 --> 00:44:11,486
it's dead, man.

632
00:44:12,497 --> 00:44:14,543
You know, people in the game nowadays--

633
00:44:15,842 --> 00:44:17,763
I mean, it's a whole different breed.

634
00:44:18,244 --> 00:44:20,067
No code, no family,

635
00:44:21,863 --> 00:44:23,298
and damn sure no respect.

636
00:44:25,314 --> 00:44:27,714
I mean, you send Namond
out on the corner now,

637
00:44:28,404 --> 00:44:33,219
giving him maybe one, two years
before you down at the morgue

638
00:44:34,092 --> 00:44:37,077
and maybe if you're lucky
up here with you.

639
00:44:38,085 --> 00:44:39,287
Maybe, maybe not.

640
00:44:39,365 --> 00:44:40,567
That's the game.

641
00:44:40,663 --> 00:44:42,987
I'm talking about Namond here, Mr. Brice.

642
00:44:45,273 --> 00:44:48,220
He's a lot of things,
a lot of good things.

643
00:44:49,220 --> 00:44:51,333
I mean, before you know,
he might surprise all of us

644
00:44:51,372 --> 00:44:54,758
given half a chance,
but he ain't made for them corners, man.

645
00:44:55,760 --> 00:44:57,253
I mean, not like we were.

646
00:44:59,108 --> 00:45:02,558
That's why I come down here--
because I gotta believe that you see it.

647
00:45:03,283 --> 00:45:06,191
Being who you are
and all you've been through.

648
00:45:10,205 --> 00:45:11,388
You know your son.

649
00:45:18,296 --> 00:45:19,673
It's in your hands, man.

650
00:45:24,403 --> 00:45:25,832
You asking too much.

651
00:45:26,414 --> 00:45:28,759
Yeah. I'm asking.

652
00:45:32,633 --> 00:45:34,164
You sure it was the boy Bodie?

653
00:45:34,256 --> 00:45:36,252
Man, I seen him
come from out of central bookings

654
00:45:36,291 --> 00:45:37,667
over on Eager Street side.

655
00:45:38,114 --> 00:45:40,034
Then he got in some car
with some white dude.

656
00:45:40,092 --> 00:45:42,108
Police?
What kind of car, a Caprice?

657
00:45:43,494 --> 00:45:44,792
No. O.T., I think.

658
00:45:49,720 --> 00:45:51,655
They on you like a motherfucker.

659
00:45:52,193 --> 00:45:55,551
They jacking you up, pulling all
your work out of them houses, right?

660
00:45:57,411 --> 00:45:59,473
Man, we can't have nobody
snitching on us now.

661
00:45:59,831 --> 00:46:01,265
We ain't sure it's that.

662
00:46:01,941 --> 00:46:03,422
What, you want to let it go?

663
00:46:04,264 --> 00:46:05,383
Risk it?

664
00:46:07,435 --> 00:46:08,633
Send a message.

665
00:46:09,226 --> 00:46:11,426
Maybe give it to your pup,
get him started.

666
00:46:12,303 --> 00:46:15,230
You and Snoop, y'all lay low
till this shit here blow down.

667
00:46:16,013 --> 00:46:17,328
Boy worked for Bodie.

668
00:46:17,533 --> 00:46:19,556
First time,
must be someone he didn't know.

669
00:46:26,646 --> 00:46:27,981
You hear what Joe said?

670
00:46:28,246 --> 00:46:30,740
Joe's saying this cocksucker
who stole our shit

671
00:46:31,391 --> 00:46:34,359
wants to sell it back to us
for 30 on the dollar.

672
00:46:37,253 --> 00:46:39,940
Joe's saying it's another 90
to buy back our shit.

673
00:46:49,181 --> 00:46:50,516
Dang, yo.

674
00:46:51,223 --> 00:46:52,676
Thought you forgot about me.

675
00:46:54,396 --> 00:46:56,125
Hey, why don't you wait outside?

676
00:47:02,442 --> 00:47:03,876
You spoke to his father?

677
00:47:06,602 --> 00:47:07,931
If it goes the way I think,

678
00:47:08,401 --> 00:47:10,542
he'll be back
with his mom by tomorrow.

679
00:47:11,732 --> 00:47:13,205
Big day all around tomorrow.

680
00:47:13,342 --> 00:47:16,401
Delegate Watkins got us 30
minutes at the Mayor's office.

681
00:47:23,466 --> 00:47:24,919
Yo, Spider, what's the count?

682
00:47:25,141 --> 00:47:27,788
I don't even think
we gonna sell out today, man.

683
00:47:36,838 --> 00:47:37,937
Yo, Bodie.

684
00:47:39,312 --> 00:47:40,392
Yo, Bodie.

685
00:47:52,130 --> 00:47:53,898
Yo, Bodie, you better run, yo.

686
00:47:54,781 --> 00:47:56,670
Yo, this my corner.
I ain't running nowhere.

687
00:47:56,737 --> 00:47:57,895
Bodie, is you crazy?

688
00:48:09,340 --> 00:48:10,439
Shit is on!

689
00:48:10,930 --> 00:48:12,384
Run with it, motherfuckers!

690
00:48:12,577 --> 00:48:13,736
I don't give a fuck!

691
00:48:15,388 --> 00:48:16,664
I'm right here!

692
00:48:17,815 --> 00:48:20,447
You ain't putting me up in one
of them empty-ass houses, neither.

693
00:48:23,264 --> 00:48:24,285
Come on, man.

694
00:49:59,043 --> 00:50:00,417
I don't know about this.

695
00:50:01,175 --> 00:50:02,491
Mayor's office.

696
00:50:03,650 --> 00:50:08,549
Yes. Actually, you want the Department
of Housing and Community Development.

697
00:50:08,706 --> 00:50:11,437
Look, I don't know about this, man.
I just...

698
00:50:14,785 --> 00:50:15,786
ma'am, uh--

699
00:50:19,479 --> 00:50:20,520
If...

700
00:50:21,718 --> 00:50:22,837
I'm sorry.

701
00:50:23,516 --> 00:50:25,696
If the mayor prefers not to--

702
00:50:25,991 --> 00:50:28,646
or if he, like, feels more comfortable
with Dr. Perenni alone,

703
00:50:29,608 --> 00:50:32,937
you know, because of the
drug-legalization controversy last year.

704
00:50:33,293 --> 00:50:35,709
I don't think Mayor Carcetti
is in your meeting.

705
00:50:35,826 --> 00:50:37,123
He's in Annapolis.

706
00:50:40,279 --> 00:50:42,970
OK. Thank you.

707
00:50:51,571 --> 00:50:52,671
What up?

708
00:50:55,794 --> 00:50:56,932
Still asleep?

709
00:50:58,347 --> 00:50:59,800
Early bird get that worm.

710
00:51:02,792 --> 00:51:04,088
How you liking the crib?

711
00:51:05,149 --> 00:51:06,347
Fine. Thanks.

712
00:51:07,419 --> 00:51:09,226
Must feel good to be on your own.

713
00:51:13,076 --> 00:51:14,733
Yo, where you get that rent from?

714
00:51:18,086 --> 00:51:19,283
Took it from a nigger.

715
00:51:24,905 --> 00:51:26,063
Why? You want it?

716
00:51:26,476 --> 00:51:28,031
No. No. You keep it, shorty.

717
00:51:34,584 --> 00:51:36,372
I'll go get Bug ready for school.

718
00:51:37,845 --> 00:51:39,318
You ready to put in work?

719
00:51:42,602 --> 00:51:43,760
Two things, then.

720
00:51:44,369 --> 00:51:47,590
First, we' gonna give you
the corner up on Passno,

721
00:51:48,481 --> 00:51:50,130
used to be Bodie's old corner.

722
00:51:50,503 --> 00:51:51,557
Now it's yours.

723
00:51:53,203 --> 00:51:54,794
Crew that up. Run that shit.

724
00:51:55,814 --> 00:51:57,699
You get the points on that shop.

725
00:52:00,095 --> 00:52:01,667
Then we got this other thing.

726
00:52:05,161 --> 00:52:09,452
Yo, if I ain't stepping on nothing,
who was that who dropped for you, yo?

727
00:52:14,610 --> 00:52:15,730
Bug's daddy.

728
00:52:15,867 --> 00:52:16,967
Word?

729
00:52:36,361 --> 00:52:38,117
That's not how you spell
"paraphernalia."

730
00:52:38,184 --> 00:52:40,353
- How the fuck do you spell it?
- Hey, fellows.

731
00:52:40,467 --> 00:52:42,529
- Not like that.
- McNulty. Hey.

732
00:52:43,724 --> 00:52:45,118
You're here 4:00-12:00, right?

733
00:52:45,152 --> 00:52:46,841
- You heard about Bodie?
- What about?

734
00:52:46,919 --> 00:52:48,844
- Bodie from up Passno.
- Yeah, yeah. What?

735
00:52:49,104 --> 00:52:50,478
Shot dead on his corner.

736
00:52:51,539 --> 00:52:52,830
Midnight shift caught it.

737
00:52:53,505 --> 00:52:54,703
Check the read-out.

738
00:52:54,782 --> 00:52:56,431
Sergeant, get your ass in here.

739
00:53:00,074 --> 00:53:03,472
Goddamn it, Norton,
you're on the brink of insubordination.

740
00:53:14,608 --> 00:53:16,919
You call D.S.S. right now
and ship him out.

741
00:53:16,958 --> 00:53:18,691
- That's an order.
- Lieutenant.

742
00:53:24,048 --> 00:53:26,620
I got $235 if it helps.

743
00:53:28,683 --> 00:53:29,802
How would that help?

744
00:53:30,963 --> 00:53:32,750
Maybe we can get
a foster spot like that.

745
00:53:32,789 --> 00:53:33,928
Pay somebody.

746
00:53:45,022 --> 00:53:46,927
This is tracking, plain and simple.

747
00:53:47,411 --> 00:53:49,355
It's a socialization process.

748
00:53:49,551 --> 00:53:52,026
To any parent who complains,
you're still segregating them.

749
00:53:52,065 --> 00:53:54,010
Look, it's for their benefit,

750
00:53:54,088 --> 00:53:56,591
and for the benefit
of the teachers trying to teach.

751
00:53:56,670 --> 00:53:59,557
And you're proposing to expand
this to every middle school?

752
00:54:00,060 --> 00:54:02,574
With enough grant money
and your support, yes.

753
00:54:03,315 --> 00:54:04,493
By September--

754
00:54:04,632 --> 00:54:06,667
But you wouldn't be teaching
test curriculum here?

755
00:54:06,706 --> 00:54:09,790
These would be the children
left behind, so to speak.

756
00:54:10,205 --> 00:54:11,658
Yeah, but as it, I mean,

757
00:54:12,118 --> 00:54:13,964
We're leaving them all
behind anyway.

758
00:54:14,082 --> 00:54:15,613
We just don't want to admit it.

759
00:54:19,195 --> 00:54:23,202
- What we mean to say is--
- Gentlemen, we'll be in touch.

760
00:54:32,751 --> 00:54:33,968
So, what, that's it?

761
00:54:34,008 --> 00:54:36,227
After a two minute hearing,
they stick a fork in us?

762
00:54:37,013 --> 00:54:38,623
I'm a liability in there, man.

763
00:54:40,454 --> 00:54:42,787
Seems like every time
I open my mouth in this town,

764
00:54:42,827 --> 00:54:44,857
I'm telling people things
they don't want to know.

765
00:54:44,877 --> 00:54:46,130
It's not you. It's the process.

766
00:54:46,169 --> 00:54:47,878
- The process?
- When we get the grant,

767
00:54:48,212 --> 00:54:50,117
We study the problem,
we propose solutions.

768
00:54:50,384 --> 00:54:51,645
If they listen, they listen.

769
00:54:51,712 --> 00:54:54,203
If they don't,
it still makes for great research.

770
00:54:54,558 --> 00:54:56,895
What we publish on this is
gonna get a lot of attention.

771
00:54:56,959 --> 00:54:59,723
- From who?
- From other researchers, academics.

772
00:55:00,158 --> 00:55:03,575
Academics?
What they gonna study your study.

773
00:55:09,742 --> 00:55:11,078
When do this shit change?

774
00:55:13,892 --> 00:55:15,149
And you put him out, huh?

775
00:55:16,269 --> 00:55:17,506
He need to get hard.

776
00:55:18,799 --> 00:55:20,271
Well, if he out, then he out.

777
00:55:21,995 --> 00:55:23,174
Oh, no, you not.

778
00:55:23,488 --> 00:55:25,403
You ain't gonna take my son
away from me.

779
00:55:25,920 --> 00:55:28,068
Remember who the fuck
you talking to right here.

780
00:55:28,697 --> 00:55:29,993
Remember who I am.

781
00:55:31,376 --> 00:55:33,143
My word is still my word.

782
00:55:33,677 --> 00:55:35,720
In here, in Baltimore,

783
00:55:35,867 --> 00:55:38,479
in any place
you can think of calling home,

784
00:55:39,108 --> 00:55:41,002
it'll be my word.
They'll find you.

785
00:55:43,232 --> 00:55:46,747
Man come down here to say my son
can be anything he damn please.

786
00:55:47,354 --> 00:55:48,650
Except a soldier.

787
00:55:51,600 --> 00:55:53,446
Yeah.
Well, look at me up in here.

788
00:55:54,381 --> 00:55:57,798
Who the fuck would want to be that
if they could be anything else, Dalonda?

789
00:56:04,260 --> 00:56:08,522
So, did you cut me off, too?

790
00:56:10,778 --> 00:56:13,449
You still got me.
We'll get by.

791
00:56:15,822 --> 00:56:17,590
But you gonna let go of that boy.

792
00:56:18,862 --> 00:56:20,080
Bet that.

793
00:56:27,753 --> 00:56:28,845
¿Quien es?

794
00:56:29,361 --> 00:56:30,618
Tu amor, baby.

795
00:57:01,955 --> 00:57:03,055
For your bank?

796
00:57:04,333 --> 00:57:05,688
That's for your pain, Butch.

797
00:57:06,221 --> 00:57:07,537
I be my own bank now.

798
00:57:09,303 --> 00:57:10,609
They ain't follow you?

799
00:57:10,825 --> 00:57:12,318
Naw. Joe paid him my way.

800
00:57:12,586 --> 00:57:15,545
He had to admit my word was
better than his. You feel me?

801
00:57:17,690 --> 00:57:18,849
Let's go, then.

802
00:57:29,800 --> 00:57:34,238
He is in the van, in the garage
in the back of 2249 Polk Street.

803
00:57:34,793 --> 00:57:36,462
Key gonna be in the cinderblock.

804
00:57:52,822 --> 00:57:54,432
You stole this much,

805
00:57:55,345 --> 00:57:56,759
and is ain't over.

806
00:58:00,206 --> 00:58:01,247
This ain't over.

807
00:58:31,955 --> 00:58:34,225
Thing about that Republican ass--

808
00:58:34,292 --> 00:58:37,764
It's not the flesh of
his political fathers.

809
00:58:59,135 --> 00:59:04,378
- Jesus. You left it
on the table.

810
00:59:04,444 --> 00:59:06,580
Smug son of a bitch.

811
00:59:06,646 --> 00:59:09,052
He was gonna make beg

812
00:59:09,119 --> 00:59:11,355
Then call a press conference

813
00:59:11,423 --> 00:59:14,660
So the world could
see me on my knees.

814
00:59:14,727 --> 00:59:17,132
Don't worry.

815
00:59:17,198 --> 00:59:20,872
Two years,
and we'll make him pay.

816
00:59:24,077 --> 00:59:25,379
Icicle.

817
00:59:25,447 --> 00:59:26,748
Got those icicles.

818
00:59:30,789 --> 00:59:32,492
Shake down.

819
00:59:36,131 --> 00:59:38,168
Corner's indicted.

820
00:59:38,234 --> 00:59:39,703
Go on. Get.

821
00:59:39,770 --> 00:59:41,407
Except you, motherfucker.

822
00:59:41,474 --> 00:59:42,476
On the wall.

823
00:59:46,215 --> 00:59:49,053
Sorry about Bodie.

824
00:59:49,120 --> 00:59:50,556
I ain't jacking you up.

825
00:59:50,622 --> 00:59:52,426
I'm trying to do right
for your boy.

826
00:59:52,493 --> 00:59:55,163
Who dropped him?
- Y'all did.

827
00:59:55,230 --> 00:59:59,104
They took him out 'cause
he was talking to y'all.

828
00:59:59,170 --> 01:00:02,477
Word is they seen him with the
police down at central booking.

829
01:00:02,543 --> 01:00:07,251
So cuff me or kick my ass off this
corner before you do me the same.

830
01:00:20,140 --> 01:00:22,944
Hey, Duquon.

831
01:00:25,449 --> 01:00:26,985
Don't you need
to be at Douglass?

832
01:00:27,051 --> 01:00:29,523
I'm on my way there. Yeah.

833
01:00:29,589 --> 01:00:32,026
Where's your book bag?

834
01:00:32,093 --> 01:00:35,232
- Oh, it's-- I'm gonna stop
past the house and get it.

835
01:00:40,274 --> 01:00:43,145
It's a present
for all you did.

836
01:00:47,386 --> 01:00:49,256
It's for your desk.

837
01:00:49,323 --> 01:00:55,200
- That's great, Duquon.
Thanks.

838
01:00:55,266 --> 01:00:58,205
Stop past anytime.

839
01:00:58,271 --> 01:01:01,910
Let me know how it's
going with you.

840
01:01:01,977 --> 01:01:03,179
OK.

841
01:01:12,195 --> 01:01:15,400
- But I ain't want to go back.
- Program's ending, Zanovia.

842
01:01:15,467 --> 01:01:18,906
- Yeah, boy.
Back to gen. pop.

843
01:01:18,973 --> 01:01:21,678
- Yes.
Pack my bags.

844
01:01:21,744 --> 01:01:22,879
Shut up.

845
01:01:22,946 --> 01:01:24,950
What about you?

846
01:01:25,017 --> 01:01:31,227
I mean, this was all right.

847
01:01:31,294 --> 01:01:33,298
But maybe it's time.

848
01:01:39,842 --> 01:01:42,179
Why are you up?

849
01:01:42,246 --> 01:01:44,216
You're working 4:00-12:00.

850
01:01:44,283 --> 01:01:47,956
What's the matter?

851
01:01:48,023 --> 01:01:49,593
Something with these bodies.

852
01:01:49,660 --> 01:01:53,966
Lester and them are
getting up on it.

853
01:01:54,033 --> 01:01:57,539
It's under Daniels.

854
01:01:57,606 --> 01:02:00,511
He's got suction there.

855
01:02:00,577 --> 01:02:02,180
He can deliver.

856
01:02:02,247 --> 01:02:04,651
You want in.

857
01:02:04,718 --> 01:02:07,556
- I just feel like
I owe it now.

858
01:02:07,623 --> 01:02:09,459
To who?

859
01:02:09,527 --> 01:02:11,195
To this kid.

860
01:02:11,263 --> 01:02:13,634
Corner kid.

861
01:02:13,701 --> 01:02:15,937
Getting ready to turn him,
you know.

862
01:02:16,037 --> 01:02:19,876
Wrap him up and give him
to Lester as a present.

863
01:02:19,943 --> 01:02:21,480
- He one of the bodies
in the houses?

864
01:02:21,547 --> 01:02:27,123
- No. They dropped him
in the street.

865
01:02:27,190 --> 01:02:29,293
Maybe I'd be different,
you know.

866
01:02:29,360 --> 01:02:31,832
Different?

867
01:02:31,897 --> 01:02:33,467
Yeah.

868
01:02:33,534 --> 01:02:38,074
No more of the drinking and warring
and all that, all that anger.

869
01:02:42,783 --> 01:02:45,053
'Cause I'm better now
here with you.

870
01:02:50,963 --> 01:02:54,236
No more "Jimmy busts
balls world."

871
01:02:54,302 --> 01:02:57,709
Jimmy bust balls?

872
01:02:57,776 --> 01:03:00,514
- I swear to God being that
son of a bitch nearly killed him.

873
01:03:24,621 --> 01:03:26,624
It's OK.

874
01:03:26,691 --> 01:03:28,561
What?

875
01:03:28,628 --> 01:03:30,330
You tried.

876
01:03:30,398 --> 01:03:34,971
You don't need to feel bad.

877
01:03:35,039 --> 01:03:36,675
Thanks.

878
01:03:51,467 --> 01:03:53,905
Hey, yo, look at this.

879
01:03:53,972 --> 01:03:55,908
Got to fucking
talk to you.

880
01:03:55,975 --> 01:03:57,744
- All right, Randy,
this way.

881
01:04:35,609 --> 01:04:37,980
Take that top bunk over there.

882
01:05:37,915 --> 01:05:40,352
Are you sure?

883
01:05:42,320 --> 01:05:44,527
I'm not asking
'cause I can't use you.

884
01:05:44,593 --> 01:05:45,996
I'm asking for your sake.

885
01:05:46,063 --> 01:05:47,632
I think I can do this

886
01:05:47,699 --> 01:05:50,003
And keep myself away
from myself,

887
01:05:50,070 --> 01:05:52,707
If that makes any sense.

888
01:06:03,358 --> 01:06:05,428
But I gotta tell you.

889
01:06:05,495 --> 01:06:08,201
We're not gonna get Marlo Stanfield
or anyone else above the street

890
01:06:08,266 --> 01:06:10,905
Not on street corners.
- What do you suggest?

891
01:06:10,972 --> 01:06:13,442
Either a wide C.I.
or a Title III.

892
01:06:13,509 --> 01:06:15,913
That's what makes this case.

893
01:06:15,980 --> 01:06:17,716
You sure?

894
01:06:17,783 --> 01:06:21,890
Maybe you do this fast
and clean and simple.

895
01:06:21,957 --> 01:06:25,096
Then you don't do it at all.

896
01:06:25,163 --> 01:06:27,500
Chain of command, Colonel.

897
01:06:29,369 --> 01:06:33,309
- How in the hell do we kick up
percentages in math and reading both?

898
01:06:33,376 --> 01:06:35,547
You believe the numbers?

899
01:06:35,614 --> 01:06:40,790
- 38% proficient.
8% advanced. What?

900
01:06:40,856 --> 01:06:44,662
- Proficient means they're at
least two grades below their level.

901
01:06:44,729 --> 01:06:48,903
Advanced can mean they're at
grade level or a year below.

902
01:06:48,970 --> 01:06:53,343
They score them like that, and
they say we're making progress.

903
01:06:55,414 --> 01:06:57,285
OK. I'm still learning.

904
01:06:57,350 --> 01:06:59,755
Naw. You're gonna be fine.

905
01:06:59,822 --> 01:07:03,695
- Albert, Zanovia, Namond,
good to have you back with us.

906
01:07:03,762 --> 01:07:06,934
- Yeah. Your worst nightmare
come right back on you.

907
01:07:12,109 --> 01:07:13,846
Say, naw, I'm just foolin'.

908
01:07:15,615 --> 01:07:19,088
OK. Everyone open to 121.

909
01:07:23,929 --> 01:07:26,901
Who figured out
the first problem?

910
01:07:26,968 --> 01:07:28,036
Kareem?

911
01:07:28,103 --> 01:07:29,205
164.

912
01:07:29,272 --> 01:07:30,975
- Correct.
How'd you get it?

913
01:07:31,041 --> 01:07:32,177
Don't know.

914
01:07:32,244 --> 01:07:35,082
Come. Show us.

915
01:07:35,148 --> 01:07:37,953
- Just when you think
you're done.

916
01:07:38,020 --> 01:07:40,358
What's that one? 20?

917
01:07:40,423 --> 01:07:43,263
22.

918
01:07:43,329 --> 01:07:45,633
Anybody heard from Bunk?

919
01:07:45,699 --> 01:07:49,573
- Ballistics say the guns match
to nothing. Open and closed.

920
01:07:49,640 --> 01:07:51,343
And they cleaned the prints.

921
01:07:51,409 --> 01:07:55,217
- Well, maybe
we'll find a witness.

922
01:07:55,284 --> 01:07:59,324
Maybe trace lab will give us
a hair or splatter or something.

923
01:07:59,391 --> 01:08:02,061
But short of that, we're gonna
have to go pro-active.

924
01:08:02,128 --> 01:08:05,834
- Where are you on the new body?
- Back to square one.

925
01:08:05,901 --> 01:08:07,971
We're in here for the long haul.

926
01:08:08,038 --> 01:08:10,842
Colonel, how you happen to pick
this place for us to stage?

927
01:08:10,909 --> 01:08:12,913
- Lemille?
- Hmm.

928
01:08:12,980 --> 01:08:16,719
- hey closed it a few years back, and I
knew it was near a lot of our crime scenes.

929
01:08:16,786 --> 01:08:21,695
I went to school here
back in the day.

930
01:08:21,761 --> 01:08:24,399
Got a decent education
now that I think on it.

931
01:08:49,709 --> 01:08:52,080
You try and talk to him?

932
01:08:52,147 --> 01:08:55,285
Didn't know what to say.

933
01:08:55,352 --> 01:08:57,923
Only heard from my sergeant
this morning.

934
01:08:57,990 --> 01:09:00,627
Guess I missed the 24
they wrote on it.

935
01:09:00,694 --> 01:09:02,398
- And he really tried
to do himself?

936
01:09:02,464 --> 01:09:04,534
It wasn't just for show
or nothing?

937
01:09:04,601 --> 01:09:08,875
- He's got some problems, but
insincerity ain't one of them.

938
01:09:08,941 --> 01:09:11,112
- Shame's some
tricky shit, ain't it?

939
01:09:11,179 --> 01:09:12,782
Makes you feel like
you want to change

940
01:09:12,848 --> 01:09:15,887
And then beats you back down
when think you can't.

941
01:09:15,953 --> 01:09:18,124
- When was the last time
y'all talked?

942
01:09:18,191 --> 01:09:19,794
More than a couple of years

943
01:09:19,860 --> 01:09:22,499
Since he last got
on the wagon, I think.

944
01:09:22,565 --> 01:09:25,103
But if he's up in D ward,

945
01:09:25,170 --> 01:09:27,474
He's clearing the motherfucker
right now.

946
01:10:02,166 --> 01:10:04,437
You coming?

947
01:10:04,504 --> 01:10:06,608
Maybe later.

948
01:10:53,554 --> 01:10:56,693
- Can't believe you'd leave
that money on the table.

949
01:10:56,758 --> 01:10:59,864
Why not?

950
01:10:59,931 --> 01:11:02,936
School. Kids.

951
01:11:03,003 --> 01:11:04,405
Shit.

952
01:11:04,473 --> 01:11:07,010
You ain't done enough
of this here, I suppose.

953
01:11:07,077 --> 01:11:09,648
They always disappoint.

954
01:11:09,716 --> 01:11:13,955
Closer you get, more you look.

955
01:11:14,022 --> 01:11:16,593
All of them.

956
01:11:20,467 --> 01:11:23,405
- If he tries...
might stay with Royce.

957
01:11:24,474 --> 01:11:27,479
If not, there's this young buck
out in Salisbury

958
01:11:27,545 --> 01:11:32,487
Thinks he can snatch up
the first district seat.

959
01:12:10,952 --> 01:12:14,459
- You can look him
in the eye now.

960
01:12:14,525 --> 01:12:17,163
No matter who he is
or what he's done,

961
01:12:17,230 --> 01:12:19,066
You look him right in the eye.

962
01:12:34,526 --> 01:12:37,364
I'm still your father.

963
01:14:16,300 --> 01:14:18,336
What you want?

964
01:17:34,200 --> 01:17:38,200
Transcript: FRM Team - Synchro: Sixe
The Wired Team - www.thewire-france.com



## S05E04

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:22,152 --> 00:00:23,476
Fuck is he doing?

2
00:00:23,843 --> 00:00:25,819
Cops still parked
right up the block.

3
00:00:26,376 --> 00:00:27,925
What are we, invisible?

4
00:00:28,983 --> 00:00:30,408
Stupid fucking yos.

5
00:00:31,047 --> 00:00:33,462
Think just fucking with him, man.

6
00:00:36,490 --> 00:00:38,250
You want to wait for him
to serve somebody?

7
00:00:38,410 --> 00:00:39,377
Fuck it.

8
00:00:40,510 --> 00:00:41,878
They're dirty either way.

9
00:00:52,143 --> 00:00:53,872
Hands on the wall, fuckers.

10
00:00:55,796 --> 00:00:56,941
We ain't done nothing!

11
00:00:57,101 --> 00:00:59,683
Seriously. I was just sitting
in my chair reading a magazine, is all.

12
00:00:59,843 --> 00:01:02,577
Watching your crew
work a ground stash, you mean?

13
00:01:04,777 --> 00:01:05,806
What the fuck?

14
00:01:09,877 --> 00:01:10,782
Asshole!

15
00:01:11,734 --> 00:01:13,917
Y'all still taking a charge
for this, you know that?

16
00:01:14,077 --> 00:01:15,704
- You're a truant.
- Today's Saturday.

17
00:01:15,864 --> 00:01:16,788
Try Wednesday.

18
00:01:17,313 --> 00:01:19,541
Why you don't page truancy?
Why y'all locking me up?

19
00:01:19,845 --> 00:01:21,144
Hey, Colicchio.

20
00:01:21,304 --> 00:01:22,940
Officer Colicchio, shitbird.

21
00:01:24,877 --> 00:01:26,378
We need to block
every lane here?

22
00:01:27,696 --> 00:01:29,481
Hey, shut it down.
It's a police operation.

23
00:01:29,641 --> 00:01:31,686
Let's get back to your post.
Back these vehicles up.

24
00:01:31,846 --> 00:01:33,513
- Officer.
- I'm not telling you again.

25
00:01:33,673 --> 00:01:34,973
Tony, calm down.

26
00:01:36,558 --> 00:01:39,018
Officer, if you could just move
your car forward Just a little bit,

27
00:01:39,178 --> 00:01:40,693
I'm gonna get right down the road.

28
00:01:55,653 --> 00:01:56,928
We're the police!

29
00:02:02,583 --> 00:02:04,669
What are you doing?
Let me go!

30
00:03:48,816 --> 00:03:49,663
Fuck!

31
00:03:50,293 --> 00:03:51,965
- Problem?
- I spent all day

32
00:03:52,125 --> 00:03:55,238
trying to trace this $80,000 withdrawal
from Clay's personal account...

33
00:03:55,545 --> 00:03:56,691
Figuring it was dirty.

34
00:03:56,851 --> 00:04:00,022
Turns out he's repaying a loan
from his mother-in-law.

35
00:04:00,182 --> 00:04:01,077
A loan?

36
00:04:01,237 --> 00:04:04,205
Has to be. I mean, she gives him
the same amount in 2002.

37
00:04:04,365 --> 00:04:08,074
He uses it as a down payment on
a property that he buys the same week.

38
00:04:09,620 --> 00:04:10,314
See?

39
00:04:13,217 --> 00:04:16,034
He bought a weekend house down
in Calvert County six years ago.

40
00:04:16,194 --> 00:04:18,855
You pulled the loan application
on the property, right?

41
00:04:20,443 --> 00:04:21,545
Just a second.

42
00:04:23,723 --> 00:04:24,756
Here you go.

43
00:04:29,091 --> 00:04:30,127
Got him.

44
00:04:31,217 --> 00:04:32,231
The head shot.

45
00:04:33,069 --> 00:04:33,895
What?

46
00:04:35,897 --> 00:04:38,957
And if anyone is suggesting
that I've broken chain of command,

47
00:04:39,117 --> 00:04:40,582
that I've gone behind your back,

48
00:04:40,742 --> 00:04:43,661
that I've lobbied against you
in any way, they're lying.

49
00:04:45,551 --> 00:04:47,314
I don't know who told
the newspaper that,

50
00:04:47,474 --> 00:04:49,465
but they were lying
when they said it.

51
00:04:51,518 --> 00:04:52,636
Yeah.

52
00:04:56,385 --> 00:04:57,625
Respectfully, sir,

53
00:04:57,785 --> 00:04:59,802
I don't know where this shit
is coming from.

54
00:05:20,715 --> 00:05:21,563
Sir...

55
00:05:22,676 --> 00:05:24,077
no one has spoken to me--

56
00:05:24,455 --> 00:05:26,064
Not Carcetti, not anyone.

57
00:05:26,921 --> 00:05:28,059
But if I'm approached,

58
00:05:28,219 --> 00:05:30,541
My answer will be
to decline the position

59
00:05:30,786 --> 00:05:33,493
And say I serve
at your pleasure.

60
00:05:40,134 --> 00:05:41,015
Sir?

61
00:05:43,373 --> 00:05:44,166
Sir?

62
00:06:00,620 --> 00:06:03,453
Go with the Preakness piece
Or this one about the firefighter death?

63
00:06:03,613 --> 00:06:07,026
- What are you interviewing for?
- Metro position, Virginia bureau.

64
00:06:07,186 --> 00:06:09,834
Firefighter, I think. Got to show
something I wrote on deadline.

65
00:06:09,994 --> 00:06:11,414
Burrell might get the axe today.

66
00:06:11,581 --> 00:06:13,504
- Who told you that?
- Picked it up on my calls.

67
00:06:13,664 --> 00:06:16,606
Desk Sergeant in the eastern
says it's all over the department.

68
00:06:17,354 --> 00:06:18,294
Wish me luck.

69
00:06:18,454 --> 00:06:19,429
Good luck.

70
00:06:23,174 --> 00:06:26,661
Got a rumor that Burrell is gonna
get fired today if not tomorrow.

71
00:06:26,952 --> 00:06:27,789
Yeah?

72
00:06:29,554 --> 00:06:31,211
- Work it.
- What about Twigg?

73
00:06:31,371 --> 00:06:32,854
With his sources, you know?

74
00:06:33,014 --> 00:06:35,064
I can't throw one at a guy
on his last day, can I?

75
00:06:35,737 --> 00:06:37,358
You work it as best you can.

76
00:06:37,518 --> 00:06:40,051
You are now
my new Senior cop reporter.

77
00:06:45,359 --> 00:06:46,308
Unclaimed.

78
00:06:46,958 --> 00:06:49,370
So far this year... 11.

79
00:06:50,084 --> 00:06:53,207
13 if we add the two in the freezer
I ain't I.D.'ed yet.

80
00:06:53,367 --> 00:06:55,152
Run it for no fixed address.

81
00:06:56,795 --> 00:06:59,644
Jimmy, it'd help if I knew
what the fuck you were looking for.

82
00:06:59,804 --> 00:07:02,577
Body wise, I just want to know where
we're pulling most of the homeless from.

83
00:07:02,737 --> 00:07:04,135
With or without O.D.'s?

84
00:07:04,295 --> 00:07:06,629
Numbers are way up
since Fentanyl showed up.

85
00:07:06,789 --> 00:07:08,446
Throw them in.
The more, the merrier.

86
00:07:08,606 --> 00:07:09,522
All right.

87
00:07:11,583 --> 00:07:12,552
Damn!

88
00:07:14,072 --> 00:07:15,730
They're all dead
and no fixed address?

89
00:07:17,193 --> 00:07:19,314
Dropping like flies
in the southern lately.

90
00:07:19,474 --> 00:07:20,862
Hey, Lester, it's me.

91
00:07:21,022 --> 00:07:22,529
Yeah, in the morgue.

92
00:07:23,123 --> 00:07:25,530
Some 4:00 to 12:00
with a lot of midnight,

93
00:07:25,837 --> 00:07:27,825
And a lot of them
in south Baltimore.

94
00:07:29,004 --> 00:07:31,746
So who do we know working
12:00 to 8:00 in the southern?

95
00:07:32,189 --> 00:07:34,123
2300 in the district.
That'll work.

96
00:07:34,283 --> 00:07:36,395
Jimmy, am I missing something here?

97
00:07:36,723 --> 00:07:38,127
How does this help you?

98
00:07:43,990 --> 00:07:46,197
Don't want none
of that phony gangster shit.

99
00:07:46,579 --> 00:07:48,056
He was old-school.

100
00:07:48,216 --> 00:07:50,132
Funny, I feel like
I should know Butchie,

101
00:07:50,292 --> 00:07:51,857
But I can't place him.

102
00:07:52,117 --> 00:07:53,813
Came up under teensy.

103
00:07:54,357 --> 00:07:57,355
Caught him a slug early.
Took his sight.

104
00:07:57,890 --> 00:08:01,567
Dabbled now and then, but kept it quiet
as a puppy walking on cotton.

105
00:08:03,504 --> 00:08:05,179
This here do just fine.

106
00:08:12,190 --> 00:08:13,570
Have it say,

107
00:08:13,923 --> 00:08:18,672
"Butchie. Woe to them that
call evil good and good evil."

108
00:08:20,490 --> 00:08:23,673
Sign it, "your true and loyal friend,

109
00:08:24,237 --> 00:08:25,633
"Proposition Joe."

110
00:08:29,232 --> 00:08:33,307
You ain't thinking no kindly note
gonna slow Omar coming at us.

111
00:08:33,725 --> 00:08:36,694
It's how I feel.
He was a good man.

112
00:08:37,058 --> 00:08:39,480
- And Marlo?
- Marlo is Marlo, man.

113
00:08:39,640 --> 00:08:42,342
He weren't the one
that put me in this trick bag.

114
00:08:42,502 --> 00:08:46,233
The motherfucker who snuggled up
and whispered in Marlo's ear did that.

115
00:08:46,593 --> 00:08:47,860
I know what you thinking,

116
00:08:48,020 --> 00:08:50,453
And I ain't making a move
against no kin,

117
00:08:50,613 --> 00:08:52,966
Not till I got more to go on than words.

118
00:08:53,126 --> 00:08:55,433
And knowing my sister's son
the way I do,

119
00:08:55,593 --> 00:08:58,025
If the boy got 50 grand
in his pocket,

120
00:08:58,226 --> 00:09:00,990
It ain't gonna be long
before it jump out and find itself

121
00:09:01,150 --> 00:09:02,559
in some salesman hand.

122
00:09:02,870 --> 00:09:05,162
And that kind of goody, we know.

123
00:09:05,860 --> 00:09:09,093
In the meantime, if Omar coming
for any of us, He coming for me,

124
00:09:09,359 --> 00:09:11,393
And out of respect
for that man's skill set,

125
00:09:11,553 --> 00:09:14,861
I'm gonna take myself out
of the lineup after the meet tomorrow.

126
00:09:15,021 --> 00:09:17,217
'Til this shit sort itself out,

127
00:09:17,860 --> 00:09:19,822
Cheese gonna watch the shop.

128
00:09:20,708 --> 00:09:21,939
You gonna watch Cheese.

129
00:09:27,211 --> 00:09:29,117
Very clean. Very nice.

130
00:09:34,579 --> 00:09:36,601
But this is unnecessary.

131
00:09:37,026 --> 00:09:39,582
It was not our intent
to mislead.

132
00:09:39,923 --> 00:09:42,843
When I spoke before
about the condition of your money,

133
00:09:43,285 --> 00:09:45,588
I was talking... in symbols.

134
00:09:46,746 --> 00:09:49,759
The money, it came from the street,
And so I thought

135
00:09:49,919 --> 00:09:52,929
you came... from the street.

136
00:09:53,628 --> 00:09:54,585
I did.

137
00:09:56,161 --> 00:09:57,061
I do.

138
00:09:57,228 --> 00:09:58,976
It was not the money
that concerned me.

139
00:09:59,178 --> 00:10:01,568
You have been
more than generous,

140
00:10:01,728 --> 00:10:04,888
and this is a gift
of an honorable man, clearly.

141
00:10:05,518 --> 00:10:07,335
But, in accepting such a gift,

142
00:10:07,590 --> 00:10:10,069
we would give you
the wrong impression.

143
00:10:18,857 --> 00:10:20,686
You come from the street, hmm?

144
00:10:22,263 --> 00:10:24,908
The street... doesn't concern us.

145
00:10:25,362 --> 00:10:27,747
We know him down here,
and we trust him.

146
00:10:28,320 --> 00:10:30,843
But... to know more people,

147
00:10:31,460 --> 00:10:32,960
to learn more names,

148
00:10:33,728 --> 00:10:35,833
to have them learn our names...

149
00:10:36,188 --> 00:10:38,015
I'm not here to badmouth Prop Joe.

150
00:10:38,662 --> 00:10:40,268
But people depend on me.

151
00:10:40,928 --> 00:10:43,099
Now, last year,
there was a robbery.

152
00:10:44,960 --> 00:10:48,067
I'm saying, you know, what?
What if this happens again?

153
00:10:48,227 --> 00:10:49,563
Where do that put my people?

154
00:10:49,730 --> 00:10:51,320
That's for you to discuss with Joe.

155
00:10:51,950 --> 00:10:54,237
All I'm asking for
is an insurance policy.

156
00:10:54,397 --> 00:10:56,075
You know, something covers me

157
00:10:56,235 --> 00:10:58,160
- and covers you.
- And covers Joe.

158
00:11:05,996 --> 00:11:09,503
The young man makes a point.

159
00:11:09,832 --> 00:11:11,052
You're right.

160
00:11:11,455 --> 00:11:13,097
These are volatile times.

161
00:11:13,634 --> 00:11:16,512
It is not unreasonable
to carry insurance.

162
00:11:17,323 --> 00:11:20,498
Who can say
what tomorrow will show us?

163
00:11:22,001 --> 00:11:22,970
You go.

164
00:11:24,348 --> 00:11:25,428
Be safe.

165
00:11:29,807 --> 00:11:30,693
Your case.

166
00:11:32,164 --> 00:11:35,519
Oh, y'all came a ways.
Put it to expenses.

167
00:11:41,263 --> 00:11:43,247
If we were to tell him no,

168
00:11:43,601 --> 00:11:45,188
he will still come back.

169
00:11:46,565 --> 00:11:48,124
This he shows us.

170
00:11:52,021 --> 00:11:53,674
But he is not Joe.

171
00:11:55,470 --> 00:11:56,980
He is not Joe.

172
00:11:59,548 --> 00:12:00,938
If I follow this,

173
00:12:01,098 --> 00:12:03,332
the senator's mother-in-law
gave him $80,000

174
00:12:03,492 --> 00:12:06,272
that he used as a down payment
on some property.

175
00:12:06,432 --> 00:12:09,005
Later, he paid the money back,
which makes it a loan.

176
00:12:09,307 --> 00:12:11,312
Which falsifies the loan application.

177
00:12:11,472 --> 00:12:13,905
The moment he signs the application,
he's exposed.

178
00:12:14,065 --> 00:12:18,206
Title XVIII of the U.S. Code,
chapter 47, section 10-14,

179
00:12:18,366 --> 00:12:20,951
Loan and credit applications.
30 years

180
00:12:21,383 --> 00:12:22,967
and not to exceed $1 million.

181
00:12:23,127 --> 00:12:25,550
Over at the U.S. Attorney's office,
they call it "the head shot."

182
00:12:25,710 --> 00:12:27,070
30 years for something

183
00:12:27,230 --> 00:12:29,999
that every kid two years out of college
does with a starter home.

184
00:12:30,159 --> 00:12:33,547
Daddy loans you money to qualify;
a couple years later, you pay him back.

185
00:12:34,633 --> 00:12:35,630
30 years.

186
00:12:36,168 --> 00:12:37,832
With leverage like that,

187
00:12:38,292 --> 00:12:40,144
this case needs to go federal.

188
00:12:48,939 --> 00:12:50,407
Outstanding work, Detective.

189
00:12:50,641 --> 00:12:52,816
Let me have some time
to digest this.

190
00:12:54,989 --> 00:12:55,947
Counselor,

191
00:12:56,391 --> 00:12:57,327
a moment?

192
00:13:01,933 --> 00:13:03,452
Is there another way to go at this?

193
00:13:03,612 --> 00:13:06,747
- How strong are our theft counts?
- Straightforward document cases,

194
00:13:07,000 --> 00:13:09,868
Four counts. They're a lock.
He stole from his own charities.

195
00:13:10,033 --> 00:13:12,281
We convict,
that's 10 years per count.

196
00:13:12,883 --> 00:13:15,968
Nothing to sneeze at,
even without the bank charge.

197
00:13:41,802 --> 00:13:43,802
You think it might be,
OK for me to sit in

198
00:13:43,968 --> 00:13:46,620
- on one of your budget meetings?
- On our good days.

199
00:13:49,803 --> 00:13:51,832
Ed? This is Scott Templeton.

200
00:13:53,035 --> 00:13:54,443
Good to meet you.
Have a seat.

201
00:13:54,974 --> 00:13:56,253
Give me a second.

202
00:14:00,937 --> 00:14:03,855
Next mouth needs fed
is the right reverend Isaac Cason.

203
00:14:04,015 --> 00:14:06,119
You'd think I was putting
Ray Lewis out to pasture.

204
00:14:06,279 --> 00:14:07,838
All I'm trying to do is dump Burrell.

205
00:14:07,998 --> 00:14:11,081
You want my community to swallow Rawls,
you'd better grease that morsel up good.

206
00:14:11,241 --> 00:14:13,051
It's Rawls for six months,
then it's Daniels.

207
00:14:13,211 --> 00:14:16,109
What, you're gonna tell me Daniels
isn't black enough for you guys?

208
00:14:16,269 --> 00:14:17,644
They don't know him.

209
00:14:17,804 --> 00:14:20,537
They know Burrell, qnd they could
get him on the phone when--

210
00:14:20,882 --> 00:14:23,527
Burrell came in here with bad stats.
He lied to my face.

211
00:14:23,687 --> 00:14:26,070
Rawls lied, too, but you're bumping him
to acting commissioner.

212
00:14:26,230 --> 00:14:28,111
Only 'til Daniels
gets groomed as deputy ops.

213
00:14:28,271 --> 00:14:30,077
We can't fire everyone
all at once, can we?

214
00:14:30,237 --> 00:14:31,645
This isn't getting us anywhere.

215
00:14:32,260 --> 00:14:33,384
Only two more left.

216
00:14:33,544 --> 00:14:36,239
Fine. How can I be of assistance
to the good reverend Cason?

217
00:14:36,399 --> 00:14:37,959
He has property up in Park Heights.

218
00:14:38,119 --> 00:14:39,852
He wants to convert it
to Senior housing.

219
00:14:40,012 --> 00:14:41,842
- Can we accommodate him?
- We're broke, but,

220
00:14:42,002 --> 00:14:44,512
We could steer
some of the HUD money his way.

221
00:14:45,170 --> 00:14:47,154
That leaves reverend Myrtle Smith.

222
00:14:47,314 --> 00:14:50,643
She wants to extend parking
to a vacant lot next to her church.

223
00:14:50,904 --> 00:14:52,421
- It's city property.
- That's it?

224
00:14:52,581 --> 00:14:53,722
Last is the least.

225
00:14:53,882 --> 00:14:56,304
We'll get the reverend
a long-term lease, dollar a year.

226
00:14:58,838 --> 00:15:01,614
Then there's the matter
of McCulloh homes.

227
00:15:02,845 --> 00:15:06,290
That would be the same McCulloh homes
that's adjacent to Andy Krawczyk's

228
00:15:06,450 --> 00:15:09,104
$300 million expansion
of the state office complex.

229
00:15:09,264 --> 00:15:11,055
- It's over 500 units.
- Public housing.

230
00:15:11,215 --> 00:15:13,392
Narrese, you're gonna need
that hope VI money for that.

231
00:15:13,552 --> 00:15:16,124
- Is there any hope VI money to be had?
- It doesn't matter, gentlemen.

232
00:15:16,284 --> 00:15:18,846
All madame president wants
from us is the green light.

233
00:15:19,776 --> 00:15:21,373
You want him gone, right?

234
00:15:25,174 --> 00:15:26,136
It's good stuff.

235
00:15:26,831 --> 00:15:29,125
Some of your feature work
a little wrought

236
00:15:29,285 --> 00:15:31,308
for what we do here
at the "Post" language-wise,

237
00:15:31,468 --> 00:15:34,453
- But it all shows initiative.
- That's the style they want from me,

238
00:15:34,773 --> 00:15:36,246
but to tell you the truth,

239
00:15:36,406 --> 00:15:37,884
I prefer to write it dry.

240
00:15:38,240 --> 00:15:40,693
- You've been in Baltimore long?
- Two years.

241
00:15:41,506 --> 00:15:44,505
Before that, I was at the
"Kansas City Star" for three years,

242
00:15:44,773 --> 00:15:46,323
"Wichita Eagle" before that.

243
00:15:46,483 --> 00:15:47,741
The "Sun's" a fine paper.

244
00:15:48,956 --> 00:15:50,232
Before the cutbacks, maybe.

245
00:15:50,392 --> 00:15:52,514
Well, they still beat us
often enough in Annapolis

246
00:15:52,674 --> 00:15:55,219
for my Maryland desk
to take them seriously.

247
00:15:55,939 --> 00:15:59,300
You have anything to do with
those ground red stories last year?

248
00:16:00,022 --> 00:16:02,094
It's good stuff,
real good stuff.

249
00:16:12,774 --> 00:16:15,080
You wanted to go
to the page one meeting, right?

250
00:16:15,240 --> 00:16:16,691
Another time, maybe.

251
00:16:20,708 --> 00:16:23,047
Anyway, as he says,
we'll keep the resume on file.

252
00:16:23,207 --> 00:16:25,050
A few more clips,
a little more seasoning,

253
