00:16:25,210 --> 00:16:26,863
We'll take another look, OK?

254
00:16:28,934 --> 00:16:30,492
You can just toss that.

255
00:16:38,952 --> 00:16:42,648
That's the plan: to let him
cut his teeth as deputy for operations,

256
00:16:42,808 --> 00:16:45,276
and in six months, make him.

257
00:16:45,751 --> 00:16:48,975
He's not the spic-and-span boy
they think he is.

258
00:16:53,142 --> 00:16:56,998
He came up in the eastern district,
part of a bad drug unit

259
00:16:57,158 --> 00:16:58,809
that was skimming seized drug money.

260
00:16:58,969 --> 00:17:00,059
I actually had to--

261
00:17:00,219 --> 00:17:03,515
This isn't about Daniels.
You came in with bad stats,

262
00:17:03,894 --> 00:17:05,742
And for the mayor,
that was the last straw.

263
00:17:05,902 --> 00:17:07,282
My numbers were clean.

264
00:17:07,442 --> 00:17:09,739
They had gone through staff review.
You tell Carcetti--

265
00:17:09,899 --> 00:17:11,575
Ervin, it doesn't matter now.

266
00:17:12,102 --> 00:17:12,959
You're done.

267
00:17:13,119 --> 00:17:14,411
Carcetti has moved on you.

268
00:17:16,434 --> 00:17:18,638
You tell him
if he does me like this,

269
00:17:19,109 --> 00:17:20,216
I'll do Daniels.

270
00:17:20,491 --> 00:17:21,483
You kill Daniels,

271
00:17:21,643 --> 00:17:23,921
and we end up with Bill Rawls
as police commissioner.

272
00:17:24,543 --> 00:17:27,466
The ministers, the caucus,
the council-- They'll live with Daniels.

273
00:17:27,626 --> 00:17:28,490
Why?

274
00:17:29,100 --> 00:17:32,216
Because Carcetti gave away
the store just to push you out.

275
00:17:32,376 --> 00:17:34,197
30 pieces of silver each, huh?

276
00:17:34,557 --> 00:17:35,766
We'll have your back.

277
00:17:36,136 --> 00:17:37,458
I promise you.

278
00:17:37,808 --> 00:17:38,819
Full pension

279
00:17:38,979 --> 00:17:40,143
and a transitional job

280
00:17:40,303 --> 00:17:42,435
on the mayor's criminal justice
coordinating council,

281
00:17:42,595 --> 00:17:45,083
And from there,
something down in Washington

282
00:17:45,243 --> 00:17:46,882
with one of the police associations--

283
00:17:47,042 --> 00:17:48,737
six figures guaranteed.

284
00:17:50,534 --> 00:17:52,866
You go the right way,
and attention will be paid, Ervin.

285
00:17:53,026 --> 00:17:54,493
But you go kicking and screaming,

286
00:17:54,735 --> 00:17:57,242
and no one--
Not the caucus, not the ministers,

287
00:17:57,402 --> 00:17:58,304
not me--

288
00:18:00,205 --> 00:18:01,417
will be there for you.

289
00:18:06,477 --> 00:18:07,423
Your choice.

290
00:18:12,077 --> 00:18:14,889
Press conference tomorrow.
You play out the string.

291
00:18:15,215 --> 00:18:16,881
Carcetti will do the same.

292
00:18:32,108 --> 00:18:36,185
<i>Attention: all unauthorized
vehicles parked on the loading dock</i>

293
00:18:36,345 --> 00:18:37,884
<i>are now being towed.</i>

294
00:18:38,412 --> 00:18:40,618
<i>Attention: all unauthorized...</i>

295
00:18:40,778 --> 00:18:42,038
No one's saying anything?

296
00:18:42,198 --> 00:18:44,413
- I thought you might help me.
- Not even off the record?

297
00:18:44,573 --> 00:18:46,363
- I just need to confirm.
- ...he told you.

298
00:18:46,523 --> 00:18:48,966
E-Dot deadline's creeping up.
Where the hell are we at?

299
00:18:49,126 --> 00:18:51,035
A source at the courthouse
says it's true

300
00:18:51,195 --> 00:18:52,825
he heard it from Steintorf at the hall.

301
00:18:52,985 --> 00:18:56,012
Nothing from the mayor's office,
but they've schedded a press conference.

302
00:18:56,172 --> 00:18:58,891
- What's coming out of headquarters?
- Nothing. Daniels had no comment,

303
00:18:59,051 --> 00:19:00,513
and Rawls won't return my calls.

304
00:19:00,673 --> 00:19:02,163
Fuck, fuck, fuck.

305
00:19:02,875 --> 00:19:05,919
And where the hell is Templeton all day?
He could be throwing calls, too.

306
00:19:06,079 --> 00:19:07,852
My last gift to you, Gus.

307
00:19:09,436 --> 00:19:11,912
It's Twigg, and I'm on a deadline,
so cut the bullshit.

308
00:19:12,072 --> 00:19:14,822
Don't tell me they're firing
the police commissioner tonight

309
00:19:14,982 --> 00:19:16,450
and you don't know all about it.

310
00:19:17,479 --> 00:19:19,119
Don't be fucking telling me that.

311
00:19:19,513 --> 00:19:21,028
Lucky I signed off on your ass,

312
00:19:21,188 --> 00:19:23,120
or you'd be
on your way out to boys' village.

313
00:19:23,280 --> 00:19:24,656
And look how you do me.

314
00:19:24,816 --> 00:19:26,920
Not ming around,
not letting me see Bug.

315
00:19:27,080 --> 00:19:29,687
- Is that how you pay back a mother?
- How should I pay you back?

316
00:19:29,847 --> 00:19:31,381
Start by showing a little respect.

317
00:19:31,870 --> 00:19:32,829
That all?

318
00:19:33,580 --> 00:19:36,720
Truth is, things have been
rough around the way.

319
00:19:37,180 --> 00:19:39,146
What you're doing's so good,
thought maybe

320
00:19:39,306 --> 00:19:40,654
you'd throw some ends my way.

321
00:19:40,922 --> 00:19:42,949
Seeing as how I was here for you
and all.

322
00:19:43,109 --> 00:19:45,213
I ain't paying you to be my mother.

323
00:19:55,695 --> 00:19:58,421
The pros from downtown are here.

324
00:19:58,811 --> 00:20:02,359
- What can I do for you gents?
- You got a copy of the shift roster?

325
00:20:10,354 --> 00:20:13,484
- Didn't Oscar get a realtor's license?
- That would be his day job.

326
00:20:13,644 --> 00:20:16,787
My favorite side partner
from my salad days in patrol.

327
00:20:16,947 --> 00:20:17,803
Thank you.

328
00:20:18,817 --> 00:20:20,789
Hard to imagine you in patrol.

329
00:20:21,964 --> 00:20:23,326
Damn if I can find it.

330
00:20:23,486 --> 00:20:25,438
That's why they call it a hole.

331
00:20:27,082 --> 00:20:29,744
That there is the sickest idea yet.
You know that, right?

332
00:20:29,904 --> 00:20:31,836
I'm just gilding your lily, son.

333
00:20:33,409 --> 00:20:35,227
There.
Right there.

334
00:20:44,516 --> 00:20:47,857
- Go away! I'm on my lunch break.
- Excuse me, officer.

335
00:20:48,017 --> 00:20:49,710
Is this the on-ramp to 95?

336
00:20:54,983 --> 00:20:55,927
Socks.

337
00:20:56,983 --> 00:20:58,427
I'll be fucked.

338
00:21:00,450 --> 00:21:02,257
This is my partner,
Jimmy McNulty.

339
00:21:03,166 --> 00:21:05,490
You look like a man
in the market for a new house.

340
00:21:05,881 --> 00:21:07,986
Think abouit.
It's a buyer's market.

341
00:21:09,717 --> 00:21:10,717
Nice garden.

342
00:21:10,877 --> 00:21:12,912
Ah, you have an eye
for quality, Socks.

343
00:21:13,396 --> 00:21:15,732
Call me if you decide to make a move.

344
00:21:18,768 --> 00:21:20,250
So this isn't a social call?

345
00:21:20,410 --> 00:21:21,722
I wish it were.

346
00:21:23,251 --> 00:21:24,725
Well, get on with it.

347
00:21:24,885 --> 00:21:26,624
I got a busy day tomorrow.
I need my rest.

348
00:21:26,784 --> 00:21:28,491
Oscar, we're in need of a body--

349
00:21:28,832 --> 00:21:31,293
Male, homeless,
little or no decomp.

350
00:21:31,453 --> 00:21:32,715
Unattended death?

351
00:21:33,751 --> 00:21:36,340
That shouldn't be no problem, Socks,
seeing as you homicide.

352
00:21:36,500 --> 00:21:39,092
We need to get to it before anybody else
gets a look-see.

353
00:21:41,651 --> 00:21:43,347
You want to open an H-file?

354
00:21:47,011 --> 00:21:48,763
Well, that's got to be a first.

355
00:21:53,819 --> 00:21:55,179
How do I reach you?

356
00:21:58,552 --> 00:22:00,030
- All right.
- All right.

357
00:22:01,359 --> 00:22:02,836
You want to know why?

358
00:22:07,383 --> 00:22:08,485
Is that it?

359
00:22:10,906 --> 00:22:12,051
If he backs up on us--

360
00:22:12,211 --> 00:22:14,169
McQuayle was in homicide.
He caught one--

361
00:22:14,329 --> 00:22:15,563
A botched kidnapping.

362
00:22:15,723 --> 00:22:18,966
He gets there, finds the area
Chief sightseeing through his scene,

363
00:22:19,126 --> 00:22:20,770
asks him to back off,

364
00:22:20,930 --> 00:22:22,784
- cites the G.O.
- G-3:

365
00:22:23,015 --> 00:22:26,390
authority and responsibility to
coordinate the investigation shall rest

366
00:22:26,550 --> 00:22:28,109
with the homicide detective.

367
00:22:29,211 --> 00:22:30,959
Area Chief takes umbrage.

368
00:22:31,240 --> 00:22:33,438
Oscar stands his ground,
and there's quite a dust-up.

369
00:22:33,598 --> 00:22:35,899
The next morning,
he's told he's insubordinate.

370
00:22:36,153 --> 00:22:39,987
He's got to work two weeks extra duty
pounding pavement up Monument Street.

371
00:22:40,289 --> 00:22:44,046
He told them to go fuck themselves,
you know, he'll take the trial board.

372
00:22:44,720 --> 00:22:46,460
Well, he eats two weeks,

373
00:22:46,620 --> 00:22:48,495
and they shitcan him out the unit.

374
00:22:49,504 --> 00:22:50,518
Area Chief?

375
00:22:51,153 --> 00:22:53,083
Name of Rawls,
as I remember it.

376
00:23:22,154 --> 00:23:23,771
How you still alive, yo?

377
00:23:25,579 --> 00:23:28,368
They needed to send a message.
Tell him.

378
00:23:28,822 --> 00:23:32,207
Said, "tell Omar he put
his hand in the wrong pocket."

379
00:23:32,367 --> 00:23:34,332
And you need to know,
Marlo dogs,

380
00:23:34,492 --> 00:23:35,995
they didn't let Butchie go easy.

381
00:23:36,155 --> 00:23:39,781
I'm gonna work them.
Sweet Jesus, I'm gonna work them.

382
00:23:40,555 --> 00:23:42,966
- I want in.
- Nah, this one on me, yo.

383
00:23:43,221 --> 00:23:45,096
But you don't know them people.

384
00:23:53,462 --> 00:23:55,129
As expected, it's Rawls,

385
00:23:55,289 --> 00:23:57,064
with Daniels waiting in the wings.

386
00:23:58,289 --> 00:24:00,609
Did they not know that
I had made myself a candidate?

387
00:24:00,769 --> 00:24:02,571
- I feel dissed.
- So the great white Rawls

388
00:24:02,731 --> 00:24:05,563
- Filly has his day.
- Not much more than a day it shall be.

389
00:24:05,723 --> 00:24:06,907
Daniels by year's end.

390
00:24:07,813 --> 00:24:08,921
Look at this.

391
00:24:14,022 --> 00:24:15,457
You're not even gonna read it?

392
00:24:16,156 --> 00:24:17,696
All you do is change the date.

393
00:24:17,911 --> 00:24:19,129
I'm covering my ass, Jay.

394
00:24:19,289 --> 00:24:20,627
Consider it covered.

395
00:24:21,727 --> 00:24:22,609
Motherfucker,

396
00:24:23,094 --> 00:24:25,631
I am the primary
on 22 bodies more than a year old,

397
00:24:25,791 --> 00:24:28,116
and I still haven't got
trace analysis on 14 scenes.

398
00:24:28,276 --> 00:24:30,497
The lab can't keep up
with this year's cases.

399
00:24:30,789 --> 00:24:32,916
You want action,
show me some traction.

400
00:24:33,635 --> 00:24:35,620
Or buy yourself a chemistry set.

401
00:24:45,657 --> 00:24:47,280
Just doing background on my vics,

402
00:24:47,440 --> 00:24:48,698
Looking for a common thread.

403
00:24:48,858 --> 00:24:50,357
Motherfucker, don't even--

404
00:24:51,629 --> 00:24:53,438
Fuck you, too, motherfucker.

405
00:24:55,763 --> 00:24:57,874
- What's wrong with Bunk?
- Hard to say.

406
00:24:58,429 --> 00:25:00,877
Beneath that gruff veneer,
he's actually very emotional.

407
00:25:02,324 --> 00:25:05,230
Looking for the theme
in your homeless case, are you?

408
00:25:06,091 --> 00:25:07,542
Well, wish me luck.

409
00:25:07,947 --> 00:25:10,465
I'm gonna try for an interview
with my only wit.

410
00:25:10,625 --> 00:25:12,106
The home invasion?

411
00:25:26,229 --> 00:25:29,092
Fuck him, Tony. The guy was an asshole.
He saw what you've been doing.

412
00:25:29,252 --> 00:25:31,299
You know who you were
beating on yesterday?

413
00:25:31,459 --> 00:25:32,822
You fucking know?

414
00:25:33,526 --> 00:25:36,204
A teacher,
from Stuart Hill elementary,

415
00:25:36,459 --> 00:25:39,199
trying to get around our bullshit
to make it to an after-school program.

416
00:25:39,359 --> 00:25:41,908
- He should have said so.
- He never got a chance.

417
00:25:44,626 --> 00:25:46,726
Boy, I seen some stupid shit in my day,

418
00:25:46,886 --> 00:25:50,032
but even by western standards,
this rates a whole new category.

419
00:25:50,253 --> 00:25:52,282
I.I.D. is down the hall
talking to the Major.

420
00:25:52,442 --> 00:25:55,409
They're gonna be down here
looking for statements in 10 minutes.

421
00:25:56,572 --> 00:25:58,599
Tony, you got to write this smart.

422
00:25:59,520 --> 00:26:01,381
The excessive horn blowing
distracted you

423
00:26:01,541 --> 00:26:03,592
from securing juvenile prisoners who...

424
00:26:03,752 --> 00:26:05,525
became volatile due to the noise,

425
00:26:06,226 --> 00:26:08,126
And you warned the driver
several times--

426
00:26:08,510 --> 00:26:09,722
Fuck that motherfucker.

427
00:26:10,293 --> 00:26:12,077
- Say what?
- I said, fuck him.

428
00:26:12,389 --> 00:26:14,421
Shitbird lays on his horn,
he should be locked up.

429
00:26:14,581 --> 00:26:16,145
Fuck his ignorant ass.

430
00:26:17,560 --> 00:26:19,206
<i>Admin Lieutenant to the Major's office.</i>

431
00:26:19,926 --> 00:26:21,644
<i>Admin lieutenant to the major's office.</i>

432
00:26:26,027 --> 00:26:27,759
Tony, I'm writing you up.

433
00:26:30,895 --> 00:26:33,067
- You ain't gonna back me?
- I'm charging you.

434
00:26:33,353 --> 00:26:36,097
Then charge me.
You're a fucking rat.

435
00:26:38,494 --> 00:26:39,795
Then I'm a rat.

436
00:26:48,228 --> 00:26:50,779
No way. After what I've been through
to toss him out of the plane,

437
00:26:50,939 --> 00:26:52,989
Now you want me to pretty up
the man's parachute?

438
00:26:53,149 --> 00:26:55,168
The commissioner
has served this city for 34 years.

439
00:26:55,328 --> 00:26:57,435
Any five of which would be enough
to have him indicted.

440
00:26:57,595 --> 00:27:00,202
You should have thought about this
before you put a gun to my head

441
00:27:00,362 --> 00:27:02,586
and snatched up the McCulloh homes
for whatever developer

442
00:27:02,746 --> 00:27:04,793
- you're hiding in your skirt.
- This isn't about me,

443
00:27:04,953 --> 00:27:06,835
and it isn't even about Burrell.

444
00:27:06,995 --> 00:27:10,173
It's about Daniels or whoever you're
trying to empower in that department.

445
00:27:10,333 --> 00:27:12,592
- How so?
- 34 years is a long time.

446
00:27:12,752 --> 00:27:15,679
Anyone who hangs around that long
can put his hands on a lot of dirt.

447
00:27:15,995 --> 00:27:17,681
- If he'd talk out of turn--
- Daniels?

448
00:27:18,109 --> 00:27:19,828
I'm not being specific here.

449
00:27:20,162 --> 00:27:22,061
I'm just making it clear
for everyone's sake

450
00:27:22,221 --> 00:27:24,312
It would be better
if Burrell went quietly.

451
00:27:28,996 --> 00:27:32,042
We've scheduled a press
conference for this afternoon.

452
00:27:32,786 --> 00:27:35,503
I think Ervin is ready
for a little grip and grin.

453
00:27:35,663 --> 00:27:37,450
With you, with Rawls...

454
00:27:37,744 --> 00:27:41,163
for considerations, he might
even put his arm around Daniels.

455
00:27:44,376 --> 00:27:46,965
Money from a donor
to west side hoops.

456
00:27:47,663 --> 00:27:48,954
Deposit date.

457
00:27:49,563 --> 00:27:51,673
Withdrawal from that account

458
00:27:51,833 --> 00:27:53,431
to his personal account.

459
00:27:54,014 --> 00:27:54,984
Again...

460
00:27:55,768 --> 00:27:57,053
money from a donor.

461
00:27:59,090 --> 00:28:00,964
Thank you for coming, Senator.

462
00:28:02,868 --> 00:28:04,686
We've asked you in to answer

463
00:28:04,846 --> 00:28:06,521
questions regarding certain

464
00:28:06,681 --> 00:28:08,237
financial irregularities.

465
00:28:08,516 --> 00:28:11,484
We can go to my office and talk first
or get right to it.

466
00:28:12,436 --> 00:28:13,472
Lead on.

467
00:28:15,875 --> 00:28:17,528
If you'll follow me, then.

468
00:28:27,671 --> 00:28:29,401
He's pretty cool about it.

469
00:28:30,565 --> 00:28:32,470
The coming out tells the tale.

470
00:28:33,031 --> 00:28:33,980
Devon?

471
00:28:34,665 --> 00:28:36,187
<i>Do you know this story?</i>

472
00:28:38,832 --> 00:28:40,632
<i>Or would you like me
to read it to you?</i>

473
00:28:42,498 --> 00:28:43,446
<i>Devon?</i>

474
00:28:53,561 --> 00:28:58,543
Now, then, I show you a canceled check
dated 22 January, 2007,

475
00:28:58,703 --> 00:29:00,876
from Sterner, Ernst,
and Bauer Development Group

476
00:29:01,036 --> 00:29:03,730
made payable to West Baltimore
Hoops, Incorporated

477
00:29:03,890 --> 00:29:05,872
in the amount of $11,000.

478
00:29:06,132 --> 00:29:10,794
And this dated 23 January, 2007,

479
00:29:11,066 --> 00:29:14,573
a check drawn on the West Baltimore
Hoops, Incorporated account

480
00:29:14,733 --> 00:29:17,550
In the amount of $11,000.
And a deposit slip

481
00:29:17,805 --> 00:29:20,813
dated 23 January, same year,

482
00:29:20,973 --> 00:29:22,555
to your personal account

483
00:29:22,715 --> 00:29:24,641
in the amount of $11,000.

484
00:29:29,568 --> 00:29:32,732
I come here to help,
but y'all out for blood.

485
00:29:34,144 --> 00:29:36,319
I'm not answering no more questions.

486
00:29:37,145 --> 00:29:39,572
You are invoking your right
against self-incrimination,

487
00:29:39,732 --> 00:29:41,116
- sir?
- Damn right.

488
00:29:41,276 --> 00:29:43,736
Then we'll conclude this testimony.

489
00:30:05,835 --> 00:30:06,661
Damn.

490
00:30:07,225 --> 00:30:09,008
And that was just a love tap.

491
00:30:09,168 --> 00:30:13,139
Think what'd have happened if we hit
the good Senator with the whole shebang.

492
00:30:16,001 --> 00:30:17,376
Work on the Fifth, huh?

493
00:30:18,109 --> 00:30:19,835
Why did we even grand jury, then?

494
00:30:20,001 --> 00:30:23,283
The answer to at, Detective,
is out on Calvert Street.

495
00:30:23,443 --> 00:30:25,535
Senator. Senator,
we'd like to talk to you.

496
00:30:25,695 --> 00:30:26,744
Please, over here.

497
00:30:26,904 --> 00:30:28,709
Senator, would you care
to make a statement?

498
00:30:31,441 --> 00:30:33,442
Is it true that you appeared
before the grand jury?

499
00:30:33,602 --> 00:30:35,597
Jane, I insisted that I be called.

500
00:30:36,069 --> 00:30:38,661
It's our understanding that
you're the target of an investigation

501
00:30:38,821 --> 00:30:41,047
- into theft and fraud.
- Nooo. Pardon. Nooo.

502
00:30:42,139 --> 00:30:44,095
Some people are confused
about some things.

503
00:30:44,402 --> 00:30:46,848
But that's why I came down here today,
to set them straight.

504
00:30:47,135 --> 00:30:50,302
Happy to do it, too.
Happy to avail myself...

505
00:30:50,765 --> 00:30:52,859
Grand jury's supposed to be secret.

506
00:30:53,319 --> 00:30:56,232
- Who called the reporters?
- Mr. Bond, our state's attorney--

507
00:30:56,392 --> 00:30:58,985
Laying claim to the Senator
before anybody else can.

508
00:30:59,284 --> 00:31:01,916
There just seemed to be
a little bit of a misunderstanding

509
00:31:02,076 --> 00:31:04,176
about some of my dealings
here in the community.

510
00:31:04,336 --> 00:31:07,069
As soon as this newspaper
stink get off my ass,

511
00:31:07,320 --> 00:31:09,809
I'm gonna unload my club
and clear a mil.

512
00:31:09,969 --> 00:31:12,543
And I'm gonna snatch up every vacant
I can get my fat-ass fingers on.

513
00:31:12,703 --> 00:31:14,417
There you go.
Like a real player.

514
00:31:14,577 --> 00:31:17,003
It's a whole new world out there.
Buy you some property.

515
00:31:17,163 --> 00:31:19,043
Hold onto it 'til
the white people show up,

516
00:31:19,203 --> 00:31:21,043
- You make a killing.
- Milton's into that,

517
00:31:21,203 --> 00:31:24,610
Except he got some kind of deal with
that bullshit prisoner entry program.

518
00:31:24,770 --> 00:31:27,847
- Got convicts fixing up his house.
- Motherfuckers...

519
00:31:28,471 --> 00:31:29,766
shut the fuck up.

520
00:31:30,972 --> 00:31:33,044
I'm sick of listening to your shit.

521
00:31:34,097 --> 00:31:36,231
Have we got business?
If we ain't, we gonna bounce.

522
00:31:37,162 --> 00:31:39,211
Marlo here seems pressed for time.

523
00:31:39,648 --> 00:31:42,478
So y'all can pick back up
on this after the meeting.

524
00:31:42,638 --> 00:31:43,696
Last up.

525
00:31:44,169 --> 00:31:46,366
- We got hungry man.
- Junior here

526
00:31:46,526 --> 00:31:48,868
took it upon himself
to make unlawful incursions

527
00:31:49,028 --> 00:31:51,177
into county territory
that was marked for my people.

528
00:31:51,337 --> 00:31:53,873
Incursions?
Ain't you the articulate motherfucker?

529
00:31:54,033 --> 00:31:55,875
Keep on talking, boy.
You gonna get spanked.

530
00:31:56,035 --> 00:31:58,504
Like you got the heart.
Motherfucker piss like a bitch.

531
00:31:58,664 --> 00:32:00,155
All right, shut it down.

532
00:32:02,562 --> 00:32:04,467
Last I look,
you wasn't no charter member.

533
00:32:06,839 --> 00:32:08,041
I apologize.

534
00:32:08,672 --> 00:32:12,141
My nephew gonna heed
the boundaries, I assure you.

535
00:32:12,823 --> 00:32:15,144
A'ight.
Meeting's adjourned.

536
00:32:21,977 --> 00:32:23,608
What the fuck up in here?

537
00:32:29,656 --> 00:32:31,244
Just like I told you, right?

538
00:32:31,830 --> 00:32:34,080
I pulled some of it out,
brought it back home.

539
00:32:34,573 --> 00:32:35,536
I was, uh--

540
00:32:35,914 --> 00:32:37,099
I was thinking.

541
00:32:38,606 --> 00:32:39,995
What next with this?

542
00:32:42,206 --> 00:32:44,250
You clear some time tomorrow,

543
00:32:45,201 --> 00:32:47,510
I'll open the door for you.
That work?

544
00:32:48,847 --> 00:32:49,554
Son...

545
00:32:50,673 --> 00:32:55,382
you need to focus a bit more on what
can be gained by working with people.

546
00:32:55,713 --> 00:32:57,498
That's just a thought, now.

547
00:32:58,520 --> 00:33:00,272
Yeah. Thanks.

548
00:33:17,047 --> 00:33:19,042
Come to see a dead man walking?

549
00:33:22,040 --> 00:33:24,598
I hear Carcetti's gonna do right by you.

550
00:33:24,973 --> 00:33:27,981
Salary with the coordinating council,
then a D.C. job.

551
00:33:29,073 --> 00:33:31,846
- You deserve it.
- Sure, I deserve it,

552
00:33:32,006 --> 00:33:33,703
but not for doing the job.

553
00:33:34,708 --> 00:33:35,725
What I got,

554
00:33:35,936 --> 00:33:38,993
they gave me for carrying
their water all these years.

555
00:33:39,514 --> 00:33:41,069
To Carcetti, I'm a hack.

556
00:33:41,442 --> 00:33:42,987
Royce was no different.

557
00:33:44,554 --> 00:33:45,526
Maybe I am.

558
00:33:45,815 --> 00:33:48,548
But every day, they send over
a new priority.

559
00:33:48,898 --> 00:33:51,514
Go after the bad guys.
No, change that.

560
00:33:52,079 --> 00:33:54,304
Make quality-of-life cases.

561
00:33:54,464 --> 00:33:55,848
Get on top of the murders.

562
00:33:56,008 --> 00:34:00,297
On second thought,
run the whores out of Patterson Park.

563
00:34:00,709 --> 00:34:04,828
You think the mayor
tells the schools how to teach kids,

564
00:34:05,207 --> 00:34:07,016
or the health department
how to do its job,

565
00:34:07,176 --> 00:34:08,896
or sanitation how to pick up trash?

566
00:34:09,056 --> 00:34:13,580
But get elected, and suddenly,
they know police work.

567
00:34:15,276 --> 00:34:17,058
You might think it'll be different

568
00:34:18,424 --> 00:34:19,755
when you sit here,

569
00:34:20,827 --> 00:34:21,854
but it won't.

570
00:34:22,476 --> 00:34:24,505
You will eat their shit.

571
00:34:25,498 --> 00:34:27,867
Daniels, too, when he gets here.

572
00:34:45,010 --> 00:34:47,130
<i>I wonder how you get
the ladder to go up.</i>

573
00:34:47,544 --> 00:34:48,927
<i>How do you do that?</i>

574
00:34:52,043 --> 00:34:53,923
<i>This is a wonderful fire truck.</i>

575
00:34:55,120 --> 00:34:57,269
<i>I wonder where all the firemen are.</i>

576
00:34:58,936 --> 00:35:00,754
<i>Think they could fit in here?</i>

577
00:35:02,281 --> 00:35:04,584
<i>I wonder what kind of siren
sound this makes.</i>

578
00:35:05,568 --> 00:35:06,780
Cheryl, hey.

579
00:35:08,658 --> 00:35:12,655
I was thinking I might want
to swing by and see Elijah, you know?

580
00:35:14,901 --> 00:35:17,356
Yeah, I know it's been a while.
But...

581
00:35:18,848 --> 00:35:20,535
No, no, no. I can get off.

582
00:35:20,977 --> 00:35:22,711
Yeah, tomorrow'd be fine.

583
00:35:25,700 --> 00:35:27,089
Yeah. Sure.

584
00:35:27,611 --> 00:35:28,961
<i>I'll be right back.</i>

585
00:35:32,045 --> 00:35:34,669
- I'm sorry. I just don't think--
- No, no. It's OK.

586
00:35:34,829 --> 00:35:37,138
Right now, he's too withdrawn
to revisit the event.

587
00:35:39,712 --> 00:35:42,280
How do you come back
from something like that?

588
00:35:52,446 --> 00:35:54,157
You look nervous, Deputy.

589
00:35:56,379 --> 00:35:58,329
I swear I didn't ask for this.

590
00:35:58,489 --> 00:35:59,448
Relax.

591
00:36:00,043 --> 00:36:03,706
You once told me that if I was gonna do
you, you'd be done already. Remember?

592
00:36:05,021 --> 00:36:07,794
Shit, I don't even remember
what was in that file.

593
00:36:07,954 --> 00:36:10,395
Something about the eastern district.

594
00:36:11,280 --> 00:36:13,895
So long ago, who can remember?

595
00:36:24,062 --> 00:36:26,395
I wanted to say a few words
about public service

596
00:36:26,809 --> 00:36:28,714
and about Ervin H. Burrell.

597
00:36:30,345 --> 00:36:32,379
During my time on the city council,

598
00:36:32,947 --> 00:36:34,237
Erv was no stranger to me.

599
00:36:34,397 --> 00:36:36,325
<i>I chaired the public safety
subcommittee,</i>

600
00:36:36,485 --> 00:36:38,114
<i>and I called upon him many times.</i>

601
00:36:38,274 --> 00:36:40,728
<i>We worked closely together then,
and when I became Mayor,</i>

602
00:36:40,888 --> 00:36:42,452
<i>we formed a strong relationship...</i>

603
00:36:42,612 --> 00:36:45,248
he feared and hated me,
and I merely wanted him dead.

604
00:36:46,399 --> 00:36:48,054
<i>... making Baltimore a safer city.</i>

605
00:36:48,214 --> 00:36:50,296
Don't stray from the inner harbor.

606
00:36:52,673 --> 00:36:56,137
<i>I know that the criminal justice
coordinating council need a new...</i>

607
00:36:56,297 --> 00:36:59,345
it took a while, but I finally
put his ass out to pasture.

608
00:37:00,587 --> 00:37:01,722
<i>If you would.</i>

609
00:37:02,682 --> 00:37:04,589
<i>Thank you.
I have a plaque for you.</i>

610
00:37:04,749 --> 00:37:06,102
Plaques for hacks.

611
00:37:06,315 --> 00:37:08,055
Prerogative of any big-city Mayor.

612
00:37:09,706 --> 00:37:12,626
How much of that insight and analysis
can we get in tomorrow's story?

613
00:37:13,352 --> 00:37:14,553
Little to none.

614
00:37:16,079 --> 00:37:18,248
Twigg was the man who could work
the department sources,

615
00:37:18,408 --> 00:37:21,151
and they're the ones that would shit
all over a dog-and-pony show like that.

616
00:37:21,311 --> 00:37:22,660
What about Price at the hall?

617
00:37:22,820 --> 00:37:24,388
They set up the press conference.

618
00:37:24,548 --> 00:37:26,673
They're not gonna tell the
truth, even on background.

619
00:37:26,833 --> 00:37:30,083
A veteran in the cop shop is what
gets us over on a story like this,

620
00:37:30,243 --> 00:37:32,482
and fuck if we didn't buy ours out.

621
00:37:32,789 --> 00:37:35,850
Gus, I understand that you're
disappointed with the cutbacks,

622
00:37:36,010 --> 00:37:37,508
But civility is important.

623
00:37:38,062 --> 00:37:40,216
I've been meaning to talk to you
about your profanity.

624
00:37:40,376 --> 00:37:41,637
My profanity?

625
00:37:42,149 --> 00:37:44,140
A collegial atmosphere is essential.

626
00:37:50,890 --> 00:37:52,012
Collegial?

627
00:37:52,369 --> 00:37:55,318
I failed out of journalism school.
What the fuck do "collegial" mean?

628
00:37:55,648 --> 00:37:57,654
Jesus Christ.
We don't have this?

629
00:37:58,022 --> 00:38:01,523
<i>Prosecutors would not comment on
a possible grand jury investigation,</i>

630
00:38:01,683 --> 00:38:03,291
but sources familiar with the case

631
00:38:03,451 --> 00:38:05,424
<i>say the Senator
has been under investigation</i>

632
00:38:05,584 --> 00:38:07,079
-<i> for more than a year</i>.
- Sorze.

633
00:38:10,094 --> 00:38:11,792
Clay Davis was grand-juried today.

634
00:38:11,952 --> 00:38:14,185
He's been under investigation
for almost a year.

635
00:38:14,345 --> 00:38:15,985
I'm a federal court reporter, remember?

636
00:38:16,145 --> 00:38:18,330
We haven't had daily city court covere
since Doug Strock

637
00:38:18,490 --> 00:38:20,843
- took the buyout before last.
- This isn't a federal probe?

638
00:38:21,003 --> 00:38:23,387
If it was, I would have had it
months ago. This is city.

639
00:38:23,547 --> 00:38:25,473
You want one reporter
covering two courthouses,

640
00:38:25,633 --> 00:38:27,763
fine. Why don't you
shove the broom up my ass,

641
00:38:27,923 --> 00:38:29,307
and I'll sweep the floor.

642
00:38:29,467 --> 00:38:31,024
All right. Just get caught up, OK?

643
00:38:31,184 --> 00:38:33,272
Meanwhile, see if you can
get a quote from Davis.

644
00:38:33,432 --> 00:38:35,608
You're chasing
a courthouse story with Sorze.

645
00:38:35,768 --> 00:38:38,110
- No problem. What do you need?
- Find the state's attorney.

646
00:38:38,270 --> 00:38:41,225
He set up a perp walk for Clay Davis
outside the grand jury today.

647
00:38:41,385 --> 00:38:43,824
We get a hold of Bond,
he'll catch us up on all this shit.

648
00:38:45,518 --> 00:38:46,425
Jesus.

649
00:38:46,585 --> 00:38:48,537
You remember in the good old days
when nobody

650
00:38:48,697 --> 00:38:50,548
in their right mind
would stage a perp walk

651
00:38:50,708 --> 00:38:52,721
without calling a daily newspaper?

652
00:38:53,740 --> 00:38:56,484
Nowadays, all they care about
is a goddamn video.

653
00:38:58,951 --> 00:39:00,285
They've forgotten.

654
00:39:00,445 --> 00:39:02,118
I don't even know
why we're doing this.

655
00:39:02,278 --> 00:39:04,519
I can knock out an office report
like this in my sleep.

656
00:39:04,679 --> 00:39:08,391
There's no way Jay gets off his fat ass,
comes up to check what I'm doing.

657
00:39:08,551 --> 00:39:09,959
A lot rides on this.

658
00:39:10,119 --> 00:39:12,760
Work it like a real case,
it'll feel like a real case,

659
00:39:12,920 --> 00:39:15,459
And more importantly,
it'll read like a real case.

660
00:39:15,619 --> 00:39:17,719
You should have seen me
in the squad room today.

661
00:39:17,879 --> 00:39:20,585
All the case work laid out
like I'm lost in a career case.

662
00:39:20,745 --> 00:39:23,008
- Landsman barely noticed.
- We crank this up,

663
00:39:23,168 --> 00:39:25,825
Landsman's not the only one who's
gonna be thumbing through this H-file.

664
00:39:26,589 --> 00:39:29,245
We get sloppy, we get cuffed.

665
00:39:31,602 --> 00:39:33,293
What do you want me to do?

666
00:39:33,565 --> 00:39:35,978
What detectives do, detective.

667
00:39:54,574 --> 00:39:56,514
Can I talk to you for a second?

668
00:39:57,114 --> 00:40:00,167
Maybe later.
I got to get ready for work.

669
00:40:16,033 --> 00:40:17,300
Does your dog bite?

670
00:40:17,653 --> 00:40:19,030
Got teeth, don't he?

671
00:40:20,087 --> 00:40:22,154
Chip change, get your ass in here.
That's it.

672
00:40:23,108 --> 00:40:25,328
I'm Detective McNulty,
Homicide.

673
00:40:25,488 --> 00:40:27,182
May I ask you a few questions?

674
00:40:28,020 --> 00:40:29,111
Got a card?

675
00:40:33,488 --> 00:40:34,706
You got a card?

676
00:40:36,551 --> 00:40:38,293
- Card?
- Business card, yeah.

677
00:40:39,259 --> 00:40:41,320
I can't make no money like that...

678
00:40:54,923 --> 00:40:56,168
This-- That.

679
00:40:56,390 --> 00:40:57,580
That is a card.

680
00:41:16,575 --> 00:41:17,644
We having fun yet?

681
00:41:20,877 --> 00:41:22,045
I need a drink.

682
00:41:41,010 --> 00:41:43,720
I'm gonna ask you once,
where Joe?

683
00:41:44,424 --> 00:41:45,926
Skip past the talking.

684
00:41:46,791 --> 00:41:48,074
Do what you feel.

685
00:41:49,307 --> 00:41:50,803
Joe ain't had nothing to do with--

686
00:41:52,850 --> 00:41:55,197
Now, Slim, you gonna make me
hurt you, yo.

687
00:41:55,476 --> 00:41:56,818
Ask yourself, dog,

688
00:41:56,978 --> 00:41:58,837
why would Joe give Butchie up?

689
00:42:01,872 --> 00:42:03,657
If Marlo could make him talk,

690
00:42:04,092 --> 00:42:06,402
he puts Joe inside your big score.

691
00:42:07,025 --> 00:42:09,988
If Joe turned Butchie,
I'd tell you.

692
00:42:10,790 --> 00:42:12,664
Shit, I help you, even.

693
00:42:13,324 --> 00:42:14,869
But it just ain't like that.

694
00:42:17,025 --> 00:42:17,991
Come on, yo.

695
00:42:21,459 --> 00:42:22,466
Finish it.

696
00:42:49,855 --> 00:42:51,714
Take a look at the fifth graph.

697
00:42:52,214 --> 00:42:56,233
"The Mayor, comma, incensed by
the commissioner's performance..."

698
00:42:56,537 --> 00:42:58,579
- "Incensed" seems over the top.
- I don't know.

699
00:42:58,818 --> 00:43:01,972
Drug legalization fiasco,
the bodies in the vacants,

700
00:43:02,325 --> 00:43:04,627
The bullshit stats.
I'd be incensed.

701
00:43:07,581 --> 00:43:09,723
Take a look at Arnold's fifth graph.

702
00:43:10,127 --> 00:43:10,855
OK.

703
00:43:12,274 --> 00:43:14,634
"Incensed" is to inflame with wrath.

704
00:43:14,922 --> 00:43:18,349
It speaks to obsession.
Is this the Mayor's state of mind?

705
00:43:18,594 --> 00:43:20,434
Something more nuanced, perhaps.

706
00:43:20,636 --> 00:43:22,394
Galled, vexed, annoyed...

707
00:43:22,554 --> 00:43:24,647
safer still--displeased.

708
00:43:25,223 --> 00:43:26,920
You'd take the crab
out of crab soup.

709
00:43:31,060 --> 00:43:32,167
Hey, Scott,

710
00:43:32,327 --> 00:43:34,768
That was good work by you
and Sorze catching us up.

711
00:43:35,104 --> 00:43:37,701
- Great effort.
- There's an "attaboy" for you.

712
00:43:39,282 --> 00:43:40,957
How'd it go in Washington?

713
00:43:42,257 --> 00:43:44,053
Eh, buyer's market out there.

714
00:43:44,528 --> 00:43:45,508
Metro desk.

715
00:43:48,077 --> 00:43:49,928
"Baltimore Sun" ain't so bad.

716
00:43:51,359 --> 00:43:52,715
<i>9-Adam-4-3.</i>

717
00:43:53,462 --> 00:43:54,247
<i>43.</i>

718
00:43:54,994 --> 00:43:58,553
<i>Reported D.O.A. alley
in the rear of the old plant.</i>

719
00:43:59,214 --> 00:44:00,239
<i>Copy D.O.A.</i>

720
00:44:01,215 --> 00:44:03,135
9-46.
K-G-A,

721
00:44:03,295 --> 00:44:05,735
Advise 43 I'm close by.
I'll handle it.

722
00:44:05,895 --> 00:44:07,609
<i>Copy, 9-Adam-46.</i>

723
00:44:08,794 --> 00:44:10,789
Bunk, are you feeling all right?

724
00:44:11,308 --> 00:44:13,622
She said "D.O.A.," not "doughnut."

725
00:44:34,663 --> 00:44:37,671
I know y'all into keeping
things on the hush-hush tip,

726
00:44:37,831 --> 00:44:38,971
But, damn, Chris,

727
00:44:39,297 --> 00:44:41,455
This C.I.A. shit off the hook.

728
00:44:43,208 --> 00:44:44,046
I, uh...

729
00:44:45,096 --> 00:44:47,968
I ain't done nothing lately
to piss you off, right?

730
00:44:49,664 --> 00:44:50,557
Right?

731
00:44:58,030 --> 00:44:59,870
Man already shit hisself,

732
00:45:00,190 --> 00:45:02,195
And we ain't even get started t.

733
00:45:02,664 --> 00:45:04,204
He's funky, yo.

734
00:45:04,931 --> 00:45:06,165
It's a gift from Marlo.

735
00:45:06,482 --> 00:45:07,971
But you know how that go.

736
00:45:08,131 --> 00:45:10,204
Give a gift, get a gift.

737
00:45:14,565 --> 00:45:16,652
Yo, hungry man, what's up?

738
00:45:28,173 --> 00:45:29,804
Lester, you can turn around.

739
00:45:30,753 --> 00:45:32,153
Yeah, false alarm.

740
00:45:34,586 --> 00:45:37,004
- Won't work. He's too far gone.
- I find them, Detective.

741
00:45:37,164 --> 00:45:39,239
What you do after that
is your business.

742
00:45:39,473 --> 00:45:41,060
Thanks. Maybe next time.

743
00:45:41,714 --> 00:45:44,205
Seeing as how I'm doing you
a favor, Detective,

744
00:45:44,571 --> 00:45:47,227
You can write the first
officer's report for me.

745
00:45:51,132 --> 00:45:53,093
My sequence is a-1-15.

746
00:46:05,599 --> 00:46:07,813
I know him.
Avon's lawyer.

747
00:46:08,128 --> 00:46:09,329
Yeah, mine, too.

748
00:46:09,800 --> 00:46:11,006
Brick uses him.

749
00:46:11,440 --> 00:46:15,128
So does Phil boy for most of his stuff,
not just the criminal side.

750
00:46:15,772 --> 00:46:19,243
Yeah, Levy excels in putting
our limp-dick money to work.

751
00:46:19,967 --> 00:46:22,315
You want to know what to do
with them bank checks?

752
00:46:22,475 --> 00:46:24,200
This where you need to be.

753
00:46:25,988 --> 00:46:28,306
Joseph, you're looking prosperous.

754
00:46:28,533 --> 00:46:29,482
I get by.

755
00:46:30,400 --> 00:46:31,417
Mr. Stanfield.

756
00:46:31,914 --> 00:46:33,877
Joseph tells me
good things about you.

757
00:46:35,834 --> 00:46:37,172
You ever find that camera?

758
00:46:38,633 --> 00:46:39,636
Cost me the job.

759
00:46:41,901 --> 00:46:44,847
So let's, go into the conference room
where we can spread out.

760
00:46:49,034 --> 00:46:51,781
This between you
and your attorney.

761
00:47:12,687 --> 00:47:14,714
Carcetti finally dumps Burrell.

762
00:47:15,769 --> 00:47:18,464
Ervin was a year before me at Dunbar.

763
00:47:19,869 --> 00:47:20,793
No shit.

764
00:47:22,446 --> 00:47:24,044
He was in the glee club.

765
00:47:27,469 --> 00:47:28,974
You're killing me.
I got to ask.

766
00:47:29,134 --> 00:47:30,184
Stone stupid.

767
00:47:38,269 --> 00:47:39,443
Say hi to Aunt Kima.

768
00:47:45,603 --> 00:47:47,803
Anyways, you were
right on time with this.

769
00:47:47,969 --> 00:47:49,943
I got a dozen things
I got to get done,

770
00:47:50,103 --> 00:47:52,748
and I got to do them while
working overtime at the station.

771
00:47:53,063 --> 00:47:54,175
Been busy, huh?

772
00:47:54,534 --> 00:47:56,877
Your boss got fired,
and we've been running ever since.

773
00:47:58,900 --> 00:47:59,925
Bye, Lij.

774
00:48:01,151 --> 00:48:02,758
Go on. We'll be fine.

775
00:48:12,003 --> 00:48:13,432
Wow, that's good.

776
00:48:14,068 --> 00:48:15,812
You staying inside the lines.

777
00:48:21,003 --> 00:48:22,194
Want to do something?

778
00:48:24,003 --> 00:48:25,198
Go to the park?

779
00:48:26,704 --> 00:48:28,035
Get some ice cream?

780
00:48:35,190 --> 00:48:36,291
What did you say?

781
00:48:38,537 --> 00:48:40,077
You don't have a house?

782
00:48:41,147 --> 00:48:42,312
What's up with that?

783
00:48:42,608 --> 00:48:43,924
A hero needs a house.

784
00:48:49,681 --> 00:48:51,557
Been a long time
since I built a house.

785
00:48:53,260 --> 00:48:54,434
Hope I remember how.

786
00:49:26,139 --> 00:49:27,190
Deputy ops.

787
00:49:28,809 --> 00:49:31,299
No, this is Daniels.
Cedric Daniels.

788
00:49:33,574 --> 00:49:35,517
He's now in the commissioner's office.

789
00:49:36,673 --> 00:49:37,379
Yes.

790
00:49:55,707 --> 00:49:58,218
He knows he fucked up.
He knows this.

791
00:49:59,406 --> 00:50:01,930
He's proud, you know?
He doesn't want to beg.

792
00:50:03,173 --> 00:50:04,598
It's not about that.

793
00:50:05,226 --> 00:50:06,383
Come on, Carv.

794
00:50:07,040 --> 00:50:09,051
You cannot do one of your own guys.

795
00:50:10,040 --> 00:50:12,281
I know you got rank now.
You're damn near lieutenant.

796
00:50:12,441 --> 00:50:13,497
But still...

797
00:50:15,769 --> 00:50:17,400
It ain't about the rank.

798
00:50:21,856 --> 00:50:23,388
I never told you, Herc.

799
00:50:25,514 --> 00:50:27,178
Never said a fucking word.

800
00:50:28,505 --> 00:50:30,581
But when I gave you that kid
to debrief last year,

801
00:50:30,741 --> 00:50:32,114
what's-his-face?

802
00:50:32,274 --> 00:50:35,672
You were supposed to get him
to Bunk Moreland. You remember that?

803
00:50:36,074 --> 00:50:39,172
Yeah. I fucked up.
So what?

804
00:50:40,641 --> 00:50:42,042
So it mattered.

805
00:50:43,006 --> 00:50:45,253
So what the fuck does this
have to do with Colicchio?

806
00:50:45,542 --> 00:50:46,862
It all matters.

807
00:50:47,953 --> 00:50:50,047
I know we thought it didn't, but...

808
00:50:52,308 --> 00:50:53,333
it does.

809
00:50:57,375 --> 00:50:59,345
So you got to do Colicchio, huh?

810
00:51:00,843 --> 00:51:02,836
Guess you think they had to do me.

811
00:51:06,728 --> 00:51:07,973
Yeah, probably.

812
00:51:11,932 --> 00:51:14,750
These guys are gonna talk shit
about you for a while.

813
00:51:14,910 --> 00:51:16,249
But fuck 'em, Carv.

814
00:51:16,643 --> 00:51:18,078
You do what needs done.

815
00:52:02,104 --> 00:52:04,905
- I was out all morning.
- You worked 8:00 to 4:00.

816
00:52:05,878 --> 00:52:08,651
I'm working a serial killer.
They call me on any suspicious death.

817
00:52:08,914 --> 00:52:10,754
Yeah? Where'd they reach you?

818
00:52:12,978 --> 00:52:14,414
Well, I'm not gonna lie.

819
00:52:14,689 --> 00:52:16,579
I stopped, had a couple,
then I got the call.

820
00:52:16,739 --> 00:52:19,235
I know. I can smell
the Jameson's from here.

821
00:52:20,145 --> 00:52:22,290
- Jamie and Listerine-- Your scent.
- Beadie...

822
00:52:23,667 --> 00:52:25,445
- I'm just--
- We had something, Jimmy.

823
00:52:25,639 --> 00:52:28,072
You and me,
we had something.

824
00:52:30,149 --> 00:52:31,925
You know, when people told me

825
00:52:32,085 --> 00:52:35,614
stories about you, about how you were,
I couldn't believe it.

826
00:52:36,413 --> 00:52:37,736
I couldn't see it.

827
00:52:57,512 --> 00:52:58,857
Yeah. 10 minutes.

828
00:53:00,106 --> 00:53:02,277
I got another one.
South Baltimore.

829
00:53:07,168 --> 00:53:10,524
- Beadie, I'm chasing a serial killer.
- Yeah. That's not all you're chasing.

830
00:53:13,213 --> 00:53:15,487
Look. If you don't want to be here...

831
00:53:17,214 --> 00:53:18,581
I got to go.

832
00:53:23,380 --> 00:53:24,569
He changed up.

833
00:53:25,814 --> 00:53:29,125
Marlo's no fool.
He know you be coming at him.

834
00:53:29,362 --> 00:53:31,421
Word is, him and Chris
went to the mattresses,

835
00:53:31,581 --> 00:53:33,380
on the move almost every night.

836
00:53:33,540 --> 00:53:35,054
Fool enough to kick a sleeping dog.

837
00:53:35,214 --> 00:53:38,120
- That should tell you something, no?
- While I got the boy waiting on me,

838
00:53:38,280 --> 00:53:39,953
I ain't go at him straight up.

839
00:53:40,290 --> 00:53:42,064
I go after his people, you feel me?

840
00:53:42,224 --> 00:53:45,604
You hurt enough of them, that snake
gonna stick his head above that hole.

841
00:53:46,748 --> 00:53:47,897
That one there?

842
00:53:48,921 --> 00:53:51,588
He's a lieutenant.
We gonna go after him first.

843
00:53:53,231 --> 00:53:54,609
Mark that ride, yo.

844
00:53:56,048 --> 00:53:56,949
Oscar.

845
00:53:58,315 --> 00:53:59,248
Lester.

846
00:53:59,415 --> 00:54:01,402
- Thank you, baby.
- Yeah. Anytime, man.

847
00:54:09,515 --> 00:54:10,458
He's perfect.

848
00:54:10,618 --> 00:54:12,553
Can't be dead
more than a couple of hours.

849
00:54:12,912 --> 00:54:14,194
Better lose these.

850
00:54:22,883 --> 00:54:25,022
You're a twisted fuck, McNulty.

851
00:54:25,282 --> 00:54:27,089
Defense wounds.
Help sell it.

852
00:54:28,179 --> 00:54:30,061
You got a lot of nerve
calling me twisted.

853
00:54:30,221 --> 00:54:32,556
You're the fella
that came up with the teeth.

854
00:54:32,716 --> 00:54:35,197
You know how these psycho
serial motherfuckers are.

855
00:54:35,357 --> 00:54:36,635
They mature.

856
00:54:37,455 --> 00:54:39,487
They start simple and crude

857
00:54:40,049 --> 00:54:42,657
And become more and more ornate.

858
00:54:42,817 --> 00:54:43,743
There you are.

859
00:54:43,903 --> 00:54:46,119
Don't ever tell my mother
or my priest you saw me do this.

860
00:54:46,279 --> 00:54:47,621
Take it to my grave.

861
00:54:59,450 --> 00:55:01,759
- Want me to take that?
- Nah, I got it.

862
00:55:04,273 --> 00:55:05,990
What you see in this hole, man?

863
00:55:06,150 --> 00:55:07,688
All the money you got?

864
00:55:09,817 --> 00:55:11,102
Your great-grandfather,

865
00:55:12,013 --> 00:55:15,315
First colored man to own
his own house in Johnson Square.

866
00:55:16,184 --> 00:55:17,672
That means something,

867
00:55:18,559 --> 00:55:20,195
Something you young'uns lost.

868
00:55:21,518 --> 00:55:23,657
Well, we outside when you ready.

869
00:55:23,997 --> 00:55:25,857
Hey, keep sharp while I'm gone, boy.

870
00:55:26,017 --> 00:55:27,425
Charles say Omar back,

871
00:55:27,585 --> 00:55:29,177
and while he left Charles standing,

872
00:55:29,337 --> 00:55:32,499
the man might feel less inclined
if he get the drop on you or yours.

873
00:55:33,215 --> 00:55:35,318
Ain't got to fret none about Omar.

874
00:55:42,559 --> 00:55:43,885
No need for that.

875
00:55:54,904 --> 00:55:56,689
You ain't come to see me off.

876
00:56:01,385 --> 00:56:02,445
My nephew.

877
00:56:07,052 --> 00:56:08,958
Boy was always a disappointment.

878
00:56:11,607 --> 00:56:13,039
But I treated you like a son.

879
00:56:13,886 --> 00:56:15,627
I wasn't made to play the son.

880
00:56:15,787 --> 00:56:17,647
But my supply--
The good dope?

881
00:56:17,807 --> 00:56:19,971
The Greeks, they cool with it.

882
00:56:25,520 --> 00:56:26,838
Proposition, then:

883
00:56:28,787 --> 00:56:30,447
I just step out the way.

884
00:56:31,865 --> 00:56:34,660
You never hear from me again.
I just disappear.

885
00:56:35,722 --> 00:56:37,731
You'd be up into mischief in no time.

886
00:56:38,773 --> 00:56:41,526
Truth is, you wouldn't be able
to change up any more than me.

887
00:56:44,787 --> 00:56:46,114
Close your eyes.

888
00:56:49,087 --> 00:56:50,438
It won't hurt none.

889
00:56:53,034 --> 00:56:54,433
There. There, now.

890
00:56:56,788 --> 00:56:58,270
Joe, relax.

891
00:57:00,882 --> 00:57:02,138
Breathe easy.

9

we're also running

Nothing yet.

on a profile?

15

this is a strange one.

18

adolescent sadism.

20

This sexual thing--

21

It is different.

22

We put it out on vicap,

23
00:00:54,234 --> 00:00:56,000
and we have no hits anywhere
else in the country.

24
00:00:56,100 --> 00:00:58,167

kinky shit now and then,

25
00:00:58,267 --> 00:01:02,367
but chewing
on a homeless fella?

26

27

What else do you need?

00:13:16,400 --> 00:13:20,667
- Then you're
a fucking liar.

281
00:13:29,567 --> 00:13:32,901
- Omar.
It's omar, yo.

282
00:14:16,167 --> 00:14:17,634
- Gotta giddy
up an' go, dawg.

283
00:14:17,701 --> 00:14:20,167
get!

284
00:14:39,133 --> 00:14:42,367
One...

285
00:14:42,534 --> 00:14:46,067
Two...

286
00:14:46,167 --> 00:14:49,367
Three...

287
00:14:49,467 --> 00:14:51,367
Four.

288
00:14:52,834 --> 00:14:54,200
Ya see there?

289
00:14:54,367 --> 00:14:57,734
Omar know which one it is.

290
00:14:57,834 --> 00:15:02,000
Look like all your muscle
done up and indisposed now.

291
00:15:02,100 --> 00:15:07,200
So you might as well go ahead
and drop it out, ya feel me?

292
00:15:11,100 --> 00:15:18,083
I'm a blast
to walk up in there now--

293
00:15:18,118 --> 00:15:25,067
I'm a blast
to walk up in there now--

294
00:15:25,200 --> 00:15:27,133
You workin'
a stanfield corner,

295
00:15:27,234 --> 00:15:30,033
which means you workin'
for a straight up punk.

296
00:15:30,133 --> 00:15:33,400
Ya feel me?

297
00:15:33,501 --> 00:15:35,567
I'm out here in these streets
every day.

298
00:15:35,667 --> 00:15:37,200
Me an' my lonesome.

299
00:15:37,300 --> 00:15:41,400
An' where he at?
huh?

300
00:16:02,601 --> 00:16:05,133
Yo, y'all put it
in his ear.

301
00:16:05,300 --> 00:16:07,701
Marlo stanfield
is not a man for this town.

302
00:16:07,834 --> 00:16:09,133
Ya dig?

303
00:16:09,300 --> 00:16:11,868
Mmm-hmm--

304
00:16:11,968 --> 00:16:14,334
Yeah--

305
00:16:16,601 --> 00:16:17,701
Yeah, eight men,
four cars.

306
00:16:17,834 --> 00:16:20,767
Ellis briefed 'em.
They know what's what.

307
00:16:22,901 --> 00:16:23,801
No, they're just happy
for the o.t.

308
00:16:23,901 --> 00:16:27,067
Look, don't worry, lester.

309
00:16:29,434 --> 00:16:33,367
- Just sign the motherfucker
and shut the fuck up.

310
00:16:41,801 --> 00:16:43,534
Gimme.

311
00:16:45,634 --> 00:16:46,601
We ready?

312
00:16:46,701 --> 00:16:47,868
'cause you gotta figure
an extra hour

313
00:16:47,968 --> 00:16:51,868
to get 'round the capital
beltway this time of day.

314
00:16:53,334 --> 00:16:55,067
You ever done
an f.b.i. Profile before?

315
00:16:55,167 --> 00:16:56,067
Once.

316
00:16:56,167 --> 00:16:57,934
How'd it go?

317
00:16:58,100 --> 00:16:59,100
Oh, they take your file,

318
00:16:59,200 --> 00:17:01,701
read you back some shit
you already know.

319
00:17:01,834 --> 00:17:02,801
Then why do it?

320
00:17:02,901 --> 00:17:06,467
So that we can saywe did.

321
00:17:12,901 --> 00:17:19,851
- Need a pack of newport.
Soft pack.

322
00:17:19,886 --> 00:17:26,801
- Need a pack of newport.
Soft pack.

323
00:17:26,968 --> 00:17:27,834
And let me get one
of them, too--

324
00:17:29,100 --> 00:17:36,133
Ahhhh!

325
00:17:36,200 --> 00:17:37,634
Don't shoot!

326
00:18:01,434 --> 00:18:03,133
- Lowenthal.
Where the fuck is he?

327
00:18:03,234 --> 00:18:06,400
Um, he's, uh--

328
00:18:06,501 --> 00:18:08,868
There you go, bunk.

329
00:18:08,968 --> 00:18:13,334
- Hey. Request for
a d.n.a. Comparison.

330
00:18:13,434 --> 00:18:15,701
case
Oh-six-h-two-seventy-one.

331
00:18:15,767 --> 00:18:17,133
Latent trace
to obtained samples.

332
00:18:17,234 --> 00:18:20,300
And it's a part of
the serial killer thing.

333
00:18:20,400 --> 00:18:22,033
It's now a part
of that investigation.

334
00:18:22,133 --> 00:18:23,133
Well, that's different.

335
00:18:23,234 --> 00:18:24,434
If it's connected
to that investigation--

336
00:18:24,567 --> 00:18:27,234
- It is.
It is, here.

337
00:18:27,334 --> 00:18:28,300
It's in my notes.

338
00:18:28,400 --> 00:18:30,200
- I never said
I was in a fire fight.

339
00:18:30,300 --> 00:18:31,300
Not on that day.

340
00:18:31,400 --> 00:18:32,901
- I'm sorry,
but you did.

341
00:18:32,968 --> 00:18:35,634
- I told you the lead vehicle
took a hit from an elevated i.e.d.

342
00:18:35,734 --> 00:18:36,801
Killed the fifty gunner,

343
00:18:36,901 --> 00:18:38,968
and blew the hands
off the driver.

344
00:18:39,067 --> 00:18:41,901
That's it.
That's enough, man.

345
00:18:42,000 --> 00:18:43,434
Why you go and make
the rest of that shit up?

346
00:18:43,534 --> 00:18:44,534
- I didn't make
anything up.

347
00:18:44,634 --> 00:18:46,000
We sat there
having coffee--

348
00:18:46,067 --> 00:18:47,000
Coffee--

349
00:18:47,067 --> 00:18:48,000
- Having donuts
and coffee.

350
00:18:48,133 --> 00:18:49,367
- And you said--
- What I say?

351
00:18:49,501 --> 00:18:51,000
- Can I finish?
- I don't know.

352
00:18:51,067 --> 00:18:53,234
I'm hearing about coffee
and donuts, I'm not hearing--

353
00:18:53,334 --> 00:18:56,334
- Can I finish? If you're not going
to let me tell my side of the story--

354
00:18:56,501 --> 00:18:57,868
- A lie ain't a side
of the story,

355
00:18:57,968 --> 00:18:58,901
it's just a lie.

356
00:18:59,000 --> 00:19:00,267
- I don't have to
listen to this--

357
00:19:00,334 --> 00:19:02,434
- Okay--hey, scott,
let's just relax here.

358
00:19:02,534 --> 00:19:05,968
Both you gentlemen, let's just
step back here, please?

359
00:19:06,133 --> 00:19:08,267
Now, Mr. Hanning,
forgive me,

360
00:19:08,367 --> 00:19:09,567
but do you drink much?

361
00:19:09,634 --> 00:19:12,634
- You think I fucking sleep
under a bridge sober?

362
00:19:12,734 --> 00:19:17,534
- Sometimes when I have a few--
And I do like to have a few--

363
00:19:17,634 --> 00:19:19,934
I tend to be a little more
descriptive in the telling of a tale.

364
00:19:20,000 --> 00:19:20,934
In fact--

365
00:19:21,100 --> 00:19:22,334
- I know what it
is to tell a story.

366
00:19:22,434 --> 00:19:25,334
I've told plenty
in my time.

367
00:19:27,100 --> 00:19:29,267
But there's some things
that happen,

368
00:19:29,367 --> 00:19:32,367
you don't ever
fuck with them.

369
00:19:34,367 --> 00:19:36,968
Scott?

370
00:19:41,934 --> 00:19:43,133
- I believe you,
mr. Hanning.

371
00:19:43,234 --> 00:19:45,667
I believe
that you believe.

372
00:19:45,767 --> 00:19:49,200
That you believe
you told me one thing.

373
00:19:49,300 --> 00:19:51,834
But, sir, with all
due respect and gratitude

374
00:19:51,934 --> 00:19:53,667
for you and the service
you gave to this country,

375
00:19:53,767 --> 00:19:55,501
you didn't tell me
that thing.

376
00:19:55,567 --> 00:19:57,200
You told me
something else.

377
00:19:57,300 --> 00:19:59,934
I wrote what
mr. Hanning told me.

378
00:20:00,033 --> 00:20:01,133
Mr. Hanning--

379
00:20:01,200 --> 00:20:02,200
- I know you probably--
- What if one of the guys,

380
00:20:02,300 --> 00:20:04,033
what if a marine
who was there--

381
00:20:04,200 --> 00:20:06,567
He reads that shit
that you made up?

382
00:20:06,667 --> 00:20:08,200
That's why
I come down here today.

383
00:20:08,300 --> 00:20:11,767
What if one of the guys
sees that?

384
00:20:11,934 --> 00:20:14,934
Man, get him
outta my face.

385
00:20:26,968 --> 00:20:29,501
- Guy's just off.
Off in general.

386
00:20:29,601 --> 00:20:32,133
Off his meds.
I dunno, but off.

387
00:20:32,234 --> 00:20:33,601
A lot of them are,
you know.

388
00:20:33,701 --> 00:20:36,334
- I mean, I hate to say it--
- Yeah, he puts on a good front.

389
00:20:36,501 --> 00:20:38,667
We'll call the marines,
get a service record,

390
00:20:38,767 --> 00:20:40,701
reach out to some people
in his unit,

391
00:20:40,767 --> 00:20:42,667
find out what the fuck happened
that day outside of--

392
00:20:42,767 --> 00:20:44,033
What was it?
Fallujah?

393
00:20:44,133 --> 00:20:45,934
Yeah.

394
00:20:46,033 --> 00:20:47,133
- Alright, if it went down
the way you said,

395
00:20:47,234 --> 00:20:48,734
we'll let it be.

396
00:20:48,868 --> 00:20:52,767
But if not, we'll chalk it up
as a misunderstanding.

397
00:20:52,868 --> 00:20:54,267
But misunderstanding or no,

398
00:20:54,334 --> 00:20:58,901
we will write a correction if
what we printed wasn't accurate.

399
00:21:03,901 --> 00:21:06,901
- And we didn't
have coffee.

400
00:21:07,000 --> 00:21:10,067
We had chocolate milk.

401
00:21:14,701 --> 00:21:18,133
- You Miss what you had,
though?

402
00:21:18,234 --> 00:21:22,634
- I still got too much dog in me
to be settled like that.

403
00:21:24,100 --> 00:21:28,801
It wasn't cheryl.
It was me.

404
00:21:28,901 --> 00:21:31,701
Thing is, is I found a connect
with the boy, you know?

405
00:21:31,834 --> 00:21:33,734
That part of it
feels right to me.

406
00:21:33,834 --> 00:21:36,534
Kids are great.

407
00:21:36,634 --> 00:21:39,267
Yeah.

408
00:21:39,367 --> 00:21:41,267
What about you an' beadie?

409
00:21:41,367 --> 00:21:45,267
You were quiet there
for a time.

410
00:21:45,367 --> 00:21:46,367
Yeah.

411
00:21:46,467 --> 00:21:48,367
Bunk once told me
i'm no good for people.

412
00:21:48,467 --> 00:21:50,901
Everyone around me,
he said.

413
00:21:51,000 --> 00:21:52,267
Was he drunk?

414
00:21:52,434 --> 00:21:54,367
- Yeah.
But still.

415
00:21:56,200 --> 00:21:57,868
- Omar be dead.
I'm tellin' you.

416
00:21:58,000 --> 00:21:58,934
Heard that before.

417
00:21:59,033 --> 00:21:59,934
F'real.

418
00:22:00,033 --> 00:22:01,100
You see him?

419
00:22:01,267 --> 00:22:02,667
- Seen his dead ass
layin' right up in there.

420
00:22:02,767 --> 00:22:04,834
Boy up on the corner say
he try to rob them koreans

421
00:22:05,000 --> 00:22:07,567
and got kilt.

422
00:22:19,467 --> 00:22:21,000
- You shoulda let me give him
the years, bunk.

423
00:22:21,100 --> 00:22:24,133
He'da been better off.

424
00:22:24,300 --> 00:22:25,734
Thanks for calling.

425
00:22:25,834 --> 00:22:26,834
- Figured
you'd wanna see this,

426
00:22:26,934 --> 00:22:30,133
you being so tight
with the mope.

427
00:22:34,567 --> 00:22:35,767
Professional job here.

428
00:22:35,868 --> 00:22:37,200
- Nah.
Thought so at first,

429
00:22:37,300 --> 00:22:39,334
but the korean broad
we sent downtown

430
00:22:39,434 --> 00:22:42,767
said he got done in by a short
little fella with a big gun.

431
00:22:42,868 --> 00:22:45,400
Shit, walked in
an' lit his ass up.

432
00:22:45,501 --> 00:22:47,467
How short?

433
00:22:52,501 --> 00:22:54,200
The boy robbed him?

434
00:22:54,300 --> 00:22:55,868
- Counterlady said the hoppers
all ran up in here

435
00:22:55,968 --> 00:22:57,501
afterward for souvenirs.

436
00:22:57,601 --> 00:22:59,601
Took his shotty
and his semiauto too.

437
00:22:59,667 --> 00:23:03,067
Ran all through
his pockets.

438
00:23:04,901 --> 00:23:07,434
Be my guest.

439
00:23:19,801 --> 00:23:22,067
- Back on the hunt,
were you?

440
00:23:22,167 --> 00:23:24,400
- Youngun say
he out here with no car,

441
00:23:24,501 --> 00:23:27,167
walkin'
with a limp an' shit.

442
00:23:27,267 --> 00:23:28,501
He gonna fall,
chris.

443
00:23:28,601 --> 00:23:31,267
You gonna see.

444
00:23:35,067 --> 00:23:36,567
Marlo need a meet.

445
00:23:36,734 --> 00:23:39,267
For real?

446
00:23:43,834 --> 00:23:45,734
- Leander,
where we at?

447
00:23:45,901 --> 00:23:47,000
Still setting this up.

448
00:23:47,167 --> 00:23:48,901
Why, did you catch
another one?

449
00:23:49,000 --> 00:23:52,701
- Six-fifty-five
and thirty-four.

450
00:23:52,801 --> 00:23:54,100
- Well,
we're not on anybody yet,

451
00:23:54,200 --> 00:23:55,167
so we'll pick it up
in the morning.

452
00:23:55,267 --> 00:23:57,834
- Alright.
Later.

453
00:23:57,968 --> 00:23:59,067
Okay.

454
00:23:59,167 --> 00:24:01,267
Doze, truck,
you're on monk metcalf.

455
00:24:01,367 --> 00:24:03,267
Bobby, you and brian
are on chris partlow.

456
00:24:03,367 --> 00:24:05,167
He usually rides
with snoop pearson,

457
00:24:05,267 --> 00:24:06,467
but if they split,

458
00:24:06,534 --> 00:24:07,968
karen and tony
will pick up on her.

459
00:24:08,100 --> 00:24:09,133
Marcus, angela--

460
00:24:09,267 --> 00:24:11,000
You're the backup unit
when we need one.

461
00:24:11,100 --> 00:24:12,667
- You're gonna be stanfield?
- Yeah.

462
00:24:12,767 --> 00:24:14,133
All their business
is face-to-face,

463
00:24:14,200 --> 00:24:16,400
and they meet in the open
several times a day.

464
00:24:16,501 --> 00:24:19,200
We're just trying to find
the pattern in the meets.

465
00:24:19,300 --> 00:24:20,567
- Where do we pick
these guys up?

466
00:24:20,667 --> 00:24:24,033
- Stanfield has every corner
between m.l.k. And monroe,

467
00:24:24,133 --> 00:24:27,267
and they start shaping it up
around eleven or so, okay?

468
00:24:27,367 --> 00:24:29,133
That's when the re-up orders
start coming in,

469
00:24:29,267 --> 00:24:32,467
that's when you'll start to see
monk making the rounds.

470
00:24:32,567 --> 00:24:35,267
Most mornings, marlo starts off
with a parley or two

471
00:24:35,367 --> 00:24:38,634
on the playground
between mosher and lanvale.

472
00:24:38,734 --> 00:24:40,567
Now, these guys
seem to be wholesaling, too.

473
00:24:40,667 --> 00:24:42,133
Other dealers,
players--

474
00:24:42,234 --> 00:24:45,334
Anyone who wants to get
with him gets him there, okay?

475
00:24:45,434 --> 00:24:47,934
Chris and snoop
are usually with him.

476
00:24:48,067 --> 00:24:50,834
And mcnulty's got you
covered for paperwork.

477
00:24:50,934 --> 00:24:53,467
None of what we do here
is necessary for court,

478
00:24:53,567 --> 00:24:56,334
so rest easy on that, alright?

479
00:24:56,501 --> 00:25:00,300
So we stage here
tomorrow at nine.

480
00:25:03,701 --> 00:25:04,968
No sign of him,

481
00:25:05,033 --> 00:25:08,100
but I ain't on nothin' else
for as long as it take.

482
00:25:08,234 --> 00:25:11,200
- You ain't heard?
Omar bagged up.

483
00:25:11,300 --> 00:25:13,601
Shit, I thought y'all
was gonna tell me.

484
00:25:13,734 --> 00:25:15,868
I just got the word myself
from monk.

485
00:25:15,968 --> 00:25:18,067
- Who got him?
- Some young boy.

486
00:25:18,167 --> 00:25:19,801
- Who?
- Ain't heard a name.

487
00:25:19,901 --> 00:25:21,767
Don't even know
if there was a why.

488
00:25:21,901 --> 00:25:25,133
Hopper wanna hear a pop,
see the damage, ya know?

489
00:25:25,234 --> 00:25:27,267
Yeah--
That shit is gone.

490
00:25:27,334 --> 00:25:28,701
We done
with this next resupply,

491
00:25:28,801 --> 00:25:34,167
you an' me got some time
in a.c. Coming to us, don't we?

492
00:25:34,267 --> 00:25:37,334
- Forensically, this guy
is all over the map.

493
00:25:37,501 --> 00:25:39,968
Sexual to a point,
but inhibited.

494
00:25:40,067 --> 00:25:42,901
Nocturnal on some,
diurnal on the others.

495
00:25:43,067 --> 00:25:45,133
And the notion of targeting
the homeless, to begin with?

496
00:25:45,234 --> 00:25:46,801
Well, we've only seen that
a couple times before,

497
00:25:46,901 --> 00:25:50,734
but in those instances, it's
been someone within that cohort.

498
00:25:50,834 --> 00:25:52,634
And they're not usually
carrying cell phones

499
00:25:52,734 --> 00:25:54,100
and calling newspapers.

500
00:25:54,200 --> 00:25:56,200
- You caught
a strange one here.

501
00:25:56,267 --> 00:25:58,267
- Detectives,
hey, don't get up.

502
00:25:58,367 --> 00:26:01,267
Arthur toland,
deputy director of the unit.

503
00:26:01,367 --> 00:26:02,467
Just wanted to drop by

504
00:26:02,534 --> 00:26:04,834
and make sure
we're progressing your case.

505
00:26:04,968 --> 00:26:06,000
Yeah, yeah.

506
00:26:06,100 --> 00:26:07,267
Great. Thanks.

507
00:26:07,367 --> 00:26:09,634
- You might recognize
the director from television.

508
00:26:09,734 --> 00:26:10,701
He's done all of them.

509
00:26:10,801 --> 00:26:12,267
- You know
those news shows.

510
00:26:12,367 --> 00:26:15,100
Always want a talking head
when a case comes up.

511
00:26:15,200 --> 00:26:19,167
Greta van susteren,
nancy grace, chris matthews,

512
00:26:19,267 --> 00:26:21,167
that fella with the big
forehead, whatshisname--

513
00:26:21,267 --> 00:26:22,667
Larry king?

514
00:26:22,767 --> 00:26:23,767
Yeah, yeah, yeah.

515
00:26:23,834 --> 00:26:25,033
Hey, what the hell.

516
00:26:25,200 --> 00:26:26,567
It's a chance to get the word
out for the bureau.

517
00:26:26,667 --> 00:26:30,834
And I sell some books.

518
00:26:30,901 --> 00:26:37,000
"human hunters: the rise
of the american serial killer"?

519
00:26:37,100 --> 00:26:39,300
They've used a lot of my stuff
on those c.s.i. Shows.

520
00:26:39,400 --> 00:26:43,667
I've consulted for them.

521
00:26:43,734 --> 00:26:46,167
You haven't heard--

522
00:26:46,267 --> 00:26:48,167
So, how long you been doing
death investigations?

523
00:26:48,267 --> 00:26:50,734
Eight years.

524
00:26:50,834 --> 00:26:53,200
We don't see a lot of
serial stuff actually.

525
00:26:53,300 --> 00:26:54,400
Drug murders.

526
00:26:54,534 --> 00:26:56,400
A street robbery
every now and then.

527
00:26:56,501 --> 00:26:58,033
- Three hundred or so
a year.

528
00:26:58,133 --> 00:27:00,701
- Well, you've got
a serial case now,

529

00:50:38,434 --> 00:50:40,301

1025
00:50:40,401 --> 00:50:41,967
Anna said your hair
looked funny.

1026
00:50:42,067 --> 00:50:44,234
- Well, just so long as
she was impressed.

1027
00:50:44,334 --> 00:50:45,767
Cnn was there.

1028
00:50:45,867 --> 00:50:48,401
I wonder if they'll cycle
any coverage through tonight.

1029
00:50:48,500 --> 00:50:50,201
- A good day
for hizzoner, huh?

1030
00:50:50,301 --> 00:50:51,468
I dunno.

1031
00:50:51,567 --> 00:50:53,034
Nerese shook me down
for a mayoral endorsement,

1032
00:50:53,134 --> 00:50:55,301
and clay davis,
back from the grave,

1033
00:50:55,401 --> 00:50:57,234
took a couple
liquor board seats.

1034
00:50:57,334 --> 00:50:59,767
Just so as they won't join
in upshaw's little warparty

1035
00:50:59,867 --> 00:51:01,834
down in prince george's.

1036
00:51:01,934 --> 00:51:03,034
- You're gonna endorse
nerese?

1037
00:51:03,134 --> 00:51:04,767
You told me
you prefer bond.

1038
00:51:04,867 --> 00:51:07,900
- I do,
but this thing with upshaw--

1039
00:51:08,001 --> 00:51:09,767
Shit, I might even
have to give him a bump

1040
00:51:09,867 --> 00:51:11,167

1041
00:51:11,267 --> 00:51:12,800
- God.
What's he asking?

1042
00:51:12,900 --> 00:51:14,700
There--look.

1043
00:51:14,800 --> 00:51:16,600
What's upshaw asking?

1044
00:51:16,700 --> 00:51:19,867
- Half of any extra school
or anti-crime money

1045
00:51:19,967 --> 00:51:21,434
I get outta the legislature
for baltimore

1046
00:51:21,533 --> 00:51:22,967
would go to p.g. County.

1047
00:51:23,134 --> 00:51:24,900
- You take that deal
and baltimore's out

1048
00:51:25,034 --> 00:51:27,267
half of what you want to bring
back to the city schools.

1049
00:51:27,401 --> 00:51:31,533
- Yeah, but if I don't win, jen,
I bring back exactly nothing.

1050
00:51:31,667 --> 00:51:33,434
Look.

1051
00:51:33,533 --> 00:51:35,533
- And we are saying
to this senseless killer,

1052
00:51:35,600 --> 00:51:38,767
and to all the other ills--

1053
00:51:48,001 --> 00:51:49,567
- Go on.
Straight to bed.

1054
00:51:49,700 --> 00:51:50,567
Hey, kiddo.

1055
00:51:50,734 --> 00:51:54,267
Hey, mcnulty.

1056
00:51:54,368 --> 00:51:56,834
Where'd you go to?

1057
00:51:56,900 --> 00:51:58,900
- None of your business
really, jimmy.

1058
00:51:59,001 --> 00:52:00,633
Next time,
i'm not going anywhere.

1059
00:52:00,800 --> 00:52:02,101
Next time, you're gonna
be out on your ass,

1060
00:52:02,201 --> 00:52:05,900
because that's
my fucking house.

1061
00:52:11,834 --> 00:52:13,734
That's police work, son.

1062
00:52:13,800 --> 00:52:15,834
- I pull the a.d.c. Book
to find a location,

1063
00:52:15,934 --> 00:52:19,201
and I'm on the same page number
as the second hand.

1064
00:52:19,301 --> 00:52:20,567
And I remember
wead a lotta clocks

1065
00:52:20,667 --> 00:52:21,900
with thirty-four seconds.

1066
00:52:22,001 --> 00:52:23,567
- That's a page
from west baltimore.

1067
00:52:23,667 --> 00:52:24,834
Right.

1068
00:52:24,934 --> 00:52:27,368
Now, the second hand
is always the map page.

1069
00:52:27,468 --> 00:52:30,401
Longitude, a-through-k,
is the hour,

1070
00:52:30,533 --> 00:52:34,301
and for the latitude, they go
by five-minute intervals.

1071
00:52:34,401 --> 00:52:36,301
Now they know
the meeting spot in advance,

1072
00:52:36,401 --> 00:52:38,934
and they code it
by the grid square.

1073
00:52:39,034 --> 00:52:41,767
But if the clock
has nothing to do with time,

1074
00:52:41,900 --> 00:52:45,167
how do they know
when to meet?

1075
00:52:49,201 --> 00:52:52,134
- Everything's less than
a half hour of driving,

1076
00:52:52,234 --> 00:52:56,533
even in traffic.

1077
00:52:56,667 --> 00:52:58,600
My guess is
that the standing logic

1078
00:52:58,700 --> 00:53:02,834
is that they meet
within an hour or so.

1079
00:53:07,401 --> 00:53:10,667
You know what else
makes sense?

1080
00:53:10,767 --> 00:53:16,134
This clock face when no one
was on the move?

1081
00:53:16,234 --> 00:53:19,034
The times are all

1082
00:53:19,134 --> 00:53:22,900
And that's the page
for east bawlmer.

1083
00:53:23,001 --> 00:53:24,533
Cheese.

1084
00:53:24,633 --> 00:53:26,401
Cheese wagstaff?

1085
00:53:31,700 --> 00:53:34,067
- Marlo's wholesaling
on the westside through monk,

1086
00:53:34,167 --> 00:53:35,067
and on the eastside
with cheese.

1087
00:53:35,167 --> 00:53:36,900
He's got the whole
goddamn city.

1088
00:53:37,034 --> 00:53:40,334
- How do we know
it's cheese?

1089
00:53:40,434 --> 00:53:42,267
oh--

1090
00:53:47,167 --> 00:53:50,600
You, too, huh?

1091
00:53:50,700 --> 00:53:52,334
You all
are good with this?

1092
00:53:52,500 --> 00:53:53,900
Kima--

1093
00:53:54,034 --> 00:53:55,633
Not me.

1094
00:54:00,434 --> 00:54:02,001
All the guysat the bar, jimmy?

1095
00:54:02,101 --> 00:54:03,734
All the girls?

1096
00:54:03,834 --> 00:54:06,434
They don't show up
at your wake.

1097
00:54:06,533 --> 00:54:08,267
Not because
they don't like you

1098
00:54:08,368 --> 00:54:11,734
but because they never
knew your last name.

1099
00:54:11,834 --> 00:54:14,267
A month later, someone tells 'em
"oh, jimmy died."

1100
00:54:14,368 --> 00:54:15,700
"jimmy who?"

1101
00:54:15,800 --> 00:54:16,834
"jimmy the cop."

1102
00:54:16,967 --> 00:54:21,101
"ohh," they say.
"him."

1103
00:54:21,267 --> 00:54:23,368
And all the people
on the job,

1104
00:54:23,468 --> 00:54:26,368
all the people you spent all
those hours in the radio car with,

1105
00:54:26,468 --> 00:54:29,267
the guys with their feet up
on their desk telling stories,

1106
00:54:29,368 --> 00:54:31,034
who shorted you
on the food runs,

1107
00:54:31,134 --> 00:54:33,633
who signed your
overtime slips.

1108
00:54:33,734 --> 00:54:37,667
In the end, they're not
gonna be there either.

1109
00:54:37,767 --> 00:54:39,134
Family.
That's it.

1110
00:54:39,267 --> 00:54:40,201
Family.

1111
00:54:40,301 --> 00:54:41,900
And if you're lucky,

1112
00:54:42,001 --> 00:54:45,468
one or two friends
who are the same as family.

1113
00:54:45,567 --> 00:54:47,567
That's all
the best of us get.

1114
00:54:47,667 --> 00:54:50,667
Everything else is just--

1115
00:54:58,267 --> 00:55:02,567
- There is no
serial killer.

1116
00:55:02,667 --> 00:55:06,334
There are no murders.
I made it all up.

1117
00:55:11,234 --> 00:55:12,334
They were--they were
shutting us down.

1118
00:55:12,468 --> 00:55:14,500
They were--
They were just--

1119
00:55:14,600 --> 00:55:15,700
It's hard to explain.

1120
00:55:15,834 --> 00:55:17,667
I don't even know
where the anger comes from.

1121
00:55:17,767 --> 00:55:20,401
I don't know
how to make it stop.

1122
00:55:20,567 --> 00:55:27,834
They fucking task me,
they do.

1123
00:55:27,967 --> 00:55:30,201
We took the money from
the bullshit investigation,

1124
00:55:30,301 --> 00:55:32,034
and we routed it
to lester.

1125
00:55:32,134 --> 00:55:36,800
Now he's got the cake
to take down marlo stanfield.

1126
00:55:36,900 --> 00:55:39,267
And now
that I've done all this--

1127
00:55:39,334 --> 00:55:40,267
Now that I've
watched myself do it,

1128
00:55:40,334 --> 00:55:46,334
I can't even stand to--

1129
00:55:46,434 --> 00:55:48,533
Lester says he's close.

1130
00:55:48,600 --> 00:55:49,600
Time will pass,

1131
00:55:49,700 --> 00:55:53,967
and I'll be able
to shut this thing down.

1132
00:55:54,067 --> 00:55:57,334
If you don't go to jail.

1133
00:56:01,600 --> 00:56:03,967
You had no fucking right.

1134
00:56:04,067 --> 00:56:10,167
- I know.
- This is my life, too.

1135
00:56:10,267 --> 00:56:12,101
You start to tell the story;
you think you're the hero.

1136
00:56:12,201 --> 00:56:26,067
And then, when you get done
talking, you--

1137
00:57:22,868 --> 00:57:44,068
from thewire-france.com
for wikisubtitles.net

00:09:10,801 --> 00:09:12,367

you don't know him.

134

No opinions,

135
00:09:15,300 --> 00:09:17,167
No, no,
i'm not saying anything.

136
00:09:17,334 --> 00:09:19,534
I'm not. I just need
fresh eyes on the fella.

137
00:09:19,634 --> 00:09:21,634
Just a careful look.

138
00:09:23,400 --> 00:09:24,667

139
00:09:24,767 --> 00:09:26,167

140
00:09:27,567 --> 00:09:29,467
I hope you're wrong.

141
00:09:29,534 --> 00:09:30,601
'course you do.

142
00:09:35,033 --> 00:09:36,167
It sticks. Dag.

143
00:09:36,267 --> 00:09:37,934
- Course it sticks.
It's barb wire.

144
00:09:38,033 --> 00:09:41,067
Sticking's what
it's s'posed to do.

145
00:09:41,267 --> 00:09:42,167
Come on.

146
00:09:42,267 --> 00:09:43,501
I ain't got all day.

147
00:09:47,434 --> 00:09:48,367
Hurry up now.

148
00:09:48,467 --> 00:09:58,550
Grab the aluminum
strips there first off.

149
00:09:58,585 --> 00:10:08,634
Grab the aluminum
strips there first off.

150
00:10:08,734 --> 00:10:10,133

to get back over?

151

Climb the damn fence.

152

153
00:10:14,834 --> 00:10:16,100
Grab them steel pipes quick,

154
00:10:16,234 --> 00:10:17,501

155
00:10:30,701 --> 00:10:33,033
Robert Ruby.

156
00:10:33,133 --> 00:10:35,000

159

All of it, every edition.

160
00:10:42,000 --> 00:10:43,400
Hey, I'm a fan.

161
00:11:04,667 --> 00:11:06,434
Twenty-three-fourteen.

162
00:11:06,534 --> 00:11:07,868
Monk is westbound
onto O'Donnell.

163
00:11:08,000 --> 00:11:10,834
Cheese Wagstaff
is on the way in.

164
00:11:10,968 --> 00:11:12,067
Also, there's
a truck leaving.

165
00:11:12,167 --> 00:11:13,667
The one we saw
back on the loading dock.

166
00:11:13,767 --> 00:11:15,000
That'd be empty.

167
00:11:15,100 --> 00:11:17,300
They've offloaded,

168
00:11:17,400 --> 00:11:18,667
Bobby and me

169
00:11:18,767 --> 00:11:19,968

170
00:11:20,067 --> 00:11:21,968

171
00:11:27,534 --> 00:11:28,534
Forgetting for a moment

172
00:11:28,667 --> 00:11:30,567
our little problem

173
00:11:30,667 --> 00:11:32,200
we came in promising

174
00:11:32,300 --> 00:11:33,601

175
00:11:33,701 --> 00:11:35,334
Right up on the

00:11:35,434 --> 00:11:37,400

177

178

179

For a year now,

180

181

182
00:11:44,834 --> 00:11:46,701

thing is a ship,

183
00:11:46,801 --> 00:11:47,701
a super-tanker.

184
00:11:47,801 --> 00:11:48,701
We can't just
turn it around...

185
00:11:48,801 --> 00:11:49,934
Like that.

186
00:11:50,033 --> 00:11:51,434
More foot patrols.

187
00:11:51,534 --> 00:11:52,501
More cars on the street.

188
00:11:52,601 --> 00:11:54,234
Get a handle on it, dammit.

189
00:11:54,334 --> 00:11:55,267
See that's

190
00:11:55,367 --> 00:11:56,400
what doesn't work.

191
00:11:56,534 --> 00:11:58,501
More cops where
people can see them.

192
00:11:58,601 --> 00:11:59,634
More cops on the pavement,

193
00:11:59,734 --> 00:12:01,400

194

195

196
00:12:05,334 --> 00:12:06,968
Respectfully, sir,

197
00:12:07,100 --> 00:12:10,000

198
00:12:10,133 --> 00:12:11,767
We take the time to retool,

199
00:12:11,868 --> 00:12:13,667

not to chase stats,

200
00:12:13,801 --> 00:12:14,801
but to do actual
police work.

201
00:12:14,901 --> 00:12:16,934

202
00:12:17,033 --> 00:12:18,767
I was told by our mayor

203

would be no more band-aids,

204
00:12:21,367 --> 00:12:22,734

205
00:12:22,834 --> 00:12:24,400

with the school budget.

206
00:12:24,534 --> 00:12:26,400
And we lost some of the time
we needed to address

207
00:12:26,501 --> 00:12:28,434

208
00:12:28,534 --> 00:12:30,200
Understood. We will
work back on those,

209
00:12:30,300 --> 00:12:31,601
and we will

00:12:31,701 --> 00:12:34,267
support that kinof reform,

211
00:12:34,367 --> 00:12:35,934

212
00:12:36,033 --> 00:12:37,601
But now, deputy, right now,

213
00:12:37,734 --> 00:12:40,300
my boss needs the crime
to go down.

214
00:12:40,400 --> 00:12:42,934
Not three years from now.
Not even a year from now.

215
00:12:43,033 --> 00:12:47,200
He needs a ten-percent drop
in the next quarter...

216
00:12:47,300 --> 00:12:48,467
Or no one

217
00:12:48,567 --> 00:12:51,300
is gonna be in a position
to reform anything.

218
00:12:59,634 --> 00:13:01,367
Be creative, gentlemen.

219
00:13:10,667 --> 00:13:11,567
Deputy.

220
00:13:11,667 --> 00:13:12,901
A detective's outside
for you,

00:13:13,000 --> 00:13:14,267

00:13:21,133 --> 00:13:22,634
- Sydnor and I developed
a source

223
00:13:22,734 --> 00:13:25,667
and ran fresh surveillances
on Marlo Stanfield.

224
00:13:25,767 --> 00:13:27,133
And we believe we're
about to catch

225
00:13:27,267 --> 00:13:28,167
his people very dirty.

226
00:13:28,300 --> 00:13:29,167
What?

227
00:13:29,267 --> 00:13:30,334
- We wrapped on that
Clay Davis

228
00:13:30,434 --> 00:13:32,167
thing and instead of
shutting major crimes down,

229
00:13:32,300 --> 00:13:34,801
we took a couple weeks and

230
00:13:34,901 --> 00:13:37,200
With the right warrants,
he's about to fall.

231
00:13:37,300 --> 00:13:38,667
How the fuck...

232
00:13:38,767 --> 00:13:40,300
- There's no time, cedric.
In an hour or so,

233
00:13:40,400 --> 00:13:41,400
i'm gonna need...

234
00:13:45,300 --> 00:13:46,200
Yeah?

235
00:13:46,300 --> 00:13:48,000
- Lester...
- What's up?

236
00:13:48,100 --> 00:13:49,834
- We pulled up monk.
Dirty as a motherfucker.

237
00:13:49,934 --> 00:13:51,601
Eight keys of the raw.

238
00:13:51,734 --> 00:13:54,200
No, he jersey-rolled a stop and
when we tried to pull him over,

00:13:54,300 --> 00:13:55,801
he went rabbit on us.

240
00:13:55,934 --> 00:13:57,834
We ran him down on lafayette,

241
00:13:57,934 --> 00:13:58,901
You got the phone, right?

242
00:13:59,000 --> 00:14:00,901
Yeah, man. I got it.

243
00:14:01,000 --> 00:14:02,234
Good work.

244
00:14:03,868 --> 00:14:05,033
It's down.

I need teams to arrest

00:14:07,000 --> 00:14:08,767
Chris Partlow,

00:14:08,901 --> 00:14:10,767
I also need someone

00:14:10,868 --> 00:14:12,968
To get on the horn to Baltimore
county for an s-and-s

249
00:14:13,067 --> 00:14:15,033
warrant on a middle
river warehouse.

250
00:14:15,167 --> 00:14:16,267
And, oh yeah...

251
00:14:17,334 --> 00:14:19,000
Bunk meland

He held that back so we could

255
00:14:24,767 --> 00:14:26,934

256
00:14:27,033 --> 00:14:28,367
No sir.

257
00:14:28,467 --> 00:14:30,434
I think you're caught up.

258
00:14:34,801 --> 00:14:36,801
- Hello?
- Ronnie, dear.

259
00:14:36,901 --> 00:14:38,033
Hey...

00:14:38,133 --> 00:14:49,300

261
00:15:14,300 --> 00:15:16,133
- He was trying to erase

262
00:15:36,934 --> 00:15:38,033
Secure this location

00:15:38,167 --> 00:15:40,400

264
00:16:54,467 --> 00:16:55,567
Shit's on t.v, yo.

265
00:16:59,167 --> 00:17:01,467
- With a street value
of almost sixteen

266
00:17:01,567 --> 00:17:03,000
million dollars in heroin,

267
00:17:03,133 --> 00:17:05,334

268
00:17:05,434 --> 00:17:08,567

269
00:17:08,667 --> 00:17:11,934

270
00:17:12,067 --> 00:17:15,934
...and perseverance by our

271
00:17:16,033 --> 00:17:18,634
And while I am told that this
investigation is continuing,

272
00:17:18,734 --> 00:17:22,067
it is my understanding that

00:17:22,167 --> 00:17:24,033

00:17:24,133 --> 00:17:26,567

277
00:17:30,501 --> 00:17:32,200
We did not give up on that

279
00:17:35,234 --> 00:17:38,367

280
00:17:38,501 --> 00:17:39,467

281
00:17:39,567 --> 00:17:41,133
And let me just say to all

282
00:17:41,234 --> 00:17:44,567

00:17:44,667 --> 00:17:47,100

285
00:17:48,767 --> 00:17:50,601

288
00:17:54,634 --> 00:17:56,033

289

communities.

Today the mayor of Baltimore,
our state's attorney,

00:18:01,167 --> 00:18:04,667

00:18:04,767 --> 00:18:07,501

Deputy.

Alma Gutierrez, "Sun" papers.

00:18:16,968 --> 00:18:18,734

Last time the "Sun"

00:18:26,734 --> 00:18:27,801

00:18:27,901 --> 00:18:30,300

303
00:18:40,367 --> 00:18:42,634
"a source of information

They sayin' somebody talkin'?

"from information received,

My hair, I expect.

00:19:12,133 --> 00:19:15,534

00:19:15,634 --> 00:19:17,601

319
00:19:17,701 --> 00:19:19,133
Onliest people knew 'bout

Snoop knew.

Shit.

youngun Michael?

Maybe it was him ran his mouth.

He got picked up, right?

325

I did that thing for him.

Why would he talk about it an'

00:19:32,834 --> 00:19:34,634

kinda backtalk 'bout shit.

00:19:34,734 --> 00:19:35,634
Buck' wild about this 'n that.

Like what?

332
00:19:37,234 --> 00:19:39,300

333
00:19:39,400 --> 00:19:41,234
Cryin' about how Omar in the

00:19:41,367 --> 00:19:42,767

00:19:43,968 --> 00:19:45,067
Nuthin'.

Omar tried callin'

338
00:19:49,267 --> 00:19:50,167
But, shit, it wadn't nothin'...

339
00:19:50,267 --> 00:19:51,334
What he say about me?

340
00:19:51,467 --> 00:19:52,667
- Nuthin', man.
Just talkin' shit.

00:19:52,767 --> 00:19:54,501
He use my name?

342
00:19:54,601 --> 00:19:55,667
In the street?

343
00:19:57,133 --> 00:19:59,367
Talk, motherfucker.

344

He just, ya know...

Say that you need to

He call me a punk?

348
00:20:10,200 --> 00:20:11,167
It was bullshit, man.

349
00:20:11,267 --> 00:20:12,200
You ain't need

350
00:20:12,300 --> 00:20:13,567

know about

351

what I need on my mind,

My name was on the street.

353
00:20:20,133 --> 00:20:21,200
When we bounce from

354
00:20:21,334 --> 00:20:22,200
y'all gonna go down

Word did not
