00:20:28,434 --> 00:20:29,901
Let 'em know Marlo
step to any motherfucker.

00:20:30,000 --> 00:20:33,934
Omar, Barksdale...

My name is my name.

One detective,

Shit, now that Chris Partlow's

we might have some

just workin' a file.

With your

00:21:24,100 --> 00:21:25,200

00:21:25,300 --> 00:21:26,601

00:21:27,801 --> 00:21:29,133
Nowhere.

00:21:31,334 --> 00:21:33,567
Killer stopped calling.

00:21:33,667 --> 00:21:35,200

00:21:35,334 --> 00:21:36,267

fire should be

00:22:00,734 --> 00:22:02,601
No more killing,

52
00:02:20,345 --> 00:02:22,244
YOU CANNOT BE TELLING ME
I HAVE TO LIVE WITH THIS.

53
00:02:22,378 --> 00:02:24,811
- DEPUTY, COUNSELOR...

54
00:02:24,911 --> 00:02:27,278
IF YOU TWO WILL EXCUSE US,
WE ARE GOING TO

55
00:02:27,411 --> 00:02:29,743
DISCUSS THIS FIRST AS
A MATTER OF PUBLIC POLICY.

56
00:02:29,876 --> 00:02:31,643
UNTIL WE CAN REASON THE
BEST WAY TO ADDRESS THIS,

57
00:02:31,743 --> 00:02:34,009
DO NOTHING AND SPEAK
TO NO ONE

58
00:02:34,109 --> 00:02:35,443
ABOUT ANY OF THIS.

59
00:02:35,543 --> 00:02:38,242
- IF THIS BECOMES
PUBLIC IN THE WRONG WAY,

60
00:02:38,376 --> 00:02:40,108
A LOT OF PEOPLE WHO
WERE LEGALLY RESPONSIBLE

61
00:02:40,241 --> 00:02:41,908
FOR THE SITUATION,
GOOD PEOPLE

62
00:02:42,008 --> 00:02:45,308
WHO WERE NONETHELESS IN A
SUPERVISORY ROLE HERE...

63
00:02:45,408 --> 00:02:47,207
ARE GOING TO SUFFER.

64
00:02:47,307 --> 00:02:49,174
AND THAT'S NOT THE
OUTCOME THAT ANYONE WANTS.

65
00:02:50,840 --> 00:02:52,839
- WHAT MIKE IS SAYING IS
THAT WE NEED TO

66
00:02:52,939 --> 00:02:55,339
BE VERY CAREFUL
ABOUT HOW TO PROCEED.

67
00:03:05,271 --> 00:03:07,071
- I WISH I WAS STILL
AT THE NEWSPAPER

68
00:03:07,171 --> 00:03:09,737
SO I COULD WRITE
ON THIS MESS.

69
00:03:09,837 --> 00:03:11,936
IT'S TOO FUCKIN' GOOD.

00:03:17,037 --> 00:03:25,137
www.wikisubtitles.net

71
00:03:33,938 --> 00:03:49,638
www.thewire-france.com

72
00:03:51,339 --> 00:04:04,439

73
00:04:32,740 --> 00:04:40,440
www.ncicap.org

74
00:04:44,441 --> 00:04:48,841
www.hbo.com/thewire

75
00:04:49,437 --> 00:04:52,737
<i>" ... the life of kings."
- H. L. Mencklen.</i>

76
00:05:03,485 --> 00:05:06,018
- LESTER. WHAT BRINGS YOU DOWN?

77
00:05:06,085 --> 00:05:07,583
WE DON'T HAVE ANYTHING
SCHEDULED FROM YOU TODAY,

78
00:05:07,683 --> 00:05:09,451
I DON'T THINK...

79
00:05:15,216 --> 00:05:18,183
- 40,000 FROM THE SHOWBOAT
ON THE BOARDWALK.

80
00:05:18,283 --> 00:05:20,149
26 AT THE BORGATA.

81
00:05:21,581 --> 00:05:24,082
80 OVER THE LAST
YEAR AT THE TAJ MAHAL...

82
00:05:24,149 --> 00:05:27,148
AND THAT'S JUST THE
ATLANTIC CITY CASINOS.

83
00:05:27,248 --> 00:05:29,014
- I LIKE TO PLAY. SO WHAT?

84
00:05:29,114 --> 00:05:31,347
- YOU LOST THREE TIMES
YOUR SALARY OVER

85
00:05:31,447 --> 00:05:32,746
THE LAST TWO YEARS.

86
00:05:34,113 --> 00:05:35,780
I RAN YOU THROUGH SENTINEL
TITLE AND CAME BACK

87
00:05:35,880 --> 00:05:39,346
WITH SEVEN PAGES OF LIENS
AND A THIRD MORTGAGE

88
00:05:39,446 --> 00:05:41,545
YOU FOLDED ON TWO MONTHS AGO.

89
00:05:41,645 --> 00:05:44,278
GARY, YOU'RE DONE.

90
00:05:44,378 --> 00:05:45,512
- WHAT DO YOU MEAN?

91
00:05:45,577 --> 00:05:47,711
- WE FOUND SEALED GRAND
JURY PAPERS IN THE HOUSES

92
00:05:47,811 --> 00:05:49,210
OF DRUG DEALERS.

93
00:05:49,310 --> 00:05:51,210
AND WE'VE GOT PEOPLE
NAMING YOU ON IT.

94
00:05:54,044 --> 00:05:56,143
YOU HAVE A PROBLEM, GARY.

95
00:05:57,410 --> 00:05:59,143
BUT YOU HAVE FRIENDS
IN THIS COURTHOUSE,

96
00:05:59,243 --> 00:06:00,709
LIFELONG FRIENDS.

97
00:06:00,842 --> 00:06:03,409
COP TO THE PROBLEM,
GIVE UP THE NAMES OF THOSE

98
00:06:03,509 --> 00:06:05,275
THAT BOUGHT FROM YOU.

99
00:06:05,375 --> 00:06:07,573
DISBARRED? YEAH, NO DOUBT.

100
00:06:07,673 --> 00:06:10,707
BUT YOU PLAY IT CLEAN
FROM THIS MOMENT ON,

101
00:06:10,807 --> 00:06:13,273
AND WE BOTH KNOW
YOU'LL PROBABLY WALK.

102
00:06:15,639 --> 00:06:16,706
- WHY DID YOU LOOK AT ME?

103
00:06:16,806 --> 00:06:18,407
- I RAN THE FINANCES
ON EVERYONE WHO WORKED

104
00:06:18,507 --> 00:06:20,339
THIS UNIT OVER THE
LAST COUPLE YEARS.

105
00:06:20,406 --> 00:06:21,738
YOU WERE THE ONLY BOGIE.

106
00:06:21,838 --> 00:06:23,439
IF THE S.A.O. WEREN'T
SO SCREWED UP,

107
00:06:23,538 --> 00:06:24,972
THEY'D HAVE BEEN
RUNNING BACKGROUND

108
00:06:25,072 --> 00:06:26,204
CHECKS AS A ROUTINE.

109
00:06:26,304 --> 00:06:27,804
BUT I GUESS YOU KNEW THAT.

110
00:06:29,537 --> 00:06:32,404
- I ALWAYS WONDERED IF THEY'D
GET THEIR SHIT TOGETHER.

111
00:06:32,504 --> 00:06:34,504
BUT THAT'S BALTIMORE,
ISN'T IT?

112
00:06:37,802 --> 00:06:40,269
SO WHAT HAPPENS NOW?

113
00:06:40,369 --> 00:06:42,102
- WELL, FOR STARTERS...

114
00:06:46,634 --> 00:06:48,534
YOU'RE GONNA MAKE
A PHONE CALL.

115
00:06:50,633 --> 00:06:53,334
- McNULTY, FREAMON,

116
00:06:53,434 --> 00:06:54,666
SYDNOR,

117
00:06:54,800 --> 00:06:57,433
ANYONE WHO HAS THE SMELL OF
THIS ON THEM SHOULD BE GONE.

118
00:06:57,532 --> 00:06:59,366
BEFORE THE CLOSE OF BUSINESS,
THEY SHOULD BE SUSPENDED

119
00:06:59,500 --> 00:07:01,099
AND BEFORE THE END
OF THE WEEK, INDICTED.

120
00:07:01,199 --> 00:07:03,298
- I KNOW, BUT...
- BUT WHAT?

121
00:07:03,399 --> 00:07:04,831
WE'RE GONNA LET THIS SHIT
STAND BECAUSE IT'LL

122
00:07:04,931 --> 00:07:06,465
HURT CARCETTI TO AIR IT OUT?

123
00:07:06,564 --> 00:07:08,064
INSTEAD OF CLEANING
HOUSE LIKE WE NEED TO,

124
00:07:08,197 --> 00:07:09,663
HE'S UP THERE FIGURING
OUT HOW TO HIDE THE DIRT.

125
00:07:09,764 --> 00:07:12,131
I SWEAR, I GOTTA MIND
TO CALL THE GOVERNOR MYSELF

126
00:07:12,231 --> 00:07:13,131
AND JUST LET IT FLY.

127
00:07:13,231 --> 00:07:15,196
- CEDRIC, YOU CAN'T.
- WHY NOT?

128
00:07:15,296 --> 00:07:16,996
IF I LET THIS THING STAND,
I MIGHT AS WELL JUST

129
00:07:17,096 --> 00:07:18,996
ROLL OVER AND PLAY DEAD
FOR EVERY POLICE

130
00:07:19,096 --> 00:07:20,195
WHO KNOWS ABOUT THIS.

131
00:07:22,928 --> 00:07:24,229
WE COVER THIS UP...

132
00:07:24,362 --> 00:07:26,727
- CEDRIC, YOU CAN'T
DO ANYTHING.

133
00:07:26,827 --> 00:07:28,727
THOSE ARE YOUR DETECTIVES.

134
00:07:28,827 --> 00:07:31,395
THEY NEED SOMEONE TO BLAME,
THEY WILL MEASURE YOU FOR IT...

135
00:07:31,527 --> 00:07:32,993
- I DON'T GIVE A FUCK.

136
00:07:35,293 --> 00:07:37,394
- AND THEY'LL FIRE ME.

137
00:07:42,126 --> 00:07:44,292
YOU HEARD STEINTORF...

138
00:07:46,524 --> 00:07:48,524
I WAS IN CHARGE OF THIS THING.

139
00:07:48,624 --> 00:07:50,524
I WAS ON THAT WIRETAP...

140
00:07:52,990 --> 00:07:54,656
THIS IS MY CAREER.

141
00:07:54,757 --> 00:07:55,957
THIS IS EVERYTHING.

142
00:08:00,323 --> 00:08:05,621
YOU GO PUBLIC,
AND IT HURTS CARCETTI.

143
00:08:05,721 --> 00:08:07,688
MAYBE HE DOESN'T GET
TO BE GOVERNOR.

144
00:08:07,788 --> 00:08:12,021
BUT HE IS STILL THE MAYOR
AND BOND IS STILL MY BOSS

145
00:08:12,154 --> 00:08:14,886
AND YOU KNOW THE WEIGHT
WILL NOT FALL ON THEM.

146
00:08:14,986 --> 00:08:16,186
IT NEVER DOES.

147
00:08:16,286 --> 00:08:18,353
- CHRIST.

148
00:08:18,453 --> 00:08:20,819
- EVERYTHING
I'VE WORKED FOR, ALL THOSE YEARS

149
00:08:20,953 --> 00:08:22,618
IN THAT COURTHOUSE...

150
00:08:29,218 --> 00:08:31,084
PLEASE.

151
00:08:33,516 --> 00:08:36,683
- 25 CENTS.
"BALTIMORE SUN."

152
00:08:36,816 --> 00:08:40,383
SIR, "BALTIMORE SUN."
ONE QUARTER.

153
00:08:40,483 --> 00:08:48,647
- KEEP IT.
- THANK YOU, SIR. THANK YOU.

154
00:08:48,748 --> 00:08:52,314
- PEOPLE TIP PRETTY GOOD,
DON'T THEY?

155
00:08:52,481 --> 00:08:54,447
- PAINING FOR WHAT
HE HAD DONE TO US.

156
00:08:54,580 --> 00:08:56,447
I'M SORRY FOR HIM, MAN,
REALLY, BUT I STILL

157
00:08:56,580 --> 00:08:58,645
CAN'T LET HIM COME UP
FROM THE BASEMENT.

158
00:09:02,446 --> 00:09:04,778
YOU GONNA PUT ALL
THAT IN THE PAPER?

159
00:09:04,878 --> 00:09:06,711
- THAT'S THE PLAN.

160
00:09:06,811 --> 00:09:09,544
- EVEN THE PARTS
ABOUT SHERROD?

161
00:09:09,644 --> 00:09:10,877
- YEAH.

162
00:09:14,144 --> 00:09:15,411
- WHAT GOOD IS...

163
00:09:15,510 --> 00:09:16,609
WHAT GOOD IS A STORY
LIKE THAT?

164
00:09:16,709 --> 00:09:18,176
- LIKE WHAT?

165
00:09:18,276 --> 00:09:20,709
- ME, SHERROD.
GETTIN' HIGH. NOT GETTIN' HIGH.

166
00:09:20,809 --> 00:09:22,142
MY SISTER,
ALL THAT SHIT IN THERE.

167
00:09:22,242 --> 00:09:24,142
WHAT GOOD DO ANY OF THAT
DO TO PUT IT IN THE NEWSPAPER?

168
00:09:24,209 --> 00:09:26,575
- PEOPLE READ IT,
THEY THINK ABOUT IT.

169
00:09:26,675 --> 00:09:27,608
MAYBE SEE THINGS DIFFERENT.

170
00:09:27,708 --> 00:09:29,774
- I DON'T KNOW, MAN.

171
00:09:29,874 --> 00:09:30,907
- BUBS, YOU DON'T
WANT ME TO DO THIS,

172
00:09:31,008 --> 00:09:32,041
I WON'T DO IT.

173
00:09:34,973 --> 00:09:37,506
- I DON'T KNOW.

174
00:09:37,606 --> 00:09:39,973
"BALTIMORE SUN."
A LITTLE BIT OF SUN.

175
00:09:40,107 --> 00:09:41,406
SUN PAPER.

176
00:09:41,505 --> 00:09:42,705
- LOOK, RUPERT,
YOU CAN GO PUBLIC WITH

177
00:09:42,805 --> 00:09:43,772
THIS THING IF YOU WANT,

178
00:09:43,872 --> 00:09:46,006
BUT YOUR SHOP IS GOING
TO COME OUT LOOKING

179
00:09:46,106 --> 00:09:47,271
WORSE FOR LETTING IT
HAPPEN IN THE FIRST PLACE.

180
00:09:47,372 --> 00:09:49,504
- THE BETTER MOVE IS
TO SHUT IT DOWN QUIETLY

181
00:09:49,604 --> 00:09:50,904
AND THEN DEAL WITH
THOSE RESPONSIBLE

182
00:09:51,038 --> 00:09:52,437
THROUGH BACK CHANNELS.

183
00:09:52,570 --> 00:09:54,170
WE'LL BURY THESE GUYS SOFTLY,

184
00:09:54,270 --> 00:09:56,870
AND IN A HOLE SO DEEP
NO ONE WILL EVER GET CLOSE

185
00:09:56,970 --> 00:09:58,204
TO DIGGING THEM UP.

186
00:10:01,136 --> 00:10:03,535
- I CAN SEE THAT.

187
00:10:03,635 --> 00:10:06,801
- COMMISSIONER,
DO YOU AGREE?

188
00:10:06,935 --> 00:10:10,035
- WELL, IT IS A
LITTLE MORE PROBLEMATIC FOR ME.

189
00:10:10,135 --> 00:10:13,633
THE OFFENDERS ARE IN MY SHOP,
ARE THEY NOT?

190
00:10:15,401 --> 00:10:19,433
- CAN I HAVE A WORD WITH YOU
IN PRIVATE, BILL?

191
00:10:19,532 --> 00:10:22,733
- HEY, IF RAWLS ISN'T IN,
I'M NOT EITHER.

192
00:10:22,898 --> 00:10:25,165
- OH, I WOULDN'T WORRY
ABOUT BILL RAWLS.

193
00:10:25,265 --> 00:10:27,531
I BELIEVE HE'S ABOUT TO
HAVE ONE OF THOSE ROAD

194
00:10:27,631 --> 00:10:29,931
TO DAMASCUS MOMENTS....

195
00:10:31,831 --> 00:10:33,264
- I CAN SEE WHAT
YOU'RE THINKING IN THERE.

196
00:10:33,398 --> 00:10:35,629
I CAN SEE THE GEARS
GRINDING IN THAT HEAD

197
00:10:35,730 --> 00:10:36,997
OF YOURS.

198
00:10:39,097 --> 00:10:41,996
YOU'RE THINKING, HEY,
I MIGHT HAVE SOME WOOD

199
00:10:42,129 --> 00:10:43,495
ON CARCETTI HERE.

200
00:10:43,595 --> 00:10:44,829
AFTER ALL, THERE'S NO WAY
THEY CAN PIN THE BLAME

201
00:10:44,929 --> 00:10:46,795
ON ME FOR THIS FIASCO
WITHOUT DOING THEIR

202
00:10:46,895 --> 00:10:48,395
BOY DANIELS, TOO, RIGHT?

203
00:10:48,527 --> 00:10:49,828
YOU'RE THINKING WE'D HAVE
TO FIRE DANIELS

204
00:10:49,961 --> 00:10:51,761
TO FIRE YOU AND
THAT WOULDN'T SIT WELL

205
00:10:51,861 --> 00:10:53,394
GIVEN HOW MUCH WE'VE
ALREADY SOLD DANIELS.

206
00:10:53,493 --> 00:10:55,693
ISN'T THAT WHAT YOU'RE THINKING?

207
00:10:55,793 --> 00:10:56,827
AND SO YOU'RE TELLING
YOURSELF MAYBE THERE'S

208
00:10:56,927 --> 00:10:58,626
A WAY FOR YOU
TO LEVERAGE THIS.

209
00:10:58,760 --> 00:11:00,859
TO GET YOURSELF A FULL
TERM AS COMMISSIONER,

210
00:11:00,959 --> 00:11:02,293
TO DELAY DANIELS A
FEW MORE YEARS IN

211
00:11:02,393 --> 00:11:04,026
EXCHANGE FOR YOU
SHUTTING THE FUCK UP

212
00:11:04,126 --> 00:11:06,459
AND DOING WHAT
YOU'RE TOLD.

213
00:11:06,591 --> 00:11:08,359
AND YOU KNOW WHAT, BILL?
YOU'RE NOT FAR OFF.

214
00:11:08,459 --> 00:11:10,292
YOU DO HAVE A LITTLE
LEVERAGE HERE,

215
00:11:10,425 --> 00:11:11,623
BUT JUST A LITTLE.

216
00:11:11,757 --> 00:11:14,490
AND I WOULDN'T OVERPLAY
YOUR HAND.

217
00:11:14,657 --> 00:11:16,191
- HOW WOULD YOU PLAY IT?

218
00:11:16,291 --> 00:11:17,490
- I'D SHUT THE FUCK UP
AND WAIT YOUR TURN,

219
00:11:17,622 --> 00:11:18,856
AND WHEN TOMMY GETS
TO THE STATEHOUSE,

220
00:11:18,956 --> 00:11:20,756
HE BRINGS YOU
WITH HIM TO BE STATE

221
00:11:20,889 --> 00:11:22,990
POLICE SUPERINTENDENT,

222
00:11:23,090 --> 00:11:25,822
BECAUSE WHILE YOU MAY BE
A SHADE TOO WHITE

223
00:11:25,922 --> 00:11:28,022
TO RUN THE BALTIMORE
DEPARTMENT,

224
00:11:28,122 --> 00:11:35,388
YOU'RE JUST ABOUT RIGHT
FOR THE M.S.P.

225
00:11:35,554 --> 00:11:36,786
- I HAVE YOUR WORD?

226
00:11:36,886 --> 00:11:38,486
- AND I HAVE YOURS.

227
00:11:48,718 --> 00:11:50,784
- BACK CHANNEL IS
THE WAY TO GO.

228
00:11:50,884 --> 00:11:51,918
- SEE?

229
00:11:52,018 --> 00:11:54,783
THE POLICE COMMISSIONER
DONE FELL OFF HIS ASS.

230
00:12:01,049 --> 00:12:02,016
- CAN I HELP YOU?

231
00:12:02,116 --> 00:12:06,349
- UM, I NEED TO SEE
MR. PREZBO.

232
00:12:07,315 --> 00:12:08,848
- SOMEONE WILL COME DOWN.

233
00:12:29,778 --> 00:12:31,345
- ARE YOU A STUDENT HERE?

234
00:12:31,445 --> 00:12:33,978
- MS. DONNELLY, IT'S ME,
DUQUAN.

235
00:12:34,144 --> 00:12:36,044
- WELL, IT'S GOOD TO SEE
YOU, DUQUAN,

236
00:12:36,144 --> 00:12:37,676
BUT YOU'RE NOT A STUDENT
HERE SO I CAN'T

237
00:12:37,776 --> 00:12:39,643
LET YOU INSIDE.

238
00:12:39,743 --> 00:12:42,010
- I JUST CAME PAST TO SEE
MR. PREZBO.

239
00:12:42,110 --> 00:12:43,475
- WELL, HE'S TEACHING
RIGHT NOW.

240
00:12:43,575 --> 00:12:46,909
- I KNOW. I CAN WAIT.

241
00:12:47,009 --> 00:12:48,775
- WELL, YOU'RE GONNA
HAVE TO STAY OUTSIDE,

242
00:12:48,908 --> 00:12:50,574
AND AFTER THE BELL,
I'LL TELL

243
00:12:50,674 --> 00:12:52,408
MR. PRYZBYLEWSKI YOU'RE OUT
HERE FOR HIM, OKAY?

244
00:13:02,006 --> 00:13:04,839
- I'M GOING TO SURPRISE
YOU WITH SOMETHING.

245
00:13:04,939 --> 00:13:07,205
- YOU ALREADY HAVE.

246
00:13:07,305 --> 00:13:09,705
- I GOT A TIP FROM
AN INFORMANT ABOUT A

247
00:13:09,805 --> 00:13:12,072
LEAK OUT OF THE GRAND
JURY UNIT,

248
00:13:12,172 --> 00:13:14,004
SAD TO SAY IT'S
CHECKED OUT.

249
00:13:14,104 --> 00:13:15,204
- WE KNOW ABOUT THE LEAK.

250
00:13:15,304 --> 00:13:17,171
- YEAH, BUT DO YOU
KNOW WHO IT IS?

251
00:13:17,271 --> 00:13:19,237
GARY DIPASQUALE.

252
00:13:19,337 --> 00:13:21,337
DECENT ENOUGH GUY,
BUT HE'S GOT A BEAR OF

253
00:13:21,437 --> 00:13:23,103
A GAMBLING PROBLEM
AND A BANK OF

254
00:13:23,203 --> 00:13:24,669
DRUG LAWYERS WHO ARE
WILLING TO PAY FOR

255
00:13:24,769 --> 00:13:26,035
THEIR LOOK-SEES.

256
00:13:26,135 --> 00:13:28,302
TROY SANDERS, MARVIN BRONFMAN,

257
00:13:28,402 --> 00:13:31,500
DENNIS CRAY, SID SILVERSTEIN.

258
00:13:31,600 --> 00:13:34,801
AND THE PICK
OF THE LITTER? MAURICE LEVY.

259
00:13:36,034 --> 00:13:38,334
I KID YOU NOT.

260
00:13:38,434 --> 00:13:39,833
- GARY IS THEIR LEAK?

261
00:13:39,933 --> 00:13:41,033
- HE BROKE RIGHT AWAY.

262
00:13:41,133 --> 00:13:43,799
HE WAS READY TO GIVE IT UP.
HE NEEDED TO.

263
00:13:43,899 --> 00:13:48,966
ONE-PARTY CONSENT
CALL IMPLICATING MAURY LEVY.

264
00:13:49,066 --> 00:13:50,432
- WHERE'S GARY NOW?

265
00:13:50,564 --> 00:13:52,165
- HE WENT UP TO THE SECOND
FLOOR TO HAND

266
00:13:52,298 --> 00:13:53,931
IN HIS LETTER OF
RESIGNATION, THEN HE WENT HOME

267
00:13:54,031 --> 00:13:55,231
TO WAIT FOR THE SWORD
TO DROP.

268
00:13:55,332 --> 00:13:59,697
HE'S OKAY,
HE'S BETTER THAN YOU'D THINK.

269
00:13:59,897 --> 00:14:02,629
YOU KNOW, IF WE CAN TURN
LEVY AND SOME OF THESE

270
00:14:02,729 --> 00:14:05,229
OTHER DRUG LAWYERS,
WE CAN ROUTE THE DRUG

271
00:14:05,330 --> 00:14:08,262
MONEY ALL OVER TOWN.

272
00:14:08,362 --> 00:14:10,661
IT'S SAD BUSINESS,
I KNOW, BUT AT LEAST

273
00:14:10,761 --> 00:14:13,429
WE KNOW THE TRUTH NOW,
RIGHT?

274
00:14:13,528 --> 00:14:15,428
- THE TRUTH, YOU SAY?

275
00:14:23,859 --> 00:14:26,458
- HEY.
- DUQUAN, HELLO.

276
00:14:26,558 --> 00:14:27,458
- SNATCH-POPS.

277
00:14:27,558 --> 00:14:30,326
- HEY!- DAMIEN. YOU LOST

278
00:14:30,458 --> 00:14:32,391
- BUT I SAID SNATCH-POPS.
- I DON'T CARE WHAT YOU SAID.

279
00:14:32,490 --> 00:14:33,857
YOU'RE GONNA BUY HIM
A NEW SANDWICH,

280
00:14:33,991 --> 00:14:35,958
AND PAST THAT, YOU'RE GONNA
GO INSIDE AND ASK MR. WILLIAMS

281
00:14:36,058 --> 00:14:37,358
FOR A BROOM TO CLEAN THAT UP,
YOU UNDERSTAND?

282
00:14:37,490 --> 00:14:38,690
- BUT, MR. P...

283
00:14:38,790 --> 00:14:41,057
- RIGHT NOW, DAMIEN,
OROU'RE MINE FOR ANOTHER

284
00:14:41,190 --> 00:14:42,190
WEEK OF DETENTION.

285
00:14:42,290 --> 00:14:43,790
I DON'T WANT TO HEAR
ANOTHER WORD.

286
00:14:46,889 --> 00:14:49,922
- LOOKS LIKE YOU GOT
THE HANG OF IT.

287
00:14:50,056 --> 00:14:52,088
- WHAT'S UP WITH YOU, DUQUAN?

288
00:14:52,188 --> 00:14:54,088
- OH, AIN'T NOTHING.

289
00:14:54,221 --> 00:14:55,422
- YOU STILL AT SOUTHWESTERN?

290
00:14:55,554 --> 00:14:58,720
- WELL, I'M, LIKE, NEEDING

291
00:14:58,820 --> 00:14:59,987
YOU KNOW?

292
00:15:00,087 --> 00:15:02,054
I'M OUTDOORS NOW.

293
00:15:04,386 --> 00:15:05,619
AND, UM...

294
00:15:05,686 --> 00:15:08,420
I WAS HOPING MAYBE I
COULD GET WITH YOU

295
00:15:08,519 --> 00:15:10,952
AND BORROW SOME MONEY,

296
00:15:11,052 --> 00:15:12,651
SO I COULD GET A PLACE
AND SOME CLEAN CLOTHES

297
00:15:12,751 --> 00:15:14,685
AND GET MYSELF
SETTLED SO I CAN GO BACK

298
00:15:14,785 --> 00:15:16,951

299
00:15:17,051 --> 00:15:18,450
- YOU'RE ON THE STREET?

300
00:15:18,583 --> 00:15:19,884
- I MEAN, I GOT SOME PEOPLE
READY TO GIVE ME

301

A REALLY, REALLY GOOD PLACE

302
00:15:21,449 --> 00:15:22,716
WITH SOME MONEY FOR IT.

303

- HOW MUCH DO YOU NEED?

304

305
00:15:30,382 --> 00:15:32,416
BUT IF YOU COULD GO
ONE FIFTY MORE,

306
00:15:32,515 --> 00:15:34,014
I COULD ENROLL
IN THE G.E.D. PROGRAM

307
00:15:34,114 --> 00:15:35,514
DOWN B.C.C.C.

308
00:15:36,647 --> 00:15:38,214
THEN I COULD GET MY
G.E.D. WITHOUT HAVING

309
00:15:38,315 --> 00:15:39,513
TO GO BACK TO SOUTHWESTERN,

310
00:15:39,646 --> 00:15:41,113
THEN I COULD GET
MY WORK PERMIT.

311
00:15:43,180 --> 00:15:44,213
- I DON'T THINK
YOU'RE ELIGIBLE FOR

312
00:15:44,314 --> 00:15:46,812
A G.E.D. PROGRAM IF
YOU'RE STILL OF AGE

313
00:15:46,946 --> 00:15:48,912
TO ATTEND HIGH SCHOOL,
DUQUAN.

314
00:15:49,012 --> 00:15:50,679
- YEAH, YOU ARE.

315
00:15:53,511 --> 00:15:55,178
- I'LL TELL YOU WHAT.

316
00:15:55,278 --> 00:15:57,843
GIVE ME A COUPLE MINUTES,
I'LL DRIVE YOU DOWN THERE.

317
00:15:57,944 --> 00:16:00,044
AND IF YOU ARE ELIGIBLE,

318
00:16:00,144 --> 00:16:01,344
RIGHT TO THE BURSAR'S

319
00:16:01,443 --> 00:16:03,510
- NAW, MR. P., YOU AIN'T
GOT TO THROUGH ALL THAT.

320
00:16:03,610 --> 00:16:04,742
BESIDES, I REALLY AIN'T
GOT THE TIME TO

321

GO DOWN THERE TODAY.

322
00:16:06,709 --> 00:16:08,209
BUT, YOU KNOW, I'M GONNA.

323

324
00:16:15,574 --> 00:16:17,640

325
00:16:17,774 --> 00:16:19,874

GO DOWN TO B.C.C.C.

326
00:16:19,974 --> 00:16:24,173
IN A FEW DAYS AND FIND
OUT IF YOU'RE ENROLLED.

327
00:16:24,307 --> 00:16:26,572
IF YOU ARE,
I'M GONNA SAY, "GREAT,

328
00:16:26,673 --> 00:16:28,471
"DUQUAN CAN COME PAST
WITH HIS CERTIFICATE

329

"WHEN HE GETS IT,
AND WE'RE STILL FRIENDS

330
00:16:31,538 --> 00:16:33,939
AND HE CAN STILL
RELY ON ME."

331
00:16:34,072 --> 00:16:38,271
BUT IF YOU AREN'T ENROLLED,
THEN...

332
00:16:38,371 --> 00:16:41,103
WELL, I IMAGINE I'M NOT
GONNA SEE YOU AGAIN,

333
00:16:41,203 --> 00:16:42,270
AM I?

334
00:16:42,370 --> 00:16:44,304
- NO, MR. P.

335
00:16:44,436 --> 00:16:46,070
I'M DEFINITELY GONNA ENROLL.

336
00:16:46,203 --> 00:16:47,735
YOU'LL SEE.

337
00:16:51,936 --> 00:16:53,068
- I'LL GET MY STUFF.

338
00:16:53,135 --> 00:16:55,402
I'LL MEET YOU IN THE LOT

339

A BANK MACHINE.

340
00:17:02,633 --> 00:17:04,034
- JAY, ALL I'M SAYING
IS WE'VE RUN DOWN

341
00:17:04,134 --> 00:17:05,732
ALL THE LEADS WE HAD,
ALL THE OFFICE REPORTS

342
00:17:05,832 --> 00:17:08,099
ARE IN AND AT THIS POINT,
BARRING ANY NEW DEVELOPMENTS,

343
00:17:08,199 --> 00:17:10,266
I DON'T NEED ALL
THIS FUCKING MANPOWER.

344
00:17:10,366 --> 00:17:11,765
- FUCK ME, JIMMY.

345
00:17:11,898 --> 00:17:13,365
LAST WEEK YOU WERE CRYING

346
00:17:13,464 --> 00:17:14,598
DICK YOU COULD GET
YOUR HANDS ON.

347
00:17:14,698 --> 00:17:15,998
- WELL, THE CASE
HAS GONE QUIET.

348
00:17:16,098 --> 00:17:18,031
THERE'S NO RED RIBBONS.
THERE'S NO BODIES.

349
00:17:18,164 --> 00:17:19,298
THERE'S NO DISAPPEARANCES.

350
00:17:19,398 --> 00:17:20,398
THERE'S NOT A FUCKING

351
00:17:20,497 --> 00:17:21,630
THIS THING'S FUCKING
THING IS USELESS.

352
00:17:21,730 --> 00:17:23,896
- SO WHAT? YOU DON'T WANT
THE WIRETAP EITHER NOW?

353
00:17:23,996 --> 00:17:25,763
- WELL, THE JUDGE GAVE

354
00:17:25,896 --> 00:17:27,096
ONCE THAT RUNS OUT,
THEN...

355
00:17:27,196 --> 00:17:28,330
- MOTHERFUCKER,
YOU WERE THE ONE WHO WAS

356
00:17:28,429 --> 00:17:30,628
ALL SEMPER FI FOR THIS
SERIAL KILLER

357
00:17:30,728 --> 00:17:31,929
AND NOW YOU'RE FUCKIN'

358
00:17:32,029 --> 00:17:33,528
- JAY, I'M READY
TO WORK THE CASE.

359
00:17:33,662 --> 00:17:35,560
BUT SHORT OF ANY NEW
LEADS OR DEVELOPMENTS,

360
00:17:35,661 --> 00:17:37,361
WHAT THE FUCK DO YOU
WANT ME TO DO?

361
00:17:37,460 --> 00:17:41,927
I CAN'T MAKE SHIT UP,

362
00:17:42,093 --> 00:17:43,860
IT IS WHAT IT IS.

363
00:17:43,960 --> 00:17:45,526

SURVEILLANCE TEAMS BACK, JIMMY,

364
00:17:45,660 --> 00:17:47,792
DON'T COME CRYING FOR
MORE MANPOWER TOMORROW.

365
00:17:47,892 --> 00:17:48,926
YOU HEAR?

366
00:17:50,126 --> 00:17:51,959
- SHIT IS LIKE A WAR,
AIN'T IT?

367
00:17:52,059 --> 00:17:54,358
EASY TO GET IN,
HELL TO GET OUT.

368
00:18:13,955 --> 00:18:15,855
- PEARLMAN
KNOWS EVERYTHING. DANIELS, TOO.

369
00:18:15,988 --> 00:18:18,021
THEY FIGURED IT OUT.

370
00:18:18,121 --> 00:18:21,687
- HOW?
- I DON'T KNOW.

371
00:18:21,820 --> 00:18:22,954
- JESUS.
WHAT ARE THEY...

372
00:18:23,054 --> 00:18:24,920
- I DON'T KNOW.

373
00:18:25,020 --> 00:18:26,120
SHE MADE IT CLEAR
IN NO UNCERTAIN TERMS

374
00:18:26,220 --> 00:18:28,387
THERE ARE NOT TO BE ANY
FURTHER HOMELESS KILLINGS.

375
00:18:28,486 --> 00:18:30,518
NOTHING MORE ON THIS
CASE WHATSOEVER.

376
00:18:30,618 --> 00:18:32,585
- DOES SHE KNOW ABOUT MARLO,
THAT OUR CASE--

377
00:18:32,685 --> 00:18:33,785
- SHE KNOWS EVERYTHING.

378
00:18:33,885 --> 00:18:36,285
DANIELS KNOWS.

379
00:18:36,385 --> 00:18:38,318
THEY WENT DOWN TO THE
E.C.U., DIALED UP THE WIRETAP

380
00:18:38,417 --> 00:18:41,784
NUMBER AND UP POP'S
MARLO'S CELL PHONE.

381
00:18:41,884 --> 00:18:43,950
- WHY AREN'T WE FIRED?
WHY AREN'T WE IN FUCKING
BRACELETS?

382
00:18:44,050 --> 00:18:45,250
- I DON'T KNOW.

383
00:18:46,883 --> 00:18:48,149
- OH SHIT, LESTER.

384
00:18:49,749 --> 00:18:50,649
WE GOTTA GET OUTTA HERE.

385
00:18:50,749 --> 00:18:53,182
WE GOTTA THINK THIS
THING THROUGH.

386
00:18:53,283 --> 00:18:54,547
OH, JESUS FUCKING CHRIST.

387
00:18:54,648 --> 00:18:56,348
- LOOK, MEET ME DOWN

388
00:18:56,447 --> 00:18:57,714
ALL RIGHT?

390
00:19:32,942 --> 00:19:34,009
- HOW MUCH?

391
00:19:40,774 --> 00:19:41,674

392
00:19:41,774 --> 00:19:42,908
- DAMN, BOY.

393
00:19:43,007 --> 00:19:45,140
TEACHER MUST LOVE

394
00:19:45,274 --> 00:19:46,307
C'MON WITH IT.

395
00:19:46,406 --> 00:19:49,472
THEY GONNA PUT OUT TESTERS

396
00:19:49,572 --> 00:19:51,006
WE GONNA BE LATE FOR IT.

397
00:20:02,070 --> 00:20:03,703
C'MON, BOY. C'MON.

398
00:20:03,803 --> 00:20:04,904
C'MON.

399
00:20:22,533 --> 00:20:23,767
- DEPUTY...

400
00:20:46,630 --> 00:20:48,663
- TO BE CONTINUED.

401
00:20:53,162 --> 00:20:55,363
- FUCK FUCK FUCKING FUCK.

402
00:20:55,462 --> 00:20:56,394
- AH, WHAT'S THE MATTER?

403
00:20:56,494 --> 00:20:58,461
COTTAGE CHEESE FOR LUNCH
AGAIN THERE, CARL?

404
00:21:00,728 --> 00:21:03,426
- JUST BECAUSE IT HAPPENED
DOESN'T MEAN IT'S NEWS.

405
00:21:04,994 --> 00:21:07,960
THERE'S ALWAYS A
SALMONELLA OUTBREAK SOMEWHERE.

406
00:21:08,060 --> 00:21:09,893
I DON'T SEE WHY WE HAVE TO
COVER THIS ONE...

407
00:21:09,993 --> 00:21:12,093
- WHAT'S THE FIRST RULE
OF REWRITE, SPRY?

408
00:21:12,193 --> 00:21:13,525
- SHOOT IT DOWN.

409
00:21:15,458 --> 00:21:16,892
- DID YOU READ THIS?

410
00:21:18,259 --> 00:21:20,390
WE ARE CREDITING OUR
OWN COVERAGE WITH

411
00:21:20,490 --> 00:21:23,291
CHANGING THE
GOVERNOR'S MIND?

412
00:21:23,390 --> 00:21:25,157
I'M ALREADY TO THE JUMP
AND THERE'S NOT A

413
00:21:25,258 --> 00:21:27,589
QUOTE FROM ANYONE

414
00:21:27,689 --> 00:21:28,789
WITH ANYTHING OF THE SORT.

415
00:21:28,890 --> 00:21:30,956
- YEAH, THE GUV
IS RESTORING FUNDING, ALL RIGHT.

416
00:21:31,090 --> 00:21:32,622
THAT'S 'CAUSE CARCETTI'S
BEEN BEATING THE SHIT

417
00:21:32,722 --> 00:21:34,289
OUT OF HIM
ON THIS ISSUE.

418
00:21:34,388 --> 00:21:35,755
WE'RE JUST AN AFTERTHOUGHT.

419
00:21:35,855 --> 00:21:38,289
- WHITING CAN SMELL THE
PUBLIC SERVICE PULITZER, HUH?

420
00:21:38,388 --> 00:21:39,687
- SEEMS SO.

421
00:21:39,787 --> 00:21:40,854
- YOU GET A CHANCE YET?

422
00:21:40,988 --> 00:21:42,754
- YEAH, YEAH. I READ IT.

423
00:21:42,854 --> 00:21:43,954
- AND?

424
00:21:46,220 --> 00:21:48,120
- BEAUTIFUL.

425
00:21:48,254 --> 00:21:49,887
NO, NO, NO. I MEAN IT.

426
00:21:50,020 --> 00:21:52,652
YOU GOT SOME REAL JOE MITCHELL
STUFF ON THE PAGE THERE.

427
00:21:52,752 --> 00:21:55,585
REALLY MAKES ME FEEL LIKE
I KNOW THIS GUY AND HIS WORLD.

428
00:21:55,685 --> 00:21:57,851
YOU JUST PULLED IT ALL
THROUGH THE KEYHOLE.

429
00:21:57,951 --> 00:21:59,051
- THANKS, GUS.

430
00:21:59,151 --> 00:22:00,751
- WE GET SOME GOOD ART,
I'M GONNA PUSH FOR

431
00:22:00,851 --> 00:22:01,885
THE SUNDAY FRONT.

432
00:22:02,018 --> 00:22:03,084
- WELL, THE THING IS,
I GOTTA MAKE SURE

433
00:22:03,184 --> 00:22:04,284
THE GUY IS GOOD
WITH IT.

434
00:22:04,383 --> 00:22:05,583
- WHAT DO YOU MEAN?

435
00:22:05,683 --> 00:22:07,217
- THE PART OF THE STORY ABOUT
THE KID STILL BOTHERS HIM,

436
00:22:07,317 --> 00:22:09,250
AND WHEN HE TOLD ME ABOUT IT,
HE WAS JUST TALKING...

437
00:22:09,382 --> 00:22:10,782
- YOU TOLD HIM YOU WERE
WRITING ABOUT HIM, RIGHT?

438
00:22:10,883 --> 00:22:12,216
- I KNOW, BUT...

439
00:22:12,316 --> 00:22:13,415
I'M PUTTING THE GUY'S
LIFE OUT THERE.

440
00:22:13,515 --> 00:22:14,682
I JUST WANNA FEEL
CLEAN ABOUT IT.

441
00:22:14,782 --> 00:22:16,615
YOU KNOW WHAT I'M SAYIN'?

442
00:22:16,715 --> 00:22:18,315
- I REMEMBER CLEAN.

443
00:22:20,548 --> 00:22:22,014
- OBVIOUSLY,
THEY'RE NOT IN A HURRY

444
00:22:22,114 --> 00:22:24,513

'CAUSE WE AIN'T CUFFED.

445
00:22:24,614 --> 00:22:26,413
- THEY'RE PRETENDING ON THIS
CASE LIKE WE'RE PRETENDING.

446
00:22:26,513 --> 00:22:27,713
WHY?

447
00:22:29,779 --> 00:22:32,579
- CARCETTI.
HE'S EXPOSED ON THIS.

448
00:22:32,679 --> 00:22:35,945
- HOW? JUST BLAME IT ALL ON US,
ON THE DEPARTMENT.

449
00:22:36,045 --> 00:22:38,112
- TO KILL US, THEY'D
HAVE TO KILL RAWLS, DANIELS,

450
00:22:38,212 --> 00:22:39,744
AND HALF THE CHAIN
OF COMMAND.

451
00:22:39,844 --> 00:22:42,444
AND HE MADE THOSE GUYS.
IT'S HIS POLICE DEPARTMENT.

452
00:22:42,544 --> 00:22:44,311
SO HE OPENS HIMSELF
UP RIGHT WHEN HE'S OUT

453
00:22:44,410 --> 00:22:45,710
THERE RUNNING FOR GOVERNOR.

454
00:22:46,943 --> 00:22:48,310
- SO THEY WANT US
TO DO WHAT?

455
00:22:48,409 --> 00:22:49,543
RUN THIS THING DOWN QUIETLY?

456
00:22:49,643 --> 00:22:50,643
THAT'S NO PROBLEM.

457
00:22:50,776 --> 00:22:52,209
- SIX MONTHS FROM NOW,
AFTER THE ELECTION,

458
00:22:52,309 --> 00:22:55,042
THEY MIGHT DECIDE TO OPEN UP
AND GRAND JURY US.

459
00:22:55,176 --> 00:22:58,275
WE COULD STILL GO TO JAIL,
AND IF NOT,

460
00:22:58,374 --> 00:23:00,342
I'D EXPECT TO BE BACK
IN THE PAWN SHOP UNIT

461
00:23:00,441 --> 00:23:01,507
AND YOU, MY BROTHER,
ARE GONNA RIDE THE BOAT.

462
00:23:01,608 --> 00:23:05,241
- SO WHAT?
IT WAS WORTH IT.

463
00:23:05,341 --> 00:23:06,406
WASN'T IT?

464
00:23:07,607 --> 00:23:08,840
- DEPENDS.

465
00:23:08,940 --> 00:23:10,672
ARE THEY GONNA LET
THE CASE AGAINST MARLO

466
00:23:10,772 --> 00:23:13,973
AND HIS PEOPLE STAND,
KNOWING WHAT THEY KNOW?

467
00:23:14,073 --> 00:23:15,106
- WHY WOULDN'T THEY?

468
00:23:15,206 --> 00:23:16,671
IT STILL WORKS ON THE
SEIZURES AND CELL PHONES.

469
00:23:16,771 --> 00:23:18,005
IT WORKS WITHOUT
THE ILLEGAL TAP.

470
00:23:18,138 --> 00:23:19,571
- YEAH, IT DOES.

471
00:23:19,671 --> 00:23:21,938
AND THEY MADE A BIG DEAL
ABOUT DROPPING MARLO.

472
00:23:22,038 --> 00:23:23,503
THEY CALLED THAT PRESS
CONFERENCE

473
00:23:23,604 --> 00:23:25,004
AND LINKED HIM TO
ALL THE BODIES.

474
00:23:25,137 --> 00:23:27,137
- FOR THEM TO DROP
THE CASE NOW...

475
00:23:27,238 --> 00:23:30,402
- YOU KNOW, YOU THINK
ABOUT IT...

476
00:23:30,603 --> 00:23:35,302
WE'VE GOT ALMOST AS MUCH
ON THEM AS THEY DO ON US.

477
00:23:35,401 --> 00:23:37,102
- THAT TOM WOLFE WANNABE
THINKS HE'S GONNA

478
00:23:37,202 --> 00:23:39,468
GET A PHRASE LIKE THAT
PAST ME?

479
00:23:39,602 --> 00:23:41,134
NO FUCKIN' WAY,
MOTHERFUCKER.

480
00:23:47,867 --> 00:23:50,100
- IT'S LIKE A SWEATER WITH
THE THREADS HANGING OFF.

481
00:23:50,200 --> 00:23:52,599
PULL ANY THREAD...

482
00:23:52,699 --> 00:23:55,266
MOSTLY EXAGGERATIONS
AND TOO-PERFECT QUOTES,

483
00:23:55,398 --> 00:23:56,999
SOMETIMES ON-THE-RECORD.

484
00:23:57,099 --> 00:23:59,464
I CALLED SOME OF THEM BACK,

485
00:23:59,598 --> 00:24:02,798
ASKED IF THEY REALLY
SAID THOSE THINGS.

486
00:24:02,931 --> 00:24:03,931
YOU KNOW WHAT THE CITY
HOUSING COMMISSIONER TOLD ME

487
00:24:04,031 --> 00:24:05,563
ABOUT THE QUOTES IN
THE FLIPPING STORY?

488
00:24:05,663 --> 00:24:06,563
- HMM?

489
00:24:06,697 --> 00:24:08,563
- HE WISHED HE'D SAID
SOME OF THEM,

490
00:24:08,663 --> 00:24:10,963
BUT THAT HE'D NEVER BEEN
THAT SMART IN HIS LIFE.

491
00:24:11,029 --> 00:24:13,696
SOMEONE TAKES
THE TIME TO...

492
00:24:13,796 --> 00:24:16,495
RE-REPORT THIS STUFF,
IT'LL GET UGLY.

493
00:24:16,596 --> 00:24:18,828
WHAT'RE YOU GONNA DO?

494
00:24:18,928 --> 00:24:22,329
- I DON'T KNOW, ROBERT.
I DON'T KNOW.

495
00:24:22,428 --> 00:24:23,827
- KEEP MY NAME OUT OF IT.

496
00:24:34,826 --> 00:24:36,259
- NO BAIL.

497
00:24:36,358 --> 00:24:37,992
THEY'RE CLAIMING A
PROPENSITY FOR VIOLENCE AND

498
00:24:38,092 --> 00:24:40,092
WITNESS INTIMIDATION AT
THE BAIL REVIEW,

499
00:24:40,192 --> 00:24:41,924
TRYING TO HAVE YOU HELD
AS THE KINGPIN.

500
00:24:42,024 --> 00:24:42,991
- THEY CAN DO THAT?

501
00:24:43,091 --> 00:24:44,058
- THEY CAN TRY.

502
00:24:44,158 --> 00:24:47,325
DEPENDS ON WHICH
JUDGE THEY DRAW.

503
00:24:47,423 --> 00:24:49,324
- SO THEY AIN'T GOT NO
BAIL FOR CHRIS, RIGHT?

504
00:24:49,456 --> 00:24:50,523
I MEAN, HE GOT THE
MURDER WARRANT.

505
00:24:50,623 --> 00:24:52,023
- MONK NEITHER.

506
00:24:52,123 --> 00:24:54,022
TOO MUCH WEIGHT IN HIS CAR
AND HE'S ON PAROLE FROM

507
00:24:54,122 --> 00:24:55,223
THE '04 CHARGE.

508
00:24:55,355 --> 00:24:58,056
BEST I COULD DO WAS SPRING
MR. WAGSTAFF ON 300,000.

509
00:24:58,189 --> 00:24:59,323
- HE SHOW THAT KIND
OF MONEY?

510
00:24:59,422 --> 00:25:00,554
- PUT UP HIS UNCLE'S HOUSE
ON SURETY BOND

511
00:25:00,688 --> 00:25:01,654
FOR A THIRD OF IT.

512
00:25:01,754 --> 00:25:04,188
BONDSMAN IS FRONTING
THE REST ON A FAKE LIEN.

513
00:25:06,120 --> 00:25:07,720
RIGHT NOW, THE IMPORTANT
THING IS NOT BAIL,

514
00:25:07,820 --> 00:25:10,753
THE IMPORTANT THING
IS THIS...

515
00:25:10,920 --> 00:25:13,919
I NEED YOU TO TELL ME WHO
ELSE KNEW YOUR CLOCK CODE.

516
00:25:14,019 --> 00:25:15,552
- I TOLD YOU.

517
00:25:15,652 --> 00:25:20,918
ME, CHEESE, MONK, CHRIS
AND THE SUPPLY. THAT'S IT.

518
00:25:21,018 --> 00:25:22,085
- NO ONE ELSE.

519
00:25:22,185 --> 00:25:23,351
- NO ONE ELSE EVEN HAD
MY CELL NUMBER.

520
00:25:23,451 --> 00:25:25,117
EXCEPT YOU.

521
00:25:29,084 --> 00:25:30,317
WHAT?

522
00:25:30,416 --> 00:25:32,482
- THERE'S A LIE
IN HERE SOMEWHERE.

523
00:25:32,583 --> 00:25:33,549
- I AIN'T LYIN'.

524
00:25:33,649 --> 00:25:34,783
- I DON'T MEAN YOU.

525
00:25:34,883 --> 00:25:37,481
LOOK, THE POLICE SAY
A SOURCE TOLD THEM

526
00:25:37,615 --> 00:25:39,715
THAT YOU WERE RE-UPPING
ON THE DAY,

527
00:25:39,815 --> 00:25:41,115
AND WORD OF THAT
MIGHT HAVE SLIPPED OUT.

528
00:25:41,216 --> 00:25:42,581
THAT'S POSSIBLE.

529
00:25:42,681 --> 00:25:44,215
I MEAN, IF YOU WERE
WHOLESALING ALL OVER TOWN...

530
00:25:44,315 --> 00:25:46,380
BUT THEY ONLY GRAB YOUR
CELLS WHEN THEY ARREST YOU

531
00:25:46,447 --> 00:25:49,247
AND THEN THEY HAVE TO
GO GET WARRANTS

532
00:25:49,346 --> 00:25:51,580
BEFORE THEY CAN LOOK AT
THE PHOTOS ON THE PHONES.

533
00:25:51,680 --> 00:25:52,913
AND IT'S ONLY WHEN THEY
GET TO THE PHOTOS

534
00:25:53,013 --> 00:25:55,079
AND BREAK THE CODE

535
00:25:55,179 --> 00:25:56,846
THAT THEY HAVE ENOUGH TO
TYPE A CHARGING DOCUMENT

536
00:25:56,946 --> 00:25:58,512
FOR YOU OR CHRIS, RIGHT?

537
00:25:58,612 --> 00:26:01,744
I MEAN, YOU AREN'T
CAUGHT WITH DRUGS.

538
00:26:01,845 --> 00:26:03,411
BUT THEY HAD THE ARREST
WARRANTS ON BOTH OF YOU

539
00:26:03,511 --> 00:26:05,111
WITHIN A COUPLE HOURS.

540
00:26:05,245 --> 00:26:09,211
WHICH MEANS THAT THEY BROKE
THE CODE ALMOST INSTANTLY,

541
00:26:09,311 --> 00:26:11,376
IN NO TIME AT ALL.

542
00:26:11,476 --> 00:26:13,709
- THEY WIRETAPPED ME.

543
00:26:13,843 --> 00:26:16,442
- MY INVESTIGATOR
THINKS SO.

544
00:26:16,542 --> 00:26:17,843
BUT HE SAYS HE DOESN'T
KNOW FOR SURE WHICH

545
00:26:17,943 --> 00:26:19,641
UNIT RAN THE TAP,
OR WHO MANNED IT.

546
00:26:21,008 --> 00:26:22,808
IT DOESN'T ADD UP.

547
00:26:29,974 --> 00:26:31,706
- YOU GETTIN' OUT.

548
00:26:32,940 --> 00:26:34,339
YOU AIN'T.

549
00:26:35,973 --> 00:26:38,072
YOU HIT THE STREETS,
YOU ROUND UP AS MUCH

550
00:26:38,172 --> 00:26:40,638
MUSCLE AS POSSIBLE
AND GET THAT BOY.

551
00:26:40,772 --> 00:26:42,371
- HE DID SNOOP CUZ
HE KNEW WE WAS ON HIM.

552
00:26:42,471 --> 00:26:43,971
- HE KNEW WE WAS ON HIM CUZ
HE THE ONE TALKED ABOUT

553
00:26:44,071 --> 00:26:45,271
THE DAMN RE-UP.

554
00:26:48,470 --> 00:26:51,037
GET YOUR SHIT TOGETHER,
MAN.

555
00:26:51,137 --> 00:26:53,204
THE BONDSMAN CAME IN
WITH LEVY.

556
00:26:53,304 --> 00:26:55,070
- A'IGHT. I'M ON IT.

557
00:27:06,734 --> 00:27:09,267
- HEY, MAN, YOU GOT A DOLLAR?

558
00:27:10,400 --> 00:27:11,800
C'MON.

559
00:27:35,263 --> 00:27:38,095
- HEY, PAL.

560
00:27:38,196 --> 00:27:39,628
HEY.

561
00:27:40,862 --> 00:27:42,129
HEY.

562
00:27:42,229 --> 00:27:43,862
PAL, YOU ALL RIGHT?

563
00:27:46,028 --> 00:27:47,961
- OKAY, HERE IT COMES...

564
00:27:48,061 --> 00:27:50,793
THE DREADED CRAB CLAW.

565
00:27:52,227 --> 00:27:55,526
YOU KNOW WHAT HAPPENS
WHEN CRAB CLAW GOES...

566
00:27:56,625 --> 00:27:58,859
IT'S ALL CRAB TONIGHT...
- NO CRAB CLAW!

567
00:27:58,959 --> 00:28:01,026
- YES, CRAB CLAW!

568
00:28:01,159 --> 00:28:02,825
YEAH!
CRAB CLAW DOES IT AGAIN.

569
00:28:02,958 --> 00:28:04,091
SIX!

570
00:28:04,192 --> 00:28:05,192
SIX AND I'M OUT...

571
00:28:09,090 --> 00:28:10,323
YEAH?

572
00:28:11,857 --> 00:28:13,390
WHERE?

573
00:28:14,722 --> 00:28:16,422
YOU'RE FUCKING KIDDING ME.

574
00:28:16,522 --> 00:28:18,556
IT'S MORE BULL...

575
00:28:18,656 --> 00:28:20,621
IT'S BOGUS, JAY.
I'M TELLING YOU...

576
00:28:25,189 --> 00:28:26,454
OKAY.

577
00:28:28,520 --> 00:28:30,121
I GOTTA GO.

578
00:28:31,720 --> 00:28:32,986
I HAVE TO KEEP
RUNNING THE STRING OUT.

579
00:28:33,086 --> 00:28:34,220
I HAVE NO CHOICE.

580
00:28:34,319 --> 00:28:36,753
- YOU SAID
THE BOSSES KNOW.

581
00:28:36,853 --> 00:28:38,220
- YEAH.
SOME DO, SOME DON'T.

582
00:28:38,319 --> 00:28:41,052
THE ONES THAT DO
WANT US TO KEEP PRETENDING.

583
00:28:41,186 --> 00:28:42,785
WE STOP PRETENDING,
THEN...

584
00:28:45,450 --> 00:28:50,084
LISTEN, WE'LL FINISH
THIS TOMORROW NIGHT, OKAY?

585
00:28:50,185 --> 00:28:51,650
I'LL SEE YOU IN A BIT.

586
00:29:01,715 --> 00:29:03,215
- WHAT DO YOU THINK?

587
00:29:05,748 --> 00:29:08,314
I MEAN, PUTTIN' MY SHIT
IN THE STREETS, HUH?

588
00:29:11,080 --> 00:29:12,247
- WELL, IT'S YOU.

589
00:29:13,346 --> 00:29:14,513
HE'S GOT YOU.

590
00:29:14,613 --> 00:29:17,146
- YEAH, WELL...

591
00:29:17,280 --> 00:29:19,879
- I MEAN HE'S GOT
WHAT YOU'RE ABOUT.

592
00:29:19,979 --> 00:29:22,945
THE GUY LIKES YOU,
THAT SHOWS THROUGH.

593
00:29:23,045 --> 00:29:25,112
I MEAN, YOU KNOW,
HE'S SAYING THIS GIVING

594
00:29:25,212 --> 00:29:26,912
BACK THAT YOU'RE DOING,
HE'S PUTTING

595
00:29:27,045 --> 00:29:29,443
THAT UP AGAINST SHERROD.

596
00:29:29,544 --> 00:29:33,244
AND HE AIN'T LETTIN' YOU
OFF THE HOOK FOR SHIT, BUT...

597
00:29:33,343 --> 00:29:34,277
HE'S JUST PUTTIN'
IT ALL OUT THERE.

598
00:29:34,409 --> 00:29:35,709
YOU KNOW, THE GOOD
AND THE BAD.

599
00:29:35,776 --> 00:29:37,277
- KNOW WHAT?

600
00:29:40,176 --> 00:29:42,142
THE BAD DON'T BOTHER ME
TO HAVE OUT THERE.

601
00:29:42,242 --> 00:29:44,209
SHIT, I KNOW THE BAD.

602
00:29:44,308 --> 00:29:47,108
I AIN'T LYIN' TO NO ONE
ABOUT THE BAD.

603
00:29:47,208 --> 00:29:49,474
- SCARED OF SOMEBODY
CALLIN' YOU GOOD?

604
00:29:52,207 --> 00:29:54,274
- A LOT OF FOLKS
VOLUNTEER PLACES.

605
00:29:54,373 --> 00:29:55,807
A LOT OF PEOPLE
SHARE AT MEETINGS.

606
00:29:55,907 --> 00:29:57,040
PLENTY OF MOTHERFUCKERS
WAKE UP EVERY DAY

607
00:29:57,140 --> 00:29:58,906
AND NOT GET HIGH.

608
00:29:59,039 --> 00:30:00,839
MAN MAKIN' ME SOUND SPECIAL
FOR DOIN' WHAT THE FUCK

609
00:30:00,939 --> 00:30:02,139
I NEED TO BE DOIN'.

610
00:30:06,337 --> 00:30:07,671
- READ IT, SUCKA.

611
00:30:16,702 --> 00:30:19,170
- "YOU CAN HOLD BACK FROM
THE SUFFERING OF THE WORLD,

612
00:30:19,270 --> 00:30:21,302
"YOU HAVE FREE
PERMISSION TO DO SO,

613
00:30:21,402 --> 00:30:23,568
"AND IT IS IN ACCORDANCE
WITH YOUR NATURE,

614
00:30:23,668 --> 00:30:26,802
"BUT PERHAPS THIS VERY
HOLDING BACK IS THE ONE

615
00:30:26,902 --> 00:30:29,201
SUFFERING YOU COULD
HAVE AVOIDED."

616
00:30:30,268 --> 00:30:32,867
FAN-ZEE KAFKA.

617
00:30:32,967 --> 00:30:34,034
WHO'S HE?

618
00:30:34,134 --> 00:30:35,499
- SOME WRITER.

619
00:30:36,633 --> 00:30:37,633
- YOU READ HIS BOOKS?

620
00:30:37,766 --> 00:30:39,033
- FUCK NO.

621
00:30:39,133 --> 00:30:41,199
BUT YOU REMEMBER FLUBBER?

622
00:30:41,331 --> 00:30:43,999
HE HANDED THAT TO ME
THE NIGHT THAT

623
00:30:44,099 --> 00:30:46,931
HE HAD ME START LEADING
THE SAINT MARTIN MEETING.

624
00:30:48,364 --> 00:30:50,297
I KEPT IT EVER SINCE.

625
00:30:51,764 --> 00:30:53,296
- WHAT IT MEAN TO YOU?

626
00:30:57,630 --> 00:30:59,529
- YOU WANT THESE?

627
00:30:59,629 --> 00:31:01,562
- YEAH, MY MAN SAY HE
NEED IT BACK AND

628
00:31:01,662 --> 00:31:02,929
NOT TO MAKE ANY COPIES.

629
00:31:04,629 --> 00:31:05,995
HE SAYIN' HE AIN'T
SUPPOSED TO SHOW IT

630
00:31:06,095 --> 00:31:07,928
TO ME BEFORE IT GOES
IN THE PAPER.

631
00:31:08,028 --> 00:31:09,327
I MEAN, IF I LET HIM.

632
00:31:09,427 --> 00:31:10,828
- YOU GONNA?

633
00:31:14,860 --> 00:31:16,660
- THANKS FOR THE CRABS.

634
00:31:17,859 --> 00:31:19,859
- YEP.

635
00:31:22,359 --> 00:31:23,725
- GRAY VAN.

636
00:31:25,358 --> 00:31:26,525
YOU GET THE TAG?

637
00:31:26,625 --> 00:31:28,491
- I COULDN'T SEE IT
FROM WHERE I WAS.

638
00:31:28,591 --> 00:31:30,057
- DESCRIBE THE DRIVER.

639
00:31:30,191 --> 00:31:32,024
- WHITE. SIX FOOT.

640
00:31:32,124 --> 00:31:35,124
NOT HEAVY,
NOT SKINNY EITHER.

641
00:31:35,224 --> 00:31:36,422
- CLOTHES?

642
00:31:36,523 --> 00:31:38,823
- NOTHING I NOTICED.
KINDA NON-DESCRIPT.

643
00:31:38,923 --> 00:31:40,422
- NON-DESCRIPT?

644
00:31:40,523 --> 00:31:41,855
- I WAS SURPRISED, I GUESS.

645
00:31:41,955 --> 00:31:43,688
I JU THOUGHT, WHOA,
WHAT'S HE DOING?

646
00:31:43,789 --> 00:31:45,822
- FUNNY IT BEIN'
YOU TO SEE THIS.

647
00:31:45,922 --> 00:31:47,821
- IT'S WEIRD. IF AN INTERVIEW
DOESN'T RUN LATE,

648
00:31:47,954 --> 00:31:50,654
I'M NOT EVEN HERE TONIGHT.

649
00:31:50,754 --> 00:31:52,888
YOU MIND IF I GET INSIDE?
I GOTTA CHECK IN WITH MY DESK.

650
00:31:53,021 --> 00:31:55,120
YOU NEED ANYTHING ELSE,
YOU GOT MY NUMBER.

651
00:31:55,220 --> 00:31:56,254
- YEAH.

652
00:32:02,019 --> 00:32:03,719
- THAT GUY'S AN ASSHOLE.

653
00:32:03,819 --> 00:32:06,317
THIS SMOKEHOUND
CAN'T REMEMBER A THING.

654
00:32:06,451 --> 00:32:07,484
ONLY MOTHERFUCKER HE
REMEMBERS MESSIN'

655
00:32:07,584 --> 00:32:09,284
WITH HIM IS THE FELLA
THAT FOUND HIM.

656
00:32:09,384 --> 00:32:11,785
WHATEVER HAPPENED BEFORE
THAT IS ANYONE'S GUESS.

657
00:32:12,850 --> 00:32:14,750
- HEY.

658
00:32:15,750 --> 00:32:17,750
SOMEONE TRY TO KIDNAP YOU?

659
00:32:17,817 --> 00:32:19,083
DRAG YOU INTO A VAN?

660
00:32:19,183 --> 00:32:20,183
- OK.

661
00:32:20,282 --> 00:32:22,682
- WHO WAS TRYING TO HURT YOU?
- MY FATHER.

662
00:32:22,816 --> 00:32:24,681
BUT HE WAS A DRUNK.

663
00:32:24,782 --> 00:32:26,548
- DETECTIVE,
THERE'S A VAGRANT OVER HERE

664
00:32:31,881 --> 00:32:33,214
- WHAT DID YOU SEE, FELLA?

665
00:32:38,846 --> 00:32:40,713
- McNULTY?

666
00:32:42,311 --> 00:32:43,378
JOHNNY WEAVER. TACTICAL.

667
00:32:43,478 --> 00:32:44,812
- FUCK YOU.
WHY DIDN'T YOU SAY SO?

668
00:32:44,912 --> 00:32:45,812
- J.W.

669
00:32:45,945 --> 00:32:47,246
TRYIN' TO KEEP YOUR COVER,
HUH?

670
00:32:47,378 --> 00:32:48,278
IT'S BETTER FOR EVERYONE
DOWN HERE THINKS I'M

671
00:32:48,377 --> 00:32:50,211
ONE OF THE REGULARS,
RIGHT?

672
00:32:50,310 --> 00:32:52,344
ANYWAY, WHAT'S THE
RUCKUS WITH PETEY?

673
00:32:52,444 --> 00:32:54,310
-THE DRUNK?
- YEAH.

674
00:32:55,843 --> 00:32:57,543
SUN REPORTER SAYS HE'S
GOING INTO HIS BUILDING,

675
00:32:57,676 --> 00:32:58,610
HE SEES A GUY TRYING
TO DRAG HIM INTO

676
00:32:58,710 --> 00:33:00,575
A GREY VAN.

677
00:33:00,675 --> 00:33:01,976
IT'S BULLSHIT, RIGHT?

678
00:33:02,076 --> 00:33:03,509
- YEAH. PETEY WAS LAYIN'
THERE FORTY-FIVE MINUTES

679
00:33:03,609 --> 00:33:06,308
BEFORE THAT PREPPY COCKSUCKER
EVEN PARKS HIS CAR.

680
00:33:06,408 --> 00:33:08,075
- THANKS.
- NO PROBLEM.

681
00:33:08,208 --> 00:33:10,574
HEY, GIMME A DOLLAR,
MAKE IT LOOK RIGHT.

682
00:33:14,007 --> 00:33:15,340
- THANK YOU, JOHNNY.

683
00:33:17,174 --> 00:33:18,273
- WHAT ABOUT THE REPORTER?

684
00:33:18,373 --> 00:33:22,639
YOU COULD CHARGE
FALSE STATEMENT, YOU KNOW.

685
00:33:22,773 --> 00:33:24,773
- YOU LOCK UP EVERY LIAR,
THERE'S NO ROOM IN B.D.C.

686
00:33:24,873 --> 00:33:26,838
FOR ANYONE ELSE, RIGHT?

687
00:33:26,938 --> 00:33:29,172
MORE TROUBLE THAN IT'S WORTH.

688
00:33:29,271 --> 00:33:31,171
JAY, IT'S HORSESHIT.
I'M GOIN' HOME.

689
00:33:31,270 --> 00:33:33,138
YEAH.

690
00:34:13,564 --> 00:34:15,930
- BROUGHT HOME SOME CRABS.

691
00:34:16,030 --> 00:34:17,964
- I ALREADY MADE DINNER.

692
00:34:18,064 --> 00:34:18,964
- PUT 'EM IN THE FRIDGE.

693
00:34:19,064 --> 00:34:20,429
COLD FOR LUNCH TOMORROW
IF YOU LIKE.

694
00:34:20,529 --> 00:34:22,629
I CAN'T EAT 'EM ALL.

695
00:34:34,427 --> 00:34:36,494
- WE DON'T RUN THIS SHIT,
ESPECIALLY NOT OFF THE FRONT.

696
00:34:36,594 --> 00:34:37,827
- I SAW WHAT I SAW.

697
00:34:37,927 --> 00:34:40,593
- ALMA IS ON THE PHONE
WITH POLICE P.I.O.

698
00:34:40,726 --> 00:34:42,960
AND THEY ARE TELLING US
ON THE RECORD AND OFF

699
00:34:43,060 --> 00:34:44,992
THAT THEY ARE
DISCOUNTING ANY REPORT OF

700
00:34:45,092 --> 00:34:46,658
A POSSIBLE ABDUCTION.

701
00:34:46,759 --> 00:34:48,492
- THAT MAY BE.
BUT THAT DOESN'T MEAN
THEY'RE DOING THEIR JOB,

702
00:34:48,592 --> 00:34:49,492
AND IT DOESN'T MEAN
WE SHOULDN'T BE--

703
00:34:49,592 --> 00:34:50,924
- OUR JOB IS TO REPORT
THE NEWS,

704
00:34:51,024 --> 00:34:52,324
NOT TO MANUFACTURE IT.

705
00:34:55,390 --> 00:34:56,556
- NICE.

706
00:35:03,989 --> 00:35:05,255
- I KNOW THAT THEY'RE
JEALOUS OF HOW MUCH PLAY

707
00:35:05,355 --> 00:35:07,255
HIS STORIES GET,
BUT THE TRUTH IS...

708
00:35:07,355 --> 00:35:10,588
- WE CANNOT RUN THIS SHIT.

709
00:35:10,688 --> 00:35:13,755
- ARE YOU SUGGESTING THAT
SCOTT MADE ANY OF THIS UP?

710
00:35:16,286 --> 00:35:19,386
- YOU EVER NOTICE THAT
THE GUYS WHO DO THAT...

711
00:35:19,520 --> 00:35:21,452
THE BLAIRS, THE GLASSES,
THE KELLEYS.

712
00:35:21,552 --> 00:35:23,419
THEY ALWAYS START
WITH SOMETHING SMALL,

713
00:35:23,519 --> 00:35:25,252
YOU KNOW, JUST A LITTLE
QUOTE THAT THEY CLEAN UP,

714
00:35:25,352 --> 00:35:27,284
AND THEN, THEN IT'S
A WHOLE ANECDOTE,

715
00:35:27,384 --> 00:35:30,485
AND PRETTY SOON THEY'RE SEEING
SOME AMAZING SHIT.

716
00:35:30,585 --> 00:35:32,284
THEY'RE THE LUCKY ONES
WHO JUST HAPPEN

717
00:35:32,384 --> 00:35:34,784
TO BE STANDING ON THE
RIGHT STREET CORNER

718
00:35:34,884 --> 00:35:37,184
IN TEL AVIV WHEN
THE PIZZA JOINT BLOWS UP

719
00:35:37,283 --> 00:35:38,684
AND THE HUMAN HEAD ROLLS
DOWN THE STREET

720
00:35:38,784 --> 00:35:39,716
WITH THE EYES STILL BLINKING.

721
00:35:39,816 --> 00:35:41,549
- THOSE PICTURES WERE
SENT TO HIM.

722
00:35:41,649 --> 00:35:42,950
THE POLICE HAVE CONFIRMED...

723
00:35:43,050 --> 00:35:46,248
- IT ALWAYS STARTS
WITH SOMETHING TRUE,

724
00:35:46,348 --> 00:35:48,381
SOMETHING CONFIRMED.

725
00:35:48,482 --> 00:35:50,281
BUT THEN YOU'VE GOT A
SON OF A BITCH WHO JUST

726
00:35:50,381 --> 00:35:52,481
HAPPENS TO BE WALKING
IN THE GUILFORD ENTRANCE

727
00:35:52,614 --> 00:35:54,447
WHEN THE MYSTERIOUS
GRAY VAN COMES--

728
00:35:54,581 --> 00:35:58,246
- GUS, THIS HAS GOTTEN
PERSONAL BETWEEN YOU AND SCOTT

729
00:35:58,346 --> 00:36:00,913
AND IT'S AFFECTING
YOUR JUDGMENT.

730
00:36:01,047 --> 00:36:02,379
I'M MOVING THE STORY
THROUGH THE STATE DESK.

731
00:36:02,480 --> 00:36:05,812
YOU SHOULD GO HOME,
THINK THIS THROUGH.

732
00:36:05,912 --> 00:36:08,079
WE'LL TALK IN THE MORNING.

733
00:36:15,877 --> 00:36:18,977
- MAYBE YOU WIN A
PULITZER WITH THIS STUFF.

734
00:36:19,977 --> 00:36:21,509
AND MAYBE YOU GOTTA
GIVE IT BACK.

735
00:36:24,242 --> 00:36:26,275
- IT'S IN MY NOTES, GUS.
EVERYTHING THAT HAPPENED.

736
00:36:26,375 --> 00:36:28,875
EVERYTHING THAT GUY SAID
WHEN I GOT TO HIM.

737
00:36:28,975 --> 00:36:31,575
EVERY LAST WORD IS
IN MY NOTES.

738
00:36:53,304 --> 00:36:55,537
- HOME EARLIER THAN
I THOUGHT.

739
00:36:55,637 --> 00:36:58,004
- YEAH. HOME.

740
00:37:13,102 --> 00:37:15,001
- HE HIT AGAIN.

972
