YOU'RE GONNA LOSE
THE PHONES.

973
00:48:34,522 --> 00:48:37,155
- EVERHART, TWO-SEVENTY-FOUR,

974
00:48:37,255 --> 00:48:38,588
MARYLAND FOUR-FIFTY-NINE.

975
00:48:38,688 --> 00:48:40,555
OR CECCOLINI,
FOUR-THIRTY-FIVE,

976
00:48:40,655 --> 00:48:41,955
U.S. TWO-SIXTY-EIGHT.

977
00:48:44,420 --> 00:48:47,153
LYING COPS DON'T
AUTOMATICALLY KILL A CASE.

978
00:48:47,287 --> 00:48:50,054
- BUT THAT'S A LOT OF RISK
ON APPEAL...

979
00:48:50,153 --> 00:48:52,419
AND A LOT OF DIRT FOR
YOUR OFFICE TO SHOW.

980
00:48:53,786 --> 00:48:55,252
NO.

981
00:48:55,353 --> 00:48:57,118
YOU'RE SCARED
OF THE LIGHT.

982
00:48:57,218 --> 00:49:01,485
PARTLOW TAKES HIS CHANCES
ON THE LEGIT MURDER CHARGE ONLY.

983
00:49:01,619 --> 00:49:03,951
THE CONSPIRACY COUNT
GOES AND STANFIELD

984
00:49:04,051 --> 00:49:05,517
AND THE REST WALK.

985
00:49:05,618 --> 00:49:07,085
- STANFIELD WALKS.

986
00:49:07,184 --> 00:49:10,116
BUT THE CASE GOES ON
THE STET DOCKET,

987
00:49:10,216 --> 00:49:11,883
NOT DISMISSED OUTRIGHT.

988
00:49:11,984 --> 00:49:14,350
AND ALTHOUGH I CAN TELL
YOU THERE ARE PEOPLE

989
00:49:14,450 --> 00:49:15,716
IN THIS CITY WHO CAN'T
TOLERATE A SCANDAL AT

990
00:49:15,816 --> 00:49:17,749
THIS PARTICULAR MOMENT,
THAT DYNAMIC CHANGES

991
00:49:17,882 --> 00:49:19,115
AFTER NOVEMBER.

992
00:49:19,215 --> 00:49:20,282
- THE ELECTIONS...

993
00:49:20,415 --> 00:49:22,615
- AFTER NOVEMBER,
NO ONE IS GOING TO CARE

994
00:49:22,715 --> 00:49:25,348
AS MUCH ABOUT SHOWING DIRT.

995
00:49:25,481 --> 00:49:27,580
IF CARCETTI WINS,
HE'S IN ANNAPOLIS.

996
00:49:27,714 --> 00:49:29,347
IF HE LOSES,
HE'S AN INCUMBENT MAYOR

997
00:49:29,480 --> 00:49:30,413
WHO CAN TAKE A HIT OR TWO.

998
00:49:30,513 --> 00:49:32,847
SO YOU TELL
MR. STANFIELD THAT THIS

999
00:49:32,947 --> 00:49:35,746
IS HIS ONLY WINDOW.

1000
00:49:35,846 --> 00:49:38,179
PARTLOW PLEADS TO ALL
THE MURDERS

1001
00:49:38,279 --> 00:49:41,411
AND BOTH LIEUTENANTS
PLEAD TO THE DRUGS.

1002
00:49:41,545 --> 00:49:44,278
THEN STANFIELD RETIRES.

1003
00:49:44,378 --> 00:49:45,844
HE'S DONE.

1004
00:49:45,944 --> 00:49:48,544
WE EVEN GET THE SCENT OF HIM
ON THE STREET EVER AGAIN,

1005
00:49:48,644 --> 00:49:51,977
THIS CASE COMES OFF STET
AND GOES TO TRIAL.

1006
00:49:52,077 --> 00:49:53,743
AND IF WE HAVE TO PUT
A FEW COPS IN JAIL

1007
00:49:53,843 --> 00:49:55,676
RIGHT BEHIND HIM, SO BE IT.

1008
00:49:55,776 --> 00:49:58,141
WE'LL BRING THE EVIDENCE
AND TAKE A HIT.

1009
00:49:58,241 --> 00:50:00,308
YOUR CLIENT WALKS
AWAY NOW...

1010
00:50:01,709 --> 00:50:04,307
OR THE BOTH OF YOU
DON'T WALK AT ALL.

1011
00:50:28,770 --> 00:50:30,971
- LET'S GO. GET UP.

1012
00:50:47,034 --> 00:50:48,567
- THAT'S MINE.

1013
00:50:49,801 --> 00:50:51,233
- IT'S YOURS. I KNOW.

1014
00:51:04,431 --> 00:51:05,931
- DO YOU HAVE A CARD?

1015
00:51:16,396 --> 00:51:17,829
THAT'S NOT A CARD.

1016
00:51:19,862 --> 00:51:22,596
- WE MET BEFORE,
YOU REMEMBER?

1017
00:51:22,695 --> 00:51:24,227
- LIAR.

1018
00:51:26,294 --> 00:51:28,628
BLACK LIAR.

1019
00:51:28,760 --> 00:51:30,493
- WHY'D YOU KILL
YOUR FRIEND?

1020
00:51:34,427 --> 00:51:36,492
- HE DRINKS...

1021
00:51:36,593 --> 00:51:38,693
HE'S ALWAYS DRINKING.

1022
00:51:38,793 --> 00:51:41,325
- BUT YOU PUT A
RIBBON AROUND HIS WRIST.

1023
00:51:41,425 --> 00:51:42,592
LIKE THE OTHERS.

1024
00:51:43,892 --> 00:51:45,091
- YEAH.

1025
00:51:45,158 --> 00:51:46,558
- DID YOU SEE THAT
ON TELEVISION?

1026
00:51:47,557 --> 00:51:49,891
THE RIBBON ON THE WRIST?

1027
00:51:49,991 --> 00:51:52,791
DID YOU HEAR ABOUT THAT
FROM OTHER PEOPLE?

1028
00:51:52,891 --> 00:51:55,189
WHY'D YOU DO THE THING
WITH THE RIBBON?

1029
00:51:55,289 --> 00:51:56,590
- NOBODY UNDERSTANDS.

1030
00:51:59,057 --> 00:52:00,455
YOU DON'T UNDERSTAND.

1031
00:52:03,388 --> 00:52:05,721
I ALWAYS KNOW WHAT
I'M GOING TO DO...

1032
00:52:07,588 --> 00:52:10,588
BEFORE I DO IT. OKAY?

1033
00:52:10,688 --> 00:52:13,320
I ALWAYS KNOW WHAT
I'M GOING TO DO.

1034
00:52:13,420 --> 00:52:16,153
- DID YOU KILL THE OTHERS?
DID YOU KILL ALL OF THEM?

1035
00:52:16,253 --> 00:52:17,519
- EVERY ONE OF THEM.

1036
00:52:21,953 --> 00:52:25,052
I DID IT BECAUSE I KNEW
I WAS GOING TO DO IT.

1037
00:52:30,116 --> 00:52:33,450
I'VE KILLED MILLIONS.

1038
00:52:33,584 --> 00:52:37,983
OKAY?
AND THEY ALL KILLED ME.

1039
00:52:38,082 --> 00:52:40,016
- SO YOU DID ALL
THE MURDERS, HUH?

1040
00:52:44,049 --> 00:52:46,114
- YOU'RE A COWARD.

1041
00:52:48,547 --> 00:52:49,747
I CAN TELL.

1042
00:52:53,048 --> 00:53:00,245
HEY, DO YOU HAVE
A CARD?

1043
00:53:00,412 --> 00:53:04,745
- JIMMY, REPORTER'S IN THERE
WAITING FOR A PHOTO ARRAY.

1044
00:53:04,845 --> 00:53:06,411
- WHAT?

1045
00:53:06,511 --> 00:53:08,444
JAY, HE'S BULLSHIT.

1046
00:53:08,544 --> 00:53:09,978
- I KNOW HE IS.

1047
00:53:10,077 --> 00:53:11,744
BUT THE NEWSPAPER MADE
SUCH A FUSS THE MAJOR

1048
00:53:11,844 --> 00:53:13,944
WANTS US TO JERK HIM OFF,
JUST TO SAY WE DID.

1049
00:53:28,241 --> 00:53:29,975
- HEY, DETECTIVE.

1050
00:53:34,907 --> 00:53:36,540
UM...

1051
00:53:42,072 --> 00:53:44,805
- NO GRAY VAN EITHER.

1052
00:53:44,905 --> 00:53:45,872
- W-WHAT...

1053
00:53:45,972 --> 00:53:47,405
- HE DOESN'T HAVE A GREY VAN.

1054
00:53:56,336 --> 00:53:57,970
NO GRAY VAN.

1055
00:53:58,102 --> 00:54:00,202
AND HE DIDN'T CALL YOU
ON THE PHONE EITHER, DID HE?

1056
00:54:00,303 --> 00:54:02,068
HE DIDN'T CALL YOU
THE FIRST TIME

1057
00:54:02,168 --> 00:54:03,435
AND HE DIDN'T CALL
YOU THE SECOND.

1058
00:54:03,535 --> 00:54:05,302
I DID THAT.

1059
00:54:05,402 --> 00:54:08,434
YEW MORTIFY ME
IN FRONTA MY FATHA...

1060
00:54:08,534 --> 00:54:10,200
AND THOSE PICTURES YOU GOT.

1061
00:54:10,301 --> 00:54:11,734
I TOOK THOSE.

1062
00:54:11,868 --> 00:54:14,366
AND THE MISSING GUY?
HE'S MY SECOND COUSIN.

1063
00:54:14,500 --> 00:54:17,233
WE SENT HIM UP TO ATLANTIC CITY
WITH A ROLL OF QUARTERS.

1064
00:54:18,433 --> 00:54:20,198
AND YOU KNOW WHY I CAN
TELL YOU ALL THIS?

1065
00:54:20,299 --> 00:54:22,632
BECAUSE,
YOU LYIN' MOTHERFUCKER,

1066
00:54:22,732 --> 00:54:24,799
YOU'RE AS FULL
OF SHIT AS I AM,

1067
00:54:24,899 --> 00:54:26,298
AND YOU'VE GOT TO LIVE
WITH IT AND PLAY IT OUT

1068
00:54:26,398 --> 00:54:29,898
FOR AS LONG AS IT GOES.
RIGHT?

1069
00:54:29,998 --> 00:54:31,630
TRAPPED IN THE SAME LIE.

1070
00:54:32,931 --> 00:54:35,864
ONLY DIFFERENCE IS
I KNOW WHY I DID IT...

1071
00:54:35,964 --> 00:54:37,263
AND FUCK IF I CAN
FIGURE OUT WHAT IT GETS YOU

1072
00:54:37,363 --> 00:54:39,062
IN THE END.

1073
00:54:39,195 --> 00:54:41,863
BUT HEY, I AIN'T PART
OF YOUR TRIBE.

1074
00:54:41,963 --> 00:54:42,896
- YOU'RE NOT SERIOUS...
YOU CAN'T...

1075
00:54:42,996 --> 00:54:44,061
- NO.

1076
00:54:45,328 --> 00:54:46,828
NO, I'M A FUCKING JOKE...

1077
00:54:48,428 --> 00:54:49,894
AND SO ARE YOU.

1078
00:54:54,193 --> 00:54:55,960
NOW GET THE FUCK
OUT OF HERE.

1079
00:55:32,954 --> 00:55:34,120
- YOU WALK.

1080
00:55:35,620 --> 00:55:37,687
CHRIS EATS THE MURDERS,
EVERY LAST ONE,

1081
00:55:37,820 --> 00:55:39,085
TAKES LIFE WITH NO PAROLE.

1082
00:55:39,152 --> 00:55:40,786
- NO PAROLE?
- NO SHOT.

1083
00:55:40,886 --> 00:55:43,020
BUT THEY'VE GOT HIM COLD
ON THE ONE WITH THE D.N.A.

1084
00:55:43,119 --> 00:55:44,652
CAN YOU SELL THAT?
IS CHRIS LOYAL?

1085
00:55:44,752 --> 00:55:46,118
- YEAH.

1086
00:55:47,685 --> 00:55:49,919
AS LONG AS I TAKE CARE
OF HIS PEOPLE.

1087
00:55:50,019 --> 00:55:51,684
- CHEESE AND MONK ARE
LOOKING AT UP TO TWENTY

1088
00:55:51,784 --> 00:55:53,183
FOR THE DRUGS.

1089
00:55:53,284 --> 00:55:55,584
BUT THERE'S GONNA BE NO
ASSETS INVESTIGATION

1090
00:55:55,684 --> 00:55:57,283
AND YOU COME HOME
WITH ALL YOUR MONEY.

1091
00:55:58,683 --> 00:56:00,950
- WHY THEY LETTING ME WALK?

1092
00:56:01,082 --> 00:56:03,448
- THEY DON'T WANT TO,
BUT THERE'S SOME SHIT

1093
00:56:03,549 --> 00:56:04,715
IN THEIR CASE AND
THEY'D RATHER NOT SHOW

1094
00:56:04,815 --> 00:56:06,415
IT IN COURT.

1095
00:56:06,515 --> 00:56:07,749
BUT HERE'S THE RUB:

1096
00:56:07,882 --> 00:56:09,814
IF YOU STAY IN THE GAME,

1097
00:56:09,948 --> 00:56:12,015
THEY WILL.
THEY DEFINITELY WILL.

1098
00:56:12,114 --> 00:56:13,981
RIGHT NOW, WITH AN
ELECTION GOING ON,

1099
00:56:14,080 --> 00:56:15,747
THEY'RE WILLING TO
GIVE YOU A BUY.

1100
00:56:15,847 --> 00:56:17,780
BUT AFTER NOVEMBER,
IF THEY EVEN THINK

1101
00:56:17,880 --> 00:56:20,713
YOU'RE STILL A PLAYER,
THEY CAN TAKE THIS CASE

1102
00:56:20,813 --> 00:56:22,679
DOWN OFF THE SHELF AND
THE SHIT IN THE CASE

1103
00:56:22,779 --> 00:56:24,512
MIGHT NOT BE ENOUGH
TO KEEP YOU FREE.

1104
00:56:26,178 --> 00:56:27,978
DO YOU UNDERSTAND?

1105
00:56:28,111 --> 00:56:29,344
- GIVE UP THE CROWN.

1106
00:56:31,878 --> 00:56:35,610
- WELL, THAT'S THE DEAL,
KIDDO.

1107
00:56:35,710 --> 00:56:37,243
THERE'S NOT A LAWYER WHO
COULD GET BETTER FOR YOU.

1108
00:56:52,774 --> 00:56:53,941
- HOW'D THAT GO, BOSS?

1109
00:56:55,807 --> 00:56:59,740
- KIDDO, YOU ARE A GOLDMINE
TO ME. YOU KNOW THAT?

1110
00:56:59,840 --> 00:57:01,873
YOU'VE TAKEN THIS LAW FIRM
TO A WHOLE NEW LEVEL.

1111
00:57:01,973 --> 00:57:03,206
- ME?

1112
00:57:03,306 --> 00:57:04,805
- YOU DON'T TIP ME TO
THAT BAD WIRETAP,

1113
00:57:04,906 --> 00:57:05,972
I'VE GOT ALL KINDS
OF TROUBLE.

1114
00:57:06,071 --> 00:57:07,739
BUT NOW, IF MARLO
TAKES THE DEAL,

1115
00:57:07,839 --> 00:57:10,271
HE'S GONNA GET A WALK
AFTER BEING CHARGED

1116
00:57:10,371 --> 00:57:12,237
IN A MULTIMILLION
DOLLAR DRUG SEIZURE.

1117
00:57:12,337 --> 00:57:14,371
THAT DOESN'T HAPPEN
VERY OFTEN,

1118
00:57:14,471 --> 00:57:16,403
AND WHEN IT DOES HAPPEN,
THE NAME AND NUMBER

1119
00:57:16,503 --> 00:57:18,103
OF THE DEFENSE ATTORNEY
GOES IN THE FRONT

1120
00:57:18,203 --> 00:57:20,203
POCKET OF EVERY RESPECTABLE
DRUG TRAFFICKER.

1121
00:57:21,537 --> 00:57:23,402
YOU'RE A GENIUS FOR WHAT
YOU BROUGHT ME ON THIS.

1122
00:57:23,536 --> 00:57:24,736
- I'M JUST DOIN'
WHAT I DO, RIGHT?

1123
00:57:24,869 --> 00:57:27,536
YOU NEED TO KNOW SOMETHING,
ALL YOU GOTTA DO IS ASK.

1124
00:57:27,636 --> 00:57:29,101
THAT'S WHAT A DETECTIVE IS,
RIGHT?

1125
00:57:29,201 --> 00:57:30,401
- HERE.

1126
00:57:30,501 --> 00:57:32,701
YOU SHOULD COME OVER
FOR DINNER TONIGHT.

1127
00:57:32,801 --> 00:57:34,367
YVETTE'S MAKING BRISKET.

1128
00:57:34,467 --> 00:57:35,667
- YOUR HOUSE?

1129
00:57:36,834 --> 00:57:38,166
- YOU'RE MISHPUCHA NOW.

1130
00:57:45,399 --> 00:57:46,932
- IF YOU SAY SO.

1131
00:57:58,163 --> 00:57:59,463
- IT'S DOWN.

1132
00:57:59,563 --> 00:58:00,796
- NOT THAT THIS THING
IS EVER GOING TO TRIAL.

1133
00:58:00,897 --> 00:58:02,863
GUY HAS N.C.R. WRITTEN
ALL OVER HIM.

1134
00:58:02,963 --> 00:58:04,263
- CAN'T ARGUE.

1135
00:58:04,363 --> 00:58:06,228
A PADDED ROOM AT CLIFTON T.
PERKINS IS DEFINITELY

1136
00:58:06,328 --> 00:58:07,829
CALLED FOR.

1137
00:58:07,929 --> 00:58:09,295
- HE GO FOR ALL OF THEM?

1138
00:58:09,395 --> 00:58:10,594
- NO, SIR.
JUST THE LAST TWO.

1139
00:58:10,728 --> 00:58:11,828
- HE DENY THE OTHERS?

1140
00:58:11,928 --> 00:58:13,861
- HE AIN'T EXACTLY
DENYING ANYTHING IN THERE.

1141
00:58:13,995 --> 00:58:16,261
I MEAN, HE'LL COP TO
ANYTHING WE DAMN PLEASE...

1142
00:58:16,361 --> 00:58:17,793
- THEN GO BACK AND GET IT.

1143
00:58:17,860 --> 00:58:20,527
- EXCUSE ME?

1144
00:58:20,627 --> 00:58:22,059
IF HE'S N.C.R.,
WHAT THE FUCK IS

1145
00:58:22,159 --> 00:58:24,158
THE DIFFERENCE IF HE
COPS TO TWO OR SIX?

1146
00:58:24,259 --> 00:58:26,792
EITHER WAY, THEY TIE HIS
ARMS AND FEED HIM GREEN JELL-O.

1147
00:58:26,893 --> 00:58:28,259
- SIR, HE DID THE LAST TWO.

1148
00:58:29,992 --> 00:58:33,658
- MOTHERFUCKER,
YOU ARE A CUNT HAIR AWAY

1149
00:58:33,758 --> 00:58:36,090
FROM INDICTMENT AND YOU
SEE FIT TO ARGUE WITH ME?

1150
00:58:38,724 --> 00:58:41,256
- I DID WHAT I DID.
I KNOW.

1151
00:58:41,356 --> 00:58:43,422
AND NOW, I'M STANDING
RESPONSIBLE FOR TWO FRESH
MURDERS.

1152
00:58:43,556 --> 00:58:45,122
I KNOW WHAT
I'VE DONE HERE.

1153
00:58:46,356 --> 00:58:47,655
BUT I'M NOT DOING THIS.

1154
00:58:57,153 --> 00:58:59,153
- THIS IS OVER.

1155
00:59:00,286 --> 00:59:02,052
AND ALL OF OUR CITIZENS
CAN REST SOUNDLY

1156
00:59:02,152 --> 00:59:04,086
IN THE KNOWLEDGE THAT
THE MAN RESPONSIBLE

1157
00:59:04,186 --> 00:59:06,519
HAS BEEN APPREHENDED
BY THE DILIGENT

1158
00:59:06,619 --> 00:59:07,752
EFFORTS OF INVESTIGATORS.

1159
00:59:07,852 --> 00:59:09,752
- MR. MAYOR,
IS HE BEING CHARGED WITH

1160
00:59:09,852 --> 00:59:11,718
ALL OF THE MURDERS,
OR JUST TWO...

1161
00:59:11,818 --> 00:59:16,684
- UM, IT IS MY
UNDERSTANDING THAT, UH...

1162
00:59:16,751 --> 00:59:20,517
- UH, WE ARE CHARGING
THE LAST TWO INCIDENTS,

1163
00:59:20,617 --> 00:59:22,083
BUT IT IS MY
UNDERSTANDING THAT

1164
00:59:22,183 --> 00:59:24,115
HE IS SUSPECTED IN
ALL OF THE CRIMES.

1165
00:59:24,249 --> 00:59:26,082
AND WE'RE WAITING FOR
DNA TEST RESULTS.

1166
00:59:26,215 --> 00:59:28,549
INDICATIONS ARE THAT HE
MAY BE MENTALLY INCAPACITATED

1167
00:59:28,682 --> 00:59:32,348
AND THEREFORE
ADDITIONAL PROSECUTIONS WOULD

1168
00:59:32,448 --> 00:59:33,781
PROVE REDUNDANT.

1169
00:59:33,882 --> 00:59:35,214
- I'D ALSO LIKE TO CREDIT
DEPUTY COMMISSIONER FOR

1170
00:59:35,314 --> 00:59:38,146
OPERATIONS DANIELS
WITH NOT ONLY BRINGING THESE

1171
00:59:38,247 --> 00:59:39,847
CASES TO THEIR
PROPER CONCLUSION,

1172
00:59:39,947 --> 00:59:42,713
BUT BUT ALSO FOR SOLVING
LAST YEAR'S SLAYINGS

1173
00:59:42,813 --> 00:59:44,713
IN THE VACANT ROWHOUSES.

1174
00:59:44,813 --> 00:59:46,946
HE HAS GIVEN US SUCH
EXCELLENT WORK THAT

1175
00:59:47,045 --> 00:59:49,578
I THINK THAT NOW IS AS GOOD
A TIME AS ANY TO ANNOUNCE

1176
00:59:49,712 --> 00:59:52,411
THAT WE WILL BE SENDING
THE DEPUTY'S NAME FORWARD

1177
00:59:52,512 --> 00:59:54,711
TO THE CITY COUNCIL
FOR CONFIRMATION AS

1178
00:59:54,811 --> 00:59:55,978
BALTIMORE POLICE COMMISSIONER.

1179
00:59:59,477 --> 01:00:00,877
ACTING COMMISSIONER RAWLS,
TO WHOM I AM ALSO

1180
01:00:00,977 --> 01:00:03,543
EXTREMELY GRATEFUL,
WILL SERVE IN AN

1181
01:00:03,676 --> 01:00:05,776
ADVISORY CAPACITY PENDING
NEW RESPONSIBILITIES

1182
01:00:05,910 --> 01:00:07,275
AT CITY HALL.

1183
01:00:22,240 --> 01:00:24,139
- SCOTT, YOU SHOULD BE
WORKING THE MAIN BAR

1184
01:00:24,240 --> 01:00:25,439
ON THE ARREST WITH ALMA.

1185
01:00:25,539 --> 01:00:26,739
- I AM...

1186
01:00:26,873 --> 01:00:28,472
- WE'RE GOING TO WANT
YOUR BYLINE IN THIS COVERAGE.

1187
01:00:29,839 --> 01:00:31,304
- YEAH, I DON'T FEEL
SO WELL

1188
01:00:31,404 --> 01:00:32,638
MY STOMACH...

1189
01:00:34,271 --> 01:00:36,271
I THINK I GOTTA GO HOME.

1190
01:00:36,371 --> 01:00:37,704
SORRY.

1191
01:01:25,230 --> 01:01:26,863
- HAVING DUCKED THE BULLET
ON THAT HOMELESS MESS,

1192
01:01:26,963 --> 01:01:29,295
I WANT YOU TO KNOW THAT
THE MAYOR AND I BOTH

1193
01:01:29,395 --> 01:01:31,728
APPRECIATE YOUR DISCRETION.

1194
01:01:31,828 --> 01:01:33,862
BUT RIGHT NOW WE CAN'T
TAKE OUR EYES OFF

1195
01:01:33,962 --> 01:01:36,695
THE BALL WHEN IT COMES
TO CRIME OVERALL...

1196
01:01:36,795 --> 01:01:39,660
LOOKING AT YOUR WEEKLY
U.C.R.s FROM THE DISTRICTS,

1197
01:01:39,760 --> 01:01:42,460
I AM NOT SEEING THE KIND
OF DECLINE THAT'S GOING

1198
01:01:42,560 --> 01:01:45,459
TO MEASURE OUT TO A TEN
PERCENT DROP IN THE QUARTER.

1199
01:01:45,559 --> 01:01:46,960
- THEY'RE CLEAN.

1200
01:01:47,059 --> 01:01:48,025
- EXCUSE ME.

1201
01:01:48,125 --> 01:01:51,024
- THE STATS ARE CLEAN.

1202
01:01:51,124 --> 01:01:53,325
THEY'RE GONNA STAY CLEAN.

1203
01:01:53,425 --> 01:01:55,325
EITHER WE FIX THIS
POLICE DEPARTMENT

1204
01:01:55,425 --> 01:01:57,057
AND THE CRIME GOES DOWN,
OR WE DON'T

1205
01:01:57,157 --> 01:01:59,390
AND THE CRIME STAYS UP.

1206
01:01:59,524 --> 01:02:03,122
- COMMISSIONER, WE'RE
TALKING ABOUT A LITTLE HELP

1207
01:02:03,223 --> 01:02:04,523
IN THE NEXT COUPLE QUARTERS.

1208
01:02:04,656 --> 01:02:05,690
THAT'S ALL...

1209
01:02:05,790 --> 01:02:09,021
- NO. I CAN'T.

1210
01:02:09,121 --> 01:02:10,388
- YOU'RE QUIET ON
THE HOMELESS FIASCO,

1211
01:02:10,489 --> 01:02:11,789
BUT THIS MAKES
YOU SQUEAL?

1212
01:02:11,856 --> 01:02:12,889
WHAT THE--

1213
01:02:12,988 --> 01:02:15,321
- TELL THE MAYOR HIS
STATS WILL BE CLEAN.

1214
01:02:15,421 --> 01:02:19,521
BEFORE THE ELECTION,
AFTER THE ELECTION...

1215
01:02:21,019 --> 01:02:24,854
- YOU'RE RIGHT.
THEY CAN'T FIRE YOU.

1216
01:02:24,954 --> 01:02:27,886
NOT WITHOUT IT BOUNCING
BACK ON CITY HALL.

1217
01:02:27,985 --> 01:02:30,452
IF YOU DON'T MIND BEING
BURIED IN SOME BACKROOM UNIT,

1218
01:02:30,552 --> 01:02:32,651
YOU CAN STAY FOR AS
LONG AS YOU CAN STAND IT.

1219
01:02:35,318 --> 01:02:37,818
OR UNTIL YOU GET THE PENSION.

1220
01:02:37,952 --> 01:02:41,417
BUT AT THE SAME TIME,
I CAN'T LET YOU DO POLICE WORK.

1221
01:02:41,550 --> 01:02:43,650
NOT ANYTHING THAT'S
GOING TO FIND ITS WAY

1222
01:02:43,750 --> 01:02:44,916
INTO A COURTROOM.

1223
01:02:45,049 --> 01:02:47,816
I WON'T DO THAT.

1224
01:02:47,916 --> 01:02:51,315
FOR BOTH OF YOU,
THAT'S OVER.

1225
01:02:59,013 --> 01:03:00,814
- SO MARLO WALKS.

1226
01:03:00,914 --> 01:03:03,012
- OR YOU GO TO JAIL.

1227
01:03:03,112 --> 01:03:05,580
- AND YOU COULDN'T DO
ANY BETTER WITH LEVY, HUH?

1228
01:03:06,847 --> 01:03:08,613
I MEAN, GIVING UP
THE MONEY...

1229
01:03:09,745 --> 01:03:11,645
- I GOT WHAT I COULD.

1230
01:03:15,110 --> 01:03:17,811
YOU LOST THE MONEY TRAIL,
LESTER,

1231
01:03:17,945 --> 01:03:20,811
WHEN YOU DECIDED TO START
COLORING OUTSIDE OF THE LINES.

1232
01:03:25,176 --> 01:03:27,476
THIS ISN'T ON ME.

1233
01:03:31,476 --> 01:03:33,875
- WHAT THE FUCK YOU MEAN
YOU SELLING?

1234
01:03:33,974 --> 01:03:35,174
- I'M SELLIN' THE CONNECT.

1235
01:03:35,274 --> 01:03:36,575
- HOW MUCH, YO?

1236
01:03:40,040 --> 01:03:41,040
- TEN MILLION.

1237
01:03:41,140 --> 01:03:42,807
- GODDAMN.

1238
01:03:42,907 --> 01:03:44,607
- OR A HIGH BIDDER IF
I HEAR TEN FROM MORE

1239
01:03:44,707 --> 01:03:46,172
THAN ONE OF Y'ALL.

1240
01:03:46,272 --> 01:03:47,573
IF YOU ALL THINK IT
AIN'T WORTH THAT,

1241
01:03:47,706 --> 01:03:49,573
I STICK THAT SHIT BACK
IN MY POCKET AND Y'ALL

1242
01:03:49,706 --> 01:03:53,505
CAN GO BACK TO RUNNIN'
THAT STEPPED-ON NEW YORK SHIT.

1243
01:03:53,605 --> 01:03:57,305
- YOU DON'T MIND ME ASKIN',
WHY YOU SELLIN'?

1244
01:03:57,405 --> 01:04:00,304
I MEAN, EVEN FROM INSIDE
HERE, YOU CAN TAKE A SLICE

1245
01:04:00,404 --> 01:04:02,003
FOR JUST LAYIN'
IN THE CUT, NIGGA.

1246
01:04:02,103 --> 01:04:03,671
- I AIN'T GONNA BE
IN HERE LONG.

1247
01:04:03,770 --> 01:04:05,870
CASE THEY GOT AGAINST ME
ALREADY FALLIN' APART.

1248
01:04:09,603 --> 01:04:11,569
BUT THE TRUTH IS,

1249
01:04:11,669 --> 01:04:14,268
I'M DONE WITH THIS
GANGSTA SHIT.

1250
01:04:14,335 --> 01:04:16,234
I'VE BEEN THERE,
DONE THAT.

1251
01:04:16,334 --> 01:04:18,935
- YOU SOMETHIN' ELSE
OTHER THAN A GANGSTA?

1252
01:04:20,267 --> 01:04:22,366
- BUSINESSMAN.

1253
01:04:22,500 --> 01:04:24,133
YEAH, TALL MAN,
I CAN'T GET THAT SHIT WRAPPED

1254
01:04:24,266 --> 01:04:25,467
AROUND MY HEAD NEITHER.

1255
01:04:28,065 --> 01:04:31,132
ANYWAY, Y'ALL CAN'T GET
MY PRICE UP,

1256
01:04:31,232 --> 01:04:32,499
MAYBE Y'ALL POOL YOUR MONEY.

1257
01:04:33,833 --> 01:04:38,097
BUT SUPPLY ONLY GONNA DEAL
WITH Y'ALL AFTER

1258
01:04:38,198 --> 01:04:39,665
I MAKE THE INTRO.

1259
01:04:40,664 --> 01:04:43,931
THEN I'M OUT.

1260
01:04:44,063 --> 01:04:45,831
- YOU'VE GOT A PROBLEM.

1261
01:04:47,196 --> 01:04:48,429
I THOUGHT DANIELS WAS
YOUR BOY.

1262
01:04:48,529 --> 01:04:50,396
- WE'VE BOTH GOT A PROBLEM
IF CRIME DOESN'T DROP.

1263
01:04:50,496 --> 01:04:52,994
CARCETTI LOSES THE
STATEHOUSE AND YOU AREN'T MAYOR.

1264
01:04:53,094 --> 01:04:56,161
AND EVEN IF HE WINS,
NERESE, YOU'RE STUCK WITH

1265
01:04:56,228 --> 01:04:58,527
A POLICE COMMISSIONER
THAT WON'T WORK WITH YOU.

1266
01:04:58,627 --> 01:05:00,427
- OH, I'M NOT STUCK
WITH ANYTHING.

1267
01:05:00,527 --> 01:05:02,527
DANIELS EITHER COMES
AROUND OR HE'S DONE.

1268
01:05:02,661 --> 01:05:03,761
- WE JUST ANOINTED HIM.

1269
01:05:03,861 --> 01:05:05,893
WE CAN'T GO BACK
ON THAT NOW. HE KNOWS IT.

1270
01:05:06,026 --> 01:05:10,259
- EITHER HE LEARNS HIS PLACE
OR HE'LL BE OFFERING TO RESIGN.

1271
01:05:10,393 --> 01:05:12,659
OH, YOU AIN'T THE ONLY ONE
KNOWS HOW TO PLAY THIS GAME.

1272
01:05:23,023 --> 01:05:25,423
- WHAT TO SAY ABOUT
THIS PIECE OF WORK?

1273
01:05:27,223 --> 01:05:29,622
FUCK IF I DON'T FIND
MYSELF WITHOUT THE RIGHT WORDS.

1274
01:05:29,722 --> 01:05:33,322
ME, AS GIFTED A GOLDEN THROAT
AS ANY OF YOU COCKSUCKERS,

1275
01:05:33,422 --> 01:05:34,689
BEING LOOSED FROM RELIGION,
ARE EVER LIKELY TO HEAR.

1276
01:05:36,521 --> 01:05:38,588
WHAT CAN I SAY ABOUT
THE DEARLY DEPARTED?

1277
01:05:39,621 --> 01:05:40,521
I MEAN, REALLY...

1278
01:05:40,655 --> 01:05:42,520
- HE DIED YOUNG. TOO YOUNG.

1279
01:05:42,620 --> 01:05:43,687
- NOT EVEN FORTY YEARS OLD.

1280
01:05:43,787 --> 01:05:44,887
- THOUGH HAD IT LIVED,
HIS DICK WOULDA BEEN

1281
01:05:44,986 --> 01:05:46,020
A HUNDRED AND THIRTY-FOUR...

1282
01:05:47,553 --> 01:05:48,586
- SHUT UP.

1283
01:05:48,686 --> 01:05:50,152
IT'S COMING TO ME...

1284
01:05:52,719 --> 01:05:57,318
HE WAS THE BLACK SHEEP,
THE PERMANENT PARIAH.

1285
01:05:58,718 --> 01:06:01,217
HE ASKED NO QUARTER OF
THE BOSSES AND NONE WAS GIVEN.

1286
01:06:01,317 --> 01:06:05,850
HE LEARNED NO LESSONS,
HE ACKNOWLEDGED NO MISTAKES,

1287
01:06:05,982 --> 01:06:08,249
HE WAS AS STUBBORN A MIC
AS EVER STUMBLED OUT OF

1288
01:06:08,349 --> 01:06:10,917
THE NORTHEAST PARISHES TO
TAKE A PATROLMAN'S SHIELD.

1289
01:06:11,049 --> 01:06:12,615
HE BROOKED NO AUTHORITY.

1290
01:06:12,715 --> 01:06:13,816
HE DID WHAT HE
WANTED TO DO

1291
01:06:13,916 --> 01:06:16,382
AND HE SAID WHAT HE
WANTED TO SAY

1292
01:06:16,482 --> 01:06:19,848
AND IN THE END,
HE GAVE YOU THE CLEARANCES.

1293
01:06:21,314 --> 01:06:24,146
HE'S NATURAL POLICE.
YES, HE WAS.

1294
01:06:24,246 --> 01:06:26,480
AND I DON'T SAY THAT
ABOUT MANY PEOPLE.

1295
01:06:26,580 --> 01:06:27,814
EVEN WHEN THEY'RE HERE
ON THE FELT,

1296
01:06:27,914 --> 01:06:30,045
I DON'T GIVE THAT ONE UP
UNLESS IT HAPPENS TO BE TRUE.

1297
01:06:31,712 --> 01:06:33,679
NATURAL POH-LEECE.

1298
01:06:43,110 --> 01:06:44,677
BUT CHRIST,
WHAT AN ASSHOLE.

1299
01:06:49,142 --> 01:06:50,543
AND I'M TALKIN' ABOUT
THE ORDINARY,

1300
01:06:50,643 --> 01:06:53,276
GAPING ORIFICE THAT
ALL OF US POSSESS.

1301
01:06:53,376 --> 01:06:57,275
I MEAN AN ALL-ENCOMPASSING,
ALL-CONSUMING,

1302
01:06:57,408 --> 01:06:59,208
OUT OF PROPORTION TO EVERY
OTHER FACET OF HIS

1303
01:06:59,341 --> 01:07:01,641
HUMANITY CHASM.

1304
01:07:01,741 --> 01:07:04,007
FROM WHOSE BORNE,
IF I MAY QUOTE SHAKESPEARE,

1305
01:07:04,107 --> 01:07:06,140
NO TRAVELER HAS EVER RETURNED.

1306
01:07:06,240 --> 01:07:07,373
- THE FUCK DID I DO?

1307
01:07:07,506 --> 01:07:10,939
- SHUT THE FUCK UP.
YOU'RE DEAD TO US NOW.

1308
01:07:11,039 --> 01:07:12,373
- HEY, HEY...

1309
01:07:12,472 --> 01:07:15,405
- HO, HERE'S HIS
PARTNER IN CRIME.

1310
01:07:18,238 --> 01:07:20,104
- NOW, NOW. BE GENTLE.

1311
01:07:20,204 --> 01:07:21,271
BE GENTLE.

1312
01:07:21,404 --> 01:07:23,438
I'M A CIVILIAN NOW.
BE GENTLE.

1313
01:07:23,538 --> 01:07:25,069
- YOUR PAPERS WENT IN,
HUH?

1314
01:07:25,170 --> 01:07:27,069
- YEAH, THIS AFTERNOON.
THIRTY-TWO YEARS..

1315
01:07:27,170 --> 01:07:28,703
- AND FOUR MONTHS.

1316
01:07:29,936 --> 01:07:31,269
- MMM MMM.

1317
01:07:31,369 --> 01:07:33,669
Y'ALL DID A
FINE JOB WITH HIM, YOU DID.

1318
01:07:33,769 --> 01:07:35,602
HE LOOK TO BE ABOUT TEN
YEARS YOUNGER THAN I REMEMBER.

1319
01:07:37,334 --> 01:07:39,967
- C'MON, THERE'S ENOUGH ROOM
FOR BOTH OF YOU TO BE LAID OUT.

1320
01:07:43,667 --> 01:07:45,000
- ONE AT A TIME.

1321
01:07:45,100 --> 01:07:47,467
YOU DON'T CROWD A MAN
AT HIS OWN WAKE.

1322
01:07:48,767 --> 01:07:49,699
- COME ON, LESTER?

1323
01:07:49,800 --> 01:07:51,833
COME AND SNUGGLE.

1324
01:07:51,932 --> 01:07:53,566
- KEEP OUR SECRETS, JIMMY.

1325
01:07:53,666 --> 01:07:55,231
I GOT SHARDENE WITH ME TONIGHT.

1326
01:07:56,365 --> 01:07:58,131
- IF YOU GENTLEMEN
WILL SPARE US

1327
01:07:58,265 --> 01:07:59,964
THIS UNFORTUNATE
HOMOEROTIC LAPSE,

1328
01:08:00,064 --> 01:08:02,297
I WILL CONCLUDE MY
ELEGIAC REMARKS...

1329
01:08:02,397 --> 01:08:04,197
- THEN DO IT,
YOU GABBY MOTHERFUCKER...

1330
01:08:05,864 --> 01:08:08,663
- TO CONCLUDE...
TO CONCLUDE, I SAY...

1331
01:08:08,797 --> 01:08:11,929
HE GAVE US THIRTEEN
YEARS ON THE LINE...

1332
01:08:12,029 --> 01:08:13,762
NOT ENOUGH FOR A PENSION...

1333
01:08:13,862 --> 01:08:15,529
BUT ENOUGH FOR US TO
KNOW THAT HE WAS..

1334
01:08:15,629 --> 01:08:17,228
- PUT THE FUCKING
SONG ON, HUE...

1335
01:08:17,362 --> 01:08:19,861
- DESPITE HIS NEGLIGIBLE
IRISH ANCESTRY...

1336
01:08:19,960 --> 01:08:21,927
HIS DEFECTS OF
PERSONALITY...

1337
01:08:22,027 --> 01:08:25,593
AND HIS INCONSTANT
SOBRIETY AND HYGIENE...

1338
01:08:27,693 --> 01:08:30,860
A TRUE MURDER POLICE.

1339
01:08:30,959 --> 01:08:33,225
JIMMY...

1340
01:08:33,325 --> 01:08:36,125
I SAY THIS SERIOUSLY.

1341
01:08:36,225 --> 01:08:38,691
IF I WAS LAYING THERE DEAD
ON SOME BALTIMORE STREET CORNER,

1342
01:08:38,792 --> 01:08:40,425
I'D WANT IT TO BE YOU
STANDING OVER ME,

1343
01:08:40,525 --> 01:08:41,491
CATCHING THE CASE.

1344
01:08:41,591 --> 01:08:42,625
- BULLSHIT.

1345
01:08:46,624 --> 01:08:48,223
- BECAUSE, BROTHER,
WHEN YOU WERE GOOD,

1346
01:08:48,323 --> 01:08:50,556
YOU WERE THE BEST WE HAD.

1347
01:08:52,856 --> 01:08:54,856
- SHIT, IF YOU WAS LAYIN'
THERE DEAD ON SOME CORNER,

1348
01:08:54,955 --> 01:08:56,655
IT WAS PROBABLY JIMMY
THAT DONE YA.

1349
01:08:58,655 --> 01:08:59,755
- FUCK YOU!

1350
01:08:59,855 --> 01:09:01,221
IF YOU CAUGHT THE CASE,
YOU'D BE STANDING THERE

1351
01:09:01,321 --> 01:09:02,554
PISSIN' IN MY EAR.

1352
01:10:24,875 --> 01:10:27,174
- HOW DID NERESE CAMPBELL
GET IT?

1353
01:10:27,306 --> 01:10:28,807
- YOU THINK I ASKED?

1354
01:10:28,939 --> 01:10:30,540
DO YOU THINK IT EVEN MATTERS?

1355
01:10:30,673 --> 01:10:33,572
SHE GAVE IT TO ME BECAUSE
SHE THOUGHT YOU'D LISTEN TO ME.

1356
01:10:33,672 --> 01:10:36,372
- SO NOW THEY WANT
ME TO GO.

1357
01:10:36,472 --> 01:10:38,706
- THE WAY SHE EXPRESSED IT
IS THAT SHE WANTED YOU

1358
01:10:38,806 --> 01:10:41,071
TO STAY IF YOU COULD COME
TO YOUR SENSES.

1359
01:10:41,171 --> 01:10:42,805
- COME TO MY SENSES.

1360
01:10:44,805 --> 01:10:47,570
SHE WANTS ME TO JUKE
THE STATS FOR CARCETTI.

1361
01:10:47,670 --> 01:10:49,036
THIS QUARTER AND THE NEXT...

1362
01:10:49,137 --> 01:10:51,570
HIDE THE CRIME,
GET HIM ELECTED AS GOVERNOR

1363
01:10:51,703 --> 01:10:53,436
AND MAKE HER THE MAYOR.

1364
01:10:53,536 --> 01:10:54,870
- SO DO IT.

1365
01:10:54,969 --> 01:10:56,503
BURRELL JUKED
THEM BEFORE YOU.

1366
01:10:56,603 --> 01:10:58,101
WARREN FRASIER
BEFORE HIM.

1367
01:10:58,201 --> 01:10:59,635
AND AFTER YOU'RE GONE,
RAWLS OR WHOEVER

1368
01:10:59,735 --> 01:11:01,835
WILL JUKE THEM. SO WHAT?

1369
01:11:01,968 --> 01:11:04,768
- I'LL SWALLOW A LIE
WHEN I HAVE TO.

1370
01:11:04,868 --> 01:11:07,234
I'VE SWALLOWED A FEW
BIG ONES LATELY.

1371
01:11:07,367 --> 01:11:09,567
BUT THE STAT GAMES...

1372
01:11:09,667 --> 01:11:12,466
THAT LIE, IT'S WHAT RUINED
THIS DEPARTMENT.

1373
01:11:12,566 --> 01:11:15,066
SHINING UP SHIT AND
CALLING IT GOLD,

1374
01:11:15,166 --> 01:11:17,665
SO MAJORS BECOME COLONELS
AND MAYORS BECOME GOVERNORS.

1375
01:11:17,799 --> 01:11:20,898
PRETENDING TO DO POLICE WORK
WHILE ONE GENERATION FUCKING

1376
01:11:20,998 --> 01:11:22,331
TRAINS THE NEXT HOW NOT
TO DO THE JOB.

1377
01:11:22,431 --> 01:11:23,731
AND THAT...

1378
01:11:27,731 --> 01:11:30,463
I LOOKED CARCETTI
IN THE EYE.

1379
01:11:30,563 --> 01:11:31,730
I SHOOK HIS HAND.

1380
01:11:31,830 --> 01:11:34,396
I ASKED HIM IF
HE WAS FOR REAL.

1381
01:11:34,529 --> 01:11:37,763
THIS IS THE LIE
I CAN'T LIVE WITH.

1382
01:11:37,863 --> 01:11:40,095
IF I DO, THEN NERESE HAS ME
IN HER POCKET WHENEVER

1383
01:11:40,229 --> 01:11:41,428
SHE WANTS ME.

1384
01:11:41,528 --> 01:11:44,361
AND I'M NO GOOD TO
ANYONE LIKE THAT.

1385
01:11:44,461 --> 01:11:46,061
- THEN GO.

1386
01:11:46,194 --> 01:11:50,293
WITHDRAW FOR PERSONAL REASONS,
OR HEALTH REASONS.

1387
01:11:50,394 --> 01:11:51,761
WHATEVER.

1388
01:11:51,861 --> 01:11:54,493
YOU'VE GOT YOUR LAW DEGREE.
YOU'RE NOT GOING TO STARVE.

1389
01:11:56,226 --> 01:11:59,658
BUT IF YOU DON'T GO,
THEY'LL WRECK BOTH OF US.

1390
01:11:59,759 --> 01:12:01,759
- THERE'S NOT ENOUGH
IN HERE TO INDICT ME.

1391
01:12:01,891 --> 01:12:04,325
AND THE JOKE OF IT IS,
I'VE SEEN ENOUGH

1392
01:12:04,425 --> 01:12:07,391
THE LAST FEW DAYS TO HAVE
THEM INDICTED.

1393
01:12:07,491 --> 01:12:09,357
- FOR WHAT?

1394
01:12:09,457 --> 01:12:11,623
THEN USE IT, CEDRIC.

1395
01:12:11,757 --> 01:12:13,056
OR AT LEAST THREATEN TO.

1396
01:12:13,156 --> 01:12:14,656
- PEOPLE WILL GET HURT.

1397
01:12:16,022 --> 01:12:17,622
PEOPLE I CARE ABOUT.

1398
01:12:19,756 --> 01:12:21,756
- THEN YOU'RE DONE.

1399
01:12:21,888 --> 01:12:23,621
THERE'S ENOUGH IN THAT FILE
THAT YOU'LL NEVER MAKE

1400
01:12:23,755 --> 01:12:25,087
IT THROUGH
CONFIRMATION HEARINGS.

1401
01:12:25,187 --> 01:12:27,621
AND ENOUGH SO THAT MY
CAREER IS DEAD BEFORE IT

1402
01:12:27,721 --> 01:12:28,920
EVEN GETS STARTED.

1403
01:12:33,053 --> 01:12:36,185
THE TREE THAT DOESN'T BEND,
BREAKS, CEDRIC.

1404
01:12:36,285 --> 01:12:39,552
- BEND TOO FAR,
YOU'RE ALREADY BROKEN.

1405
01:12:41,185 --> 01:12:43,451
- MARLO ON A WALK.

1406
01:12:44,551 --> 01:12:46,184
AND THE MONEY, JIMMY.

1407
01:12:46,284 --> 01:12:47,784
SHE GAVE THAT AWAY, TOO.

1408
01:12:48,916 --> 01:12:50,916
- YEAH.

1409
01:12:51,050 --> 01:12:53,050
- WE DON'T GET TO
FOLLOW THE MONEY.

1410
01:12:57,182 --> 01:12:58,383
HEY...

1411
01:12:58,483 --> 01:12:59,682
WONDERIN' WHERE YOU WAS...

1412
01:12:59,815 --> 01:13:01,348
- DIDN'T KNOW IF I SHOULD
COME OUT ON THIS HERE...

1413
01:13:01,448 --> 01:13:03,515
- WHY THE FUCK NOT?

1414
01:13:03,615 --> 01:13:05,482
- WAS ME WHO TOLD DANIELS.

1415
01:13:07,547 --> 01:13:10,714
I DIDN'T WANT TO DO
IT BEHIND YOUR BACK,

1416
01:13:10,814 --> 01:13:12,780
BUT IT HAD TO BE DONE.

1417
01:13:19,679 --> 01:13:24,344
ANYWAY, IT WAS GREAT BEIN'
ON THE JOB WITH Y'ALL.

1418
01:13:26,277 --> 01:13:28,944
I JUST WANTED TO SAY
THAT TOO, I GUESS.

1419
01:13:29,044 --> 01:13:30,943
- SO WHAT?

1420
01:13:31,043 --> 01:13:34,744
YOU AIN'T GONNA DRINK
WITH ME?

1421
01:13:34,844 --> 01:13:37,042
- I AM IF YOU WANT...

1422
01:13:39,242 --> 01:13:42,808
- DETECTIVE, IF YOU THINK
IT NEEDED DOIN',

1423
01:13:42,907 --> 01:13:45,408
I GUESS IT DID.

1424
01:13:52,841 --> 01:13:54,073
- YOU COMIN'?

1425
01:14:14,403 --> 01:14:17,503
- MILTON CAME
WITH SIX HUNDRED.

1426
01:14:17,603 --> 01:14:19,435
AN' LITTLE GLEN IS
IN FOR THREE.

1427
01:14:19,535 --> 01:14:21,335
- I GOT FIVE FROM ME

1428
01:14:21,435 --> 01:14:24,001
AN' I GOT FIVE FROM
CHINAMAN TO COVER.

1429
01:14:25,568 --> 01:14:26,835
- I CAN GO THAT.
NO THING.

1430
01:14:26,934 --> 01:14:28,101
- WHAT?

1431
01:14:28,201 --> 01:14:30,000
MOTHERFUCKER, WHERE YOU GET
THAT KIND OF SCRATCH?

1432
01:14:30,101 --> 01:14:31,999
- YOU DON'T THINK CHEESE
KNOW THIS HERE GAME?

1433
01:14:32,100 --> 01:14:34,633
WE SELLIN' DOPE AN' COKE
IN BALTIMORE, NIGGA,

1434
01:14:34,734 --> 01:14:36,600
ANY OF Y'ALL AIN'T GOT
THAT KIND OF MONEY

1435
01:14:36,700 --> 01:14:37,932
NEED BE ASHAMED.

1436
01:14:38,065 --> 01:14:41,132
- YOU STILL PUTTIN' UP MORE
THAN YOUR SHARE WITH THAT.

1437
01:14:41,232 --> 01:14:44,198
- THE WAY I LOOK AT IT,
WE ALL GONNA BE MORE

1438
01:14:44,298 --> 01:14:46,565
THAN PAID ONCE WE OWN
THE CONNECT, SO...

1439
01:14:46,665 --> 01:14:47,864
- SHIT, NIGGA,
WE WAS GOOD WHEN

1440
01:14:47,964 --> 01:14:49,464
YOUR UNCLE HAD IT.

1441
01:14:49,597 --> 01:14:52,230
YOU HAD TO GO AHEAD AND
PUT UP WITH MARLO...

1442
01:14:52,330 --> 01:14:53,863
- SEE THAT.

1443
01:14:53,963 --> 01:14:56,796
SEE NOW, THAT'S JUST THE
WRONG WAY TO LOOK AT IT.

1444
01:14:56,895 --> 01:15:00,629
'CAUSE JOE HAD HIS TIME
AND OMAR PUT AN END TO THAT,

1445
01:15:00,730 --> 01:15:02,961
THEN MARLO HAD HIS TIME,
SHORT AS IT WAS,

1446
01:15:03,095 --> 01:15:05,061
AN' THE POLICE PUT
AN END TO THAT.

1447
01:15:05,161 --> 01:15:07,661
AND NOW, MOTHERFUCKER,
IT'S OUR TIME.

1448
01:15:07,794 --> 01:15:10,427
MINES AND YOURS.

1449
01:15:10,527 --> 01:15:12,860
BUT INSTEAD OF JUST
SHUTTIN' UP AND KICKIN' IN,

1450
01:15:12,960 --> 01:15:15,360
YOU GONNA STAND THERE CRYIN'
THAT BACK-IN-THE-DAY SHIT.

1451
01:15:15,460 --> 01:15:16,560
- CHEESE...

1452
01:15:16,660 --> 01:15:18,560
- THERE AIN'T NO BACK
IN THE DAY, NIGGA.

1453
01:15:18,660 --> 01:15:21,525
AIN'T NO NOSTALGIA
TO THIS SHIT HERE.

1454
01:15:21,625 --> 01:15:24,659
THERE'S JUST THE STREET
AND THE GAME

1455
01:15:24,759 --> 01:15:26,558
AND WHAT HAPPEN HERE TODAY.

1456
01:15:26,691 --> 01:15:27,857
- YOU RIGHT.

1457
01:15:32,523 --> 01:15:35,690
- WHEN IT WAS MY UNCLE,
I WAS WITH MY UNCLE.

1458
01:15:35,790 --> 01:15:38,322
WHEN IT WAS MARLO,
I WAS WITH HIM.

1459
01:15:38,422 --> 01:15:39,556
BUT NOW, NIGGA--

1460
01:15:46,221 --> 01:15:48,355
- WHAT THE FUCK
DID YOU DO THAT FOR?

1461
01:15:48,455 --> 01:15:50,487
NOW WE SHORT THE NINE.

1462
01:15:50,587 --> 01:15:52,320
- THAT WAS FOR JOE.

1463
01:15:54,320 --> 01:16:08,351
- THIS SENTIMENTAL
MOTHERFUCKER JUST COST US MONEY.

1464
01:17:37,003 --> 01:17:38,537
- HEY, ALMA...

1465
01:17:46,934 --> 01:17:48,435
I JUST HEARD.

1466
01:17:49,601 --> 01:17:51,134
- THE CARROLL
COUNTY BUREAU?

1467
01:17:51,234 --> 01:17:52,734
THAT'S HOW THEY
PUNISH ME?

1468
01:17:52,833 --> 01:17:55,233
WHY NOT JUST SEND MY ASS
ALL THE WAY TO PENNSYLVANIA?

1469
01:17:55,334 --> 01:17:56,701
- WHAT'D THEY TELL YOU?

1470
01:17:56,801 --> 01:17:59,132
- THAT I DID AN EXCELLENT JOB.

1471
01:17:59,232 --> 01:18:01,666
THAT THIS HAD NOTHING TO DO
WITH ANYTHING BUT TRYING

1472
01:18:01,766 --> 01:18:03,633
TO MAKE THE COUNTY
BUREAUS STRONGER.

1473
01:18:05,964 --> 01:18:07,799
- ALMA, I DIDN'T TELL
THEM ABOUT THE NOTEPAD.

1474
01:18:07,898 --> 01:18:09,864
I LEFT THAT PART OUT.

1475
01:18:09,964 --> 01:18:10,997
- I TOLD THEM.

1476
01:18:11,097 --> 01:18:12,431
WHEN I HEARD YOU WERE
IN TROUBLE,

1477
01:18:12,531 --> 01:18:14,764
I WENT TO WHITING,
TOLD HIM I THOUGHT YOU

1478
01:18:14,863 --> 01:18:16,030
WERE RIGHT ABOUT SCOTT.

1479
01:18:16,130 --> 01:18:17,962
I TOLD HIM ABOUT THE NOTEPAD.

1480
01:18:18,029 --> 01:18:19,630
DID HE MAKE ALL OF IT UP?

1481
01:18:19,730 --> 01:18:21,862
THE CALLS FROM THE KILLER?
THE PICTURES?

1482
01:18:21,962 --> 01:18:25,362
- SOME, NOT ALL.

1483
01:18:25,462 --> 01:18:26,662
- WHY?

1484
01:18:26,796 --> 01:18:29,061
- LOOK AROUND.

1485
01:18:29,194 --> 01:18:33,461
THE POND IS SHRINKING.
THE FISH ARE NERVOUS.

1486
01:18:33,561 --> 01:18:35,660
GET SOME PROFILE,
WIN A PRIZE...

1487
01:18:35,760 --> 01:18:38,060
MAYBE FIND A BIGGER
POND SOMEWHERE.

1488
01:18:38,160 --> 01:18:41,825
WHITING, KLEBANOW, TEMPLETON...

1489
01:18:41,925 --> 01:18:44,159
THEY SNATCH A PULITZER OR TWO,
AND THEY ARE UP

1490
01:18:44,259 --> 01:18:46,625
AND GONE FROM THIS PLACE.

1491
01:18:46,725 --> 01:18:48,525
FOR THEM, THAT'S WHAT
THIS IS ALL ABOUT.

1492
01:18:48,625 --> 01:18:49,758
ME?

1493
01:18:49,857 --> 01:18:53,023
I'M TOO FUCKIN'
SIMPLE-MINDED FOR THAT.

1494
01:18:53,157 --> 01:18:55,823
I JUST WANTED TO SEE
SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY...

1495
01:18:57,557 --> 01:18:58,989
AND WRITE A
STORY WITH IT.

1496
01:19:01,389 --> 01:19:04,222
ALMA, YOU'LL WRITE
YOUR WAY OUTTA CARROLL

1497
01:19:04,323 --> 01:19:05,789
IN NO TIME, WATCH.

1498
01:19:05,888 --> 01:19:07,021
- ABOUT AS FAST
AS YOU EDIT

1499
01:19:07,121 --> 01:19:09,155
YOUR WAY OFF THE COPY
DESK, HUH?

1500
01:19:26,951 --> 01:19:28,619
- CONGRATULATIONS,
SERGEANT GOETTE.

1501
01:19:28,719 --> 01:19:30,950
I KNOW YOU'LL DO WELL
IN THE EASTERN.

1502
01:19:35,383 --> 01:19:38,050
GLAD I GOT TO DO
THIS AT LEAST.

1503
01:19:38,150 --> 01:19:39,550
CONGRATULATIONS,
LIEUTENANT CARVER.

1504
01:19:39,650 --> 01:19:41,050
- THANK YOU, SIR.

1505
01:19:41,150 --> 01:19:42,848
I'M JUST SORRY IT WON'T
BE YOU I'M SERVING UNDER.

1506
01:19:44,582 --> 01:19:46,049
- WORD GETS AROUND, HUH?

1507
01:19:46,149 --> 01:19:48,581
- IT'S ON W.B.A.L. TODAY.

1508
01:19:48,682 --> 01:19:51,448
THEY SAID YOU'RE LEAVING
FOR FAMILY REASONS...

1509
01:19:51,581 --> 01:19:52,748
- I GUESS I GOT SOME KIDS
SOMEWHERE I DON'T

1510
01:19:52,847 --> 01:19:55,080
EVEN KNOW ABOUT.

1511
01:19:55,213 --> 01:19:56,747
THEY SAY ON B.A.L.
WHO THEY'RE SENDING UP

1512
01:19:56,846 --> 01:19:57,980
AS ACTING COMMISSIONER?

1513
01:19:58,080 --> 01:19:59,080
- SAY IT AIN'T SO.

1514
01:20:04,179 --> 01:20:05,944
- LADIES AND GENTLEMEN,

1515
01:20:06,045 --> 01:20:08,045
AS WHAT MAY BE MY
LAST OFFICIAL ACT

1516
01:20:08,145 --> 01:20:10,412
AS A BALTIMORE
POLICE OFFICER,

1517
01:20:10,512 --> 01:20:13,544
ALLOW ME TO CONGRATULATE ALL
OF THE PROMOTED OFFICERS,

1518
01:20:13,644 --> 01:20:15,910
THEIR FAMILIES,
THEIR FELLOW OFFICERS,

1519
01:20:16,010 --> 01:20:17,077
AND THEIR FRIENDS.

1520
01:20:25,841 --> 01:20:27,275
- YOU AIN'T CAREFUL,
THEY MAY MAKE YOU MAJOR.

1521
01:20:27,375 --> 01:20:28,975
THEN YOU'LL BE TRULY FUCKED.

1522
01:20:30,174 --> 01:20:31,341
GOOD JOB.
- THANKS.

1523
01:20:31,441 --> 01:20:32,874
- I'M PROUD OF YOU.
- THANKS.

1524
01:20:49,104 --> 01:20:51,204
- SEE NOW,
THERE YOU GO

1525
01:20:51,305 --> 01:20:52,837
GIVIN' A FUCK WHEN IT
AIN'T YOUR TURN

1526
01:20:52,937 --> 01:20:54,004
TO GIVE A FUCK.

1527
01:20:54,104 --> 01:20:55,003
LEHMAN'S SQUAD WAS UP.

1528
01:20:55,103 --> 01:20:56,370
- I NEEDED THE O.T.

1529
01:20:56,470 --> 01:20:58,504
- YEAH, AN' NOW
YOU GOT A SHOOTING WITH NO WITS,

1530
01:20:58,604 --> 01:21:01,935
NO SUSPECT AND NO PRAYER
OF IT GOIN' TO BLACK.

1531
01:21:02,036 --> 01:21:04,036
PICKIN' UP THE PHONE LIKE
A GODDAMN ROOKIE.

1532
01:21:04,136 --> 01:21:05,036
SHAME ON YOU.

1533
01:21:05,136 --> 01:21:07,068
- STOP SQUEALIN' LIKE A BITCH.

1534
01:21:07,168 --> 01:21:09,402
AN' MAKE SURE YOU DON'T STEP
ON THAT SHELL CASING BEHIND YOU.

1535
01:21:09,502 --> 01:21:10,801
- I AIN'T GONNA KICK NO
SHELL CASINGS BEHIND ME.

1536
01:21:10,901 --> 01:21:12,035
IT'S RIGHT THERE ON THE SIDE.

1537
01:21:12,135 --> 01:21:13,134
I'M GONNA STEP BACK AND KICK
NO DAMN SHELL CASING

1538
01:21:13,234 --> 01:21:20,033
YOU DON'T MARK WITH LETTERS
AND NUMBERS.

1539
01:21:20,199 --> 01:21:21,266
- I UNDERSTAND.

1540
01:21:21,400 --> 01:21:23,133
AND YOU GOTTA BE IN THE SYSTEM.

1541
01:21:23,266 --> 01:21:24,433
THEY SENT YOU THE FORM.

1542
01:21:24,566 --> 01:21:26,198
- THEY TOLD ME THAT
WASN'T GOOD ENOUGH.

1543
01:21:26,299 --> 01:21:27,965
THEY SAID THEY WANTED
THE OTHER PAPER WORK.

1544
01:21:28,065 --> 01:21:30,032
- AND YOU SAID YOU APPLIED
FOR S.S.I., MR. BELTON?

1545
01:21:30,132 --> 01:21:31,364
- YES, MA'AM.

1546
01:21:31,464 --> 01:21:32,464
- WELL, LET'S GO
INSIDE AND LOOK IT UP ON

1547
01:21:32,564 --> 01:21:33,698
THE COMPUTER.

1548
01:21:33,797 --> 01:21:35,930
- HEY, YOU REMEMBER ME?

1549
01:21:37,064 --> 01:21:38,530
I BROUGHT THIS GUY IN
A FEW WEEKS BACK,

1550
01:21:38,630 --> 01:21:40,130
I JUST WANTED TO SEE
HOW HE WAS...

1551
01:21:41,764 --> 01:21:44,629
- HE WANDERED OUT AFTER
A COUPLE NIGHTS.

1552
01:21:44,729 --> 01:21:45,928
SORRY.

1553
01:21:46,995 --> 01:21:48,329
- WHERE...

1554
01:21:49,728 --> 01:21:51,128
WHERE DO THE HOMELESS
GO AROUND HERE?

1555
01:21:51,228 --> 01:21:52,395
- DIFFERENT PLACES.

1556
01:21:52,495 --> 01:21:53,994
DOWN BY THE RIVER,
OVER IN THE

1557
01:21:54,094 --> 01:21:55,594
WAREHOUSE DISTRICT...

1558
01:21:57,060 --> 01:21:58,494
SOME OF THE PLACES,
I DON'T REALLY THINK

1559
01:21:58,594 --> 01:21:59,661
IT WOULD BE SAFE
FOR YOU TO GO...

1560
01:21:59,761 --> 01:22:02,126
- I'M POLICE.
WELL, I USED TO BE.

1561
01:22:02,226 --> 01:22:03,326
- WAIT HERE.

1562
01:22:03,426 --> 01:22:04,726
I'LL SEE IF I
CAN FIND YOU A MAP.

1563
01:22:04,859 --> 01:22:07,092
- THANKS.
- COME ON, MR. BELTON.

1564
01:22:10,891 --> 01:22:12,725
- AND IF THE MAJOR COULD FIND
HIS ASS WITH HIS HAND,

1565
01:22:12,824 --> 01:22:14,024
HE'D KNOW THAT THIS WE HAVE
MORE THAN ENOUGH FOR US

1566
01:22:14,124 --> 01:22:15,724
TO BE UP ON A PEN REGISTER.

1567
01:22:15,823 --> 01:22:18,457
LIEUTENANT CARVER TOLD HIM SO,
BUT FUCK IF HE ISN'T TRYING

1568
01:22:18,557 --> 01:22:19,723
TO SHUT THIS THING DOWN.

1569
01:22:24,623 --> 01:22:26,489
ALL'S I'M SAYIN' IS A
PHONE CALL OR TWO AND

1570
01:22:26,589 --> 01:22:28,522
YOU'RE GONNA FIND OUT
THAT THEY'RE GETTIN'

1571
01:22:28,622 --> 01:22:30,689
SOME KINDA PRESSURE FROM
SOMEWHERE TO SIT ON THIS THING,

1572
01:22:30,788 --> 01:22:33,154
EVEN THOUGH WE'VE TIED
THREE KILLINGS TO THIS CREW.

1573
01:22:34,820 --> 01:22:37,321
- DOES THE POLICE
COMMISSIONER KNOW?

1574
01:22:37,421 --> 01:22:38,919
- HIM?

1575
01:22:39,020 --> 01:22:40,520
HE WOULDN'T KNOW POLICE
WORK IF IT TOOK DOWN HIS

1576
01:22:40,620 --> 01:22:42,120
FRONT DOOR ON A WARRANT.

1577
01:22:46,286 --> 01:22:48,152
JUST...

1578
01:22:48,252 --> 01:22:50,184
KEEP MY NAME OUT OF IT.

1579
01:22:52,551 --> 01:22:55,351
- NEW WESTPORT IS LIKE
HOWARD STREET TEN YEARS AGO,

1580
01:22:55,451 --> 01:22:58,183
EXCEPT THE LAND'S CHEAPER
AND THERE'S MORE POTENTIAL

1581
01:22:58,284 --> 01:23:00,350
FOR MIXED-USE BECAUSE OF
THE WATERFRONT LOCATION.

1582
01:23:00,450 --> 01:23:01,717
- THERE YOU ARE.

1583
01:23:01,816 --> 01:23:03,616
- YOU CAN'T PUT A PRICE
ON A WATERVIEW.

1584
01:23:03,750 --> 01:23:04,949
- OH, YES, YOU CAN.

1585
01:23:05,049 --> 01:23:07,016
YOU DEFINITELY CAN.

1586
01:23:08,715 --> 01:23:10,848
- ANDY, HE'S GOTTA MEET
TOMMY AND THEY'RE LEAVING EARLY,

1587
01:23:10,981 --> 01:23:12,248
SO LET ME BORROW HIM
FOR A MOMENT.

1588
01:23:12,348 --> 01:23:13,482
- SURE, NO PROBLEM.

1589
01:23:13,582 --> 01:23:15,080
NICE TO MEET YOU,
MR. STANFIELD.

1590
01:23:18,314 --> 01:23:20,347
- YOU KNOW WHO YOU
WERE TALKING TO?

1591
01:23:20,447 --> 01:23:23,513
- NAH.
- ANDY KRAWCZYK.

1592
01:23:23,613 --> 01:23:25,013
VERY CONNECTED.

1593
01:23:25,113 --> 01:23:26,513
VERY BIG WITH DEVELOPMENT
AROUND THE HARBOR.

1594
01:23:26,613 --> 01:23:29,512
HE'S SOMEONE YOU'RE
GONNA WANNA KNOW WELL,

1595
01:23:29,646 --> 01:23:31,479
BUT KID, DO NOT...

1596
01:23:33,711 --> 01:23:35,977
DO NOT GET IN A ROOM
WITH HIM ALONE.

1597
01:23:36,077 --> 01:23:37,645
YOU WANT ME IN THERE WITH YOU,
BELIEVE ME.

1598
01:23:37,745 --> 01:23:39,343
OTHERWISE, GUYS LIKE THAT
WILL BLEED YOU...

1599
01:23:39,410 --> 01:23:41,577
I WANT YOU TO MEET TOMMY
FLANAGAN BEFORE HE LEAVES...

1600
01:23:41,677 --> 01:23:44,510
- YEAH, GIMME A MINUTE.
I NEED TO, UM...

1601
01:23:44,644 --> 01:23:46,042
- BATHROOM?
- YEAH.

1602
01:23:46,142 --> 01:23:47,376
- DOWN THE HALL TO THE RIGHT.

1603
01:23:52,375 --> 01:23:55,074
HEY, WATCH THAT STUFF.
YOU'LL PUT ON WEIGHT.

1604
01:24:12,904 --> 01:24:14,838
- BUT NEXT TIME,
I WANT YOU TO MAKE SURE

1605
01:24:14,938 --> 01:24:17,371
THAT YOU WATCH THIS MONEY...

1606
01:24:19,404 --> 01:24:21,936
- UH-UH. DON'T...
UMM-UH. DON'T DO IT.

1607
01:24:29,369 --> 01:24:30,768
TIME TO GIVE THAT UP.

1608
01:24:31,935 --> 01:24:33,402
- DO YOU KNOW WHO I AM?

1609
01:24:33,502 --> 01:24:35,001
- NAME'S VINSON.

1610
01:24:35,101 --> 01:24:38,034
USED TO BE MARLO'S BANK,
BUT MARLO AIN'T 'ROUND NO MORE,

1611
01:24:38,134 --> 01:24:43,233
AND YOU STILL MOVIN' MONEY
FOR OTHER PLAYERS SO...

1612
01:24:43,367 --> 01:24:44,933
I'M THINKIN' SOME OF THAT
MONEY NEED TO BE MINE.

1613
01:24:45,066 --> 01:24:46,965
- SHIT...

1614
01:24:47,065 --> 01:24:49,099
YOU JUST A BOY.

1615
01:24:51,865 --> 01:24:53,665
THAT'S JUST YOUR KNEE.

1616
01:24:53,764 --> 01:24:55,864
- THAT MOTHERFUCKER SHOT ME.

1617
01:25:02,364 --> 01:25:04,063
- NICE DOIN' BUSINESS,
GENTLEMEN.

1618
01:25:10,428 --> 01:25:12,228
- NO WAY, THAT'S BULLSHIT.

1619
01:25:12,328 --> 01:25:14,695
I HEARD IT DIFFERENT.
THE REAL STORY ABOUT OMAR

1620
01:25:14,794 --> 01:25:15,995
IS THAT A BUNCH OF COPS
MADE IT LOOK LIKE THEM

1621
01:25:16,095 --> 01:25:17,461
NEW YORK BOYS KILLED HIM.

1622
01:25:17,594 --> 01:25:18,694
BUT IT WAS THEM.

1623
01:25:18,793 --> 01:25:20,227
THEY'RE THE ONES THAT
REALLY KILLED HIM.

1624
01:25:20,327 --> 01:25:21,461
- LISTEN, MOTHERFUCKER,

1625
01:25:21,561 --> 01:25:22,859
I KNOW WHAT HAPPENED TO HIM.

1626
01:25:22,959 --> 01:25:24,460
THEM POLICE HAD NOTHING
TO DO WITH IT.

1627
01:25:24,593 --> 01:25:26,159
NO NEW YORK BOYS NEITHER.

1628
01:25:26,260 --> 01:25:28,393
SO OMAR'S GOT AN A.K.,
RIGHT?

1629
01:25:28,492 --> 01:25:29,958
BUT HE'S SURROUNDED.

1630
01:25:30,092 --> 01:25:32,359
IT'S LIKE EIGHT,
NINE MOTHERFUCKERS UP THERE

1631
01:25:32,492 --> 01:25:33,492
AND THEY ALL GOT NINES.

1632
01:25:33,592 --> 01:25:34,658
BUT HE LIKE,
"YOU ALL THINK YOU..."

1633
01:25:34,757 --> 01:25:36,057
- FUCK YOU LOOKIN' AT?

1634
01:25:37,890 --> 01:25:39,124
- YOU, NIGGA.

1635
01:25:39,224 --> 01:25:40,391
- YOU KNOW WHO I AM?

1636
01:25:40,491 --> 01:25:41,756
- NIGGA, YOU KNOW
WHO I AM?

1637
01:25:44,190 --> 01:25:45,557
- OH, SHIT!

1638
01:26:11,318 --> 01:26:12,552
- YEAH...

1639
01:27:42,304 --> 01:27:45,136
- ON ME, ALL RIGHT?

1640
01:28:11,399 --> 01:28:12,931
- THANK YOU. THANK YOU.

1641
01:28:15,332 --> 01:28:16,731
THANK YOU.

1642
01:28:16,831 --> 01:28:19,564
THIS IS A GREAT DAY FOR
DEMOCRATS AND IT'S A

1643
01:28:19,698 --> 01:28:21,331
GREAT DAY FOR MARYLAND.

1644
01:28:23,598 --> 01:28:25,096
- HEY, ZORZI.

1645
01:28:25,196 --> 01:28:26,597
I HOPE I GET THIS BY E-DOT.

1646
01:28:26,697 --> 01:28:28,663
- OKAY, THREE MINUTES,
FOR CHRIST'S SAKE.

1647
01:28:28,762 --> 01:28:30,196
DON'T GET YOUR
PANTIES IN A KNOT.

1648
01:28:46,360 --> 01:28:47,960
- COMMISSIONER VALCHEK.

1649
01:29:07,123 --> 01:29:08,289
- MADAM PROSECUTOR,

1650
01:29:08,423 --> 01:29:09,489
GENTLEMEN...

1651
01:29:11,156 --> 01:29:13,590
FIRST CASE UP AND
I HAVE TO RECUSE MYSELF.

1652
01:29:13,690 --> 01:29:16,622
- YOUR HONOR,
I APPRECIATE YOUR CONCERN.

1653
01:29:34,918 --> 01:29:36,686
- CONGRATULATIONS,
SUPERINTENDENT.

1654
01:29:36,785 --> 01:29:38,018
WELCOME ABOARD.

1655
01:29:38,117 --> 01:29:39,984
- THANK YOU, GOVERNOR.
HAPPY TO BE ABOARD.

1656
01:29:40,084 --> 01:29:41,418
- THANK YOU.

1657
01:31:09,070 --> 01:31:10,536
LARRY...

1658
01:31:24,634 --> 01:31:26,434
LET'S GO HOME.
